Name: Nocturne Reverie
Description: Riche raised her glass at the ball as past years flickered by. She sighed at humans' trust in eternity.

Name: Greenwood Mystery
Description: The familiar smell of soil brought tears to their eyes. They rebuilt their homeland and crowned Nadia leader.

Name: Woodland Glimpse
Description: Venomous fangs and tough scales fell before their shields and blades. The serpents were finally cast out.

Name: Snow-Laden Realm
Description: The mage scoffs. 'These people worship you as a higher being. They only want to leech your strength.'

Name: Moonlit Remains
Description: Legends speak of a city called Veiled Moon, unseen on maps, more a projection of many cities than a real place.

Name: Ash of White Moon
Description: Eternal night envelops the city, with no neon, no stars. Only the white full moon, ever fixed, watches over all.

Name: Field Ballad
Description: Even the tiniest seed grows. Humble hearts hear the earth's echo. Hard work will yield bountiful fruits in autumn.

Name: Glimmering Radiance
Description: Through the lens, her blonde hair flies, red dress blazes, and her smile is dreamy. She perfects the beloved role.

Name: Screening of Dream
Description: A photographer clicks by instinct, catching her glance back. Ivanna winks slyly, brighter than any starlight.

Name: Start of Dream
Description: The next day, the photo tops headlines. Some call it all planned; most marvel at her newfound, radiant vitality.

Name: Berry Fantasy
Description: This studio can make all your dreams real: space travel, fairy worlds… Each corner filled with surprises!'

Name: Berry Fantasy - Dream
Description: A bit nervous, Lulu walks through the quiet corridor. She opens her shoot room, and her eyes widen in surprise.

Name: Forest Wandering
Description: She opens the envelope, revealing an invitation. Elegant script reads: 'Let us make all your dreams come true.'

Name: Forest Wandering - Berry
Description: If not for the shooting outfits in the clearing, she might forget she's in a studio, not the heart of a real forest.

Name: Vintage Dreams
Description: She thinks it a dull advertisement, yet her assistant's eyes light up, urging her to try this dream-making studio.

Name: Vintage Dreams - Violet
Description: A streetcar slowly moves in the set. She pauses, skirt fluttering in the breeze, replying to the echoes from the era.

Name: Path of Starlight
Description: Yellow flowers bloom by the roadside. Few notice, but she presses the shutter, capturing their grace in the sunset.

Name: Holy Night Snow Elf
Description: The Snow Elf quickly tucks Momo into the hood and places a snowman headpiece on him. 'Shh, the ball is starting~'

Name: 璀璨心辉
Description: 剧场灯光渐暗，观众将目光凝聚在舞台中心，静静站在聚光灯下的索菲亚身姿优雅，一袭舞裙宛如待放的花蕾。

Name: Nebulous Vision
Description: She grows curious about the woman. Why would someone from a century ago sing in her dreams at night?

Name: Evanescent Dream
Description: Her song bought time for townspeople to escape. She listens and finally meets her friend's gaze as the song ends.

Name: Fleeting Memory
Description: She wakes up in the peaceful town. For a moment, she seems to catch a glimpse of a figure in a butterfly dress.

Name: Luscious Dream
Description: The oven always rang with Granny's hum that gently awakened Florie from dreams. It was her warmest childhood memory.

Name: Sugary Reverie
Description: Granny took from Florie the small plate of special waffles and tasted not only sweetness but also her love.

Name: Candied Fantasy
Description: It was time for Florie to weave a dream of love for her granny and bake new warmth and hope.

Name: Dazzling Weave
Description: One sunny afternoon, Gloria receives a sparkling invitation. She wins a long-awaited shoot at the dream studio.

Name: Whimsical Dance
Description: In the gown, Gloria sets up the camera, humming a tune. The muse reaches out playfully, inviting her to dance.

Name: Dreamlike Invite
Description: Her skirt spreads like a radiant lake with sparkling gems. The 'Dance with Muse' now begins!

Name: Fragile Dreams
Description: The invitation arrived, but she barely recalled applying. She wrote 'Lakeside Impressions' before sleep took her.

Name: Lakeside Reverie
Description: The shutter clicks. A long-lost bright smile returns to her. Each captured moment fuels her steps forward anew.

Name: Autumn Serenity
Description: All think she is now beyond the skies, yet when geese return north, every window bears a golden chrysanthemum.

Name: Silhouette in Autumn
Description: Born of wild hills, grown in mortal dust, she greets the young and sees off the old. Amid the changes, she remains.

Name: Golden Sea
Description: An ancient pearl clam is her throne. The tides bring her voices and whisperings from the world's end.

Name: Secret of the Tides
Description: Memories dim like fading gems. Tano recalls a faint light in the mist long ago, a warrior she thought was different.

Name: Echoes of Tides
Description: Greed glints in the sailor's eyes. As before, Tano offers him priceless pearls, and he clutches them in haste.

Name: Golden Pact
Description: Pearls carpet her throne, each imprisoning a greedy soul. His pearl falls among them, no different at all.

Name: Gilded Cage
Description: Heavy mist veils the shining sea again. The lonely, wealthy goddess waits for the next brave soul, or the next pearl.

Name: Sunny Breeze Whispers
Description: The sky turns gold at sunset. Through the crowd, Erin hugs a thick stack of postcards and enters the post office.

Name: Journey in Breeze
Description: The night breeze brings in flowers and laughter. 'Happy birthday, our traveler!' comes from familiar faces.

Name: Fragrance in Breeze
Description: As before, they share cake and tales from the road, bursting into laughter at Erin's playful lines.

Name: Years in Blooming
Description: Which studio can truly capture her bond with the puppy? She flips through brochures, none quite right.

Name: Leisurely Elegance
Description: Ava previews the photos, laughing at the blurred, excited puppy captured in the shots.

Name: Aromatic Grace
Description: She rubs the puppy's head. Their shared moments are her most valued treasures, preserved forever with the photos.

Name: Inspired Couture
Description: Regaining confidence, Mimi makes one beautiful outfit after another. Word spreads, and her cabin is bustling.

Name: Pen of Inspiration
Description: With spring's arrival, the forest hosts a grand fashion show. The once doubtful elf now shines as a chief designer.

Name: Winter Snow Ballad
Description: She wakes gently, gazing at her book. The bear cheers her on in the picture, with the snowy town behind it.

Name: Winter Snow Lullaby
Description: The long-sealed window opens. Snowflakes and laughter pour in. She hums a lively tune, resting her chin by the sill.

Name: Dreamland Head Chef
Description: Kaoru and Master Goose shared the soup in the sunset. It must be the happiest thing in the world to enjoy food.

Name: Dreamland Gourmet
Description: Kaoru promised to return. Master Goose wiped the sweat from his brow, hoping she wouldn't come back soon.

Name: Midnight Marvel
Description: Grandpa told Matty the stars' names and stories. The sky became her first and most romantic idea of the universe.

Name: Starveil Dream
Description: Matty no longer feels unsure about her future. With a relieved smile, she moves the scope and indulges in the stars.

Name: Floating Stars
Description: No matter what her decision is, Matty knows she'll follow the stars' guide to the future with courage and curiosity.

Name: Healing Moment
Description: Betty feels like a feather falling in endless darkness when she's suddenly embraced by warm and familiar fluff.

Name: Angelic Cure
Description: Betty pats the bear's head. It's worn but well-maintained. It's been Betty's best friend since childhood.

Name: 南斯洛信使
Description: 背着邮包灵巧地穿过大街小巷，夏洛特将远道而来的礼物放在满脸期待的孩童手中，附赠一个元气满满的微笑。

Name: 乘风信使
Description: 微凉晨风拂起少女的发丝，夏洛特正熟练地踩着平衡车，带着充满活力的笑容，把邮件送到每一个收信人的手中。

Name: 格物循理
Description: 没有灵力的人也可以做到很多事，用一生的时间去行走天地，发现和研究新的事物，推动着这个世界不断向前。

Name: 行知循理
Description: 有诗云：豆火薪传笑嫣然，书帷漫卷睛灵秀。江天绘幅远无垠，一页春秋一叶舟。

Name: 花影漱月
Description: 有诗云：既出丹渊交光夜，凝雾点漆逸流萤。亘古亘今观六合，若现若隐月停云。

Name: 流萤照月
Description: 那个决定许多生灵存亡的夜晚，魇族的力量遮蔽苍穹，羽甲熊熊燃烧，将北境都映得大亮，令满月也黯然无光。

Name: Soothing Murmur
Description: In almost eternal solitude, her curiosity for humans outside the forest sends the only ripple through her peaceful life.

Name: Drifting Gleam
Description: Cera sees lights from the village and turns around at the edge of the woods, when the girl tugs at her sleeve.

Name: Drifting Shimmer
Description: Cera smiles, accepting her invite, and steps for the first time into the lights of humans she's watched for so long.

Name: 缎光华夜
Description: 泛着缎光的礼裙在长廊上滑过，少女的身影轻盈而难以捉摸。开到极盛的玫瑰花瓣被碾碎，纷纷扬扬地飞舞下落。

Name: 缎光华夜·华丽
Description: 新成员蜜亚曾经悄悄发问：丽嘉笑得好少，而且每次走到她身边几米的地方温度似乎会降低，是我的错觉吗？

Name: 缎光华夜·珍稀
Description: 丽嘉渐渐成为大家追捧爱戴的对象，每次她打开后台的抽屉，里面总是琳琅满目地摆着各种包装的草莓汁。

Name: 缎光华夜·流云
Description: 所有人都沉浸在喜悦之中，蜜亚也被情绪所感染。窗帘的影子落在丽嘉脸上，蜜亚忽然发现自己看不清她的神色。

Name: 缎光华夜·午夜
Description: 曾经胆小的蜜亚已不再害怕很多事。作为小演员，舞台上闪闪发光的一幕刻印在她心中，给了她无尽的勇气。

Name: Sylvan Harmony
Description: Musellele collected every gurgle of the creeks, rustle of the leaves, and chirp of the birds and weaved them into music.

Name: Drizzle-Woven Waves
Description: The coastal folk warn Eve. 'Never enter the deep during a storm. Thunder is the sea's warning.'

Name: Ocean Dirge
Description: The deity keeps vigil at the rift, so the world remains in order, civilization rises again, and mortals live in peace.

Name: 心蛊引魂
Description: 江湖风雨世代不休，此刻分别，大概就是永别。星霜荏苒，寨子里的孩子们渐渐长大，阿湄也教他们折叶子吹曲。

Name: 心蛊离歌
Description: 月光照着稚嫩的面庞，孩子们笨拙地吹响了树叶。风声将曲音传得很远，绕过山崖与溪流，消散在无尽夜风里。

Name: Rosy Dream Waltz
Description: She wound the key, and cheerful carols flowed as the doll spun with drifting snow, like a dream brought to life.

Name: Crystal Snowdream
Description: She understood then: these brilliant colors were her best friend's gift—Snowy's answer to what the world could be.

Name: Prelude in Snow
Description: Warm fire danced in Loryn's hearth, yet the streets outside lay silent, wrapped in heavy snow that muffled all sound.

Name: Snowladen Ballad
Description: Born from humankind's pure wishes, Lalati glows with drifting stardust and snowlight woven into her dress.

Name: Starry Night Chimes
Description: The streets grow quiet. Soft starlight circles Lalati as every glowing star holds a precious heartfelt wish.

Name: Frostlit Verse
Description: Her figure fades into dawn. When the next festival comes, her blessings will return once more with the ringing bells.

Name: 悠然冬日
Description: 每当将最后一块碎片填入画框，复杂而绚烂的图画在她眼前展现出全貌时，菲莉丝心中总会涌出一股成就感。

Name: Night of Blossoms
Description: Ideas burst through her mind like brilliant fireworks. She opens her notes and starts drawing wonders on paper.

Name: Swaying Blossom Concerto
Description: The December Troupe is on tour with its new musical Swaying Blossom Concerto, a story about nature and friendship.

Name: 繁夜聆誓
Description: 有人在白昼踏上旅程，步履不停，远眺广阔天地，有人则在黑夜久久伫立，静心感悟，谛听繁星秘语。

Name: 璨夜星誓
Description: 在某个有风的夜晚，罗雅再次听见了星辰的低语：“贯穿过去、现在与未来的风啊，你选中的孩子即将回归。”

Name: 入梦星语
Description: 繁星连成神秘壮丽的长卷，少女以心灵为星空和人间架起桥梁，当万千辉芒洒落，或许她也成为了星光本身。

Name: 煦春灵泽
Description: 村中人以爱哺育着牧心平安长大，乡亲们常说她是春神赠予乡间的眷顾，是带来萌芽与希望的“遣春使”。

Name: 煦春灵泽·暖阳
Description: 人们日夜祈求着甘霖，却未能得到半点回应。牧心随乡亲们四处奔走，想尽办法寻找水源，可一切都只是徒劳。

Name: 暗香叩雪
Description: 出口处灯光荡漾，母亲就站在那光圈底下，目光在涌出的人流里急切梭巡，看到她的那瞬，眸子倏然亮起。

Name: Cloudborne Blessing
Description: As the sun shines on the snow-dusted bluestone street, the sound of peddling and the smells of food fill the air.

Name: 灯夕如昼
Description: 锦灯高悬，火树银花，将山下街巷照得如白昼般明亮，暖暖和大喵在其中穿梭，尽情感受元夜灯市的温暖。

Name: 牡丹韵
Description: 瑶池畔的牡丹是她最为得意之作，青枝翠叶沐浴瑶池甘露中，捧出娇艳欲滴的花瓣，层层叠叠，似霞波飘逸。

Name: 璇霄飞仙
Description: 每逢春来，孩童间总会流行起新的歌谣，稚嫩的童音赞颂着一元复始、万象更新的景象，生命的朝阳正冉冉升起。

Name: 渺云飞仙
Description: 若是问起是谁在教他们歌唱，孩子们便会指向一碧如洗的天空，不知在说居于九天的神仙，还是空中翱翔的飞鸟。

Name: 桃梦仙缘
Description: 阿绯一口咬掉了兔子糕点的脑袋，甜丝丝的。她脚步轻快地走进月老府，心里想着明日要给阿寻准备什么回礼。

Name: 桃花浅深
Description: 夜色渐临，人间桃花被微风吹落，月光下，阿寻一如往常地朝阿绯笑着招手。两人之间，还会有很长很长的岁月。

Name: 梦与华年
Description: 很久以前雕塑家与爱人一同在这座宁静的庄园生活，爱人时常与他一起修改画稿，或在雨后为他泡一杯热茶。

Name: 岁月情衷
Description: 那天之后，再也没有人见过雕塑家。他最后的作品如同神迹，每个见到的人都会不自觉地流下热泪。

Name: 岁月情韵
Description: 无数的诗人作家来到这座庄园，以雕塑为灵感撰写出动人的爱情篇章。也许在艺术与美之中，生命抵达永恒。

Name: 薰风悄语时
Description: 勤勉的女王伏案小憩，晚风轻柔将她唤醒，窗台旁夜归的骑士扮了个鬼脸，将一枝沾着露珠的蔷薇递向姐姐手心。

Name: Gala of Emerald Hues
Description: The parade ends in triumph. Risa takes the title of Queen of Carnival. She smiles, feeling calmer than she expects.

Name: 雪青浮香
Description: 她以仙叶清露研墨，子夜星辉调制颜料，在屏风上勾勒四时更迭，毫尖过处，瑶池莲开；落笔之间，人间梅谢。

Name: 重翠明微
Description: 每一笔落下，人间便多一片新绿。当青芒绘完最后那株垂绦丝柳时，晨曦初透，人间传来了第一声清亮的燕啼。

Name: 斜倚翠微
Description: 人间忽然传来万民颂唱之声，无数新生的草木精气汇聚成绿色的长河，直上九重天，轻柔托住了青芒疾坠的身体。

Name: 千星洄游
Description: 娜伊达的诞生，与这片哺育了整座森林的水泽息息相关。精灵中的智者曾笑着对好奇的小精灵们说。

Name: 星隐梦泽
Description: 她在水面上缓步行走，带起的涟漪亲吻她的裙裾，在她身后，千万道水渐渐凝成一道神圣的虚影，恍若神祇。

Name: 原野灼华
Description: 坐落在荒原深处的部落信仰火焰，祭司阿吉尼始终守护着神庙中永不熄灭的圣焰，传说那团火比文明更早诞生。

Name: 流焰境天
Description: 源源不断的圣焰盘旋而上，像是一道连接天与地的火焰之塔，那一刻荒原的风都为之停滞，辽远的沙海静默无声。

Name: 雪辉鎏金
Description: 她应当能够倾听金属的低语，令坚硬的铁石在掌下弯折，可以瞬息召唤铠甲与利剑，守护整座王国。

Name: 永昼圣冕
Description: 寒夜的风中带着血与铁的气息，敌军终于溃退，当第一缕曙光越过残破的城墙，疲惫的臣民彼此搀扶着站立。

Name: 拂晓心约
Description: 人们惊讶地发现，王都的城墙恢复如初，每一块地砖、每一道围栏都寒光凛然，映照他们逐渐神色坚定的面庞。

Name: 驭日凌穹
Description: 年轻的巫祝在第一次完成祭祀的晚夜做了个梦。梦中她站在高高的云台之上，天将明时，遥远天际浮现万丈金光。

Name: 御日巡天
Description: 神明静静地望着她，威严而悲悯。这一次，她没有再恳求对方相助。她已然明白，能够拯救凡尘的，只有人自己。

Name: 御日巡霄
Description: 钧天之乐自九天来，她缓缓闭上双眼，曾经的训谕清晰地浮现在她的脑海——教化、纪历、法度……

Name: Messenger of Love
Description: Lights dim as night falls, but the stars by the cloud cabin shine still. What beautiful moments await her tomorrow?

Name: Spring on the Fields
Description: Emerald Valley rests among green hills, streams mirror woods, clover fills the land, and people work at dawn and rest at dusk.

Name: Emerald Wilds Magic
Description: March winds sweep the valley. Dressed for the feast, people gather as songs and rich aromas of wine drift across green fields.

Name: Handsome Vigor
Description: In the mist, Cheng holds the reins as the steed gallops across the vast land, its hooves awakening seeds for spring.

Name: Gallop to Glory
Description: Hooves close in behind her, but she doesn't look back and simply loosens her reins, letting Sky sprint forward.

Name: Deadly Banquet
Description: Beneath the prosperity, corruption grows. Carol receives a mission to investigate a high official selling intel.

Name: Nightfall Menace
Description: In a splendid gown, she commands every ballroom. The dress is armor; she steps through blood as if over fallen petals.

Name: Deadly Night
Description: In a loose hoodie and black cap, she becomes an unseen hacker, drifting through torrents of data.

Name: Daybreak Blade
Description: In the hit novel Shadowed Menace, Morton seems a gentleman yet is cold at heart, except when it comes to Carol.

Name: Strawbeary Sweet
Description: When friends ask Riko about her future plans, she answers with hope, 'Make everyone happy!'

Name: Beary Sweet Cheese
Description: Her friends share a look and laugh. Some hold Riko's hand, while some wink at her. 'We are already happy!'

Name: 特别委托
Description: 我第一次见到茉琳，是在一堂班级合练的体术课上。我们被分到了同一组，作为彼此的对手交流切磋。

Name: 特别委托·忆
Description: 实训地在一座海岛上，第一次出海的我头晕目眩，死死抱着栏杆不敢松手，目之所及的一切都在无止境地旋转。

Name: 特别委托·海
Description: 有时相约在图书馆复习理论课，我去接杯水回来的功夫，茉琳已经偷偷在书上画了好几只不同造型的小白鸽了。

Name: 特别委托·念
Description: 她在那次任务中离开后……不主持训练时，我就会来这里看看她。虽然她从没说过，但我知道，她其实很怕寂寞。

Name: 岁月谧影
Description: 幼时的记忆如同无数泛着柔光的碎片，萨迦记得自己时常趴在桌前看祖母占卜，水晶球的反光映在她的眼底。

Name: 岁月谧影·华丽
Description: 她们得到的征兆各不相同，却都模糊不清。不再拥有争辩的心情，占卜师们不约而同地将目光投向了萨迦的祖母。

Name: 岁月谧影·珍稀
Description: 所有人都以为祖母在水晶球中看到了雪融之日，在漫漫寒夜里，若是没有那场预言，她们不可能坚持到春天来临。

Name: 岁月谧影·苍穹
Description: 萨迦的神情是那样沉静温和，她对莉卡讲起了多年前封锁城堡的那场大雪，以及祖母对众人隐瞒了结果的占卜。

Name: 岁月谧影·樱华
Description: 随着强大力量而来的是对占卜结果的过度笃信。莉卡将水晶球呈现的征兆视为不可逆转的结局，不容他人质疑。

Name: 喵想时刻
Description: 一只可爱的小野猫于某日不请自来，单方面相中了悠娜阳光充足的小露台，并将她最喜欢的那张躺椅据为己有。

Name: 喵想时刻·伴
Description: 昏昏沉沉间，房间内传出细微响动。悠娜费力地睁开眼，一个灵巧矫健的小身影从门缝里钻了进来，是塔塔。

Name: 喵想时刻·绘
Description: 喵呜声是塔塔光临的信号，近日它的造访越发频繁，它轻车熟路地从塔塔为它预留的那道门缝钻进了屋内。

Name: 绿野童话

Description: 祖母是草原上最有见识的人，无数个夏夜里，安娅抱着出生不久的小羊，在篝火前听祖母讲遥远的故事。

Name: 逐风旧忆·归
Description: 在白马的陪伴下，安娅去了许多地方。她见过世上无数种人生，午夜梦回，却仍怀念蔚蓝天幕下云朵似的羊群。

Name: 逐风旧忆·寻
Description: 安娅收起家当，随着部落一路向南，穿过从未涉足的山丘和平原，和大多数人一样，寻找一个安定的角落。

Name: 不苟格调
Description: 布料总在裁剪时突然滑落，最基础的立裁作业都能被做成“抽象派拼图”，老师每次检查她的作品都会拧起眉头。

Name: 不苟格调·檬
Description: 很快，摆放在橱窗里用以展示的服装，吸引来了周边写字楼里的顾客——对穿着挑剔至极又满怀热情的都市白领。

Name: 不苟格调·萄
Description: 茉利斯认为与顾客深入交流的过程，都像是与昔日同窗一起探讨流行设计，真诚的对话能激发她无限的设计灵感。

Name: Rebellious Charm
Description: Lights glow faintly like lifeless eyes, and the scent of rust hangs in the air like the city's heavy sigh.

Name: Northern Warsong
Description: Sigrun grew up on the borders and longed for the battlefields. Her favorite bedtime story was an epic of the North.

Name: Peachy Mood
Description: Aya runs her fingers along the bottles and stops at one. It's her best friend's favorite seltzer.

Name: 恬谧暮霭
Description: 阳光被展馆的彩绘玻璃折射出瑰丽的光影，暖暖伸手轻轻触碰那绚烂的色彩，眼前忽然光晕流转，世界随之变幻。

Name: 雾霭氤氲
Description: “即使是在发生了那些事之后，每次看到他的设计图，我的心中还是会涌上无数温暖的情感。”

Name: First Snow Diary
Description: Red maples line the mountain road. Their colors mix with the silent pine green, brightening the season.

Name: Pulsing Sunshine
Description: The street lamps light up in the evening breeze. Her pink ride pulls up, with a familiar paw print on the box.

Name: Beckoning Wilds
Description: A rash young man ventured alone into a legendary, cruel mountain and ate a poisonous plant by mistake.

Name: Nature's Favor
Description: Born with magical powers, they quickly learned languages and shapeshifted into different forms.

Name: Scarlet Brocade
Description: She was generous and well-praised for helping those in need. Her business expanded wherever the rivers flowed.

Name: Fleeting Mists
Description: At night, crops stopped growing while beasts prowled in the dark. People trembled in fear, waiting for sunrise.

Name: Sandswept Haze
Description: The tribe traveled between cities, trading goods and admiring fine silk and jewels along the way.

Name: Tender Ripples
Description: Her smile outshines blossoms as she finds Yanyue reduced to the form of a small fish and places her in a pond.

Name: Creed of Witch
Description: As more strange figures gather behind, Kuro hums a tuneless song, striding forward and giving life to the silent city.

Name: Security Chip
Description: Before all traces vanish, tiny information fragments may be pieced together by malicious hands, sparking a war.

Name: Connection Path
Description: When the enemy attempts to link with the center again, Norsen's planted virus triggers, severing all connections.

Name: 胧夜竹烟
Description: 即便是世上能被称为圆满之事，或也往往因少许怅惘而更显真切。清景无限，明舒的思绪却有些纷乱。

Name: Kingdom's Secret
Description: A cold blade slices a line of light in the dark. Riene, legion commander, faces the darkness alone for the gem.

Name: Flawless Dreamland
Description: The buildings follow typical human city styles, but the residents are bizarrely shaped monsters, not humans.

Name: Harvest Wish
Description: Loxie lifts her skirt and hums, walking to the fields. Her basket carries the joy and hopes of harvest season.

Name: Dreamlike Moment
Description: The final shot freezes as the curtain falls. Filming wraps, and the haze in Ivanna's eyes quietly fades away.

Name: Whims Come True
Description: Could it really be that magical? She hesitates but submits her reservation and receives a letter from the studio.

Name: Whims Come True - Dream
Description: Green grass, sparkling lake, and the scent of flowers everywhere. The tale must take place in a scene like this.

Name: Tranquil Verses
Description: Overjoyed, she rereads the letter and unfolds the blank paper, eager to write down her dreams and wishes.

Name: Tranquil Verses - Berry
Description: Though she's never been here, everything feels familiar to her, every detail matching her imagination.

Name: Thoughts on Life
Description: The studio, famed for 'realizing any dream,' offers flawless service, impressing even the most exacting guests.

Name: Thoughts on Life - Violet
Description: Inside her shawl, she discovers an embroidery titled 'Fleeting Life', indicating the sign of this dreamy journey.

Name: Mystic Butterfly
Description: Following her dream, she found the abandoned theater. It's said people can still hear singing on moonlit nights.

Name: Phantasmal Glow
Description: The studio weaves countless dreams. After deep thought, Gloria writes the theme: 'Dance with Muse.'

Name: Sunlit Wave Melody
Description: To her, life feels like a silent deep pool. Even standing before the studio, she shows little interest.

Name: Gentle Sunlight
Description: Erin is a traveler. At each new stop she mails postcards back home, sometimes with a leaf, sometimes a dried flower.

Name: Velvet Whispers
Description: One spring afternoon, a friend sends a mysterious poster, promising a photo studio that would meet Ava's hopes.

Name: Rosy Cloudlight
Description: Under dewy petals lies a delicately scented note. Momo nods proudly before tiptoeing out of the room.

Name: Crane from Moon
Description: The qin sounds drift from noon to dusk, but Lin Yao does not appear. A quiet loneliness fills her heart.

Name: Scattered Jewels
Description: Lin Yao arrives on time. After years apart, they perform together again, but their harmony has faded.

Name: Crystal Reverie
Description: Warmth makes her drowsy. She lowers her fairytale book. As it falls on the ground, a spark of starlight leaps out.

Name: Moment of Elegance
Description: Matty becomes consumed by school and life as she grows up. The telescope her grandpa gave her now gathers dust.

Name: 复古韵律
Description: 风雪交加，人们还在温暖的被窝里酣睡，夏洛特已然奔跑在街道上，将当日的快讯送进家家户户的邮箱之中。

Name: 避风斗篷
Description: 细心缝制的斗篷外套。岑缨非常喜欢，穿着它去过很多地方呢！

Name: 苍岚暮霭
Description: 作为知名设计师，阿萝每天都十分忙碌。疲惫在肩上坠出沉沉的重量，只有此刻她可以暂时将繁杂的工作抛开。

Name: 苍岚暮霭·华丽
Description: 阿萝停在了街角的一家花店前。店门口挂着水晶风铃，在微风中叮咚作响。明净的玻璃窗后，是一簇簇盛放的花。

Name: 苍岚暮霭·珍稀
Description: 在祖母的影响下，阿萝一度痴迷摄影。按下快门的刹那，转瞬即逝的光与影化作永恒，记录下她眼中的世界。

Name: 苍岚暮霭·兰烟
Description: 金色的阳光照亮了熟悉的老宅。祖母正坐在窗边，天光铺满了她的画案，墨香缭绕之间，一幅山水在笔尖流淌。

Name: 苍岚暮霭·林荫
Description: 灵感悄然降临。梦中弥散的雾气凝聚于笔端，化作颗颗晶莹剔透的水晶。纸笔摩擦声中，阿萝的新作品逐渐成型。

Name: 绒软记忆
Description: 在一个寒冷的夜晚，我被雨水浇淋得浑身湿透，有人将我抱起，为我擦干湿漉漉的毛发，把我接到温暖的小屋里。

Name: 绒软记忆·愉
Description: 客人的气味不尽相同，有的像柠檬，有的像是玫瑰，但我最喜欢的还是店主的味道，总让我想到午后的太阳。

Name: 绒软记忆·欢
Description: 不过至少有一件事我很笃定——这个世界是一座巨大的游乐场！不然，要怎么解释存在这么多琳琅满目的猫玩具？

Name: 铿锵旋律
Description: 那日黄昏，她在林间小径偶遇几名王国士兵，他们伤痕累累，神情沉稳又警惕，似乎在躲避敌军的搜捕。

Name: 铿锵旋律·夜
Description: 提前就位吹响进攻的号角、及时发出信号提示队友撤退……敏锐的观察力和迅捷的反应，令她很快适应了新战术。

Name: 铿锵旋律·曦
Description: 白紫相间的军服上缀满勋章，看上去庄重而优雅，虽不适合亲临战场，却能为人民带来安心与希望。

Name: Cosmic Poetics
Description: When Musellele's songs echoed in the woods, flowers rejoiced and leaves danced, as if all lives sang with her.

Name: 幽明弦声
Description: 雾气如此浓郁，像一张大网将人淹没，他无法辨别方向，完全依凭本能向前。就在此时，他的耳畔响起清脆铃声。

Name: Blazing Bloom
Description: Tessa adored it. Gazing into the tiny world, she whispered to the dancing doll, 'From now on, you'll be Snowy.'

Name: Clearheart Melody
Description: Tessa no longer feared being different. She faced the world with courage, guided by music and the warmth of love.

Name: 绒暖针织
Description: 这样单纯的快乐在菲莉丝开始挑战大型拼图时消失了，那些散碎的图块看起来别无二致，让菲莉丝几乎无法分辨。

Name: 咫尺星芒
Description: 星河高悬，但在她眼底，脉脉流淌的星辉，云间飘洒的光屑，新星诞生时的炫光……一切无比清晰，触手可及。

Name: 悠然漫旅
Description: 蒲公英总想旅行。它溜进风里，掠过晒谷场、溪水和红屋顶，最后轻轻落在远方的田野间。

Name: Scented Sleeves
Description: They chat and laugh while shopping. Soon, her friend is holding an armful of goods, but she hasn't picked any.

Name: 岁岁花朝
Description: 萝小满、萝福来、萝小花，还有萝小虎……来到萝萝山后，暖暖很快就将萝萝们的样貌和名字一一对应上了！

Name: 司花隐者
Description: 少女名唤花令微，是无名谷中的隐者，尤擅种花弄草，也由此被过路的山民称为花姑。

Name: 群芳毓德
Description: 分别之时，花令微道，今夜与暖暖灯市携游，她已有了新的育花灵感，待到花开之时，定邀暖暖一同欣赏。

Name: 层叠染
Description: 丹华埋头案前，协理百花册，衣袖却不慎拂倒桌前琉璃盏，盏中盛的牡丹花种越过云霞，直向苍茫人间坠去。

Name: 春声赋
Description: 她望着开得恣意奔放的牡丹，心中已有定见——既已在此落地生根，便让这缕天香永驻凡尘，与生灵为伴吧。

Name: 韶景词
Description: 人人皆道湖畔牡丹胜境有一奇景，每逢东风送暖，蝶群便纷纷云集于此，飞舞牡丹花海之间，相逢一春又一春。

Name: 红绡轻罗
Description: 年年岁岁总相异，无忧无虑的笑声与清脆的鼓点却总会在杨柳新绿的时节响彻山间田野，如同在预告春的到来。

Name: 天水桃灼
Description: 月老府一年到头总是缺人，负责牵红线这块更是重灾区，管事的神仙焦头烂额，好说歹说把阿绯架了过来。

Name: 纯白回忆
Description: 雕塑家一生都在与作品对话，仿佛只要足够耐心、足够专注，就能够对抗时间的流逝，让有限的生命抵达永恒。

Name: 晴芳缀梦
Description: 结束凌晨的会议，银发少女一面查阅文件，一面点开挚友的简讯，风拂动她的发丝，掩去她唇边的微微笑意。

Name: 紫藤花信
Description: 风贯穿过去、现在与未来，知晓这片大陆深埋在时间中的所有秘密，也知晓大陆上生活的人们种种爱恨悲欢。

Name: 紫苑琼英
Description: 每逢人间祭祀，万千信愿如萤火飘至天宫，她只淡然拂袖，任其消散于云海。春生秋杀，不过天地恒常。

Name: 宿命之昭
Description: 圣焰映照着石壁上古老肃穆的纹路，也照着一代又一代荒原的孩子长大、老去，他们的灵魂终会受到圣焰的指引。

Name: 流光誓约
Description: 年幼的欧珀只需动动手指，就能让远处的银烛台摇晃不止，她曾得意洋洋，深信这是自己卓绝天赋的象征。

Name: 碧天如练
Description: 祥云初开，神明驾驭着曦车降临世间。金红的华辇在巫祝的面前停驻，升平的乐舞之中，她的身影缓缓显现。

Name: Wind-Kissed Verdure
Description: The aged empress fell into a daze when a sudden ethereal song played, reminding her of a forgotten memory.

Name: Elegant Bearing
Description: As the breeze shakes the cloud bed, Liv stretches and draws the moonlight-woven curtain to watch the earth below.

Name: Blessed Lucky Wish
Description: Every March, the valley hosts a lively festival. Barrels of fine wine are shared as people toast the arrival of spring.

Name: Hymn of Good Fortune
Description: Golden liquid swirls in cups, grain scents intoxicate the air. Maxie sips the brew and smiles, pleased by its fresh taste.

Name: Pastoral Ballad
Description: A rattan basket, a hand-drawn tea set, puffy pillows, and storybooks. She places them where she had planned.

Name: Flawless Dream
Description: As the fog clears, a garden in full bloom unfolds before her, where beautiful girls tend the flowers with care.

Name: Undisturbed Dream
Description: The fog thickens, as the flowers and fountain fade away. The girls wave at Irena and return to the floral mist.

Name: Soaring Spirit
Description: Sky, faster!' Cheng calls as the steed leaps over hurdles like a loong chasing the wind through the clouds.

Name: Horizon Chaser
Description: Cheng snatches the flag amid waves of cheers. Tears roll down as she jumps off the horse and leans against Sky's neck.

Name: Gentle Morning Breeze
Description: It is a cute little bunny, watching in awe as it hops closer to her. Elno smiles, careful not to startle the tiny spirit of nature.

Name: Neon in the Rain
Description: Beneath the glory, threats persist. Morton is ordered to capture an ex-official stealing intel and planning to defect.

Name: 汽水冰晶
Description: 林夏从小就对音乐非常感兴趣。在她心中，世界上的每一种声音里都蕴藏着节奏与音调，等待被人们发掘。

Name: 汽水冰晶·夜紫
Description: 最初的几遍并不完美，可没有人停下来指责什么，反而在跑偏的地方笑成一团。渐渐地，旋律变得流畅明亮起来。

Name: 汽水冰晶·银白
Description: 傍晚的街道仍残留着白日余温，便利店的窗口亮起冷白灯光，冰柜传来低低的嗡鸣声，朋友们在街口对她挥手。

Name: 汽水冰晶·青柠
Description: 回到家时，窗外的霓虹在玻璃上拉出模糊的倒影，林夏把笔记本摊开在桌上，顺着刚才的碎片一点点整理。

Name: 缄默心愿
Description: 萨迦的祖母是这片土地上有名的占卜师，据说她能够从水晶球中看到任何人的未来，于她而言，世界上没有秘密。

Name: 缄默心愿·华丽
Description: 她们用各自的方式开始了占卜，向星海与皎月、深海或大地寻求一个答案——我们是否能在这场风雪中幸存？

Name: 缄默心愿·珍稀
Description: 某个安静的午后，她陪着祖母在花园中散步。想起多年前那场突如其来的大雪，萨迦好奇地问及当年占卜的结果。

Name: 缄默心愿·苍穹
Description: 莉卡仔细描述着自己在水晶球中所见到的阴影，那象征不详与厄运的影子像噩梦一般缠绕着她，让她愈发困惑。

Name: 缄默心愿·樱华
Description: 莉卡的占卜精准无比，很快获得了众人赞誉，她无疑是一颗最耀眼夺目的宝石，光芒压过了所有人。

Name: 不羁风尚
Description: 数年前在设计大赛中崭露头角后，缇妮婉拒了各大财团的招揽，选择来到这座小镇，开了一家独立工作室。

Name: 不羁风尚·忆
Description: 宅邸的大门总是紧闭着，缇妮曾好奇地握着栏杆向外张望，却被管家抱回屋内——那不是淑女该有的举动。

Name: 不羁风尚·纪
Description: 缇妮咬紧牙关坚持自己的选择，她夜以继日地磨练基本功，彻夜不灭的灯光引起了一位面点师少女的注意。

Name: 荣光期许
Description: 敏捷的野兔，狡猾的沙狐，灵巧的雉鸡……安腊常常将亲手捕获的猎物堆在安莱的帐前，想换来她的夸赞与认可。

Name: 荣光期许·丛森
Description: 飞扬的尘沙席卷原野，安腊警惕地提着长弓，环顾四周。和往日不同，今日的风里似乎弥漫着格外危险的气息。

Name: 荣光期许·天穹
Description: 银甲在阳光下熠熠生辉，安莱垂下眼睑。过去自己只为它象征的荣耀着迷，尚不知这身装束也意味着沉重的责任。

Name: Serene Adventure
Description: She rarely opens herself up. Now she's passing by the garden with a frown, so anxious that the flowers shrivel.

Name: Glory of Past
Description: She stands before the old theater, hearing echoes of past songs. Her uncle's life's work now faces closure.

Name: Fragrant Chamber
Description: All praised her diligence, but never her talent. She realized at 15 that she could never be half as good as her parents.

Name: Ribbon Wonder
Description: A cute cat-themed outfit emerges from the fierce competition and captures all judges' hearts with its fluffy charm.

Name: Shimmering Waves
Description: Gilda would often read travel journals and trace the shores in the pictures, imagining the feel of a sea breeze.

Name: Rosy Fantasy
Description: Witches complained about the girl born under the red moon: reckless, unruly, and disruptive to many clans.

Name: 思维集成
Description: 瀑布声若雷鸣，水珠迸溅，沾湿了衣摆，枪声和哨音遥遥传来，这是曾无数次出现在奥兰多噩梦中的那座峡谷。

Name: 记忆同步
Description: 莫非这是关押我的监狱？我叩击着墙体，尝试寻找逃离的出口，可钢铁铸就的高墙沉默而坚定，没有一丝裂隙。

Name: Ethereal Rhymes
Description: Camilla loves art. Lines and lights amaze her. She spends the summer working to pay for a famed school.

Name: Serene Verses
Description: When Camilla returns to the garden, the woman is gone. She never appears again, not even on Camilla's last day.

Name: Placid Sonnet
Description: Before leaving, the girl stands in the evening breeze when an apple drops into her palm. It still tastes as sweet.

Name: 黑莓特调
Description: 在校园里，米洛洛不太热衷于参加集体活动，同学们围在一起叽叽喳喳，她很少搭话，总在笔记上涂画着什么。

Name: Vernal Harmony
Description: Miata never had any friends since she was always sick in bed, so she gladly agreed to join the special tea party.

Name: Sunlit Puppet Dream
Description: Years later, the recovered girl returned to her dream garden, where the puppet with no more cracks smiled at her.

Name: Sunlit Puppet Venture
Description: Years of love and companionship filled the puppet's cracks and Miata's heart. Together they ambled in the flowers.

Name: 魔法学派
Description: 每当此时，奥瑞尔就会暂时合上厚重的典籍，熟练地用笔记本的纸页折出一只只栩栩如生的小动物。

Name: Astral Mantle
Description: After dark, Atina would set out with her light and feel the wind lash against her cheeks as her hair shimmered gold.

Name: Luminous Heartglow
Description: Travelers came and went in the desert, and Atina's name spread among them. Some called her the Lantern Goddess.

Name: Spectacular Night
Description: The place is empty and the girl in the mirror clearly doesn't belong here. She looks stiff, as if not used to her body.

Name: Sylvan Luster
Description: The little elf has heard many tales about the lake. Some say it belonged to a powerful elf and can restore everything.

Name: Vivid Imagination
Description: She reads the book until her eyelids grow heavy. Suddenly, she realizes the first words of each line form a sentence!

Name: Emerging Clouds
Description: Her body neared collapse from immense power. Yao made her one last outfit and took her to the garden.

Name: Sparkling Wish
Description: At seven, Yongan received a jade charm before her mother departed for war. A Queen of the Night was carved into it.

Name: Reminiscent Echo
Description: People thought Alia was nothing like her sister, the heir bound by strict rules and rarely smiling.

Name: Heart of Exploration
Description: After the rain cleared the mountains, she checked her pack and followed her team into a hidden valley.

Name: Gleaming Grandeur
Description: A vortex brings him to another underwater world. Paopao looks around as the current urges him on.

Name: Pearl of the Vast Sea
Description: Little Beauty asks if anyone has seen any other newcomers. She's worried… Are Paopao and the others here, too?

Name: Commonplace Soul

Description: 夏季酷热，饮品店为过路的行人带来慰藉。疲惫的卡米坐在店内，听着街边的蝉嘶哑鸣叫，躲避烈日炎炎。

Name: 前沿风尚·暮海
Description: 房门半掩的休息室中，还穿着舞裙的女孩趴伏在化妆台前。她听见了卡米的脚步声，红着眼眶回首看来。

Name: 香浓秘语
Description: 招待客人的时候，她总是细心又周到，每当客人们夸赞她时，她都会腼腆低头，露出羞涩的笑容。

Name: 香浓秘语·愿
Description: 围着红围巾的小女孩哼着歌飞跑而过，她急忙捡起小女孩掉在雪地上那只方方正正的小铁盒，送回对方手心。

Name: 香浓秘语·游
Description: 天边云朵是蓬松的棉花糖，休憩的长椅由拇指饼干拼成，过山车是一串极有弹性的软糖，座椅则是颗颗蜜瓜球。

Name: 香浓秘语·谜
Description: 地面上，无数蘑菇散发着柔和的荧光，照亮了森林入口石碑上的文字：“丛林深处，藏着灵感与奇迹。”

Name: 云生月下
Description: 回忆像窗前悬挂的风铃，总在不经意间被吹响。阿萝望着那幅画，无尽的往事仿佛从光阴深处潮涌而来。

Name: 云生月下·华丽
Description: 阿萝恍惚想起，自己有过许多梦想，最初的那个是开一家花店，然而随着年岁渐长，这个念头已被她慢慢淡忘。

Name: 云生月下·珍稀
Description: 少女似乎是第一次外出采风。对照着地图，她小心地穿过灌木丛和溪流，四处张望，灵感却狡猾地不肯轻易出现。

Name: 云生月下·兰烟
Description: 祖母笔下的风景总是灵动而飘逸，风云雨雾都格外飘渺。成为珠宝设计师多年，阿萝的设计也带着水墨的影子。

Name: 云生月下·林荫
Description: 深夜的工作室安静得能听见自己的心跳，反复打磨之下，灵感最终凝结为实体，晶石在灯下折射出柔和的弧光。

Name: 温情之绊
Description: 她动作有点笨拙，有时会缓慢地抚摸我的背脊，但她也很厉害，每天都外出打猎，总能带回食物与洁净的水。

Name: 温情之绊·愉
Description: 她是咖啡店的店主，而我是这里的第二号员工。初到店时，我被从未听过的铃铛声吓得弹跳起来，差点撞上玻璃。

Name: 温情之绊·欢
Description: 摇晃的金色光斑、哗哗作响的塑料袋、走来走去的两脚兽……我忙着推倒桌缘的水杯，和尾巴搏斗，乐此不疲。

Name: 清芳梦蕴
Description: 母亲去世后，茜娅独自照顾着这里。她细细修枝、浇灌，这片土地在她的照顾下生机蓬勃，花草繁茂。

Name: 清芳梦蕴·萌
Description: 馥郁的花香唤醒了茜娅的一天，她起初还以为自己是在做梦。她曾无数次梦见，繁花再度盛放于这座小小的花园。

Name: 清芳梦蕴·忆
Description: 阁楼里的旧物堆积如山，她借着从木窗缝隙透进的微弱光芒，艰难地在书架上翻找着补救的方法。

Name: 无畏颂歌
Description: 回忆着对附近地形的印象，她想到一个大胆的计划，于是拿起士兵们的青铜军号，来到反方向的高地上用力吹响。

Name: 无畏颂歌·夜
Description: 某夜，营地遭遇突袭，队长受伤倒地，情况紧急，她脑海中闪过数个指挥方案，却迟疑着没有立刻吹响军号。

Name: 无畏颂歌·曦
Description: 春风拂过大地，敌国终于宣布投降，旷日持久的战争画上句点，她过往的事迹被写入书本，被人们津津乐道。

Name: Daybreak Glow
Description: Cloth, medicine, bread... Rosalia tucks them into her basket. Outside, sunlight pools on the steps.

Name: Bloom-Woven Dreams
Description: Rosalia gives out her last supplies with tears. She aches for this farewell, but her heart lifts to see them go.

Name: Time-Woven Dreams
Description: A blossom drops into her basket. Another. Then another. Rosalia gazes at the smiling faces around her.

Name: 瑶草琪花
Description: 素袂只影立云崖，青锋孤鸣振玉沙。不向利禄争浮名，千山明月照琪花。

Name: 千千灵语
Description: 浓雾在一阵清风中倏然消散，一个打扮特别的少女自林间出现，她的目光越过翩跹的蝶，打量着狼狈的外来者。

Name: Timeless Fragrance
Description: Dai fills her bottles with dew before sunrise. Petals stir and fall as her fingers follow a fluttering butterfly.

Name: Breeze of Fragrance
Description: The evening breeze shakes down a white veil of magnolia petals, filling the air with a refreshing fragrance.

Name: 柔软针织
Description: 新年的钟声就要敲响，给好友的礼物早已备下，怀着满心期待织就的毛衣点缀上可爱的蝴蝶结，她会喜欢吗？

Name: Creamy Clouds
Description: She's known the brand since her childhood. Now Riki works tirelessly in the bright office, her dream within reach.

Name: 霜夜临光
Description: 老人们常说那是一场不同寻常的雪。翻开古老的年历，这场大雪象征着守护与新生，注定孕育出闪闪发光的奇迹。

Name: 霜夜临光·夜
Description: 意识逐渐模糊之际，法西安耳畔隐约响起了奇特的声音，她莫名想起彼时夜晚伏在母亲怀中时听到的絮语。

Name: 雾空潮汐
Description: 露比娜喜欢住在海边的生活。无论何时拉开窗帘就能看见大海，海风轻轻拂过耳际，留下渺远而温柔的歌声。

Name: 雾空潮汐·幽
Description: 斑斓的珊瑚组成一座沉睡的广袤花园，鱼群从她身边划过，细沙在水流中缓缓起伏，似乎勾勒着时间的形态。

Name: 绮窗梅染
Description: 夜色下的梅园清幽静谧，少女稍稍扬起手中宫灯，步入园中，她早就想好，要在今夜与梅辞岁，赴新春之约。

Name: Autumnal Verses
Description: The swing slows to a stop. She picks up leaves as souvenirs for the trip, and the breeze blows like a distant dream.

Name: Lavender Stroll
Description: Whoever sets foot in the breathtaking lavender fields will be enamored by their beauty and fragrance.

Name: Dawn of Youth
Description: The sun casts its warm and radiant light through the clouds. The girl looks up as the purest smile blooms.

Name: 烟云袅袅
Description: 图卷完成的一刻，天阶玉殿上祥花纷落，薰风阵阵，灵雀自绣画中飞出，仙人轻抚其顶，唤其名为“云翎”。

Name: 心之陷阱
Description: 想要爱情的少女会穿过高山深涧与密林旷野，最终在某个风雪将歇的黄昏抵达古堡，获得珍贵的爱情秘药。

Name: 绯心夜宴
Description: 这是一段熟悉的往事，魔女不禁笑起来。“也许，”魔女慢慢说道，“那时的魔女也骗你服下了爱情秘药。”

Name: 绯心梦宴
Description: 传说中能够带来爱情的秘药，其实只是在重重危机中让女孩们认清自己的心。爱情也是世界对勇敢者的嘉奖之一。

Name: 梦景桃苑
Description: 友人劝她，这大小也算是升迁！阿绯心里却叹气——这工作繁杂，不得有疏，且做错了，可是要大扣功德的！

Name: Iridescent Grace
Description: The town's biggest event peaks with the float parade, as girls in finery join one by one.

Name: Beyond Azure Skies
Description: The empress was crowned young. Complex state affairs, both within and beyond the court, kept her up at night.

Name: Sheng Tune Prelude
Description: Decades passed in peace as the empress's hair turned gray. She knew her fate as the familiar music played.

Name: Ethereal Elegance
Description: She closed her eyes with a serene, hopeful smile, having fulfilled her duty and finally come to rest.

Name: Fantasy Flight
Description: The morning fog envelops the city as birds brush each other's feathers. Countless stories will unfold on a new day.

Name: Mountain Trek
Description: The treatments drag on and hurt. Her hands are bruised from needles. Sometimes she thinks of giving up.

Name: Mountain Stroll
Description: She often leads group hikes. New friends fill her life, and the once-lonely girl is finally surrounded by warmth.

Name: Mountain Delight
Description: Surrounded by people, Corinne never forgets her bunny. Those memories of comfort are irreplaceable.

Name: Verdant Chime
Description: From creative outfits to original verses, Lucia is always full of inspiration to brighten everyday life.

Name: Springtime Letter
Description: Ran into a super life-savvy girl.' 'Feeling healed today.' 'Life is lovely like this.' Warm words make up Lucia's day.

Name: Ballad of Repose
Description: The girls noticed Irena. 'Where are you from?' One of them asks curiously, but Irena finds herself at a loss.

Name: Entwined Memories
Description: Irena opens her eyes to gauzy curtains and the bright sunlight. She is lying on her desk, waking up from a dream.

Name: Spring Day Reverie
Description: From that day on, every afternoon the bunny appears on time, quietly staying by her as she paints bright spring scenes.

Name: Springtime Encounter
Description: The second egg rests on soft grass. She picks up a bunch of flowers nearby, petals brushing her fingers with sweet scent.

Name: Springtime Poem
Description: Elno finds the last egg beneath her favorite tree. The bunny holds it, wearing the blue dress Elno once gave as a gift.

Name: Secret Directive
Description: Code-named 'Night Owl,' the target is cunning and elusive. After days of pursuit, Morton confirms he will appear at a gala.

Name: Refreshing Cream
Description: When friends invite her to a spring picnic, Riko doesn't hesitate: strawberry cake, of course!

Name: 盛夏旋律
Description: 叮咚的雨声敲打着窗台，小小涟漪里藏着独属于盛夏的旋律，林夏赶忙拿起笔将稍纵即逝的灵感记录下来。

Name: 盛夏旋律·夜紫
Description: 少女们在笑声里完成了一首属于夏天的歌曲。演奏完毕，大家围成一团抱住了林夏，她们期待着正式登台演出。

Name: 盛夏旋律·银白
Description: 有人抱着吉他，有人拎着几罐汽水，笑闹着讨论去哪里。她们顺着人行道漫无目的地走着，夜风渐渐吹散了燥热。

Name: 盛夏旋律·青柠
Description: 林夏抱起吉他轻轻拨动，笑意慢慢浮现，这是一首属于夜晚、属于朋友，属于这座城市的自由漫游的夏日之歌。

Name: 梦园童话
Description: 店内玩偶的标签上都有店主佩洛画的简笔画，风格奇特，每只各异，无疑成为了这些玩偶的“防伪标志”。

Name: 梦园童话·华丽
Description: 妹妹画下了一张张玩偶设计图，其中她最喜欢的是那张小羊玩偶，既可爱又柔软，看着便教人十足安心。

Name: 梦园童话·珍稀
Description: 女孩说，小熊是祖母送给她的。祖母一向手巧，用零散的布料拼成了小熊，又在它肚子里塞满晒过太阳的棉花。

Name: 梦园童话·诺
Description: 世上究竟有没有能忘却一切悲伤的魔法？失去妹妹的佩洛曾不计代价地疯狂寻觅，在某天，她终于得到了答案。

Name: 梦园童话·愈
Description: 离开玩偶店的人们步伐轻盈，在无尽的赞美中，佩洛的名字传遍了小镇。而小羊玩偶身上隐秘的裂痕也越来越多。

Name: 个性印象
Description: 被问及原因时，缇妮笑着说：“独特的创意是我设计的基石，我想将它带给每一位追求新意的客人。”

Name: 个性印象·忆
Description: 晚宴总在七点整开始，蛋糕的口味提前数月就已定好，过于熟悉的音乐里，身穿礼服的大人们以乏味的姿态起舞。

Name: 个性印象·纪
Description: 从某一天清早起，缇妮的门前总会出现一篮面包，信卡上娟秀的字迹解释了自己的身份，也寄托着少女的善意。

Name: 流辉银甲
Description: 安莱是部落公认的勇者，她勇敢机敏，总是披着擦得闪亮的铠甲，在战斗时一往无前，带领族人得胜归来。

Name: 流辉银甲·丛森
Description: 远处的草丛里传出窸窣的轻响，身后亦响起细微的脚步声，安腊弓起肩背，将箭矢搭在弓弦上，靠向身旁的巨石。

Name: 流辉银甲·天穹
Description: 安莱飞速地在压力下成长，她必须克服她的鲁莽与孩子气，因为她的每个决策，都关系到上百名族人的存亡。

Name: Graceful Prelude
Description: The servant prepares a table of pastries, confident it'll cheer her up. The strawberry cake is the girl's favorite!

Name: Tea Party Daydream
Description: The girl wakes up to a cute black toy bunny in her arms and jumps out of bed, her eyes shining with excitement.

Name: 絮叶风吟
Description: 一轮烈日高高地挂在故事书的第一页，太阳不知疲倦，日复一日炙烤着大地，往日繁茂的绿植无精打采地垂下头。

Name: Fancy Dreamland
Description: Joy knows no limits, and vivid shows unfold. Are you audience or performer? Both deserve to be fully enjoyed!

Name: 校园幻想
Description: 菲奈得到了一个解释的机会，她迷迷糊糊地说，自己昨晚去了海底，海豚们拜托她帮忙收集沉入泥沙中的星光。

Name: Forgotten Theater
Description: Her uncle loved theater but never business. New amusements steal the crowd, and the old troupe fades.

Name: Meowgical Melody
Description: The outfit as expected wins the contest. As per the rules, the winner must share their inspiration.

Name: Hazy Peaks
Description: Yuan knows these hills and the timing to gather herbs. Mist lifts, dew glistens, green covers the slopes.

Name: Springtime Keepsake
Description: The girl picks up the sprigs and hands them to Yuan. Yuan beams and slips a wild pear flower into her hair.

Name: Rain-Washed Skies
Description: Twilight falls. The path stays wet. Yuan sings softly homeward, her basket full enough to hold the season.

Name: Elegant Sentiments
Description: Her care shines like the sun. Her protection is woven into the small moments of life, enduring year after year.

Name: 简单心愿
Description: 小时候的心愿总是很简单：买到好吃的泡泡糖，今天能再遇路边的小猫，或是闭上眼睛就能重回昨晚的甜美梦境。

Name: Sunlit Ripples
Description: Marina formed a band with her friends at school, who encouraged her to write down melodies in her mind and sing.

Name: Distant Frostnight
Description: Daisy has a colleague who has long lived with her in the vast garden. They both serve the garden's owner.

Name: Distant Frostnight - Decay
Description: The marionette is mostly quiet, but her emotionless eyes always light up with joy when she sees beautiful plants.

Name: 温雅回忆
Description: 有人觉得她很有个性，也有人会悄悄抱怨米洛洛太过寡言少语，我行我素，久而久之，很少有人主动和她接触。

Name: 喵喵梦工场
Description: 她的每一份付出，都能在游戏机屏幕窄窄的一方天地里得到温暖的反馈，柔软的猫咪肉垫轻轻托住她的精神世界。

Name: 随性空间
Description: 不是每个人都能找到属于自己的频道，米洛洛却在猫猫岛上收获了陪伴和快乐，以及不用开口就能被理解的信赖。

Name: Sugared Cheesecake
Description: Sugar is sparkling magic, like stardust sprinkled over a cake, sweetening every girlish dream.

Name: 缄默冥想
Description: 附灵魔咒的光晕下，折纸小动物们暂时拥有了生命，它们亲昵地靠近奥瑞尔，陪伴她度过了许多挑灯苦读的夜晚。

Name: 童心魔法师
Description: “老师！我也要学这个！”面对着孩子们向往的眼神，奥瑞尔莞尔，“没问题，只要你们能全优通过期末考试。”

Name: 秘法学院
Description: 课堂重新恢复了秩序，望着学生们埋头苦读的身影，奥瑞尔翻开随身携带的笔记本，露出了满意又狡黠的笑容。

Name: Troubling Chatters
Description: The other cats didn't like her, but she had a loyal servant: an old nun who was her housekeeper, chef, and doctor.

Name: 梦愿旅途
Description: 于新旅程的起点，柔和之风牵引它沉默内敛的孩子与被命运选中的粉发少女相会，友谊的种子轻轻落在两人心间。

Name: 纯挚祈语
Description: 新生的草木随着风的节拍摇曳，轻柔的风环绕此间，它将这首始于雪夜与月轮的隽永诗篇，传向山海的彼方。

Name: Mistbound Sorrow
Description: She sighs in relief after checking her impeccable smile, then straightens the flowers in her hair and brushes her hem.

Name: Mirrorborne Splendor
Description: Time seems endless. Roxanne has never come for another dance. Luckily, she's been growing stronger lately.

Name: Roseate Murmur
Description: The damage to her marionette body heals slowly. Now she has more time to wait for Roxanne and tell her off.

Name: Nebular Lullaby
Description: A fun secret hides within!' the friend who gives Ruby the book says. 'Find it, and you'll get an amazing gift.'

Name: Warden of Tomes
Description: As the Tome Warden, she catches rats, watches over the books, oversees supplies, and has access everywhere.

Name: Blooms of Yesterday
Description: It was a fine day, so Yao decided to drag the wooden box she got from the pawnshop out of her warehouse.

Name: Unstained Spirit
Description: Yongan couldn't see her mother much since the war broke out, but a woman always kept her company in her dreams.

Name: Colorful Graffiti
Description: She lifts her brush, adding gentle colors to the blank canvas, brightening another ordinary day.

Name: Sincere Bravery
Description: They are hunting a site lost to history. Its sheer age and hidden location have foiled expedition after expedition.

Name: Brimming Youth
Description: She runs to the meeting point and high-fives every teammate. The club game is about to kick off.

Name: Sapphire Memories
Description: Summer holds so many memories, especially of the sea. Real moments by the sea, or just hazy dreams of it…

Name: Sunlit Years
Description: Following the current, Paopao soon meets a school of fish. They huddle together, arguing about something.

Name: Ruthless Greed
Description: Beautiful fish swim leisurely around him. As he observes the world, they watch him too, just as curious.

Name: Abysmal Thunder
Description: Mange Snake's greatest dream is to become the Dragon King and rule the world. 'I'll do anything for it!'

Name: Echoes of Nightmare
Description: They were always together. The girl woke to kiss her cheek each morning and slept with her under the stars.

Name: Bewitched Lore
Description: Two battered souls set off together. They cross snowy mountains and silent streets, seeking to mend themselves.

Name: Bewitched Whispers
Description: One day, Kelly finds an abandoned doll in a roadside dump. Like her, it has a hollow button for an eye.

Name: Worry-Free Tavern
Description: Blaire's tavern is always a hit. Guests say it has the crispest beer, tastiest pretzels, and purest laughter.

Name: Beer O'Clock
Description: The eve of a festival is Blaire's busiest time. She brings out fresh beer and bakes pretzels to share with everyone.

Name: Casual Shorts·Blue
Description: The pair of shorts is as casual as its name. And of course you're free to wear it however you like.

Name: Casual Shorts·Pink
Description: Girls can wear a simple T-shirt to accompany these pink shorts and look cute.

Name: Casual Shorts·Beige
Description: When you have no idea of wearing what kind of bottoms to match your clothes, just go with these.

Name: Classic Kilt·Brown
Description: Such British-style plaid skirt and a shirt will bring you back to campus life.

Name: Classic Kilt·Blue
Description: If you love wearing school uniforms, you must have this dark blue kilt, perfect choice!

Name: Classic Kilt·Red
Description: Red kilt, quite British.

Name: Classic Kilt·Green
Description: Such deep green kilt is a must-have in your wardrobe.

Name: High-waist Shorts
Description: The detective assistant seems to like the pair of shorts. Maybe because of the waist design?

Name: Sakura Bud
Description: It is an elegant and soft tulle skirt dotted with petals.

Name: Snow Bud
Description: It is an elegant and soft tulle skirt dotted with snowflakes.

Name: Momo Overalls·Blue
Description: A big hit! How does it feel to wear Momo?

Name: Momo Overalls·Brown
Description: A brown colored Momo overall. No girls will ever refuse the charm of this.

Name: Momo Overalls·Black
Description: A black colored Momo overall. The blackness is in stark contrast with the pink cat ears. So much cuteness!

Name: Momo Overalls·White
Description: A white colored Momo overall. Most suitable for gentle and cute girls.

Name: Blue Purity·Skirt
Description: The skirt goes with Blue Purity·Top. It has the same unique pattern and elegant decorative rose.

Name: Silent Cherry·Skirt
Description: Go with Silent Cherry·Top. The shape is like layered cream cake, pretty European girl style!

Name: Peter Pan·Pants

Description: 希雅坐在裁缝桌前，看着还未完成的作品发呆，随后她将那些衣裙也收进了箱子里，好像将无法兑现的梦想封存。

Name: 逸闻趣记
Description: 二姐塔芙利带来了珍藏的童话书，她会为亲爱的小妹妹讲上一千个故事，让妹妹的童年充满美好与浪漫。

Name: 逸闻趣记·华丽
Description: 当花园里的树木郁郁葱葱，能够为她们撑起一片清凉时，姐妹们会围坐在葡萄藤架下的茶桌旁享受下午茶时光。

Name: 逸闻趣记·珍稀
Description: 姐姐们与她依依惜别，叮嘱她要照顾好自己。花园里从此少了个活泼跳脱的身影，只有在学院忙碌的求学者。

Name: 逸闻趣记·沁
Description: 贝尔蒂喜欢听塔芙利用温柔的声音给自己讲故事，塔芙利也非常乐意在自己的书桌旁添上一把高度正好的小椅子。

Name: 逸闻趣记·醇
Description: 酿造酒品之余，克罗妮也喜欢烘焙甜品，用她灵巧的双手将各种食材变成一个个造型独特、口味多变的小点心。

Name: 迷寐幻象
Description: 考古学家被猫咪明亮的眼眸吸引，跟着它在飞沙中穿行。他们绕过无数沙丘，终于，一座宏伟的古堡出现在眼前。

Name: 迷寐幻象·绚
Description: 就在此时，一条漆黑的猫尾缠上商人的腰间，将他拉了上来，惊魂未定的商人跟随黑猫的脚步，来到一处绿洲。

Name: 迷寐幻象·斓
Description: 一只黑猫缓缓走到他身边，用温暖的身体蹭了蹭他的裤脚。突然，黑暗中亮起了点点微光，像是夜空中的星辉。

Name: 突破自我
Description: “老师说这本书深入浅出，很适合你阅读，我和同学们还一起做了注释，要是你还有哪里不懂，随时来问我们。”

Name: 突破自我·檬
Description: 一位刚参加工作的实习生找到了茉利斯，她想要一套适合在职场穿着的套装，同时也要兼具她喜欢的清新田园风。

Name: 突破自我·萄
Description: 记者希望在确保服装满足采访者得体的穿着要求的同时，还要让装扮巧妙融入葡萄酒发布会主题，彰显独特韵味。

Name: Heart Yet Unveiled
Description: With a creak, Irena opens the door, smiling, a gift box in her hands. Breeze and sunlight follow her inside.

Name: Agile Poise
Description: They say the disaster was caused by metallic beasts. They invaded and infected the city, turning lives into metal.

Name: Sunlit Breeze
Description: One day, Cecilia hears an angry squeak and runs over to see the little Miana defending herself against a huge bird.

Name: Frostwind Sword
Description: Sigrun yearned for such an honor, but she wasn't blessed with a strong physique to swing the guards' greatsword.

Name: Drifting Snow
Description: In July, a plague hit the town. The couple treated the patients day and night, but could offer little help without a remedy.

Name: Travel Companion
Description: Pete's head is fluffy and round like a chestnut, and he bats his bright eyes whenever the girl pets him.

Name: Scholarly Fragrance
Description: Seasons change and students grow, yet memories stay: heartfelt lessons and the soft scent of books in the classroom.

Name: Puzzles of Memories
Description: Early winter snow falls lightly, creating a fairy-tale scene for those who long for dreamy winter landscapes.

Name: Warm Anchor
Description: Hazel knocks on every door with Buddy, delivering lost music boxes, letters, hometown noodles…

Name: Born Untamed
Description: A girl sprang between him and danger. Her weapon gleamed, and wolves cowered and fled.

Name: Rippling Love Poem
Description: Rippling water reflects his profile. She approaches, hearing him softly read the tank description like a love poem.

Name: Valiant Stance
Description: However, serpents invaded their homes and drove them to barren lands with their venomous fangs.

Name: Starward Gravity
Description: Like stars that gravitate together in the night sky, Liko and the puppies shine with love and companionship.

Name: Hanging Starlights
Description: Evening stars gaze low. The world sleeps in silence. She drifts into a strange dream, hearing whispers constantly.

Name: Frosted Silence
Description: Most monsters seem oblivious to the sudden human. Or perhaps, to them, humans are no different from monsters.

Name: Whispering Field
Description: Loxie's pumpkins flourish under green leaves, her tireless care yielding golden, plump fruits.

Name: Floral Calendar
Description: Every morning, she places a bouquet by the window: sunflowers when it's sunny and white lilies when it rains.

Name: Orchid Meadow
Description: Since she gained awareness nearly 300 years ago, things have changed, but she has never sought ascension to Heaven.

Name: Gleaming Daydreams
Description: On the note is Bobo's beautiful handwriting. Beside it, a childlike doodle of a yellow-caped cat giving a thumbs-up.

Name: Wondrous Reverie
Description: A warm touch falls on her shoulder. Beneath the candlelight, Ace gently drapes a sun-kissed cloak over Nikki.

Name: Silver Moonset
Description: Lang Shuang knows Lin Yao long awaited the chance, so she is not angry, but feels a tinge of helplessness.

Name: Clink of Jade
Description: The sounds of qin and zhu blend as one. They compose this impromptu piece into a new song, Parting Feelings.

Name: Forest Fairytale
Description: The table is piled with fabrics. Sewing tools sit on shelves. Designing and making clothes is her passion.

Name: Gleaming Ice Lake
Description: She sits up in delight as a fluffy little white bear pops from the snow and bows to her with a polite greeting.

Name: Exclusive Recipe
Description: She brought her book of recipes for this journey, full of scribbles and simple drawings of every food.

Name: 绒云映粉
Description: 旭日初升，天边的云染上了毛茸茸的桃粉色，自然的浪漫于无声蔓延，为这宁谧晨间漾开些许温柔。

Name: 多闻阙疑
Description: 岑缨性格开朗，求知欲旺盛，这份与众不同的好奇心令她醉心于家族残卷中记载的阵法之术。

Name: 澧兰沅芷
Description: 云无月的搭配不太常见，绛紫色的罩裙之下，是阔腿裤。

Name: 炫彩主张
Description: 她认真对待每位客人，不厌其烦地打磨细节，直到对方睁开眼露出惊喜的微笑。在这过程中，她感到疲惫而满足。

Name: 炫彩主张·沁风
Description: 卡米的背包里除了化妆包和绘画用具，渐渐多出许多旅途中的纪念品。每件小小的工艺品都承载着绮丽的回忆。

Name: 炫彩主张·柚夏
Description: 一个青年轻快走进店内，买了一杯清凉的果汁汽水。缤纷鲜果点缀的柜台边，笑语如同飞鸟，在狭小的店内回旋。

Name: 炫彩主张·暮海
Description: 女孩从小就梦想站上舞台，她挥洒汗水刻苦练习，从简陋的舞蹈室，到小镇的广场，它们见证她的黑夜与白天。

Name: 美味灵感
Description: 闲暇时光，她喜欢翻阅父母厚厚的烹饪书籍。一次心血来潮，她决定尝试制作自己的最爱——甜甜圈。

Name: 美味灵感·愿
Description: 小女孩脸蛋红扑扑的，连声向她道谢，毫不犹豫地打开自己的小铁盒，将盒中的坚果一股脑倒进她的手中。

Name: 美味灵感·游
Description: 小精灵们提着装满糖豆的小桶，笑着围拢在她身旁：乐园的晚会即将开始，勇敢的女孩会获得意外的惊喜。

Name: 美味灵感·谜
Description: 她小心迈步，夜风轻轻拂动树叶，为她带来一阵似有若无的甜香，鼓舞她怀揣勇气，快步向前。

Name: 疏影横斜
Description: 阿萝小心翼翼地展开了画卷。飘逸的画面中，薄雾似乎随着她的动作流散了，水潭也仿佛泛起层叠的涟漪。

Name: 疏影横斜·华丽
Description: 花店中的少女正在忙碌。每天她都会接到各种各样的订单，要根据不同的需求制作花束，可不是一件容易的事。

Name: 疏影横斜·珍稀
Description: 少女懊恼地嘟哝着，到底哪里才能找到值得记录的风景？满心烦闷之际，她脚下一滑，扑通一声跌进了溪水里。

Name: 疏影横斜·兰烟
Description: 记忆中祖母总是在窗明几净的屋子里作画，年幼的阿萝跑到桌前，祖母会耐心给她讲解画作中暗藏的精巧细节。

Name: 疏影横斜·林荫
Description: 珠宝的线条如同花瓣的弧度，在不同角度下闪烁着转瞬即逝的光影，像一个灿烂的生命在寰宇中投射的无尽可能。

Name: 茸茸冬日
Description: 我还是会想念自由，时常悄悄跑出她的领地。有时她很快找到我的踪迹，有时我也会主动现身，让她大吃一惊。

Name: 茸茸冬日·愉
Description: 她没有怪我把摆好的杯碟撞碎一地，反而用零食安抚我的肚胃，花去整个下午的时间为我们搭筑好温馨的小窝。

Name: 茸茸冬日·欢
Description: 我也曾有家。时间使记忆变得模糊，只记得那时我的主人爱把我抱在怀里，后来，主人却总是忧愁地望着我叹气。

Name: 隽雅花意
Description: 她漫步于繁花中，指尖轻抚盛放的花瓣，脚边簇着沾有晨露的花团，随着柔风，掠过她翩跹的裙摆。

Name: 隽雅花意·萌
Description: 但这是多么真实呀！茜娅甚至听见了鸟雀的啾啁。她猛地从床上坐起，趴在窗台边，向外张望。

Name: 隽雅花意·忆
Description: 指尖掠过一本本褪色的书脊，茜娅像抚摸着岁月的脉络，她触到一本烫金封皮的手札，缀着的铜扣已然锈蚀。

Name: 不屈战意
Description: 高亢的号声吸引了敌人，而她的身影消失在林中，凭借敏锐的直觉和灵巧的身法逃出生天，与获救的士兵们相会。

Name: 不屈战意·夜
Description: 以自身为饵需要的是不惧牺牲的勇气，指挥作战却要背负生命的重量，短暂的心理斗争后，她吹响了第一个指令。

Name: 不屈战意·曦
Description: 战场上的岁月恍如隔世，锻炼出的敏锐与机智却不曾消失，她将其应用于新的工作中，有条不紊地统筹各项事务。

Name: Morning Bloom
Description: Her name reflects the grace of flowers. Born noble, she stayed pure and candid, never hardened by life.

Name: 杳渺青碧
Description: 空谷幽兰寂寂发，远山含烟白瀑斜。千秋刻痕依稀在，不教星火落尘沙。

Name: 银花祭舞
Description: 自古以来，此间便少与外界来往，传说中这里每个人都掌握着诡谲的蛊术，贸然闯入者都会被捉去喂蛇。

Name: Dew-Touched Silk
Description: Her silk trousers, brushed by dew, deepen to a richer green, making Grandma's peach embroidery even more vivid.

Name: Heart of Magnolia
Description: The trees stretch in various forms and glow white under the moon as dewdrops shimmer on the petals.

Name: 绒暖格纹
Description: “三！二！一！”烟花绽放的瞬间，少女们欢呼着紧紧相拥，约定今后的每一次盛典，都要和彼此一起庆祝！

Name: Firework Brilliance
Description: She's ready to start a career, and soon she's assigned her first job: to advertise a new cookie stick for the brand.

Name: 寒星莹莹
Description: 从小，法西安就对冰雪有着一种难以言喻的亲近和眷恋。她时常趴在窗前，看着飞雪与被雪光映亮的淡紫色天幕。

Name: 寒星莹莹·夜
Description: 那声音既像河流冻结的一瞬，也像是冰雪在阳光下消融的时分，无数雪花上下翻飞，为她唱起无字的古老歌谣。

Name: 梦海手札
Description: 她与大海的渊源要从初次潜水说起。那时的露比娜还很稚嫩，她尝试了无数种生活，做什么似乎都能轻易成功。

Name: 梦海手札·幽
Description: 那一刻，露比娜想要流泪。她正身处一个辽阔而真实的世界之中，昔日沉默的风景也接纳了她成为自己的一部分。

Name: 寒枝映雪
Description: 少女的裙摆拂过花枝，冷香不意间缠住了她的裙角。少女稍稍侧过脸去，便见枝头点点腊梅，凌寒绽放。

Name: Meadow Zephyr
Description: Dandelion seeds drift in the golden autumn sunshine. Brushing off her dress, she sets off along a familiar trail.

Name: Fragrant Rendezvous
Description: The wave of fragrance envelops her until the distant church bell pulls her from her reverie.

Name: Illuminated Vision
Description: The path to the future is laid out as she wishes for freedom and courage to chase all the possibilities in life.

Name: 青冥月涌
Description: 初春的大地尚在沉睡，寒意仍未消散。云翎振翅飞翔，自杳冥而下，如流星般划过天际，飞越连绵起伏的群山。

Name: 绮丽梦旅
Description: 某年冬天，一场大雪覆盖了整个国度，积雪中天地显得格外静谧，年轻的公主离开宫殿，独自踏上了未知的旅途。

Name: 绮幻魔法
Description: 公主的眼中倒映着魔女的身影，那些支撑着她穿过高山深谷、战胜恶龙与树精的回忆汇聚如潮，在此刻化为现实。

Name: 柔光华忆
Description: 不堪压力的阿绯原本想趁乱溜走，然而抓她来的那位神仙抱着她的腿不撒手，哭声委实凄惨……阿绯心软了。

Name: Fired-Up Drumbeats
Description: Risa dreams of shining brightest. She prepares for two months, crafting a gilded dress that gleams as she spins.

Name: Melodic Guidance
Description: One night, the young empress tossed and turned when she heard a familiar, soothing lilt like a babbling spring.

Name: Dreambound Encounter
Description: As the clouds parted in an ethereal melody, the girl reached out to the empress, guiding her beyond.

Name: Mischievous Messenger
Description: In a quiet backyard, an old man hides his gift behind a vase as his wife carefully tends the blooming roses.

Name: Fully Charged
Description: Her parents give her a stuffed bunny. She has her first friend now. A wave of real tenderness softens her heart.

Name: Spring Wander
Description: She shares the bunny's tale. It stood by her through illness until brighter days came, always giving her strength.

Name: Dreambound Letter
Description: Today's plan—a picnic! Lucia is hopeful and nervous for her first picnic post. She wants everything to be perfect.

Name: Sunlit Delight
Description: Those she met and shared her day with became witnesses to her picnic. Their lenses captured those beautiful moments.

Name: Sunlit Gathering
Description: Lucia scrolls down the posts and sends likes to everyone. Her task to share the day has been completed with others!

Name: Blushing Dawn
Description: The girls don't mind her silence. They take her hands and invite her on a tour of the gorgeous garden.

Name: Tender Slumber Tale
Description: Elno decides to give her new friend a gift. She makes a dress by hand, its blue hem like a clear spring afternoon sky.

Name: Reflections of Vanity
Description: Welton's gala gathers elites. Disguised as a gem dealer, Morton secures an invite and blends into the glittering crowd.

Name: Strawberry Mille Crepe
Description: Stirring fresh milk and flour, Riko pictures the look of happiness on her friends' faces. She loves it the most.

Name: 即兴狂想
Description: 夏天，夏天是由什么构成的呢？是杯中相互碰撞的冰块，是汽水炸开的气泡，耳机里忽然放大的鼓点让心跳失衡。

Name: 即兴狂想·夜紫
Description: 夜幕降临之时舞台灯光亮起，乐队的大家在后台彼此加油打气，直到音乐响起的瞬间，所有杂念都被抛在身后。

Name: 即兴狂想·银白
Description: 奇特的琴声从拐角飘来，电车驶过时带起一阵气流，广告屏的光影闪烁不息。林夏放慢脚步，观察着周遭的路人。

Name: 即兴狂想·青柠
Description: 垃圾桶边堆满了纸飞机，所有的困扰与烦恼在此刻烟消云散。灵感总这样，藏在某个拐角等待与她撞个满怀。

Name: 咩咩奇遇
Description: 在孩子们眼中，玩偶店是独立于现实世界的童话镇，橱窗前站得笔直的锡兵就是这片净土的忠诚守护者。

Name: 咩咩奇遇·华丽
Description: 妹妹央求佩洛一起帮忙。起初，她们只是粗略地裁剪布料，填充进棉絮，然后尝试将它们缝合起来。

Name: 咩咩奇遇·珍稀
Description: 疼爱她的祖母离世月余，女孩仍然无法从悲伤中脱离，她始终缝不好玩偶，更不知道失去祖母后如何继续生活。

Name: 咩咩奇遇·诺
Description: 要想遗忘悲伤，必须把与这份悲伤息息相关的回忆全数抽离，这是谁也无法逃避的规则，是必须付出的代价。

Name: 咩咩奇遇·愈
Description: 某一天，曾经向佩洛寻求帮助的女孩再度登门，她仍旧抱着那只小熊，目光比佩洛初次见到她时还要空洞。

Name: 潮流宣告
Description: 缇妮相信，如火焰般灼烈的热情在设计中不可或缺，她爱用炽热的红色装饰飘扬的裙摆，点燃服装的活力与激情。

Name: 潮流宣告·忆
Description: 缇妮总觉得整个世界如同一个巨大的娃娃屋，人们像是被摆弄的玩偶，过着被安排好的生活，带着虚假的笑容。

Name: 潮流宣告·纪
Description: 绿豆馅的吐司、薄荷奶油味的贝果、夹着厚酸奶的可颂，充满创意的面包让缇妮不由会心一笑。

Name: 自由猎手
Description: 安莱的实力和领袖气质为族人所称颂，可安腊还记得，接过首领的重担时，姐姐也才像她今年一般大。

Name: 自由猎手·丛森
Description: 幽绿色的眼瞳在风沙中亮起，狼群渐渐迫近，安腊有些不安地握紧长弓，姐姐拉弦时沉静的眸子闪现在她的脑海。

Name: 自由猎手·天穹
Description: 她变得冷静而果断，总能迅速地做出正确的决定，但唯独在面对安腊时，她还是那个总会过度担忧的长姐。

Name: Bunny's Game
Description: But she stops by the pastry table only for a moment and apologizes to the servant. She's not in the mood for it.

Name: 田野漫游
Description: 萝萝希居住的村子虽还有足够的水源，但村民们听闻旱情席卷了北方的城镇，难免忧心忡忡。

Name: Vivid Spectacle
Description: The curtain rises. Fix your gaze! The spinning orbs hide secrets; in a blink, they turn into cotton candy and chocolate!

Name: 跃动序言
Description: 老师的眉头皱得更深了！被提醒下不为例的菲奈不敢再辩解，心中却想，自己明明遵循教导，实话实说了呀！

Name: Shadows of Past
Description: The troupe couldn't wait for miracles and quietly left. The hopeful light in her uncle's eyes dimmed.

Name: Berry Frosting
Description: Under the limelight, the host opens the winner's letter that tells the story of a girl and her cat in a yellow cape.

Name: Verdant Scent
Description: She moves along the paths, scanning carefully. With a swing of her hoe, another stem falls into her basket.

Name: Tender Years
Description: Her tenderness is like a soft spring breeze, caressing the new leaves and soothing the unease along our journey of growth.

Name: 干练风采
Description: 晨光熹微，万物复苏，勤劳的人们换上了干练的装束。在这宁静而美好的时刻，蓬勃生机已于梦想中悄然萌发。

Name: 蜜彩乐园
Description: 让想象力在梦中肆意挥洒，乘着流星落在棉花糖做的云朵上，沿着长长的彩虹桥奔跑，直到能摸到月亮的尖角。

Name: Lilting Tune

Name: Unknown Surprise
Description: A collection of charming gifts is always hard to resist. Perhaps friends will love the surprise.

Name: Magic Pocket - Bright
Description: When the fountain went missing, the townsfolk turned to Pearly, hoping she could retrieve it.

Name: Creekside Letter
Description: Sheila pulled the rope as water splashed on her shoes. She was surprised to notice a scent from the bucket.

Name: Sandy Glitter

Name: Moonlit Visit

Name: Bond of Life

Name: Specter of Past

Name: Elegant Rhymes
Description: As she reached out, the inlays glowed faintly. The next moment, the crate popped open, revealing a doll inside.

Name: 寒风凛冽
Description: 克蕾索自小听着爷爷讲述先驱们的英勇事迹长大，人们都说她有一双闪烁着光芒的眼睛和一颗坚定的心。

Name: 寒风凛冽·华丽
Description: 教官的目光如锐利的鹰隼，紧锁在克蕾索的身上，那深邃的双眼之中蕴含她无法解读的复杂情绪。

Name: 寒风凛冽·珍稀
Description: 当王城沉浸在宁静之中，一场刺杀行动悄然展开。刺客如同幽灵般潜入王宫，企图无声无息结束女皇的生命。

Name: 寒风凛冽·将
Description: 克蕾索所在的连队被部署到了一片地形复杂，气候恶劣的战场上，敌军凭借先进的装备和充足的补给，步步紧逼。

Name: 寒风凛冽·谍
Description: “风筝”是克蕾索行动时的代号，寓意着她看似独自飘荡，实则身有所属，源源不断向己方传输关于敌军的情报。

Name: Malty Foam
Description: Turn on the tap for the foamy and malty liquid to spill out. Ambera's special brew - fancy a cup, love?

Name: Zephyr Echo
Description: Ayesha plucked the strings as golden jewels struck the instrument, the tune riding the wind to faraway lands.

Name: 纯真庇佑
Description: 在那个战乱年代，教堂为无数平民提供了庇护。外界炮火纷飞，唯独这里还能偶尔听见孩子们的歌声。

Name: 纯真庇佑·粉

Name: 纯真庇佑·湛
Description: 当翻开厚重的书卷，旧时的故事跃然眼前。她看到的并非是单纯的文字，而是无数待人拾取的时光。

Name: 纯真庇佑·青
Description: 信息采集、检测、修复……剥落的壁画与破损的雕像逐渐焕发出昔日光彩，玫雅首次参与的修复工作宣告完成。

Name: 童心珍忆
Description: 正值游乐场举办庆典，园中摆放了许多泡泡机。奥菲娅与朋友们笑闹着追逐彩色泡泡，玩得不亦乐乎。

Name: 童心珍忆·碧
Description: 纸张穿过光阴落在手心，上面是小奥菲娅留下的字迹，笨拙又认真地写着一个纯挚的心愿。

Name: 童心珍忆·澄
Description: 奥菲娅决定留在游乐场，成为一名工作人员。她古灵精怪，新设了许多趣味小游戏，总能引起孩子们的兴趣。

Name: 亭亭绻思
Description: 家人请来了最好的礼仪老师，露晞成为了他们最出色的学生，亭亭玉立的少女比沾着晨露的郁金香还要动人。

Name: 亭亭绻思·夕

Name: 亭亭绻思·暮

Name: Dusting Breeze

Name: Soundless Rhymes

Name: Floral Insight

Name: Dreamward Wish
Description: Sunflowers grow strong under the blazing heat and always passionately chase for their destination.

Name: Pristine Psalm
Description: The lambs, having absorbed nightmares, emit a radiant glow. Anno gently strokes them, praising their bravery.

Name: Cheerful Rhyme

Name: Splash Symphony

Name: Colorful Circuits
Description: I'll look for materials that won't melt! Youell searched the forest for silvery roots, glow grass and golden stamens.

Name: Crimson Phantom

Name: Spiritual Myth
Description: Paint with a marker and carve with a handy knife. It takes not only creativity but patience to carve a pumpkin.

Name: Chantilly Blend
Description: It's Sylvette's Sweet Hour! Today I'm trying the winter-exclusive box from Chocolove. Let's get started!'

Name: Iridescent Finesse
Description: Prince Yong was the emperor's younger brother, so the governor lied, saying the treasure was family heritage.

Name: Faithful Promise
Description: History is a story of the past. Nobody lives forever, but the past always remains true, waiting to be discovered.

Name: Cordial Hope
Description: Versha decided to knit a special hat with wool, hoping it would be warm, soft, and filled with beautiful wishes.

Name: Frosting Strings
Description: Fine, crystal-like sprinkles float and fall upon the flowing river of chocolate, finding a perfect home.

Name: Heartfelt Romance
Description: She writes down her birthday wishes every year, including any gifts she wants, and realizes them on her birthdays.

Name: 曲径人家
Description: 少女独居在此已多年，从不过问外界如何，享受宁静与自在，所求不过能日日居于幽篁间，听竹叶飒飒之声而已。

Name: Blooming Reverie
Description: The bud shivers. 'What's happening?' the kids are worried, but the bud suddenly blooms and unfurls its petals.

Name: Future Vision
Description: Customers would sometimes complain about time moving too slowly or too fast. Could they control time as well?

Name: Gentle Encounter
Description: A bell rings as the girl opens the door. She is greeted by the scent of books and the shopkeeper's warm smile.

Name: 糖霜心意
Description: 盛大的茶会即将开始，空气中弥漫着诱人的香甜气息，小动物们身着围裙与帽子，搬运着各式美味的茶点。

Name: 糖霜心意·影
Description: 瓷器碎裂，鲜果纷纷腐败，小动物们也化身成了张牙舞爪的魔兽，啵啵提起裙摆匆匆逃离这场荒诞的茶会。

Name: 凛冽霜风
Description: 没有人不会被雪原极致的白触动，凝望着它，心中的喧嚣与纷扰悄然消散，只留下无限的宁静与平和。

Name: 凛冽霜风·愿
Description: 在中央大街的一家冰点铺里，海樱买到了一支自由之塔造型的雪糕，精致的外观令大喵新奇不已。

Name: Corridor Maze
Description: Arianna, a designer who walks between reality and fantasy, blurs the line between life and dream, black and white.

Name: Hazy Circle
Description: Travelers from afar, to see the fairy, venture deep into the forest at midnight, and you may see Fina singing.

Name: Hazy Circle - Dream
Description: Ignoring the travelers behind the trees, Fina looks down, clasps her hands, and begins singing the old tune.

Name: Charm Overflow
Description: She wiggles her ears, eliciting excited screams from the audience—she always appears as a raccoon for outsiders.

Name: Charm Overflow - Mocha
Description: The guide writes in the end, 'Kokia carries candy around and loves kids. She might gift some when they leave.'

Name: Silent Sonnet
Description: She loves adventurers and invites them to her home if they pass by. Daisy just wants to be friends.'

Name: Unanswered Puzzle
Description: The town wasn't peaceful lately. The Gem Burglar was still on the loose, and this gem could be his next target.

Name: Abstruse Nature
Description: Shroomoo was elated about her new finding. She chose one, carefully dusted spores off the top, and picked it.

Name: Abstruse Nature - Dream
Description: Unlike the real person, 'Shroomoo' only recorded the special mushroom in her notebook, which is also amazing!

Name: Sincere Hospitality
Description: The old cat's name is Fish. Its story is written on the wall—this Siamese cat was Saki's mother's dear companion.

Name: Blossom Overdue
Description: Mikari seemed like a late bloomer at school. She was quiet and ordinary, like a small bud in a sea of blooms.

Name: Candid Praise
Description: Tiya was her best friend since they were kids. Tiya's mother treated her with hospitality whenever she stayed over.

Name: 温暖相随
Description: 一位老妇人默默坐到了少女的身边。她递给少女一个精致的礼物盒，里面是一只毛茸茸的兔子玩偶。

Name: 温暖相随·织
Description: 在不断的实践中她逐渐发现，除了编织衣物，灵活运用技巧，她还可以编织出各式各样的可爱玩偶。

Name: 温暖相随·静
Description: 以兴趣为出发点，她开始写侦探小说。她敏锐细心，故事结构紧凑；又富有创意，总能设计出巧妙的作案手法。

Name: 温暖相随·音
Description: 在制作人的邀请下，她录制了属于自己的第一支单曲，虽然技巧不够纯熟，但纤细的情感格外动人。

Name: 触梦及星
Description: 只要置身于植物环绕之中，感受它们蓬勃的生命力，她便如同一只展翅高飞的鸟儿，在广袤无垠的天际自由翱翔。

Name: 触梦及星·华丽
Description: 调香秘籍的失窃，让菈佩诺意识到，这场突如其来的火灾，绝非一场简单的意外，其背后一定另有隐情。

Name: 触梦及星·珍稀
Description: 菈佩诺还是第一次听到这种说法，在一次次相处中，他们渐渐无话不谈，同音共律，仿佛找到了彼此心灵的共鸣。

Name: 触梦及星·芜
Description: 时光仿佛在这一刻倒流，当他们开口呼唤对方时竟没有丝毫生疏，依然能够像从前那样，心无芥蒂、无话不谈。

Name: 触梦及星·焚
Description: 菈佩诺咬紧牙关，一面扮演着巨擘的得力助手，一面收集他的罪证，她还需要一个时机，让他身败名裂悔不当初。

Name: Taste of Wonder
Description: As the baker introduces every ingredient from whipped cream and fine powdered sugar, the students exclaim in awe.

Name: 瞬息千里
Description: 她也见过不慎跌落赛道的滑板选手，在血与泪中重新站起，收获尊敬与赞叹。

Name: 潇洒跃升
Description: 滑板上的世界是怎样的？在玻维尔心中，每一次腾跃，都是一次短暂的飞翔，好像拥有了一双看不见的翅膀。

Name: 瞬息千里·迷彩
Description: 五彩斑斓的灯光飞速后退，揉合成一团扭曲模糊的影子，在惊呼声中，她向前冲去。

Name: 潇洒跃升·迷彩
Description: 玻维尔只是平静地走向边缘，这种起伏的地形她曾滑过很多次，只不过这一次从地面转移到了大厦顶端而已。

Name: 瞬息千里·炽焰
Description: 她也为每一次失败、挫折、瓶颈而流血流泪，但每一次挫折都在磨砺着她，使她成为一个更好的自己。

Name: 潇洒跃升·炽焰
Description: 当她如愿征服了速度，连晚风都变得温柔起来，追随她穿梭在大街小巷，为她唱起高歌。

Name: 晚夜轻语
Description: 两姐妹总有说不完的话，从学习的烦恼到有关未来的畅想，每晚的睡前时光，房间里都流淌着她们的窃窃私语。

Name: 晚夜轻语·幻
Description: “善于从平凡中取材，发掘日常中的闪光点，瑞娜的设计蕴含着浓浓情感。”一位颇有名望的设计师这样赞赏她。

Name: 晚夜轻语·雾
Description: 在妹妹耀眼的光芒下，栗娜的成绩有些黯然失色，不过她始终真诚地为妹妹感到高兴，希望对方能梦想成真。

Name: Whispering Scent

Name: Mellow Shimmer

Name: 霁华无尘

Name: Misty Encounter

Name: Misty Encounter - Hidden

Description: Starlet declined again, and the bears' button eyes looked confused. Finally, they brought Starlet to a dining hall.

Name: Memory Palette

Name: Autumn Landscape
Description: Take a walk outside and feel the autumn breeze. Listen to insects chirping and enjoy the peace and serenity.

Name: Fresh Stripes
Description: Myra caught Rococo as she stumbled, then treated her to vanilla chocolate. 'May you grow up strong and bright.'

Name: Candlelit Shadow
Description: Candlelit shadows merge, their love igniting a warmth that fills the room.

Name: Crystalline Orison

Name: Misty Plume

Name: Fresh Whispers

Name: 绵软期望

Name: Criss-crossing Dreams

Name: Glamorous Vision

Name: Dream Sonnet

Name: Cherished Pair

Name: Liminal Steps

Name: 新品构想
Description: 源自于意外，诞生于偶然，这杯特调咖啡就如同捉摸不定的灵感一般，让芙拉雅回想起第一次喝咖啡时的有趣经历。

Name: 摩登印象

Name: Nocturnal Radiance

Name: Deep Nightfall

Name: Whispered Affection

Name: 风拂梨白

Name: Dream Sync
Description: Just apply, and you could be 'Little Fish'! The invitation glows—yet she hesitates, clicks the page away.

Name: 幻象风灯
Description: 可那承载了太多的东西。藏书阁中，乔琳抚摸着古老的羊皮卷，书页上的文字如此晦涩，记载着王廷的起落兴衰。

Name: 晨雾薄云
Description: 漆黑的历史渐渐显露獠牙，故事滑向不可挽回的深渊。她不禁向史官询问：“这位王为何放逐了自己的兄弟？”

Name: 幻象风灯·华丽
Description: 乔琳见到了第一位骑士，他曾经穿过险象环生的沼泽，斩杀窠巢中的恶龙，他将龙身上最闪亮的鳞片献给了王储。

Name: 晨雾薄云·华丽
Description: 他是如此自得地吹嘘着自己的英勇无畏，乔琳百无聊赖放下了龙鳞。她见过太多闪烁、华贵的珍宝。

Name: 幻象风灯·珍稀
Description: 为了给生病的邻居找药材，伊芙提着剑走进危险的森林。小镇上发生盗窃案，她就整夜看守，帮大家捉住盗贼。

Name: 晨雾薄云·珍稀
Description: 这样的小事，伊芙做了很多。后来小镇上的人们送给她一件甲胄，那是他们能打造出的最细致最坚实的盔甲。

Name: 幻象风灯·绯红
Description: 伊芙开始跟随王廷护卫练习剑术。她将每一场训练都当成一次生死决斗，全力以赴，一如她曾经沉默地走入王廷。

Name: 晨雾薄云·绯红
Description: 不仅是乔琳的护卫，伊芙也是王储的“眼睛”。尊贵的王储常年居住王廷，需要可信的人用脚步丈量这片土地。

Name: 幻象风灯·夜海

Name: 晨雾薄云·夜海
Description: 这时，一道身影出现在视野尽头，马蹄踏着将明的天色穿过花园。伊芙肩上还带着露水，她向高台上的乔琳挥手。

Name: Dazzling Sweetheart

Name: True Self Manifesto

Name: Cursebound Despair

Name: 温情牵挂
