Name: 热辣调味
Description: 那是他吃过最好吃的面，鲜香的辣油燎着舌尖，将五脏六腑煨暖。再行夜路时，似乎连刮骨的风也不再寒冷。

Name: 温情牵挂·姜黄
Description: 小学徒问尤曼，为什么坚持开解忧面馆。尤曼说，面条是记忆的载体，沉浮的不止是辛酸苦辣，还有一整个人间。

Name: 热辣调味·姜黄
Description: 男人醒后红着眼眶，吃完整碗冰冷的面。他对尤曼自嘲地笑，提起为他煮咖喱面的人。她说，咖喱是记忆的琥珀。

Name: 温情牵挂·柠香
Description: 尽管漂泊无方，女孩始终深信自己过得很好，可端起面碗的瞬间，泪水早已涌落，才发现自己如此想念家的味道。

Name: 热辣调味·柠香
Description: 酸柠面独特的香气飘荡开来，女孩的眼睛似乎瞬间便亮了些。她翻动面条时絮絮叨叨地讲，这是母亲最常做的面。

Name: Silky Memories
Description: The moon and stars pale in the light of the dazzling fireworks. People watch quietly as the firework named Nostalgia blooms.

Name: Graffiti of Youth
Description: Spray paints splash through dusk and the stars, capturing the brilliance of the future like a vibrant rainbow.

Name: Ocean Folklore
Description: The storm ceased. As the sun gently cast its light from the sky, the sails shone in the golden glimmers of the sea.

Name: Creamy Savor
Description: Many are fond of pastries with cream. They love the feeling of happiness when cream melts in their mouth.

Name: 焙香漫语
Description: 她开始做一些新的甜品，改变配比，调整食材，一系列莽撞的尝试后，每日光顾甜品店的客人似乎渐渐少了。

Name: Winter Reverie
Description: Fog deepens on the window. Rian draws playful bears building snowmen in the forest.

Name: Winter Reverie - Coffee
Description: Sweet shop scents soothe Capri's weary heart. Her foggy mind clears a bit. It's time for a revitalizing coffee!

Name: Winter Reverie - Cheese
Description: Amid busyness, Capri tastes Rian's new dessert Lime Cheese, rich yet refreshingly bright.

Name: Insight of Neon
Description: Ruin Island releases a new interstellar holographic game. She queues all night to get in the moment it launches.

Name: Silent Resonance
Description: Silence surrounds her; heartbeat seems the loudest sound, resonating with echoes from billions of light-years away.

Name: Neon Gleam
Description: A colleague hurried down the corridor. His band blinked red, warning that he was late for the designated time.

Name: Neon Gleam - Silence
Description: This plan… wasn't it made when Chenxi was still here? Why use it now?' Xuni glanced at Heimdal's screen.

Name: Dreamer's Interlude
Description: She awoke smiling, heart light with joy, and painted every memory of beauty from those strange worlds on her canvas.

Name: Original Socks
Description: The mayor rushed to the scene. Lunar met his gaze and slowly shook her head. 'Lor River denied our request for aid.'

Name: Echoes of the Past
Description: This letter just arrived. That master refuses to attend,' a clerk said, eyes brimming with tears.

Name: Graceful Serenity
Description: She looked up at the rainbow windmill. Once, it spun with chiming bells, sowing magic seeds across the valley.

Name: 薄雾暝曚
Description: 披坚执锐的红衣骑士从头盔下露出猩红的双瞳，投来一瞥。仿佛是发现了入侵者，下一瞬，他向伊莉丝冲杀而来。

Name: Amber Clouds
Description: No way!' Momo protested. 'Loving grilled fish is one thing, but I refuse to look like one myself!'

Name: Bond of the Finale
Description: Tears fell on children's palms, which suddenly refracted into dazzling light, revealing the past in vivid memory.

Name: Midnight Serenade
Description: The chilling legend kept most people away from the ruins, but they could not stop the curiosity of the children.

Name: Entwining Vines
Description: That sounds wonderful! I wish I could grow up sooner to see it myself!' Her eyes sparkled like a field of stars.

Name: Blossoming Illusion
Description: The ancient stars no longer guide her way, and the girls in the prism keep telling her to break the prism.

Name: Brilliant Rainbow
Description: The sunset bathes them. The last dice sits on a tray. With a hint of reluctance, Bunny nudges it toward Rosy.

Name: Gardening Time
Description: Days pass, seasons change, and the cicadas chirp on. She tends the seeds carefully, but they never sprout.

Name: Blissful Getaway
Description: In the end, no one took the Dreamfish—just as no one could outmatch a stylist ready for anything, even on vacation.

Name: Lyric Tides
Description: And so, Rain Over the Lake was born. As Melutin hit save, rain fell outside—she smiled softly.

Name: Distant Lightyear
Description: Melutin never shared her songs online—revealing such personal words always made her a little shy.

Name: 风露不染
Description: 茶田种在舒缓的山坡上，雾气渐渐打湿衣袖，啵啵时而弯腰仔细观察茶叶的形态，时而凑近闻一闻茶叶的香气。

Name: 风露不染·霁
Description: 人群中忽然传出惊呼，啵啵循声转头，也不由惊叹起来——被店主高高举起的那盏花灯极尽精美，引人瞩目。

Name: Dazzling Reverie
Description: The forecast promised a once-in-a-century meteor shower. Wumei clutched Lambie and waited excitedly.

Name: 青荧回环
Description: 在朋友的讲述中，熊猫的栖息地宛如幻想世界，那里没有烦恼和忧愁。这台小小的设备，真的能将其完美呈现吗？

Name: 青荧回环·华丽
Description: 阿盼在竹屋后开辟了一块田地，播撒种子，浇水收获，这些悠竹在现实世界中无法体验的事，原来是这么有趣。

Name: 青荧回环·珍稀
Description: 悠竹将自己的想法告诉了阿盼，阿盼眼中满是信赖，它用竹园中最坚韧的竹子为友人制作了一把音色优美的笛子。

Name: 青荧回环·研
Description: “这款游戏就像一把钥匙，打开了我内心深处对生活的热爱之门。我不再是被伤心过往和生活琐事困扰的自己。”

Name: 青荧回环·庆
Description: 院子里的小桌上摆满了美味佳肴，都是用悠竹亲手种出的食材精心制作的。悠竹和友人在桌边落座，相视一笑。

Name: Creamy Caramel
Description: What went wrong? The rising time or oven temperature? Lilico sighs, still not finding the answer yet.

Name: Velvet Petals
Description: She joined the contest and designed a refreshing weave of white and green inspired by her memories of the trip.

Name: Gleeful Cadence
Description: I have a listener today!' The frog looked as surprised as her and said proudly, 'You must be drawn to my singing~'

Name: Endless Flutter
Description: She painted it with immature brushstrokes after her first meeting with Lotus. It was their bond she couldn't let go.

Name: Shrouded Truth
Description: Born under a blood moon and brimming with spiritual energy, Huashu needed little guidance to master the spells.

Name: Intertwined Fate
Description: She was taken to a castle on a snowy mountain. The buyer never used her; she would just stare with a sad look.

Name: Innocent Chapter
Description: Her friends were all waiting with tea and desserts. Kimi tilted her head, surprised, and accepted the invite.

Name: Tranquil Memory
Description: She doesn't perceive time like humans. But when it comes to Kimi's growth, she'd think time flies fast.

Name: Withering Leaf
Description: The world has been destroyed and rebuilt, as the soil witnesses the cycle of fate and merges with the dust of time.

Name: Nocturnal Finale
Description: The clever, innocent girls competed with drastically different styles. Each clash was a silent battle.

Name: Nocturnal Finale - Rain
Description: Years later, Korina made her name. She'd always hoped to see her name mentioned with Elle in a magazine somewhere.

Name: Silent Prose
Description: The lady was indifferent. She was busy with all kinds of fashionable activities; a toy guard couldn't pique her interest.

Name: Silent Prose - Legacy
Description: She suddenly remembered the guard. The red paint had peeled off, and golden lines faded, but she still stood firm.

Name: Afternoon Zephyr
Description: The girl started the story with the most wonderful life she could imagine, where people lived together happily.

Name: Afternoon Zephyr - Matcha
Description: The girl curled up in the attic with the bear, reading and looking for what was hidden behind the imperfect pieces.

Name: Slumbering Shadow
Description: Bleak and meaningless, the painting was bought by an auction house to hang in a corner as a simple decoration.

Name: Glistening Waters
Description: Following the map, they found a beautiful valley with a clear, gentle stream, perfect for axolotls.

Name: 玉泥蹈火
Description: 均窑之釉，扪之甚平，而内现粗纹垂垂而直下者，谓之泪痕；屈曲蟠折者，谓之蚯蚓走泥印，是均窑之特点也。

Name: 雀跃邂逅
Description: 很快，这份小手艺被更多孩子发现了，孩子们拿着巧克力、糖果和面包，请希雅姐妹给自己的娃娃做裙子。

Name: 雀跃邂逅·樱落
Description: 临别那天，姐姐拍了拍希雅的脑袋，她们还像小时候一样亲密无间。希雅相信，自己会和姐姐在梦想的远方再见。

Name: 雀跃邂逅·童话
Description: 城中人们也渐渐听说了希雅。她有一间专门为布娃娃做衣服的裁缝坊，能根据简单的想法做出别出心裁的衣装。

Name: 雀跃邂逅·薄荷
Description: 生活还是一切如常，傍晚的炊烟弥散在霞光中，世界上悲伤与欢愉交织，小镇始终像一片温柔而安静的影子。

Name: 光阴故梦
Description: 从贝尔蒂牙牙学语，扑向姐姐们的怀抱，到她像一只轻盈的小蝴蝶在花园中玩耍嬉戏，仿佛只是一眨眼的事。

Name: 光阴故梦·华丽
Description: 松软蛋糕包裹着丝滑奶油和新鲜的草莓，香甜的味道令人无限回味——草莓泡芙是克罗妮最擅长的甜点之一。

Name: 光阴故梦·珍稀
Description: 贝尔蒂常为了一个细节废寝忘食，每当她感到疲倦与迷茫时，脑海中都会浮现出姐姐们温柔的面庞与鼓励的话语。

Name: 光阴故梦·沁
Description: 人们看待事物的角度皆有不同，从妹妹童真的视角中，塔芙利看到了自己未留意过的细节，获得了新的思考方向。

Name: 光阴故梦·醇
Description: 每当看到妹妹们品尝她制作的点心时脸上洋溢着的满足笑容，克罗妮的心中也涌起一股暖流，充盈着无尽的喜悦。

Name: 芳蕊之绊
Description: 面容如冰霜般冷峻的奥罗拉在面对薇安时却十分温和，初来乍到、茫然无措的少女很快就对她亲近起来。

Name: 沉寂光阴
Description: 生活在这片国度的人们尊称宫殿的主人为“奥罗拉大人”，据说她是最杰出的魔法师，掌握着至高的力量。

Name: 芳蕊之绊·华丽
Description: 那天夜里，薇安在塔楼顶端找到了奥罗拉。她神色平静又哀伤，说她早该知道这永恒的殿堂中容不下鲜活的生命。

Name: 沉寂光阴·华丽
Description: 她将书册带给奥罗拉，大魔法师却露出少见的迷茫，她说她已经离开尘世太久，早不记得花的形貌与气味。

Name: 芳蕊之绊·珍稀
Description: 每到一处，薇安就会弹唱起歌谣，引导着人们发现最微小的美好，让他们相信可以凭自己的力量对抗灾难与痛苦。

Name: 沉寂光阴·珍稀
Description: 宫殿里的岁月将她雕琢成如今的模样。她依然弹奏旧日的旋律，吟诵古老的魔法，只是再也没有奥罗拉在身旁。

Name: 芳蕊之绊·湛空
Description: 无论宏大还是渺小，玄虚还是真切，这些寄托都赋予了人们坚定的心，引领着他们走向独属于自己的未来。

Name: 沉寂光阴·湛空
Description: 这一夜，水晶宫殿在银月下破碎，清透的水晶漂浮在空中，映出这个广阔的世界，又化作流光没入奥罗拉的身体。

Name: 芳蕊之绊·青藤
Description: 带着老师的嘱托，奥罗拉走进宫殿，此后再不曾离开。然而她的力量终会耗尽，人们的信仰却总要有所寄托。

Name: 沉寂光阴·青藤
Description: 然而此时她却显得无比憔悴，昔日得心应手的魔法也近乎枯竭，就像许多年前那朵最终凋零的花。

Name: 轻灵足音
Description: 欣喜若狂的考古学家没有察觉，梦中的黑猫站在不远处的沙丘，宝石般的眼眸遥望着异国的来客，为他送上祝福。

Name: 砂海寻迹
Description: 古堡的大门缓缓打开，门后闪烁着奇异的光芒。考古学家激动万分，猫咪却用尾巴拦住了他，示意他不要急躁。

Name: 轻灵足音·绚
Description: 沙漠中的灵猫穿梭在旅人的梦境中，不管他们怀着何种目的，它都会用神奇的魔法，给予人们指引、希望与启示。

Name: 砂海寻迹·绚
Description: 绿洲像嵌在沙漠中的宝石，在月色下格外美丽，商人走到了月牙形的湖水旁，湖中倒映着家人焦急寻找他的身影。

Name: 轻灵足音·斓
Description: 画家的新作一经展出便引起了轰动，人们被画中对艺术一往无前的热忱吸引，画家的艺术生涯迎来了转机。

Name: 砂海寻迹·斓
Description: 黑猫引导着画家朝着微弱的光芒走去，随着他们不断前行，那一点光芒变得密集而闪亮，最终汇聚成璀璨的星河。

Name: 薄暮栖迹
Description: 祖母时常说起某颗星，它象征着一切生命的起源与无尽的自由。篝火映在安娅的眼底，也像永不熄灭的恒星。

Name: 薄暮栖迹·归
Description: 安娅骑着白马回到了草原。风中传来古老而悠远的歌谣，苍鹰盘旋在高远的天际，她的背影消失在浩瀚天地间。

Name: 薄暮栖迹·寻
Description: 漫长的迁徙令人身心俱疲，某一天安娅不小心和大家走散了。白雾从大地升起，渐渐吞没了队伍的踪影。

Name: Perfect Partners
Description: Life without a case is just too dull! Lottie let out a dramatic sigh, while Bono shaked his head.

Name: Innocent Yearning
Description: Clever and curious, Lantis often outwitted her guards, disguising herself to see the lives of her people.

Name: New Dawn Clouds
Description: Sunlight bathes Lonna's focused profile in warm golden light, as the buds tint her pale cheeks with a gentle blush.

Name: Gift of True Affection
Description: The gleam of wrapping paper and ribbon lights up her eyes. She opens the box to find a key and a bag of rose seeds.

Name: Chic Camouflage
Description: She steps out of a bright light. A unique pendant hangs over her chest, a symbol of the Ruins Hunters.

Name: Cheese Epistle
Description: The greedy bird wants to take Miana's grains. Cecilia lunges to scare the bird away and turns to see Miana gone, too.

Name: Peril in the Night Rain
Description: Perhaps, this was a larger conspiracy she was entangled in from the start. Hatred and gratitude became her shackles.

Name: Moonlit Solitude
Description: Another festival came, but this time, there was no more festivity or fireworks. Only funerals and laments filled the streets.

Name: Chestnut Memories
Description: Pete is the girl's best holiday partner. On weekends, they find an open field to play and chase after each other.

Name: Sunshine Memories
Description: Refreshing mint mixed with sweet peach… one sip can brighten your day,' her best friend used to say to Aya.

Name: Traces of Frosted Petals
Description: Snow!' Though cold, the first flakes excite everyone, leaving faint marks in people's palms as they land.

Name: Unswerving Pursuit
Description: The girl's wish is granted soon. Hazel knocks on her door, Buddy in one arm and a chubby puppy in the other.

Name: Dream Shuttle
Description: Almost everyone knows it's no ordinary delivery service. She not only delivers items but also grants wishes.

Name: Primal Howl
Description: Maybe you could leave and see the outside world?' the traveler suggested. But she shook her head.

Name: Nightfall Radiance
Description: When the sun rose weeks later, people walked to the fields only to see crops drowned by the rain.

Name: Twin Shadows
Description: The little bats are very particular. Ordinary food is too bland for them. They only eat humans' nightmares.

Name: Trial by Fire
Description: Lurking shadows deceive. Smooth paths can turn to traps, and claws may take the shape of old friends.

Name: Paradox of Fate
Description: The witch does not appear in the alley, so the boy decides to head to the crossroad himself. He knows it leads home.

Name: Midnight Mirage
Description: Welton's eternal city lights glow outside. Flowers and gifts pile up in her lounge, like another set, unreal to her.

Name: Blissful Realm
Description: Please open, Miss Lulu! Here, you are the only star. Anything is possible and any splendid dream can come true.'

Name: Blissful Realm - Dream
Description: She carefully lifts the outfits off of the grass. The colors and fabrics match her imagination perfectly.

Name: Forest Pathway
Description: What photos should she take? She thinks of wheat fields and sparkling lakes near her town, but there's no forest.

Name: Forest Pathway - Berry
Description: The wind carries the fresh scent of leaves and soil. Squirrels leap down, landing gently in her hands with pinecones.

Name: Ephemeral Splendor
Description: She seems to see a butterfly as she passes the door, and the world transforms into a bustling theater.

Name: Caramel Melody
Description: Shiny caramel oozed down, covering the waffles in an amber coat. The sweetness drew in lines of customers.

Name: Trace of Pearl
Description: Hopes shine like gems, brighter than pearls. Leaving her throne, Tano waits on the reef for news brought by tides.

Name: Vines of Lingering Scent
Description: Under her care, the puppy's fur shines. Time with it brings Ava inspiration, making her creations smoother.

Name: Joyful Leap
Description: Just as she finishes cutting a new dress, the doorbell rings. It's Miss Rabbit, her best friend in the forest.

Name: Heartfelt Memories
Description: This is Snow Dreamland, dear traveler. Will you spend happy moments with us?' The bear asks, but she looks down.

Name: Vanilla Breeze
Description: Cream and honey pancakes, burgers with seared patties, and a boiling tofu pot... All looked appetizing.

Name: Silent Symphony
Description: Stars shine on an empty corner. Matty is surprised to see a telescope standing there as if quietly waiting for her.

Name: Cirrus of Wishes
Description: As the sky darkens and shadows swarm in from all around, a fluffy bear stands firmly in front of Betty.

Name: 晴空足迹
Description: 最近，南斯洛城早报进行了改版，订阅量飞涨，夏洛特热情地接下了满满一摞报纸，开始了一天的工作。

Name: Poem of Slumber
Description: As the sun sets, a girl finally fills her basket with mushrooms, only to realize darkness has swallowed the forest.

Name: 活力重启
Description: 凭借良好的口碑，来找卡米化妆的人越来越多。有人提前三个月向她预约，也有人跨越城市请她为自己设计妆面。

Name: 活力重启·沁风
Description: 有时，卡米会摆设临时化妆摊，为想尝试的人们设计妆容。她将拍摄过的鸟羽与流风自然地融入其中，灵动无比。

Name: 活力重启·柚夏
Description: 卡米敏锐地发现了两人之间的柔情。直到汽水不再冒泡，青年才与少女告别。后者望着街道，久久没有挪开视线。

Name: 活力重启·暮海
Description: 终于，她获得了演出的机会，登台后她才发现，表演不是跳舞就足够。观众为她的舞蹈喝彩，心却从不停留。

Name: 妙趣心情
Description: 外层是香脆的白巧克力，咬开后草莓夹心清甜可口，父母品尝后惊喜不已，连声称赞她的手艺。

Name: 妙趣心情·愿
Description: 被烘烤过的焦香在她舌尖弥漫，小女孩牵紧她有些冰凉的手，快步朝不远处亮着温暖光芒的建筑跑去。

Name: 妙趣心情·游
Description: 她下定决心接受挑战，向精灵们遥指的过山车快步跑去，鼓起勇气，大步跨上蜜瓜糖球做成的座椅。

Name: 妙趣心情·谜
Description: 树上挂满各色莓果，色泽鲜艳，在月下流淌着莹光，她摘下它们细细品尝，将不同的滋味牢牢记在心间。

Name: 迷幻诗篇
Description: 随着旋律的尾音消散，华美诡谲的舞剧落下帷幕。掌声和尖叫响起，台下的观众仿佛亲历了一场古堡的奇幻之旅。

Name: 迷幻诗篇·华丽
Description: 忙碌的日常冲淡了一切，蜜亚将问题抛在脑后。反正丽嘉喜欢喝草莓汁，爱喝草莓汁的人能有什么坏心思呢！

Name: 迷幻诗篇·珍稀
Description: 为了搜集了市面上好喝的草莓汁，女孩们可是花费了不少心思。她们纷纷挤在桌后，小心翼翼地探出半个脑袋。

Name: 迷幻诗篇·流云

Description: 在父母的鼓励下，她的创作热情更浓了。众多草莓味的甜品接连诞生，顾客毫不吝啬的赞许让她脸颊微红。

Name: 愉悦向往·愿
Description: 这是小镇上的福利院，孩子们正在筹备冬日庆典，他们一面说笑，一面协力在房间内挂满富有童心的装饰。

Name: 愉悦向往·游
Description: 过山车从半空呼啸而下，她的心仿佛在空中飞翔，每过一个转弯，精灵们都会向她抛洒五彩缤纷的糖豆。

Name: 愉悦向往·谜
Description: 这些美味的果实，每一样都是不错的原料！她欣喜不已，迫切期待着能将脑中源源不断的灵感付诸实践。

Name: 丝绒夜语
Description: 这是最近风靡各大平台的话题舞台剧。以血族为主题，整套概念都出自当红剧团的灵魂人物——丽嘉之手。

Name: 丝绒夜语·华丽
Description: 某天晚上大家练习到深夜。月光被乌云渐渐遮掩，夜风拂过一地萧瑟的枯叶，这一晚的街道无疑安静得过分。

Name: 丝绒夜语·珍稀
Description: “啊，她喝了我买的草莓汁！”“快记下来，丽嘉喜欢这个！”成员们的窃窃私语并没逃过丽嘉的耳朵。

Name: 丝绒夜语·流云
Description: 时代的目光不会为任何人而长久停留。这出舞台剧让这个剧团一度备受瞩目，但之后几场表演反响却很平淡。

Name: 丝绒夜语·午夜
Description: 在追求梦想的道路上，蜜亚已经找到了更真实更坚定的自我，而她多么希望丽嘉也能感受到这份心情。

Name: 点墨渲青
Description: 周遭光影缓慢而细微地变换着，暮色笼罩了整个世界。阿萝不禁想：倘若当初选择了另一条路，如今会是怎样呢？

Name: 点墨渲青·华丽
Description: 花店的少女仔细地搭配着花朵，又在花束中放入精美的手写卡。尽管只是平淡的日常工作，她仍然干劲十足。

Name: 点墨渲青·珍稀
Description: 平凡世界像未经雕琢的璞玉，稍加打磨便会绽放出独特的光华。水面上摇曳的碎光，是独属于这一刻的美景。

Name: 点墨渲青·兰烟
Description: 老宅里的天光与祖母温柔的声音交织，氤氲间酿成了余味绵长的童年回忆。阿萝所有的梦想，都在那里萌芽。

Name: 点墨渲青·林荫
Description: 倘若选择了另一条路，如今会是怎样呢？阿萝心中已经有了答案。带着祖母的礼物，她可以过好任何一种生活。

Name: 黑巧牛奶
Description: 有一天，结束了一场和同类的冲突后，我发觉自己身处陌生的区域，气味交织，路线复杂，我认不出回去的方向。

Name: 黑巧牛奶·愉
Description: 咖啡馆的客人越来越多，猫也是。新成员一个个到来：橘黄的、纯黑的、灰白的、当然，还有和我一样的狸花。

Name: 黑巧牛奶·欢
Description: 原来游乐园里也有很多危险：忽如其来的降雨，呼啸而过的车轮，吃了上顿没下顿的担忧，还有黏在身上的毒虫。

Name: 盈香庭园
Description: 一场严寒毫无预兆地席卷而来，不过一夜之间，绚烂尽褪，草木凋零，徒留枯枝在寒风中瑟缩。

Name: 盈香庭园·萌
Description: 花园被深浅不一的绿色覆盖，锦簇繁花点缀其间，缤纷而又有致的色彩正如她记忆深处的模样！

Name: 盈香庭园·忆
Description: 她迫不及待翻开泛黄的书页，母亲画的花朵跃然纸上，清秀的字迹如藤蔓般蜿蜒，透着让人安心的隽雅与沉静。

Name: 荣耀长阶
Description: 惊叹于她的机智勇敢，队长邀请她成为新的号手，用嘹亮的号声指明方向、传递希望，为战友们带来胜利的曙光。

Name: 荣耀长阶·夜
Description: 军号在寂静的夜空中回荡，士兵们在黑暗中分散潜伏，随着敌情的变化，她吹响了不同节奏的号声灵活应对。

Name: 荣耀长阶·曦
Description: 盛大的阅兵式上，她手持银质军号走在方阵前列，吹奏出胜利的乐章，人们振臂欢呼，歌颂着和平与未来。

Name: Forlorn Visitor
Description: A musician moved into a cabin at the edge of the forest and lay in bed alone all day like a soundless instrument.

Name: Blooming Vines
Description: She crosses the town to the settlement outside the walls, where northern refugees take shelter.

Name: Stormlit Clouds
Description: Dense mist smothers the sea, lightning weaving through it. As if calling to her, the lightning tugs at her soul.

Name: 夜鼓山魂
Description: 少女扬起指尖，下一瞬，迷蝶扑向了少年的面庞，跌入无边幻梦前，他的最后一个念头闪过——把我喂点别的吧！

Name: Peachy Creek
Description: She wades home through the stream as the reflection of peach blossoms turns into a shade of pink in the ripples.

Name: Butterfly's Repose
Description: As the sky clears, a butterfly perches on a branch, following the fragrance and sinking into a long dream.

Name: Shared Moments
Description: Birdsong at her window, her mother's cake, and storybook villains… Tessa shared all her joys and sorrows with Snowy.

Name: Winter's Magic
Description: Songs rise with the chimes to greet winter,' Loryn hummed her grandma's tune as a sudden thought stirred within her.

Name: Winter's Ballad
Description: Drawn by the ringing, snow drifted down and gathered beneath trees, forming smiling snowmen crowned with mistletoe.

Name: Hymn of the Coldwind
Description: On festival eve, she arrives on dreamlit starlight; frost blooms into crystal flowers, and bells ring in joy.

Name: 晴空微澜
Description: 一天，菲莉丝的妹妹抱着一盒立体拼图找到她，懊恼地向姐姐求助。菲莉丝笑着带她在桌前坐下，打开了盒盖。

Name: Sparkling Chocolate
Description: Riki feels at a loss for ideas, as if her creativity and imagination were trapped in a fog and her mind was in a daze.

Name: 谧色回音
Description: 夜幕无声，宛若一卷厚重的深色绒布，少女登上高塔，看微风将浅云织作最柔软的丝线，又缀上漫天星彩。

Name: 柔光稚语
Description: 父母带着年幼的法西安住进了度假山庄。这里群峰环绕，终年积雪，法西安度过了一生中最无忧无虑的时光。

Name: 柔光稚语·夜
Description: 法西安感觉自己被一种柔软的力量轻轻托起，如此熟悉而安宁，她忍不住打了个哈欠，在那片怀抱中沉沉睡去。

Name: 晚风回响
Description: 她想，她还有很长时间可以挥霍，直到在无数漫不经心的尝试中找到喜欢的事……她以为一切烦恼都会迎刃而解。

Name: 晚风回响·幽
Description: 曾经遮蔽眼前的迷雾不知何时已经悄然散去，露比娜不再急于追逐轻易到手的成功，她重新拿起了笔开始书写。

Name: 柳色青青
Description: 柳色几度新绿，牧心渐渐长成青竹般秀颀的少女。她自幼无法言语，却有一颗灵澈之心，善于聆听万物细微之声。

Name: 柳色青青·暖阳
Description: 心灰意冷的牧心不知不觉走到了春神庙，她怔怔地倚着门扉，在疲惫中沉沉睡去，脸上还挂着担忧与焦急的泪水。

Name: 祥气迎春
Description: 母亲眼中的亮光驱散了她长途奔波的倦意。她小跑过去，一头扎进母亲的怀抱，母亲温热的手攥住了她的指尖。

Name: 阑夜寻春
Description: 少女提灯徐行，踏过嫣红的落花，涉过松软的积雪，正当她止步观赏粉墙绮窗边那一枝寒梅时，天际传来轻啸——

Name: Sunlit Promenade
Description: A red-tailed squirrel curiously observes the human as she smiles. It blinks and jumps back into the bushes.

Name: Wind over Ripples
Description: The wind from the hills ripples the manor lake. All her worries drift away with the breeze as she lingers.

Name: Untethered Dream
Description: Pack your dreams into your bag and set out with hope, no matter how rough the road ahead may be.

Name: Springtime Blessing
Description: Her friend pats her on the shoulder as they search on. Around the corner, she smells a faint fragrance.

Name: 重锦仙葩
Description: 一阵清雅怡人的花香拂过，萝萝们忽而兴奋地欢呼起来，头戴帷帽，身着袨服的少女向暖暖浅笑致意。

Name: 芳尘步
Description: 那花种吸收了天地千年灵气，是万千牡丹中最为珍贵之物，一点金辉没入山河之间，她追着这踪影匆匆跃入凡间。

Name: 赤霞流丹
Description: 轻柔的尾羽拂过树梢，嫩绿的新芽便如翠玉般点缀枝头，云翎又飞到溪边，喙尖啄开冰面，清澈的溪水潺潺流淌。

Name: 勇者赞歌
Description: 勇敢的公主翻过积雪遍布的山岭，被盘踞山中的恶龙拦住了去路，恶龙凶狠地咆哮着，巨大的身影遮天蔽日。

Name: 春意留白
Description: 怀揣着一颗惶恐不安的心，阿绯硬着头皮开始了这份新工作，辛辛苦苦一个月，终于成功令自己倒欠了上百功德。

Name: 澄澈爱恋
Description: 那时的雕塑家还太过年轻，他以为未来会像自己手中的作品一样坚实而恒定，人世间的风雨无法撼动其分毫。

Name: 凝芳悠行
Description: 秋千架摇晃不止，发出吱呀轻响。命运之风始终包绕其左右，时缓时急，将它精妙的安排悉数传达。

Name: Emerald Reminiscence
Description: As preparations intensify, Risa's hoop snaps without warning, and her back adornments tangle as she turns.

Name: 信步芳尘
Description: 时逢下界大疫，久旱不雨，千里皆化焦土，青芒见饿殍塞川之惨象，秀眉微蹙——律令未至，她无从布雨回春。

Name: 泠泠星芒
Description: 精灵们不愿娜伊达饱尝孤单的滋味，不管是起雾的清晨，还是夕阳斜照的黄昏，总有小精灵穿过丛林来寻她。

Name: 日照荒原
Description: 直到某天日蚀降临，光明被一只无形的手抹去了。荒原陷入前所未有的漫长黑暗，沙海嗡鸣，狂兽自黑夜中现身。

Name: 化羽栖时
Description: 可年岁推移，她的力量仍仅限于此。无论多么努力地尝试更进一步，每一次欧珀都只会陷入更深的挫败。

Name: 山止川行
Description: 天地在这一刻安静下来，巫祝伏地而拜，她的心潮如此澎湃，有那么多的疑惑与恳求，此时却说不出只字片言。

Name: Moonward Stride
Description: She was so transfixed by the heavenly tune that she stood up and followed it barefoot outside her palace.

Name: Tomorrow's Wonder
Description: The girl is flushed from the run. She opens the mailbox and holds the letter from afar to her chest.

Name: Warm Breeze Dance
Description: Maxie checks every old note, dries the grain, and tweaks the recipe with care, yet every attempt ends in failure.

Name: Gentle Breeze Waltz
Description: Deep in the valley, the green-clad fairy raises her cup. Tiny fairies tumble in clover as distant songs become their reward.

Name: Breezy Trails
Description: She stumbles on a hiking magazine. She studies every photo and imagines herself there.

Name: Nectarous Path
Description: Tulips bloom under the sky as smooth as washed satin. Lucia takes in the fresh fragrance and feels her heart lighten.

Name: Friends of Wonderland
Description: They cover Irena in a lustrous veil and guide her through the blooming garden in the warm sun and gentle breeze.

Name: Waltz of Wonder
Description: Fragrances from the garden still linger around her fingers, and the girls' voices still echo in her ears.

Name: Triumphant Ride
Description: As the sun sets, the steed slows. Cheng and Sky pass through paved streets as a snowflake lands on Sky's mane.

Name: Dust-Free Gallop
Description: The crowd cheers and fireworks rain down from afar. A colorful flag is presented to Cheng in honor of her victory.

Name: Light Footsteps
Description: The next afternoon, as Elno packs up her tools, the familiar fluff runs from the fields and gently rests its paws on her knee.

Name: Invincible Advance
Description: No firewall stops her. She breaks through layers of defense and uncovers the carefully buried evidence.

Name: Night Infiltration
Description: Amid perfume and toasts, Morton scans the room with champagne in hand, until he meets a pair of familiar eyes.

Name: Strawbeary Mousse
Description: The toy bear Riko puts by the counter seems hungry, too. Strawberry cake or mochi? She finds it hard to decide.

Name: 失控节拍
Description: 林夏沉浸在自己的幻想世界里，无数绚烂缤纷的意象扑面而来，她信誓旦旦要写出一首所有人都喜欢的歌。

Name: 失控节拍·夜紫
Description: 她们在舞台上尽情演奏、歌唱，汗水在灯光下闪着细碎的光，音浪翻涌而来，台下的观众大声呼喊着乐队的名字。

Name: 失控节拍·银白
Description: 城市在夜色中呼吸，每个细小的瞬间都真实而鲜活。林夏忽然被某种节奏击中了，杂乱的声音仿佛自动排列起来。

Name: 失控节拍·青柠
Description: 林夏把写好的歌曲分享给乐队的大家，朋友们兴致勃勃地讨论着什么时候开始排练，新消息一条接一条跳出来。

Name: 筑愿旅程
Description: 我愣了愣，连忙伸手回握住她的手。今天北地的寒风似乎不像往常一般凛冽，我感觉掌心似乎有些发热。

Name: 筑愿旅程·忆
Description: 征得教官准许后，茉琳扶我进了船舱。感到万分丢脸的我把脸深深埋在枕头里，她隔着被子轻轻拍了拍我。

Name: 筑愿旅程·海
Description: 北地即使入春仍带寒意，在茉琳的提议下，我们带着小白鸽出了趟远门——哈罗德的天空之镜，她很喜欢那里。

Name: 筑愿旅程·念
Description: 茉琳的姑姑找到学校，将那只手提箱交给了我。很长一段时间里，我只是把它放在床边，整夜整夜地守着它。

Name: 宿命凝望
Description: 怀抱憧憬的人得到鼓舞，心怀悲伤的人得到安慰，那是萨迦对占卜的最初印象。她希望自己也成为祖母那样的人。

Name: 宿命凝望·华丽
Description: 水晶球中泛起微光，一片模糊的景象在其中缓缓铺展，萨迦忍不住屏住呼吸。祖母的面容却仍然沉静又温柔。

Name: 宿命凝望·珍稀
Description: 萨迦不禁想起那个雪夜里，她和其他年轻的占卜师们挤在一起，紧张地看着祖母的水晶球，等待着一个答案。

Name: 宿命凝望·苍穹
Description: 昔日萨迦从祖母身上学到的，这一刻在莉卡心中悄然流淌。当人们窥见未来的时候，便也掌握了去改变它的可能。

Name: 宿命凝望·樱华
Description: 取消行程会为商队带来巨大的损失，可面对预言中不幸的未来，商人们又感到深深的恐惧，一时不知该如何是好。

Name: 巧心梦旅
Description: 除了精巧崭新的玩偶外，柜台后还放着一只旧旧的小羊，小羊玩偶身上有许多缝补的痕迹，显然经历了不少时间。

Name: 巧心梦旅·华丽
Description: 当她们终于做好了第一只小羊时，忍不住拥抱着欢呼起来，妹妹兴奋地说，这是她成为伟大玩偶师的第一步！

Name: 巧心梦旅·珍稀
Description: 女孩毫不犹豫地点了点头。佩洛举起了自己的法杖，微光亮起，女孩的神情变得平静，眼底的泪水也消失不见。

Name: 巧心梦旅·诺
Description: 她恋恋不舍地环视着小小的房间，用手一遍又一遍地抚摸每样东西——它们都承载着她与妹妹珍贵的回忆。

Name: 巧心梦旅·愈
Description: 玩偶成了空白记忆中唯一的锚点，似乎曾经有一双布满皱纹的手为小熊装上纽扣眼睛，那是深刻在灵魂中的画面。

Name: 猫之奇旅
Description: 悠娜给小猫起名“塔塔”，每天都精心准备水和食物，塔塔每次只是优雅地享用完，然后舔舔爪子离开。

Name: 猫之奇旅·伴
Description: 一贯不太亲近人的塔塔低下头，用鼻尖碰了碰她滚烫的手背，温暖的热源始终紧贴着她，悠娜瞬间眼眶湿润。

Name: 猫之奇旅·绘
Description: 失而复得的喜悦涌上心间，她转过头，恰好看见塔塔在阳光下梳理毛发的优雅姿态，一道灵光倏然划过脑海。

Name: 灵感追寻
Description: 热烈的交流与沟通总会在工坊出现，灵感与创意在这里碰撞，化作一张张独特的设计图、一套套充满巧思的新装。

Name: 灵感追寻·忆
Description: 直到一支流浪乐队来到这座城镇，奏响了缇妮从未听过的旋律。少女第一次溜出了家门，偷偷跑到了乐队的营地。

Name: 灵感追寻·纪
Description: 缇妮认真地向少女提出了对于创意糕点的感受和想法，少女也会仔细地观看缇妮的设计图稿，给出自己的建议。

Name: 忠诚守护
Description: 安腊憋着一口气，她想要证明自己，与安莱并肩战斗，安莱听完却紧锁眉目，眼中只有深深的顾虑与担忧。

Name: 忠诚守护·丛森
Description: 最后一匹胡狼已然奔至，腾跃而起，扑向安腊。少女抽出短匕，翻身闪过攻击的同时，将刃锋刺入了胡狼的肚腹。

Name: 忠诚守护·天穹
Description: 每次安腊外出打猎时，安莱便会放下部落中的琐事，悄然尾随。那些潜伏的危险，悄无声息地被安莱的羽箭解决。

Name: Unspoken Wish
Description: The nervous and insecure girl fell into a dream: a black bunny salutes her in a garden with its gates ajar.

Name: Covert Voyage
Description: She opens the door and tells the servant outside, 'Please give me the biggest slice of strawberry cake!'

Name: 盎然春意
Description: 她照常提着木桶走向水井，却忽然看见一团不寻常的绿色，蔫巴巴地趴在地面上一动不动，仿佛下一秒就要融化。

Name: A Moment of Humor
Description: No dull moments. Every prop brings a surprise! Even simple boots makes a cute, quirky sound at just the right time.

Name: 活力漫途
Description: 晨光落在窗台，教室也被镀上一层金色的光晕，菲奈和大家一起朗读起课本上的诗文，徜徉在文字构筑的世界里。

Name: Scarlet Dream

Description: Unable to say no, Yunshi agrees to take her as an apprentice if she finishes ten books in the allotted time.

Name: Priceless Words
Description: The only word Cassia can write is her name. Yunshi is the one that taught her. Medical scrolls will be a challenge.

Name: Hidden Wisdom
Description: Humans engraved pictures on bamboo strips to represent various meanings. Cassia is amazed by what she sees.

Name: Numbed Heart
Description: Experiencing many goodbyes, Yunshi thought she'd never feel again. The sight of an ill young man still saddens her.

Name: Cabinet of Treasures
Description: Yunshi can feel the life in every herb. After processing, even ordinary herbs thrive.

Name: Unexpected Cure
Description: Before Yunshi's transformation, death was normal for her. She became conscious and learned of the cruelty of time.

Name: Farewell, My Love
Description: Yunshi holds his frail hand and sees her reflection in his eyes. No questions were asked. He knew her sacrifices.

Name: Breeze of Kindness
Description: Yunshi became curious about the world after hearing the young man's stories. She sets out to see the world.

Name: Measured Time
Description: As she travels, she returns to the pharmacy every few years. The young man has never lost the smile on his face.

Name: Priceless Formula
Description: The pharmacy has a special place in Yunshi's heart. The two can talk about medicine all day and still feel content.

Name: Bitter Lifesaver
Description: Greenery usually return to their roots, but Yunshi views her 'roots' as Farewell Pharmacy instead of the mountains.

Name: Chest of Wishes
Description: The city-state was powerless in the end. The final survivor went to the temple, wanting to turn back time.

Name: Midnight Heart
Description: Deserters spread rumors about the temple, attracting other rulers. They secretly formed armies to investigate.

Name: Abyssal Shadow
Description: The survivor realized that unless he killed the girl, everything he did would still lead to the same conclusion.

Name: Hand of Desire
Description: Some rushed to make wishes, some fled the city. It was as if the devil's hands were manipulating everything here.

Name: Winter's Chant
Description: The girl sat in the temple, emotionless. The sound of singing and dancing could be heard from the capital's square.

Name: Sleep Talking
Description: Merchants realized they didn't have to work to make money. No one wanted to serve the rich and powerful anymore.

Name: Unexpected Storm
Description: Those in power blocked off the temple, and others secretly acted as guards to obtain this priceless power.

Name: Chaotic Path
Description: Countless people were killed, then revived by magic. The magnificent capital was in chaos.

Name: Shifting Undercurrent
Description: Money had no meaning. Only those in power could make wishes, and the desires of others turned into bloody crimes.

Name: Sweet Heartbeat
Description: The girl pushes open the shop's door and sees the boy standing in the alley. She boldly takes his hand.

Name: Bird Shepherd
Description: After the swallow's injury recovered, her mate came to her. Lady Lashani held a feast to send them off.

Name: Flower Bed
Description: Legend says a mysterious witch, Lady Lashani, lives in the mountains. She can communicate with plants and trees.

Name: Floral Pillars
Description: Spring comes to an end. Lady Lashani looks upon withered roses in her garden and whispers the swallow's song.

Name: Crown of Light
Description: Lady Lashani is alone in everything she does. She enjoys afternoon tea in the garden, watching the roses by herself.

Name: Speechless Radiance
Description: Lady Lashani slowly studies the language of plants. She has a long time to listen to each flower's tiny voice.

Name: Floral Beauty
Description: The swallow sings every song she knows for Lady Lashani. With the roses' translation, the Lady understood.

Name: Bubbling Spring
Description: The Fiend crawled out of the earth and engulfed tribes in flame. People's wails soon reached the Goddess's ears.

Name: Guardian Goddess
Description: People built a shrine to pray to the Goddess, who listened to their wishes and alleviated their pain and suffering.

Name: Divine Salvation
Description: The Goddess gazed upon the burning world, eyes full of sorrow. A tear fell, turning into an iridescent orb.

Name: Roaring Tempest
Description: The Fiend breathed fire, devouring lives and scorching the earth. The Goddess stood alone, determined to fight it.

Name: Spring Echoes
Description: To stop the Fiend, the Goddess of Wind stabbed herself in the chest, spring water gushing out and cleansing the world.

Name: Empyrean Tears
Description: For seven days it rained on the burning houses and demonic flames erupting from underground.

Name: Serene Peace
Description: No more flames, the rain ceased and peace was restored. The Goddess, exhausted of power, vanished like a drop of rain.

Name: Bubbling Spring - Annex
Description: Covered in dust and mud, the young man had walked long on the perilous mountains when he heard the sound of a spring.

Name: Guardian Goddess - Annex
Description: It was a lonesome journey, but he remained determined. A breeze caressed his cheek as if to guide him.

Name: Divine Salvation - Annex
Description: He struggled over rocks and saw a bubbling spring, clear and shimmering like a precious gem of the mountains.

Name: Roaring Tempest - Annex
Description: He thought of the Goddess's fight with the Fiend from the legends, tears of excitement rolling down his cheeks.

Name: Spring Echoes - Annex
Description: The man thought the bubbling of the spring the best sound in the world, as the chilly water washed away his tiredness.

Name: Empyrean Tears - Annex
Description: The moment the man's tears fell into the spring, it illuminated and all the mist around the mountains gathered there.

Name: Serene Peace - Annex
Description: Rain fell on the mountains that had dried for years. The Goddess reappeared with a young priest along her side.

Name: Warm Geniality
Description: One morning, the girl passed by Dana's window and praised her grandma's flower arrangements, so she gifted her one.

Name: Wish of Eternity
Description: Flowers wither, so Dana picked up her paintbrush to give her a present that could last forever.

Name: Endless Fantasy
Description: The next day, she walked down the street, stepping in puddles to bring a pack of candy for Dana's flower.

Name: Flowering Moments
Description: Dana wasn't a child who wanted candy anymore, but she couldn't say no to the girl's warm smile and tried it anyway.

Name: Warm Geniality - Gorgeous
Description: Dana has been painting ever since. The greatest beauty is life itself, echoing every tiny beauty in space and time.

Name: Wish of Eternity - Gorgeous
Description: Dana left the town to pursue art. She would sometimes look at the candy wrapping as if it filled her with strength.

Name: Endless Fantasy - Gorgeous
Description: She would decorate her rooms like her grandma did. A fresh bouquet in the morning was her way of nostalgia.

Name: Flowering Moments - Gorgeous
Description: Dana immersed herself in colors. She had a place to be, and the arduous journey before she got there was worth it.

Name: Warm Geniality - Rare
Description: Along with the letter was a painting of a girl sitting by a window with a bouquet beside her. It was the young Dana.

Name: Wish of Eternity - Rare
Description: Dana continued to paint as usual, inspired by the artist's words and no longer bothered by what others thought.

Name: Endless Fantasy - Rare
Description: As she created one masterpiece after another, praise and admiration replaced the voice of contempt.

Name: Flowering Moments - Rare
Description: Dana was now praised instead of mocked for being a small-town girl. She found it funny because she had never changed.

Name: Warm Geniality - Candy
Description: The artist never mentioned anything in the letters. Instead, she just sent different flavors of candy for Dana.

Name: Wish of Eternity - Candy
Description: The artist's name was hardly uttered anymore, and when it was, people just lamented her lack of inspiration.

Name: Endless Fantasy - Candy
Description: Tears streaming down her face, Dana thought of how the artist's brilliant work inspired the young girl she once was.

Name: Flowering Moments - Candy
Description: Dana walked down a meandering alley to a sunlit open window, the artist sitting inside, arranging a fresh bouquet.

Name: Warm Geniality - Cirrus
Description: With Dana's skills and the artist's creativity, admirers came to learn at the studio and brought it back to life.

Name: Wish of Eternity - Cirrus
Description: One day, a student knocked over Dana's notebook, a curious old candy wrapping slipping out of the pages.

Name: Endless Fantasy - Cirrus
Description: Dana said it was an important gift, but the student was more confused. It was like any candy wrappings at the studio.

Name: Flowering Moments - Cirrus
Description: Maybe whoever gifted the candy is special to Dana.' the student thought and unwrapped the candy the artist brought.

Name: Frolicking Rhythm
Description: A stage showing wondrous places with music appeared in Bona's plans. She wants to express her feelings herself.

Name: Wandering Chapter
Description: The echoing music made her think. Music records people's hopes for the future, and technology realizes them.

Name: River of Notes
Description: Luminescent lights appear whenever Bona's conductor's baton waves. Bona smiles and weaves rivers of music.

Name: Mechanical Pipes
Description: Bona leads people across time and space with music and traverses new eras. The future is vibrant and delightful.

Name: Iridescent Stars
Description: Future' draws people to Bona's performances. Lights and stellar butterflies combine to give shape to the future.

Name: Incredible Thoughts
Description: She's been tasked with programming since childhood, and Bona always revolutionized her delivered projects.

Name: Art of Display
Description: Music is a singer's language, like code for a programmer. Bona lays out rows of code and completes the stage.

Name: Rhythmic Guidance
Description: Bona collects many music pieces to develop the acoustic module, entrancing her in her small studio.

Name: Gap in Reality
Description: The virtual Bona is a popular idol, while Bona in reality is a coder from Ruin Island skilled at programming.

Name: Dazzling Butterflies
Description: A future full of possibilities contains countless hope, which is what draws people to Bona's songs.

Name: Transparent Thoughts
Description: Bona is refreshed in classical music and rejuvenated in pop, seeing infinite hope in different genres.

Name: Wings of Future
Description: The wings behind the idol Bona also represent the programmer's dream that hope will carry humans into the future.

Name: Spacetime Imprint
Description: Bona sings. The butterfly's wings shiver and people take on new travels to hyperspace in its breeze.

Name: Frost Blade
Description: The first dragon rider had lost her companion, and many other lives were lost in the never-ending battle.

Name: Final Frostbone
Description: The long war left the land in ruins. One day, a glowing, skeletal creature appeared on the battlefield.

Name: Prayer of Light
Description: Time went by, and her little dragon grew up. Many people learned the language of the Dragon Clan.

Name: Sound and Shadow
Description: Dragons love shiny things, and Zoe's dragon stared at the jewel in her palm as her tail wagged.

Name: Mirrored Dawn
Description: War descended as Zoe's dragon mourned its fallen friend. Zoe tried to stop the conflict, but people turned on her.

Name: Deep-Sea Revelation
Description: Humans cannot bear the wrath of dragons, and the dragon knight's warning had been lost, dooming the land.

Name: Midnight Light
Description: Greedy evildoers trapped a lone dragon in search of treasure. A group of dragons came at the sound of its cries.

Name: Aqua Pearl
Description: The children playing by the city walls are taken home by adults, wondering why they can't approach the dragon.

Name: Divine Robes
Description: Zoe ordered her dragon to leave, but it disobeyed her and rushed toward the crowd attacking her.

Name: Fresh Supreme
Description: A day goes by in the blink of an eye. Time is fleeting, but no matter what, the silent love remains intact.

Name: Truthful Protection
Description: His sacrifices continue in silence. It's only when we grow up and look back do we hear the unspoken words of love.

Name: Tireless Trek
Description: The stacks of homework and notebooks are the most precious souvenirs from all those years of hard work.

Name: Words of Resolution
Description: Written in the words are the memorized answers and years of diligence and aspiration for a bright future.

Name: Jar of Wishes
Description: The raccoon shook its head and spun thrice. In a flash of color, the girl gasped—a wondrous scene appeared.

Name: Nectar Essence
Description: The orchard gleamed. Fruit hung full, juice flowed through stones, and the girl heard the trees softly sing.

Name: Crisp Enchantment
Description: As dusk fell, the girl packed up alone. Then, in the orchard’s corner, something flashed and vanished.

Name: Harvest Melody
Description: She welcomed her first harvest. That day, a gentle autumn breeze brushed her hair—just like her grandmother's touch.

Name: Delicate Sweetness
Description: She bonded with the trees and learned her grandma’s cake recipe—to share with a special friend.

Name: Warm Embrace
Description: It was a fluffy raccoon with a striped tail—wait, it had Grandma’s handmade apron in its mouth!

Name: Crystal Sweetheart
Description: The apple was bright red—just like those Grandma once grew. The girl glanced at the raccoon, puzzled and curious.

Name: Faerie Voyage
Description: The girl chased it into the woods. Just as she pressed on, the raccoon stopped and tossed her an apple.

Name: Blossom Pact
Description: During a break, a raccoon brought her a fragrant cake. She took a bite—it was Grandma’s fruit mille-feuille!

Name: Silky Splendor
Description: A bamboo basket floated down the glittering river, and upon a closer look, Anya saw a bunny lying in it.

Name: Gleaming Fluff
Description: The basket floated up and down with the weak bunny quivering helplessly inside. Anya immediately held it in her arms.

Name: Lovely Snowball
Description: The bunny lay in her arms, trembling unconsciously. Anya's heart ached when she saw a ghastly wound in its leg.

Name: Silky Splendor - Heart
Description: The bunny suddenly stood up, the worn cushion anew in a flash of light and twirling around her in the air.

Name: Gleaming Fluff - Heart
Description: Anya felt the worry in the bunny's tone and nodded. It patted her, a starlight mark appearing in the palm of her hand.

Name: Lovely Snowball - Heart
Description: Anya and the talking bunny teamed up. She even sewed a cape for it and set out with it riding on the flying cushion.

Name: Dream-Weaving Flowers
Description: Peachy tulle flowers decorate the white dress with gorgeous shape and movement, showcasing the designer's skill.

Name: Childhood Innocence
Description: With much wine in her stomach, she strode confidently to challenge the girl but fell asleep in the backyard instead.

Name: Artless Shifting
Description: She sneered at the free lunch, head held high, but still gorged on the food before falling asleep soundly.

Name: Brisk Chime
Description: In her dreams, she was still a naughty tanuki a few months ago. No one could keep a rein on her despite her pranks.

Name: Dangling Leaves
Description: The girl was always friendly to her and even gifted her a leaf umbrella, which sheltered her from many rains.

Name: Clear Moonshine
Description: She strode to the village when the girl smiled and shared food and wine with her instead. She was drunk in no time.

Name: Bamboo Dewdrop in Breeze
Description: She didn't live in the bamboo shelter the girl built because of pride, but she would often take naps inside.

Name: Springwater Relish
Description: It was the tanuki's prized homebrew with an intoxicating smell, a treasure only shared with true friends.

Name: Guardian Tanuki
Description: The clever girl caught her in one try and then set her free after knowing she didn't mean harm. What a peculiar human.

Name: Fuzzy Sway
Description: Seeing the girl in her sleep, she blushed, aborted the plan to pull pranks, hopped out of the window and ran home.

Name: Wisteria Charm
Description: Mira used to make childish designs with wisteria, which sparked her decision to leave home and pursue her dream.

Name: Ripple of Vines
Description: Her parents have sent a letter with wisteria blooms. Away from home, Mira shares the same beautiful view with them.

Name: Echoes of Truth
Description: Mona loves the town and her life. It's quiet and peaceful, as if the world was filled with goodness at every moment.

Name: Puzzle Solver
Description: Through thin clouds, the silver moon shines on the empty streets, as she pursues the truth among the shadows.

Name: Case Breakdown
Description: The culprit is in handcuffs when she catches up, and a handsome officer tips his hat, 'Detective, you're late again.'

Name: Brocade in Spring
Description: Walking through the alleys with friends at dawn, sounds can be heard from the academy. Spring is a time to study.

Name: Enchanting Zither Song
Description: The strings of the zither tangle as kites fly low. One suddenly breaks, floating in the wind, then disappearing.

Name: Splendid Cut
Description: Sadness is a farewell, and melancholy is common. Why try to grow up when you can fly kites and look at the sky?

Name: First Blossom
Description: Some sigh, but some children celebrate that the kite is free. A childlike heart is something unique to this world.

Name: Drifting Butterfly
Description: Paper butterflies can surf the wind and land on clouds. Joyful and happy, they return to dance like flying fairies.

Name: Song of the Fairies
Description: Colorful kites float into the sky. Ever present is the desire to be a bird kite, soaring over rivers and mountains.

Name: Devout Blossom
Description: Elba immersed herself in books, where she saw rivers and seas, deserts and forests, like blooms scattered in text.

Name: Dozing Grace
Description: Elba received interviews and commissions as her words had spoken to many, but it was then she hit writer's block.

Name: Forgotten Chapter
Description: The once fluent flow of words was no more and the fascinating ideas turned into single notes that made no tunes.

Name: Reverie Brushes
Description: Elba would stay in her room for a whole day without progress, to the point where she considered giving up writing.

Name: Wondrous Fantasy
Description: Her friend brought her the latest product of the Apple Apparel Group, said to create beautiful dreams for the user.

Name: Devout Blossom - Dream
Description: Fragmented stories pieced together the only truth. Elba came to her fictional world and met the protagonist, Sui.

Name: Dozing Grace - Dream
Description: It was a time of war and conflicting ideas, breeding worries, but also hopes and heroes in the dark before dawn.

Name: Forgotten Chapter - Dream
Description: Elba moved from place to place, as thrilling scenes from her books unfolded before her own eyes.

Name: Reverie Brushes - Dream
Description: She followed Sui through gunfire in alleyways and over towering mountains, feeling as free as a bird.

Name: Wondrous Fantasy - Dream
Description: In dreams, Elba walked the earth and grew alongside Sui in battles, blossoming like a flower atop mountains.

Name: Devout Blossom - Still
Description: Every word she wrote hopped out and glowed the brilliance of dream and freedom as if they came to life.

Name: Dozing Grace - Still
Description: Elba tightened her grip on the pen with a clear answer in mind. She would write the most fitting ending for Sui.

Name: Forgotten Chapter - Still
Description: She will never give up writing. Her stories will continue on with a bright future for every character she has created.

Name: Reverie Brushes - Still
Description: A weakened doesn't trap a free soul, and even the tiniest seed burgeons under the sun one day.

Name: Wondrous Fantasy - Still
Description: Elba thanked her friend for bringing her hope, who then pulled her into a hug and held her hands as encouragement.

Name: Sound Asleep
Description: Imogen doesn't know what the dream will be about. Busy with work, she hasn't had a good sleep or dream for a while.

Name: Infinite Memory
Description: The pillow floated away like a cloud, leaving nothing to support Imogen as she fell into the dream world.

Name: Sound Asleep - Repose
Description: Her grandma held Imogen's hand, telling her to pursue her dream and that she had always been proud of her.

Name: Infinite Memory - Repose
Description: The familiar words questioned Imogen's sense of reality. Which version of her is the truth?

Name: Sound Asleep - Peace
Description: Even though her grandma's hat no longer warmed her, the words of love would forever be the greatest power in her.

Name: Infinite Memory - Peace
Description: Imogen still dreams of the past, but she never indulges in them. There is an old dream that she must chase.

Name: Plum Sugar
Description: School ended with a bell chime. A classmate handed two sugarcoated plums to her which drove away the tiredness.

Name: Nightfall Dance
Description: People roamed the streets at sunset before heading home. Dressed luxuriously, the girl walked into an evening dance.

Name: Chaste Blossoms
Description: Jade and blossoms in her hair and a warm smile on her face, she stands elegantly in the snow.

Name: Flowery Flair
Description: As the saw-wings return in early spring, raindrops gather in puddles, heralding the burgeoning of lives.

Name: Floral Luster
Description: Above the hazy water chirp the finches, as flowers bloom on the banks, like the fine lady in the mirror.

Name: Azure Plume
Description: In a plain dress with feather-like frills, she recalls the departure of a friend under blooming flowers at sundown.

Name: Autumn Stroll
Description: Golden leaves glisten under the autumn sun. The girl and the fox saunter around and watch every sunset.

Name: Cherry Candy
Description: The aroma and ample flesh of the cherry linger at the tip of the girl's tongue. She will forever remember the taste.

Name: Dearest Friend
Description: They share the purest love. The girl hugs the fox and smiles, promising it will never be alone again.

Name: Blooming Breeze
Description: The warm sunshine envelopes her as she puts a fallen flower between the pages, giving a scent to the story of yore.

Name: Cherry Messenger
Description: The girl has roamed the world and walked paths unknown, but now she is willing to stay in the bright autumn.

Name: Leisure in Woods
Description: As the twilight fades and the foggy forest rustles in the wind, the girl and the fox fall asleep in the moonlight.

Name: Lasting Longing
Description: Even though once tainted with lies, the lamp of longing never dims, guiding the lost souls home.

Name: Candid Hope
Description: Departure leads to growth while reunion brings hope. She continues to seek truth, stronger with each passing day.

Name: Kindred Echo
Description: The memories turn into journals as she writes them down, leading to the fortress where she protects her world.

Name: Jovial Moments
Description: Every encounter is worth remembering and sharing, and every page is a pleasant memory of a precious soul.

Name: Rainbow Candy
Description: The candy's flavor fills your mouth. The iced sweet and sour soda tastes like rainbow after summer rain.

Name: Truest Thoughts
Description: Away with the old boring sayings. There is no room for frustration and regret. I am free and unbound.

Name: Spicy Sweetheart
Description: Put forth your infinite passion for creativity and enjoy life's every moment. I am ready for a brand-new adventure.

Name: Colorful Release
Description: Say goodbye to your old self. Each day is a breath of fresh air. The colors of the sun invigorate my story.

Name: Dark Lightning
Description: The blackbird is a serious opponent, its black feathers cloaked in sunlight, its small body packed with power.

Name: Above the Clouds
Description: Her elegant and powerful broom flight awes many. Like a happy little bird, she dashes toward the big blue sky.

Name: Proof of Strength
Description: The Starlight Magic School principal left behind important notes. Yunnie is able to return them in no time.

Name: Flight Regulations
Description: After completing the impossible quest, the principal not only pays Yunnie, but also offers her a job.

Name: Pure Pursuit
Description: But I have nothing to teach the children. All I can do is fly as fast as I can.' Yunnie says, embarrassed.

Name: Forest Encounter
Description: The principal stands up and pats Yunnie on the shoulder: 'Then teach them to enjoy flying as you do.'

Name: Birds of Dusk
Description: Even the broom in Yunnie's hand wants to challenge the confident opponent. Who's faster, Yunnie, or the proud bird?

Name: Moon Seeker
Description: Not many can keep up with Yunnie's speed. Still, a flap of the blackbird's wings is enough to match the fastest winds.

Name: Gentle Shadow
Description: The Magic Biology Studies classroom is outside the old school castle. The children are excited to be here.

Name: Gentle Courtesy
Description: There are various magical creatures here, ranging from cute snowflake hares to giant armored wolves!

Name: Wavering Blossom
Description: Hey! Look! Someone is getting close to a fluffy sheep!' A child shouts in surprise as his classmates glance over.

Name: Fragrance in the Wind
Description: That's too dangerous! The children's faces fill with worry. 'We should get the teacher...' says one of the kids.

Name: Soft Clouds
Description: Soon, the students realize that the fluffy sheep wasn't aggressive — she was the teacher, Professor Ronna.

Name: Star Magnificence
Description: Oh, right! Today's the freshmen's first class.' Ronna turns around and is stunned to see the students.

Name: Stargild Night
Description: The first class has ended. The students have a new opinion of Ronna. She's forgetful, cute, and very intelligent.

Name: Magical Flower Paper
Description: Although Ronna is clumsy and forgetful about herself, she never forgets anything about the magical creatures.

Name: Magic of Time
Description: The freshmen all want to know the secrets within but find a witch in a black long dress casting a spell instead.

Name: Phantom Lullaby
Description: The freshmen carefully make their way through the castle corridor. Their footsteps echo through the hall.

Name: Shackles of Time
Description: The corridor remains dark as the walls block the sunlight, there is only light from the candle holders to the side.

Name: Silent Wish
Description: The stories from the upperclassmen echo. The corridors are eerie and daunting, even in the company of friends.

Name: Cage of Darkness
Description: However, the frightening days quickly come to an end. The candles start to light up whenever they pass through.

Name: Soundless Prayer
Description: The small magic circle emits a powerful light. The witch contently turns around... Ahh! It's Professor Miranda!

Name: Soundless Blessing
Description: Proud as always. The keen children notice something different... The slow-paced footsteps are now in a panic.

Name: Childhood Glee
Description: Squares drawn on the ground with crayons send us back in time to the childhood free of worries.

Name: Joyous Colors
Description: Momo, why did you draw the pink balloons?' 'They're not balloons! They are grilled fishes shaped like balloons!'

Name: Erudite Mind
Description: After reading a book on dreams, Misha heard that the Apple Apparel Group was recruiting testers for a new fabric.

Name: Astral Dream
Description: It is said that whoever wears a blindfold made of this fabric will experience the best dream they can wish for.

Name: Blessed Chance
Description: Her dream came true! One week later, inside Misha's mailbox lay a reply letter and a blindfold for the trial.

Name: Erudite Mind - Orange
Description: She didn't know what to do or why her dream would be like this. Misha couldn't believe this was what she wished for.

Name: Astral Dream - Orange
Description: Misha's rainforest adventure didn't get off to a good start, but she managed to find a place for rest before dark.

Name: Blessed Chance - Orange
Description: Misha finally built a simple stone hut, where the smell of roasted mushrooms emanated from a small campfire.

Name: Erudite Mind - Red
Description: Sitting on the back of the tiger under a starry sky, Misha realized for the first time that she could be so brave.

Name: Astral Dream - Red
Description: She roamed freely in the jungle and even learned to swing like a monkey. Here, she could do anything she wanted.

Name: Blessed Chance - Red
Description: This was a life that Misha had never experienced. She made up her mind to go out to see the world after waking up.

Name: Flowery Swing
Description: The birds led the way for Rhea as they talked the whole way to the forest. In front of her was a swing of flowers.

Name: Ivy Crown
Description: A beautiful red bird fell in the yard. Rhea scooped it up in her palms and built a warm new nest with twigs and hay.

Name: Warbler's Message
Description: Rhea had been getting more requests since then, surrounded in the yard by birds chirping to tell her their wishes.

Name: Dreamy Handwriting
Description: Color has no boundaries. She is a traveler in the kingdom of dreams, composing a poem with magnificent colors.

Name: Pen of Memories
Description: She's seen the greatness of mountains, streams, and the sky. Her favorite is the unexpected flower of friendship.

Name: Transparent Feelings
Description: She met a girl with a pure heart, reflecting worldly essence. However, her courage inside still shines.

Name: Colorful Shadows
Description: She has seen the gentle winds above the clouds. An infinite amount of imagination pours from her heart and fingers.

Name: Weaving Inspiration
Description: Groundbreaking designs all come from a moment of sudden inspiration derived from consolidated experiences.

Name: Sound of Chess
Description: That person cheated more than just the merchant. There hasn't been any evidence until this ledger.

Name: Files and Ranks
Description: The scammer was sent to the authorities and the debts are cleared. The merchant's business takes off immediately.

Name: Talking to Oneself
Description: However, something looks different... He notices an old booklet that wasn't there before. It's a ledger!

Name: Unexpected Breakthrough
Description: The merchant is a little confused and returns to find Ping but only finds the chest board and cooled tea...

Name: Ping's Words
Description: The girl bows to the merchant and introduces herself as Ping. She thanks him for his care and wants to help.

Name: Gold Corners
Description: Though incredible, the merchant was not stunned by the treasure he has collected. He asks Ping for a way out.

Name: Focus in Silence
Description: Ping smiles but does not speak. She grabs another board and set of chess and signals for the merchant to play.

Name: Unforeseen Moves
Description: The merchant is usually careless and loses ground frequently, but today, he plays with confidence and swiftness.

Name: Calming Wind
Description: The two played all night around the dim candlelight. As the sky brightens, the match comes to an end.

Name: Close Match
Description: The last piece is set, and the two ended in a draw. The merchant opens the door to find it being morning already.

Name: Black and White Heron
Description: The black and white pieces sit tidily on the board. Life is a strange game that passes by in the blink of an eye.

Name: Tempest Surge
Description: The traitor that coveted the treasures and summoned the beast died in raging waves with his accomplices.

Name: Spiritual Beacon
Description: Love and hate were buried in the dark tide, but the guilt ate away at her even after centuries.

Name: Stormy Ocean
Description: She was sent away on a boat. As a traveler saved by the captain, she shouldn't be involved in the pirates' scheme.

Name: The Vast Journey

Name: Astral Blaze
Description: As silver stars strew the velvety sky, the princess saw her friends off and silence returned to the palace.

Description: Mint leaves float around the brim. The small shop always brings peace of mind no matter how busy life gets.

Description: As customers held warm drinks and watched street lamps light up at night, a day's weariness would fade away.

Description: Ms. Sherry would also recommend books that miraculously fit each customer's personal taste.

Name: Illusive Haze
Description: Was their friendship all in the past now? Cirrus chose to escape and so the girls parted ways from then on.

Name: Emerald Edge - Return

Description: The empress finally captured the conspirators. Cirrus was reinstated as her first assistant and most trusted friend.

Name: Zest of Grandeur - Return
Description: The declining dynasty was revived with the empress's new policies. Peace and prosperity were finally restored.

Name: Illusive Haze - Return
Description: Cirrus traveled again with the empress in plain clothes. They knew they had both realized their wish.

Name: Emerald Edge - Depart
Description: Cirrus established order in her fleet. Anyone who disobeyed the rules would be sent away.

Description: It only took a few years for Cirrus to gain her fame, which attracted more talented people to join her crew.

Name: Illusive Haze - Depart
Description: Cirrus would sometimes gaze at the sea longingly until an eagle flew by, dropping a secret letter from the Cloud.

Name: Snowfluff Hare
Description: When the mother brought a bowl of sweet rice balls, the daughter asked, 'Does the moon rabbit like these, too?'

Name: Serene Starfall
Description: The fireworks sparks fall like shooting stars. Each is a small wish that leaves its own trace in the sky.

Name: Lepus Lantern
Description: In the Lantern Festival, every kid holds a cute bunny lamp that lights up the prosperous and joyful city.

Name: Snowfall Repose
Description: Snow falls and dresses the trees in white. The winter forest is as tranquil and beautiful as a painting.

Name: Fluffy Bunny Pom-poms
Description: A white pom-pom with two rubies makes a cute bunny hairpin! As always, her sisters can't wait to put them on.

Name: Charming Snowball
Description: Mao Ling styles her customers' hair to match the hairpins. Almost every girl wears a bunny hairpin on Long Street.

Name: Daydream Whisper
Description: All the headpieces are sold out. Mao Ling knows she could see her sisters' smiles when she gives them the lanterns.

Name: Gluttonous Bunny
Description: Life's flavors are in each bite and sip,' Mao Rui starts her lecture, though others are too busy eating her skewers.

Name: Midjourney Yearning
Description: On her travels, Mao Rui met many who loved poetry and skewers, but she most enjoys her sisters' company.

Name: Aspiring Dream
Description: As more tourists flock, Mao Rui keeps her eyes on the bunny lanterns, perfect gifts for her skillful sisters.

Name: Sugar-sweet Berry
Description: Mao Rui also makes sweet and tangy tanghulus for her customers, a refreshing treat after spicy skewers.

Name: Heavenly Reunion
Description: She sees the two most familiar faces at the ceremony. The three tie for first, sharing a knowing smile on stage.

Name: Zephyr Companion
Description: The three sisters hang the bunny lanterns at the gate. The light shines on their love for their family.

Name: Tendril Glimmer
Description: As the train picked up speed, she stood up—the girl chased the train, her pink dress flowing in the wind.

Name: Entwining Bloom
Description: When she said she'd pick the prettiest tulip, the boy shook his head, saying he liked flowers in their natural state.

Name: Soundless Echo
Description: The girl had long had a crush on him and decided to tell her feelings when he gave her the prettiest flower.

Name: Floweret Parable
Description: The girl left the manor for the first time when he left. The train station was crowded but he was all she could see.

Name: Spectral Blossom
Description: But before she received the prettiest flower, the boy came to bid her farewell as he was needed at home.

Name: Game of Snow
Description: Unlike humans, the squirrel didn't like the food stored underground; instead, it preferred nuts.

Name: Warm Hearth
Description: When Ella didn't feel like cooking, the squirrel would hop onto her lap, which always lightened her up.

Name: Breath of Frost
Description: The squirrel didn't like sleeping in the fallen leaves; it would hop around Ella's bed and sleep beside her pillow.

Name: Sun Chaser
Description: In this forest devoid of warmth, Ella and the squirrel would dance in the sunshine as it cast through the leaves.

Name: Wilderness Trip
Description: One morning, they strayed a little too far from home and lost sight of their hut when the sun was setting.

Name: Wild Berries
Description: Ella wanted to return, but the squirrel ran into the depths of the forest and picked some berries for her.

Name: Glint of Spring
Description: In the squirrel's company, Ella had brightened up and, one day, finally left the forest and saw the distant fields.

Name: Cordial Invitation
Description: Behind was the misty forest, where she had spent all her life; before her were the fields, where spring was in bloom.

Name: Furry Warmth
Description: As Ella hesitated, she felt warmth on her cheek — the squirrel was rubbing against her, encouraging her to move on.

Name: Journey Together
Description: Ella reached out her hand, feeling the warmth of the sun, and decided to embrace the world with her little friend.

Name: Breath of Wind
Description: The sun cast its light on the meadow and the flowers, but only a faint touch of warmth could penetrate the forest.

Name: Departing Melody
Description: Their laughter and songs dissipated into the sunlight. The sweet days that wouldn't last were Nehemia's final gift.

Name: Golden Deer
Description: Now a graceful young lady, Ella failed to grasp the spells, and Nehemia's face was devoid of traces of time.

Name: Flowery Utterance
Description: Nehemia tried to teach Ella spells, but however hard she worked, she couldn't establish a connection with the snow.

Name: Verdure Cypress
Description: While Nehemia was busy, Ella had put on ribbons and bells on the tree in the yard and decorated their little hut.

Name: Dazzling Heart
Description: To help Ella, Nehemia consulted the Ancient Tree, who answered all the questions, but Ella didn't understand a word.

Name: Frosty Crystal
Description: Nehemia went back and made some scrolls, which, miraculously, enabled Ella to cast a few basic spells.

Name: Prelude of Finality
Description: Nehemia said that human life would end at the age of 100. Much like snow melting, Nehemia would one day be gone.

Name: Radiant Shadows
Description: 99 — Nehemia wrote down her age in the snow and told Ella that she must find a way to leave the forest.

Name: Sole Star
Description: What were humans? And what was the curse? Ella knew nothing, except that she wanted to stay with Nehemia.

Name: Dance of Snowflakes
Description: Nehemia got carried away with her work, and Ella strolled in the forest alone and shared her stories with Nehemia.

Name: Silence of Snow
Description: The unrelenting snow had stopped. Ella ran back to tell Nehemia, only to find her collapsed in the Circle.

Name: Finale of Night
Description: Another snowy dusk. Ella was on her way back when she saw a gleam from the hut, illuminating the entire forest.

Name: Prepared and Ready
Description: She had even attached a nametag on each seat for the guests. But surely this was no surprise.

Name: Cypress in Bloom
Description: Her well-tended red flowers echoed with the evergreens, adding a wonderful touch of nature to the stage.

Name: Chime Variation
Description: Ria had carefully chosen a selection of music. Whatever the tempo, she was confident she would have a perfect dance.

Name: Sweet Infatuation
Description: Lady Ria, admired and loved by all, also had a loved one, whom she met at last year's ball and immediately fell for.

Name: Winter Love
Description: As Ria danced alone to the upbeat music, she glanced at the young man and caught a hint of surprise in his blue eyes.

Name: Hope of Reunion
Description: Ria didn't know if he was a resident of the town. So, she planned for this year's ball, just to meet him again.

Name: Cheerful Tune
Description: As the music cheerfully floated in the air and the snow gracefully fell, she finally saw that familiar figure.

Name: Destined Meet
Description: A faint smile crossed Ria's face—she was hoping that the young man, whom she had only met once, would love her dance.

Name: Blooming Life
Description: The most attractive red flower, however, was burning on her chest, making her the only star of the night.

Name: Endearing Moment
Description: The yearly ball had always been the most exciting event in the town, and this year, Lady Ria would be the host.

Name: Walking in Light
Description: Let the rising sun witness my change as I chase my dream and compose the song of a brighter future.

Name: Springtime Imprint
Description: We trace the path of time as leaves drift in a gentle breeze, moving into the embrace of spring and blooming flowers.

Name: Poised Moment
Description: She held me next to the fire and dried my fur. Since then, she has let me stay by her side for many years.

Name: Spring Strawberry
Description: Time flew as we sat by the fire watching seasons change in the yard. Strawberries in spring were the best for wine.

Name: Shrouded Bloom
Description: The quiet girl in the library carries it around. A plump and shiny strawberry should be incredibly sweet.

Name: Dune Mirage
Description: Scorpions from the sand answered the girl's whistle and swarmed toward the soldiers, breaking them apart instantly.

Name: Scorpion Heart
Description: The girl rushed home only to see soldiers in the village, a sword raised high and swung at an innocent villager.

Name: Predator Scorpion
Description: The scorpion in her palm pointed its stinger at the mayor's throat. In fear the mayor swore to never do it again.

Name: Dreadful Shadow
Description: Being forced to pay heavy taxes, the hopeless villagers had to seek help from the girl living in the mountains.

Name: Mist of Illusion
Description: They begged the girl to drive away the soldiers like how she fought off robbers, but the girl did not answer.

Name: Aureate Crescent
Description: The next morning, the girl showed up at the mayor's manor and claimed to have intelligent scorpions to show him.

Name: Dreamland Marvel
Description: The mayor only showed interest in the scorpions and patronized the naive-looking girl, inviting her to stay.

Name: Astral Glory
Description: The girl protected the village again and gave them courage. Together they ended the dark night and welcomed dawn.

Name: Myriad Echoes
Description: Qiu Ren goes off, leaving Qiguan Yu speechless with the piece of paper signed by Qiu Ren which weighed a ton.

Name: Gold Silk
Description: The guard snaps, 'Why did you promise him those benefits? You wouldn't be wronged if it wasn't for the Qiu family!'

Name: Silk Embroidery
Description: The master of the Qiu family has been ill. The family, entrenched in internal strife, is on the verge of collapse.

Name: Deep Pockets
Description: Soon, footsteps approach the door. A middle-aged man walks in with a hunch. 'I'm Qiu Ren. You were looking for me?'

Name: Encircling Haze
Description: Qiguan Yu sighs, 'Eventually, the truth can be revealed.' 'What about the Qiu family? Do we just let them get away?'

Name: Glittering Earring
Description: Qiguan Yu smiles, 'Qiu Ren is shortsighted. With him being the new head, the family will fall apart soon.'

Description: The guard seems to have more to say but Qiguan Yu waves him off. After examining the books, he turns to the innkeeper.

Description: The innkeeper takes the books and leaves the room. He feels puzzled — no one had known Qiguan Jin had a brother.

Name: Stellar Fields
Description: The innkeeper probes, 'Are you from the Zephyr Hall?' Qiguan Yu only hands over the books, 'No mistakes, well done.'

Description: As night falls, the bustling city quiets down. But the sound of wheels comes as a carriage stops before the Grand Inn.

Description: They leave the estate shortly after having achieved their goal and return to the Grand Inn without any delay.

Description: With solid evidence in hand, the slander against Qiguan Jin and the Zephyr Hall will come to an end tomorrow.

Description: Invitations have been sent to martial sects, prominent families and even the government — everyone they can think of.

Description: She opened her eyes to see the familiar bedroom. As the wind blew, she saw a crystal snowflake on the window sill.

Description: Hasina couldn't resist her curiosity about the outside world. She stole a torch and walked into the night.

Name: Myriad Thoughts - Gorgeous
Description: If stars rise from the east and fall to the west, can they be related to the Sun? Are they all like the Sun?

Name: Bejeweled Compass - Gorgeous
Description: She couldn't tell anyone as they all closed their eyes and followed the rules, refusing to look at the world.

Name: Cosmic Riddle - Gorgeous
Description: Hasina had questions that no one could answer. She could only lie under the stars, hoping they would give her answers.

Name: Starlight Beacon - Gorgeous
Description: Hasina could see the stars' movement in her mind, presenting her with wisdom and knowledge unlike anything else.

Name: Bejeweled Compass - Rare
Description: She felt closer to the outside world and couldn't wait to seek answers herself, but her people all disapproved.

Description: Her mother finally agreed with her traveling with the caravan. Hasina left her cage and ventured into a wider world.

Name: Starlight Beacon - Rare
Description: Hasina embarked on one journey after another, but she knew the stars would always be her guide wherever she went.

Description: Hasina now understood everything as her fate was written by the stars, so she ventured deeper into the unknown.

Description: Hasina led dying tribes to new settlements. They learned to change their lifestyle and look for answers like Hasina.

Description: The stars would never stop moving as Hasina's journeys would never end. She became a fascinating legend in the desert.

Description: The star trails was a book that recorded every change in time, and Hasina was only turning the pages for answers.

Name: Inkstain Heart - Rare

Description: She would recall how their neighbors talked about the hardships her mother went through to raise her alone.

Name: Spirited Reunion - Rare

Name: Spirited Reunion - Brocade
Description: Paint dried in the wind as one more scroll got tucked away in her box. She wouldn't be alone from now on.

Name: Spirited Reunion - Ice

Description: Felicia finally found the girl's star among numerous sparks. She flew toward it and scooped it up.

Name: Ephemeral Radiance
Description: Countless memories flooded in: all the rehearsals, the anticipation for the show, and suddenly falling ill...

Name: Tranquil Breeze

Name: Lilting Chant
Description: Felicia remembered how she made a wish on her birthday this year that she would become a great actress on stage.

Name: Dreamcatcher Net
Description: The star net could only be used once, so Felicia kept searching for the girl's wish that she promised to realize.

Description: The audience felt that Laurel's greatest magic was this: bringing warmth and joy, letting music soothe weary hearts.
