Name: Spotlight Spell
Description: Flowers dressed the stage. As Laurel spun, her citrine crystal flashed, casting dazzling light across amazed faces.

Name: Savage Glutton
Description: Some said there was no hawk where the Wind Whisperer lived. Just the sharp-eyed and wolf-like beast following her.

Name: Fragrant Rubble
Description: A priestess saw the Wind Whisperer coming out of a mysterious realm with one more iridescent bow in her hand.

Name: Mystique Rapture
Description: It took time to find the real Wind Whisperer. Bastet heard that day the power of nature beamed above clouds.

Name: Skyward Wings
Description: Those who claimed to have seen the Wind Whisperer said her temple was gilded with hawks around each pillar.

Name: Plumed Prestige
Description: The Wind Whisperer united everything on this land and led them out of chaos and confusion and into a new dawn.

Name: Fleeting Moments
Description: The girl's hard work paid off. When the Wind Whisperer recruited a messenger, her name was on the list of candidates.

Name: Sheathed Edge
Description: After becoming the messenger, Bastet remained diligent and modest, completing tasks and proving herself.

Name: Starlit Gloom
Description: After a day's work, Bastet sat yawning on a step of the temple, her hair billowing in the evening breeze.

Name: Warbling Trill
Description: The evening wind caressed Bastet's forehead as the sound of footsteps from behind woke her up from dozing off.

Name: Sea of Mysteries
Description: The Wind Whisperer didn't stay inside all day, but Bastet hadn't seen her in person since her appointment.

Name: Promising Tomorrow
Description: N-No, you didn't wake me. I mean, I wasn't...' Bastet took a breath, 'Anyway, welcome back, your highness.'

Name: Beyond Radiance
Description: As for what the Wind Whisperer told her later, Bastet refused to share it with her friends no matter what.

Name: Soaring Wings
Description: The wind traveled gently among soaring eagles and rambling deer, bringing interesting stories to the Wind Whisperer.

Name: Zephyr Encounter
Description: In a dark corner where time seemed to stand still, she exhausted all her strength to move one small brick.

Name: Primeval Hymn
Description: Sunlight shone in as the heaviness above lifted. A hand covered her eyes and an arm lifted her up from the rubble.

Name: Eternal Consonance
Description: She gradually opened her eyes to see a girl carrying a bow, who took her hand and headed deeper into the ruins.

Name: Sweet Endearment
Description: Young love is often tested with time. When beauty and youth are no more, will love still be the same?

Name: Fond Infatuation
Description: The Love God's arrow is the key to opening hearts, awakening one's feelings as they take the first step to true love.

Name: Heartfelt Fancy
Description: Feelings turn into songs at the Love God's fingertips, watering souls like morning dew and warming hearts like sunset.

Name: Budding Affection
Description: The Love God's magic doesn't always work, not on a kitten who only cares about fish or a certain dorky little dwarf.

Name: Manifesto of Love
Description: Love can sometimes be a trap, and when the trapped one sees through the lies, they'll grow and embrace a new life.

Name: Arrow of Devotion
Description: With gems of laughter and tears on her arrows, the Love God draws stars and lovers' dreams with gentle moonlight.

Name: Eternal Love
Description: Love can be fleeting or last a lifetime, but true love stands even the test of death and becomes eternal.

Name: Passion Spell
Description: The magic of the arrows comes from the heart. Never forget to seek inward for answers and love yourself.

Name: Sweet Enchantment
Description: Love can be subtle poems or grand gestures. The Love God likes all forms of endearment brimming with love.

Name: Magic Assistant
Description: Through poisonous swamps and thorny bushes, Tritty finally sees the rumored witch's violet mushroom house.

Name: Messenger of Joy
Description: Tritty's unannounced arrival startles the eccentric witch, as she almost trips and falls into her brewing pot.

Name: Dancing Blossoms
Description: Tritty doesn't want to miss any chance, even if hope is like a firework in the dark sky, brilliant yet distant.

Name: Wishing Strings
Description: The witch is still upset after Tritty's apology, because she doesn't have enough energy of joy for the ideal potion.

Name: Emerald Streak
Description: Tritty proposes to the witch, 'If I could perform at the festival, I might be able to gather energy of joy for you.'

Name: Eureka Fountain
Description: With the witch's potion, Tritty turns into a pretty girl, but whatever she does, she can't hide her beautiful tail.

Name: Quilled Wand
Description: To hide her tail, she takes inspiration from parade dancers and designs a gorgeous dress with feathery fleeces.

Name: Echoing Wishes
Description: Before that, she wants to join the festival with Tritty. What is it like? The witch couldn't help her curiosity.

Name: Warbling Finch
Description: Gwen could understand the white bird's changing chirps and imagine a broader world through its singing.

Name: Everlasting Bloom
Description: In spring, wisteria would grow into cascades of purple around Gwen's home, guiding the white finch when it returned.

Name: Ceaseless Cycle
Description: As long as Gwen's magic and beautiful things existed, her spinning wheel would never stop working.

Name: Embroidered Nest
Description: Gwen and the white finch were always together. She weaved the finch a warm and beautiful nest next to the wisteria.

Name: Canopied Woodland
Description: She had an idea to make fallen leaves into translucent gauze and weave it into a beautiful dress of nature.

Name: Buoyant Blooms
Description: She also made flowers brought by the white finch into fragrant brocade that changed color with the seasons.

Name: Beaded Fragrance
Description: The white finch was Gwen's only friend in the secluded forest. They talked from flowers to the secrets of color.

Name: Finch's Bloom
Description: The white finch would help Gwen weave, either picking up a thread or singing to the rhythm of the spinning wheel.

Name: Honeypot of Dreams
Description: The colorful sweets in the bear's pocket are sour, sweet or refreshing. She's always looking forward to the next one.

Name: Bubble Glitter
Description: When the last bubble breaks, she wakes up to her usual room, the doll smiling at her on her night stand.

Name: Carefree Companion
Description: She dances with the bear as the sunflowers sing. The bear is happy to make a new friend and accept her honey gift.

Name: Blossom Choir
Description: She follows the sound to see sunflowers rejoicing in the sun. She lies among the blooms as they share their stories.

Name: Heartwarming Aspiration
Description: If she could stand again, would her life be as colorful? She dozes off in the warm sunlight with such hope.

Name: Joyous Melody
Description: Her wheelchair is somehow gone. She tries to take a step, her feet in ballet shoes, leaping briskly on the ground.

Name: Haven of the Soul
Description: She's now wearing the doll's white dress, with a sea of sunflowers like the fairyland in her imagination.

Name: Colorful Fairyland
Description: She dances in the fragrant breeze and blooms, as colorful bubbles float and decorate the field as a fairyland.

Name: Sunlight Streak
Description: She lies on the grass and basks in the warmth of the sun, as butterflies whisper secrets to her ears.

Name: Gilded Rainbow
Description: She rides the wind above the clouds, collects golden candy in the rain and rests sometimes on the rainbow bridge.

Name: Free Saunter
Description: She feels the ground tremble from afar and passes a portal to see a crowned bear in her handmade overalls.

Name: Future Marvels
Description: She plans for the next picture book with hopes for the future, an interesting and joyful story forming in her mind.

Name: Nature's Gaze
Description: The priestess in every tribe knew to master the power of nature and taught her a lot of interesting things.

Name: Fluorescent Wish
Description: She wanted to settle down in a tribe after a long trek and realized she hadn't spoken to the stars for a long time.

Name: Future Haven
Description: Meteors fell in two directions. This time there was no optimal answer. She had to make the decision herself.

Name: Nature's Gaze - Harvest
Description: She offered food to travelers in need. Every member of the tribe was generous in nature.

Name: Fluorescent Wish - Harvest
Description: The tribe built a new temple to celebrate the good harvests in fall. It stood solemnly under the sun.

Name: Future Haven - Harvest
Description: The golden wind carried the smell of harvest. Beaming at the ripe crops, she hurried to move them into the granary.

Name: Nature's Gaze - Rest
Description: A revelation dawned on her. In a gentle breeze, she sang ancient rhymes with the endless expanse of nature.

Name: Fluorescent Wish - Rest
Description: She built a new temple with the tribe. Intricate patterns were engraved on the stone pillars as a gift for nature.

Name: Future Haven - Rest
Description: The sun shone as a warm wind parted fogs. In this great wild expanse, the seeds of hope quietly grew.

Name: Silhouette of Time
Description: As time passed the girls developed their own ideas for fashion design. A brighter future was within their reach.

Name: Foregone Yearning
Description: The girls bade each other farewell on graduation day. It was their hope for the future and honoring of the past.

Name: Dazzling Delight
Description: Dreams shone brightly as stars at night. They were ready for any challenges the future might have in store for them.

Name: Glorious Memory
Description: In the gifts they sent each other lay the same picture of them standing in the brilliant lights of the city square.

Name: Silhouette of Time - Peace
Description: The theme of the fashion week was 'Morning Star.' Sika wanted to interpret it in her own style.

Name: Foregone Yearning - Peace
Description: Simple but unique' was what Sika's roommates thought of her designs. Friends' encouragement always kept her going.

Name: Dazzling Delight - Peace
Description: Sika's design was lauded in the fashion week. People related to the dedication to chasing dreams in Sika's work.

Name: Glorious Memory - Peace
Description: Sika left the stage and walked into warm hugs—the girls finally reunited years after graduation.

Name: Silhouette of Time - Leap
Description: Rianne was researching for the next fashion week when two familiar names caught her eye.

Name: Foregone Yearning - Leap
Description: Discerning and progressive' was what Rianne's roommates thought of her, and she had never forgotten her dream.

Name: Dazzling Delight - Leap
Description: Rianne wrote down her interpretation of the theme: the morning star shines brighter after a long night of struggle.

Name: Glorious Memory - Leap
Description: Rianne adjusted the camera that took a photo five seconds later. They now stood more confidently in the same square.

Name: Silhouette of Time - Solo
Description: Kino sat with a cup of coffee to contemplate her design. Maybe she could use lighting to mimic the morning star.

Name: Foregone Yearning - Solo
Description: Always thinking outside the box' was what Kino's roommates thought of her, and she knew it was her special advantage.

Name: Dazzling Delight - Solo
Description: As the models walked in the morning sunlight, her designs shone like stars and won loud applause from the audience.

Name: Glorious Memory - Solo
Description: Kino took her friends' hands. They would continue to encourage each other as they stepped into a brighter future.

Name: Shards of Dreams
Description: A sound of sleds broke the silence of winter as a couple emerged from the dark and dusted snow off their clothes.

Name: Elysium Star
Description: Maggie woke up and found that the snow had stopped. She ran downstairs and saw the goddess' gift by the fireplace.

Name: Snow Feather
Description: Before going to sleep, Maggie made her wish innocently. Then she dreamed about her parents, holding her in their arms.

Name: Auspice of Snow
Description: Maggie unwrapped the gift, her grandma lovingly watching her, and saw a beautiful scarf and a star-shaped hair clip.

Name: Hug in Snow
Description: Maggie put on her new scarf and waited for her parents, who didn't show up even when the stars had risen.

Name: Starry Gift
Description: Tears welled up in Maggie's eyes. Looking at the frozen forest, Grandma patted her back, but she refused to go to bed.

Name: Dream Watch
Description: And the stars had indeed been the best gift, for they had guided innumerous souls in the darkness of winter nights.

Name: Stellar Ceremony
Description: When the snow stopped, Maggie's parents decided to hurry back. In the vast snowland, the stars had been their guide.

Name: Sweetest Hope
Description: All kinds of sweets wrapped in colorful packages with adoring affection. Special gifts for the special person.

Name: Blooming Years
Description: As she skates down the shaded street, her hair flutters in the wind; every turn she takes becomes part of her memory.

Name: Hues of Adolescence
Description: The gentle spring sunlight casts on her skateboard and her classmates wait for her to join the graduation ceremony.

Name: Mellow Zephyr
Description: Stars scattered across the sky as the evening breeze sang. Children closed their eyes, falling into beautiful dreams.

Name: Veiled Scorpion
Description: The grateful villagers offered the girl a beautiful bouquet. She held it in her arms and gently touched the petals.

Name: Whirling Clouds
Description: An elder Zhu, aided by a servant, took out a manuscript, revealing the man in red in the painting as his uncle.

Name: Ode to Love
Description: People dismissed the story. Mr. Spring was a person of arrogance and solitude, never treating others with hospitality.

Name: Ink Painting of Tiger
Description: Years later, the Zhu family shocked their guests at an event by revealing the other half of Ban Yin.

Name: Yin Yang Harmony
Description: The painting revealed another mystery: two figures in white and red admiring the red plum blossoms.

Name: Azure Waters
Description: I heard a mountain under the Bay of Cang River shared my name I became hopelessly lost'

Name: Circling Clouds
Description: The person who saved me wore a calm nonchalance on his face before introducing himself as Mr. Spring.'

Name: Encaptivating Words
Description: I'm invited to his residence. I was impressed by the stacks of fragrant scrolls and the vivid drawing of red plums.'

Name: Destined Encounter
Description: Mr. Spring showed equal interest in my travels. We became friends as we shared an admiration for each other.'

Name: Faraway Ambition
Description: Everyone in my tribe believed that east was the direction where one would find truth and the gods.'

Name: Mountains and Rivers
Description: Following this creed, I traveled to White Rock City and Rolterdan. As I journeyed, I found another also headed east.'

Name: Magical Journey
Description: Mr. Spring and I promised a reunion each year, a promise that we have always kept no matter how far we were.'

Name: Lifetime Story
Description: The elder and his uncle were close. Upon his uncle's passing, he found these travelogues that mentioned Mr. Spring.

Name: Soaring Hearts
Description: You are intrigued by the afar, while I am fascinated by the mountain. We simply share the same love.'

Name: Plum Blossom to Give
Description: I chose not to persuade further. As I left, he gifted me a painting of plums. It's been my treasure ever since.'

Name: Silent Utterance
Description: The two halves of Ban Yin were finally reunited, displaying its beauty to all those who beheld it.

Name: Painting of Hearts
Description: Insight can gained from observing Forward. Unlike Surel's early work, this one does not depict the Vien Manor.

Name: Eternal Blossom
Description: The large waves and dark colors accentuated the sole sail in the tempest using seemingly useless brushstrokes.

Name: Inseparable Companion
Description: The conversation between Surel and the fairy is so mysterious that even her parents didn't mention it in their memoir.

Name: Magnum Opus
Description: On this special afternoon, when Surel uncharacteristically put down paintbrush, her magnum opus, Forward, was born.

Name: Rural Beauty
Description: Her work covered every inch of Vien Manor. From the pond of still water to the midsummer night trail.

Name: Esteemed Fame
Description: As Surel's work gained fame, so did the manor, welcoming countless guests to behold its beauty.

Name: Country Tale
Description: Surel smiled at her parents with her easel on her back. Perhaps a polite fairy will ask her for a portrait today.

Name: Midnoon Adventure
Description: No cicada chirp or fluttering of wings could interrupt Surel from painting, until she felt a pat on her shoulder.

Name: Fairy Dwelling
Description: The forbidden palace of the Fairy King was illuminated last night in its full glory.

Name: Mirage of Life
Description: The young girl frowned as she stared at the man's pointy ears. He bowed and apologized politely for interrupting her.

Name: Wintry Surge
Description: No longer being at a loss, Satiel would still choose those silvery figures as she secretly returned to the hill.

Name: Perceptive Deer
Description: The birds and the gentle zephyr would play with her braids as she hung the decorations on the Ashen Deer's antlers.

Name: Glacial Summit
Description: The villagers, believing it to be a divine sign, braided her hair and wrote the name Satiel onto her palm.

Name: Woodland's Depths
Description: Satiel had a difficult time understanding the human tongue as she tried her best to mimic their moves and words.

Name: Grace of Nature
Description: Before Satiel realized it, the night had already fallen. Panicked, she ran toward the village at the hill bottom.

Name: Enlightened Radiance
Description: Seeing Satiel and the Deer emerge from a bush sent relief to the anxious faces of the villagers searching for her.

Name: Tale of Life
Description: The Spirit Birds and the Ashen Deer helped the villagers forage, while Satiel would often bring them a lot of food.

Name: Dawn Till Dusk
Description: Satiel's stomach growled. The villagers held her hand as they took the journey back on the torch-lit trail.

Name: Circle of Life
Description: Even as Satiel grew up, she still trod between the deer pack and the village, almost like a bridge connecting them.

Name: Eternal Dream
Description: Satiel never had to speak in front of the Ashen Deer and the Spirit Birds. When she did, she felt strange.

Name: Bells of Old
Description: The villagers sat by the dying flame, unsure where to go next. Yet, idle waiting would only spell certain death.

Name: Endless Snow
Description: That day, the snowstorm became ceaseless, slowly enveloping the mountain and blowing aside the meager tents.

Name: Enchanting Ceremony
Description: Every time the villagers invited Satiel to perform, she would bury her face into a deer's soft fur with a blush.

Name: Glimmering Candlelight
Description: The Holy Maiden braided the young girl's hair as she whispered into her ear, her eyes glimmering as she nodded.

Name: Echoes of the Void
Description: The table shuddered as the girl embraced the young woman, making her father look both embarrassed and flustered.

Name: Steps of Wishes
Description: The little girl could hold her curiosity no longer. 'O' Holy Maiden. What hast the gods whispered to thy ears?'

Name: Majestic Crown
Description: The child leaned on her father's shoulder and asked what the divine gods had revealed with their revelations.

Name: Veiled Mist
Description: Doves flew across the sky. As the crowd admired the flock, a girl, clad in white, began to walk toward them.

Name: Divine Whispers
Description: The child's father stroked her hair as the crowd laughed, jokingly telling her to ask for herself at the ceremony.

Name: Concert of Shadows
Description: She needed no introduction. To everyone, she was the definition and the indisputable image of the Holy Maiden.

Name: Ashen Hymn
Description: The girl radiated with a divine radiance as she chanted the story about a divine ship heading to the east.

Name: Between Light and Darkness
Description: The Holy Maiden sat at the feast, patiently and lovingly answering the questions from the crowd gathered around her.

Name: Silent Prayer
Description: The young lady walked toward the candle-lit podium, gently lowering her head as she beckoned toward the crowd below.

Name: Crown of Nights
Description: The young lady walked onto the podium basked in the sound of pious prayers and the shimmering candlelight.

Name: Veil of Dreams
Description: The young lady knew where she came from, and she also knew where she should lead her people.

Name: Secrets of Divinity
Description: With her hands clasped together, she whispered her yearnings and devotion to the true deities residing in her heart.

Name: Waters of Clarity
Description: Under the distant chants, the young woman began to dance under the veil of stars, her eyes shimmering like the ocean.

Name: Stellar Path
Description: As the world fell into a hush, the young woman and her companions dove into the night as they chased the morning sun.

Name: Spiritual Enlightenment
Description: The young woman stood under the stars, the wind swept through her hair and brought her the secrets hidden by time.

Name: Symphony of Stars
Description: The young woman finally broke her shackles and retrieved her soul. She now yearns to be reunited with her friends.

Name: Silent Questions
Description: The man followed the army into the snowy North Kingdom, only the stars in the sky knew of his true destination.

Name: Secret of Ages
Description: The once foreign girl was not closely intertwined with this land, her eyes resolute and glimmering with confidence.

Name: Fortune's Signs
Description: The diligent queen and her sister would sometimes lie in each other's embrace as they gazed into the stars.

Name: Stellar Brilliance
Description: Each card glowed with an inscrutable intent. Let fate guide your hand, and the stars will reveal the secret within.

Name: Flowering Romance
Description: Returning guests would often share the location of flowers with the smiling girl. Soon, a voice called out to her.

Name: Blooming Patience
Description: Mina always paused to listen to these stories, her flowers standing as a silent witness to sincerity and affection.

Name: Dream of Blossoms
Description: Mina always carried a small basket of flowers for each season. She firmly believed in waiting for a flower's bloom.

Name: Flowering Romance - Indigo
Description: The young girl who would often buy the small flower fell ill, her face pale as snow when Mina visited her.

Name: Blooming Patience - Indigo
Description: The girl spoke feebly to Mina, hoping to once again feel the touch of the yellow flower she first received from Mina.

Name: Dream of Blossoms - Indigo
Description: Yet, those delicate flowers would only blossom in summer. What should Mina do to fulfill her wish?

Name: Flowering Romance - Warmth
Description: A moment of brilliance erupted on Mina's face. She kissed her mother before rushing to her little greenhouse.

Name: Blooming Patience - Warmth
Description: Euphoria washed over Mina as the yellow petals broke through the bud. She placed the flower in her embrace and ran.

Name: Dream of Blossoms - Warmth
Description: The little girl awoke to find the yellow flowers in front of her, vibrant and filled with comforting solace.

Name: Driving Thunder
Description: Zhichen commanded the power of nature. People believed that the echoes of clapping thunder were his wrathful roar.

Name: Into the Clouds
Description: Inspired by the thunderclap, craftsmen added bear paws and eagle claws to the statue to exude its divine might.

Name: Soaring Dragon
Description: Commanding the rain, the craftsmen also added aquatic elements, in the form of winding whiskers and glimmering scales.

Name: Glimmering Scales
Description: Zhichen would call down rain in times of drought, as he would protect the city in stormed by a raging tempest.

Name: Mountain of Fortune
Description: Curious about his image in the people's minds, Zhichen often came as he observed the puny creatures and big creations.

Name: Idyllic Pavilion
Description: Crafting a statue the size of a mountain was a generational endeavor, with each craftsman adding details bit by bit.

Name: Dragon's Descendants
Description: The most skilled craftsmen were chosen as they trekked from far and wide to work on this colossal statue.

Name: Kaleidoscope of Clouds
Description: Each worker devoted their life to the statue's making, manning every task with almost pious diligence.

Name: Fortune's Evanescence
Description: Centuries have come and passed, the once barren mountain was slowly transformed into its new form.

Name: Serene Quietude
Description: The statue's unique appearance pleased Zhichen, who imprinted his form upon the stone outcrop.

Name: Azure Expanse
Description: The statue slowly began to take shape. Its mysterious appearance is accentuated by the mountain's misty veil.

Name: Unseen Lurker
Description: The statue towered into the clouds, leaving only its majestic claws visible for the mortals to behold its grandeur.

Name: Divine Genesis
Description: The statue took many forms, the antlers of deer, the scales of carps... It was like an amalgamation of nature itself.

Name: Empyrean Soar
Description: Suddenly, mountains shattered to reveal the glimmering scale underneath Zhichen leaped into the air in his new form.

Name: Cosmic Destiny
Description: With his new form, Zhichen soared through the heavens, displaying his grandeur to those who helped shape him.

Name: Lunar Floriography
Description: The fairies tried to stop Elina. Without Lake Bovaly, there were terrible dangers lurking in the depths of the woods.

Name: Wishful Tolls
Description: Elina's songs were filled with hope and excitement, 'Do not worry for me, for the moon will bestow me with courage.'

Name: Aria of Sorrow
Description: Elina departed into the strange forest under the worrying gaze of her friends as the flowers waved her goodbye.

Name: Aureate Touch
Description: Standing at the mist-enveloped entrance, Elina stopped to ask a wandering goose for directions.

Name: Symphony of Petals
Description: Elina did not feel lonely in the forest. Moonlight guided her as she sang with the flowers and the chirping birds.

Name: Effulgent Gossamer
Description: The Jungle of Thorns offered little reprieve. Elina followed the river forward until she finally saw moonlight.

Name: Effulgent Dream
Description: Across the river and through the thorns, where the moonlight quietly awaits the next adventurer.'

Name: Wondrous Odyssey
Description: It's said that the Moonlight Flower only blossoms at the river's beginning, blessing those who see it with courage.

Name: Ballad of Love
Description: The young woman's song could cure the body and soothe the soul, winning the heart of a sailor who heard her song.

Name: Tale of Ripples
Description: Isabelle would meet her love from dawn till dusk, not even the ocean could separate their beating hearts.

Name: Pearly Tears
Description: The tempest subsided, but her lover would never return again. Tears of sorrow streamed down Isabelle's cheeks.

Name: Cirrus Lament
Description: The lantern was stolen and her lover was gravely injured. As Isabelle slowly sank, even the sea wept tears of sorrow.

Name: Plumes of Reunion
Description: To awaken Isabelle, the sailor traveled far and wide, eventually finding a way from the mouth of a witch.

Name: Call of Sincerity
Description: The sailor rowed his lonely boat as he braved the waves and the thunderstorm, feeling no fear in his heart.

Name: Plumed Memento
Description: Without the protection, the sea bellowed ceaselessly, destroying all ships that dared to venture too close.

Name: Radiant Promise
Description: The sailor possessed a lantern that exuded divine powers in Isabelle's hands, drawing malicious eyes upon it.

Name: Poem of Reunion
Description: Ships once again began to frequent these waters. Isabelle once again surfaced, this time singing the sailor's song.

Name: Agate Crystal
Description: The closer she came to home, the more familiar faces greeted her along the way.

Name: Sweet Nectar
Description: She rushed into the arms of her grandmother, who sat smiling outside the decorated house.

Name: Plump Fruition
Description: Spring buds bloom in summer. Autumn fruits hang from branches, ripening into red persimmons by winter.

Name: Persimmon Lantern
Description: The persimmon-shaped lantern casts its warm glow, guiding people into a dreamy wonderland as they soundly sleep.

Name: 沁蓝滴翠
Description: 雪色纤薄的瓷杯中斟满了刚刚出坛的琼浆，映出杯底青翠欲滴的靛蓝花纹，影影绰绰间，精巧素美又极致风雅。

Name: 冰瓷化蝶
Description: 用天青色勾勒晕染的蝴蝶，在晶莹温润的瓷瓶上栩栩如生、明净无瑕，通透如琉璃的月光流淌其上，不染纤尘。

Name: 霜月露冷
Description: 月色空明流光，如同在庭院中积上了薄薄的一层霜雪。此等美景宛若渺渺仙境，令人惟愿沉入醉乡。

Name: Nightmare Resurgent
Description: The priestess chant continued until a beam of light pierced through the clouds like the sharp edge of a blade.

Name: Guarding Oracle
Description: Eons had passed, yet the seed of hope traded with countless lives had long taken root in these lands.

Name: Sanguine Rose
Description: As the chants faded, the priestess fell from the altar, charred plumes turned into roses as darkness became light.

Description: She would walk from table to table with a smile, her affectionate personality radiating toward each delighted guest.

Description: Matina had a knack for creating drinks from seemingly unrelated ingredients, often resulting in unforgettable tastes.

Description: It started out well. The leaves were thick, and nobody noticed me hiding just outside the window.'

Name: Glowing Star - Fragrant
Description: But that didn't last. One day, I fell from the cracked branch.' Matina continued.

Name: Midnight Melody - Fragrant
Description: That's how my teacher found out about me. She paid for my treatment and let me back inside the classroom.'

Name: Moonlit Veil - Fragrant
Description: Give me some snacks and a bottle of water and I could sit in a classroom learning for days.'

Name: Fishy Contemplation
Description: Between leisurely pleasures, she would sneak a peek at the worshipers here to piously make their wish.

Name: Calming Nonchalance
Description: The Fish Spirit believed that wishes were a sign of greed and true happiness is only gained by those with few needs.

Name: Fateful Romance
Description: Excited, the Fish Spirit lined up. When she met the Stargazer, she learned that a tale of love was about to unfold.

Name: Destiny's Beckon
Description: But she didn't want to be part of a love story. Yet, the stargazer smiled and told her that fate cannot be defied.

Name: Fishy Contemplation - Crimson
Description: One day, the tranquility of the temple was broken by thieves, who laid their eyes on the beautiful carp.

Name: Calming Nonchalance - Crimson
Description: Just as the Fish Spirit pondered, the bamboo on the bank lashed out and struck the thieves.

Name: Fateful Romance - Crimson
Description: Pleased with the outcome, the Fish Spirit stared at the bamboo as a realization struck her.

Name: Destiny's Beckon - Crimson
Description: The bamboo shifted slightly before taking up the shape of a person. The Fish Spirit smiled. Fate was one step ahead.

Name: Fishy Contemplation - Cerulean
Description: She almost tripped and fell until someone saved her, the pleasant smell of bamboo drifting into her nose.

Name: Calming Nonchalance - Cerulean
Description: The Fish Spirit thanked her savior. The young man nodded as he shook a fan with bamboo drawn across it.

Name: Fateful Romance - Cerulean
Description: The dog said that meeting a person repeatedly is fate at work. This was the third time that their paths had crossed.

Name: Destiny's Beckon - Cerulean
Description: The young man yielded the candy to her. Watching him leave, she quickly blushed and ran off with the sugar painting.

Name: Auspicious Clouds
Description: People admire the plum blossoms while drinking tea. They invite Kiri to join them, but she smiles and then leaves.

Name: Charm Earring
Description: She strokes the plum blossoms and plucks petals from the branches—she's going to make honey plums for the festival.

Name: First Snow
Description: When dusk falls, Kiri has a full basket of petals. She waves goodbye to the others and sets off on her way home.

Name: Eternal Prosperity
Description: Kiri is also a famous cook in the town: the unique flavor of her rice cakes and cookies is her trademark.

Name: Abundant Blessings
Description: She makes pastries for her friends every year and also receives the best cuisine and scented pouches in return.

Name: Fragrance Hall
Description: The townsfolk love sharing things with each other, and a joyful mood has filled up the air across the town.

Name: Festive Scents
Description: Smoke rises from the town. As soon as Kiri arrives, she's engulfed by the smell of pork and fish...

Name: Longing Vignettes
Description: The girl told Jin Meng that she was leaving soon. Jin Meng expressed regret that she had yet to prepare a present.

Name: Spring of Wonders
Description: She told Jin Meng that meeting her was the best present she could ever receive.

Name: Carp of Fortune
Description: It was the holidays again as Jin Meng and the girl walked hand in hand, just like the first time they met.

Name: Glimmering Opulence
Description: To repay her, she cast a spell and turned all the rice in her house into glittering gold.

Name: Auspicious Wisdom
Description: At the moment of farewell, Jin Meng gave the girl her prized goldfish pendant and decided to continue her training.

Name: Sunset's Veil
Description: When the young girl discovered the gold, she bowed to the sky and vowed to share this gift with the less fortunate.

Name: United Perseverance
Description: The girl was soon appointed as Sikong, praised and loved for her diligence and devotion to the people.

Name: Joyous Reminiscence
Description: Jin Meng gasped, she revealed herself and explained what had happened, to which the girl only smiled faintly.

Name: Ebbing Ripples
Description: It's said when a carp grows to a century old, it will be able to morph into a human. Jin Meng was such a curious carp.

Name: Sylvan Rhythm
Description: The girl wanted to be a minister and help the people. Despite being friends, Jin Meng did not know how to repay her.

Name: Current Tracing
Description: Jin Meng did not leave. She made up an excuse so she could stay by her side and find out her true aspirations.

Name: Night of Solace
Description: As she handed her present to him, she suddenly noticed a beautiful hairpin lying in his palm.

Name: Night of Joy
Description: As she walked toward the old bridge under the beautiful fireworks, she saw his figure walking slowly toward her.

Name: Blissful Chant
Description: As dawn neared and the crowd thinned, she said her farewells to him beside the bridge where they first met.

Name: Preordained Fate
Description: It was a new year, and Long Street was decorated anew. This year, she was determined to tell him her true feelings.

Name: Emerald Verdure
Description: She would often remember that night as the exchanges in letters between him and her became increasingly frequent.

Name: Distant Reminiscence
Description: She would place her tender thoughts into each gift, careful to not reveal too much affection in each one.

Name: Gilded Brilliance
Description: Goddess flickered her hand, in a mere instant, they were both thousands of miles away.

Name: Baroque Lantern
Description: She traveled with Goddess, her amazement turning into disarray as she witnessed the desolation across the land.

Name: Misty Lotus
Description: She approached Goddess, only to be stunned by the beautiful jade pedestal she was sitting on.

Name: Undying Light at Night
Description: Goddess grinned, tapping her on the forehead. Instantly, she levitated as if a weight was removed from her body.

Name: White Phoenix
Description: Is this real?' She nodded. 'I want to help them.' Her voice trembling with emotions.

Name: Spinning Plumes
Description: You should do something. I know you can.' Goddess stroked her hair gently. 'Come. We should head back.'

Name: Sparrow's Shadow
Description: Back in the capital, it was a different scene. The city was shining opulently, as if no suffering ever existed.

Name: Radiant Pearl
Description: She stared at the most opulent building inside the palace and asked Goddess who lived there.

Name: Divine Omnipotence
Description: Goddess stared at her, asking who she thinks could live in a place more extravagant than the emperor's own residence.

Name: Radiant Extravagance
Description: She suddenly felt a rush of air brushing past her as she closed her eyes to the nauseating sensation.

Name: Silent Radiance
Description: As she went to bed, something weighed on her heavily. She knew she had to do something.

Name: Cosmic Splendor
Description: Cosette was determined to swim against the current and make a name for herself in this city.

Name: Brilliant Beyond
Description: Starnight Hotel was Cosette's great work. Today was its grand opening, and every famous name was going to be there.

Name: Lustrous Trail
Description: She lived by the creed 'Go out, walk forward.' She started as a mere waiter and slowly accumulated her success.

Name: Night City
Description: Many years ago, Cosette was just a farm girl. Yet unlike her peers, she harbored great ambitions and a big dream.

Name: Radiant Chrome
Description: There are many girls just like Cosette in the city. They became friends in life and partners in their pursuits.

Name: Silent Tide
Description: Cosette had a shrewd business mind. Despite the hardships, she built one of the most successful brands in the city.

Name: Effulgent Year
Description: Cosette's affluent friends came to congratulate her, each a testament and success story in their pursuit of dreams.

Name: Nightly Stars
Description: The road to success is often paved with failures. The perseverance burning in Cosette was unyielding.

Name: Paean to Time
Description: Standing at the summit of success, Cosette's eyes shimmered slightly as she gazed resolutely into the distance.

Name: Eternal Chapter
Description: There are many women who came to this city in search of success, and Cosette was the most known out of them all.

Name: Radiant Altar
Description: People dared not look into those resolute eyes under the crown, nor stare into the burnt skin underneath those robes.

Name: Sorrowless Crown
Description: Pain and suffering often go hand in hand. When the king died, Serena became the one to shoulder the burden of war.

Name: Glacial Identity
Description: Dauntless, her bravery exceeded even that of her father. Yet even such high praises did not move Serena one bit.

Name: Northern Prophecy
Description: Serena still remembers the day her father died. It was a quiet evening, a flock of ravens were flying across the sky.

Name: Overwhelming Might
Description: That night, Serena charged into the enemy's ranks and ignited the enemy's banner into a fireball of light.

Name: Medal of Fire
Description: Serena charged with unmatched ferocity, her might seemingly unstoppable as swung her blade.

Name: Badge of Thunder
Description: As the arrow pierced the heart of the enemy's general, so did Serena's name echo through countless ears and hearts.

Name: Sun's Descent
Description: The enemy fell back. The once invincible seemingly melted away as Serene unleashed an arrow filled with vengeance.

Name: Crimson Ember
Description: Some say a cold throne can only be warmed by a compassionate heart beating for the people.

Name: Burning Resilience
Description: As Serena ascended the altar, the priest bestowed her father's scepter of power solemnly into her waiting grasp.

Name: In Her Name
Description: As Serena's just crusade gained fame, many factions sought to ally themselves with Queen Serena.

Name: Supreme Protection
Description: Even as the struggle for power raged on in the North Kingdom, Serena's sword will always fight for peace and justice.

Name: 龙舞新岁
Description: 扬起威武的龙头，龙身在人海中腾跃穿行。欢笑声、锣鼓声与鞭炮声交织，共同绘成这幅最热闹的新春画卷。

Name: 鼓乐喧天
Description: “敲锣打鼓迎新春！一敲福星高照，二敲万事如意，三敲人寿年丰！本喵在这里祝大家新年快乐哟~”

Name: Verdant Gleam
Description: When war was waged, she helped to quell the strife and restore peace. Cheers echoed throughout the land.

Name: Ominous Sign
Description: As the pandemic loomed, she dispersed people's fear and grew herbs in their soil, bringing forth hope.

Name: Plume Hat
Description: During the Light festivals, people hold grand parades and sing prayers in the bells. She, too, blends into the crowd.

Name: Slumber Veil
Description: Those who trace her steps would seek the darkness; for she always stays with those in need and fosters hope in them.

Name: Dark Messenger
Description: Blackbirds are usually ominous, but for the blessed, birds with green feathers from the darkness are a strand of hope.

Name: Dawn of Tomorrow
Description: No matter the hardship, always remember that the darkest nights always prelude the brightest dawn.

Name: Echoing Sea
Description: The idyllic tunes seemed to slow the passage of time as they danced elegantly in a sea of wondrous dreams.

Name: Seaside Adventure
Description: Swimming into the glimmering light and guided by the cerise whale, reaching for the bright and brilliant beyond.

Name: Dream's Embark
Description: Once she had made a decision, Cosette would see it through, no matter how tempting any alternatives may seem.

Name: Mystic Dream
Description: The glimmering stars and the dashing neon lights quietly shone for the girl who turned nothing into everything.

Name: Chapter of Destiny
Description: The stars beckoned toward the future and the past as the chapters of fate unfolded under a starry sky.

Name: 旧时密语
Description: 喜欢她的设计的人也不由为此捏了一把冷汗——不论流行如何天翻地覆，瑞安女士拥有一群忠实的支持者。

Name: 独具匠心
Description: 但瑞安女士用实际行动表明了自己还远不到要退出设计师行业的地步——时隔一年，她带着新作品回来了。

Name: 简约设计
Description: 简约大方的设计适配于许多不同的风格，不论是成熟优雅，还是活泼可爱，它总能为你的搭配增光添彩！

Name: Special Gift
Description: This bag takes inspiration from a gift bag. The classic colors mixed in with a dash of red fit it perfectly.

Name: Poetic Elegance
Description: Despite only releasing for a week, the new fan from the Apple Apparel Group has made it the latest fashion hit.

Name: 松雪辉照
Description: 门外站着许久未见的兄长，他风尘仆仆，身上满是落雪，眼中却似乎有着比灯火还要亮的光。

Name: 画堂浮香
Description: 家中被装点得喜气洋洋，不论是檐下、长廊还是院中，都被灯火照亮，四处都是一副佳节将至的景象。

Name: 岁寒霜华
Description: 即便如此，阿瑶却仍觉得有些失落。她知道大家与她一样，虽然没有说出口，但心中却都挂念着在外奔波的兄长。

Name: 琼筵宫灯
Description: 在等待中，佳节悄悄到来。夜色降临，华灯初上，阿瑶一家围在桌边庆贺节日，却突然听到家门被敲响的声音。

Name: 百顺为福
Description: 近来天气寒冷，许多地方都下了大雪，出行也因此受阻，兄长或许无法在节日到来之前赶回家中了。

Name: Velvet Bunny
Description: Her arrival drove away Cintra's solitude. Unlike Cintra, her cousin was a carefree flower, blooming in vibrance.

Name: Graceful Elegance
Description: She took Cintra to a cherry grove, where they found an injured rabbit, likely abandoned by its owner.

Name: Heartwarming Secret
Description: They patched up the rabbit before hiding it inside her cousin's room. For Cintra, it was a wish come true.

Name: Wishful Future
Description: When she left, her cousin told Cintra that the friendship and courage the little rabbit signified would never fade.

Name: Velvet Fun
Description: Unwilling to separate the puppies, Ira handed Chinchel some persimmon treats as he quietly thanked her.

Name: Trail of Hearts
Description: Surprised by his courtesy, she turned to see his cheeks blush. She quickly turned away, blushing slightly.

Name: Auspicious Occurrence
Description: Hearing a bark, Nini ran to the sound. Turned out Chinchel brought back a dog. The two of them instantly got along.

Name: Chasing Laughter
Description: If Ira pretended not to hear, a pebble would land squarely beside her foot, giving her a startle each time.

Name: Longing Solitude
Description: Ira would often enjoy the evening sitting in the yard. Chinchel would often use this chance to call out her name.

Name: Youthful Love
Description: The two would pull tricks and pranks between each other, slowly growing up with no clear winner.

Name: Ebbing Heartstrings
Description: He's not my best friend. He's a troublemaker!' Chinchel froze uncharacteristically at the sound of Ira's words.

Name: Unspoken Feelings
Description: Chinchel slowly became reserved and began to avoid Ira, as if trying to hide something from her.

Name: Gentle Warmth
Description: Ira's mother delegated persimmon treats to her again this year. Hesitant, Ira still left the house with Nini.

Name: Long Street Persimmon
Description: Nini always walked in the front, and her loving nature won the hearts of everyone in the neighborhood.

Name: Happy Trick
Description: Stay wise, use your creativity and enjoy the festival! Forget about your worries and spread laughter across the world.

Name: 九木香芋棒球帽
Description: 本款棒球帽自带修饰脸型的效果，香芋紫温柔可爱引领时尚单品新潮流！春光明媚，试试全新的搭配吧！

Name: 九木樱花小托特
Description: 手提斜挎皆可的粉色小托特，设计简约，色彩轻盈，适合放置随身小物，逛街郊游，轻便出行！

Name: Faraway Longing
Description: The Cloud, Pigeon Kingdom, and Wasteland... Wherever the young man went, he would send a postcard to Kiri.

Name: Prismatic Love
Description: He'd tell Kiri his next destination so she could write back, sharing fun stories and views.

Name: Special Sincerity
Description: Every postcard seemed like a bridge between them, and Kiri now looked forward to receiving her own letters.

Name: Endearing Vow
Description: Kiri had to run her shop and the photographer continued his journey, but postcards became a bond between them.

Name: Reminiscent Time
Description: The young man would send postcards with travel logs or photos, all of which Kiri treasured with heart.

Name: Fond Echo
Description: A new letter's here.' Kiri heard a knock and looked up to see the man holding a postcard with a bright smile.

Name: Wood Fairy
Description: As she slept, Abby felt something small and furry crawling up to her knee before squeezing into her arms.

Name: Tree of Dreams
Description: Abby smiled as she read the poems from the past.  Basking in the warm afternoon sun, she began to feel drowsy.

Name: Graceful Petals
Description: When she and Tara were young, they built a secret tree house that none of the adults knew about.

Name: Sunny Aria
Description: Even after Tara moved, Abby would still sometimes come here by herself and spend the night under the stars.

Name: Spring Breeze
Description: Abby squeezed into the tree house as wind flipped through the pages of slightly yellow pages of a poetry book.

Name: Special Companion
Description: The spine read: 'To my best friend Abby. May we never separate. – Tara.'

Name: Misty Umbrella
Description: Blushing in the warm breeze, Shuangyi and the young man finally shared their thoughts on poetry.

Name: Aromatic Expanse
Description: In a grove of peaches, they talked from noon to dusk. Shuangyi was impressed by his talent and sentiment.

Name: Peachy Warmth
Description: A student of her father's had exceptional talent. He could always think of the most beautiful rhyme on the spot.

Name: Blossom Mirage
Description: The students exchanged looks when they saw Shuangyi. Though the young man didn't look back, his ears had reddened.

Name: Longing Lament
Description: Shuangyi picked a peach blossom as a hair accessory that filled the grove with aroma, ready to compose a poem.

Name: Sunlit Blossoms
Description: But after two lines, her mind went blank, until a voice from the forest picked up her rhymes.

Name: Promised Years
Description: Shuangyi would come to the forest in the afternoon. She liked the clusters of blooms in spring there.

Name: Basket of Dreams
Description: Shuangyi followed the voice behind the tree and bumped into the young man from her father's class.

Name: Resplendent Tint
Description: Shuangyi quickly turned away and left before her father could scold her. He was very strict in class, after all.

Name: Wistful Longing
Description: The young man never gained any titles but left famed poems and paintings, of which Shuangyi was always the subject.

Name: Echoes of Destiny
Description: The war finally broke out. Hostility filled the once peaceful woods and fond memories shattered like glass.

Name: Lonesome Moon
Description: Instead of leaving with family, Eric hid in the dark ruins where the moon didn't shine, waiting for the promised time.

Name: Midnight Promise
Description: They promised to leave the world behind and spend the rest of their lives in a valley where they could be together.

Name: Sinful Embrace
Description: Generations of hatred might have put a wall between them, but couldn't stop the pull they felt.

Name: Moonlit Embrace
Description: If only bones remained of my hands, how should I invite you to a dance under the moon?'

Name: Hollow Lake
Description: At the end of her life, she returned to the moonlit lake, ignoring the feud between fairies and the sanguine.

Name: Starlit Meadow
Description: The buoyant songs stopped and the young man lowered his hand as the fairies' chattering sound came closer.

Name: Unclouded Moonlight
Description: She waited for the night, listening to the footsteps of patrolling fairies, and believed Eric would keep his promise.

Name: Ethereal Slumber
Description: She lifted her hem and danced as stars shimmered on her dress, igniting this long night that would last forever.

Name: Pale Moon Shadow
Description: The young man invited her to a dance, as the stars twinkled in the lake and faded away in the everlasting night.

Name: Fading Starlight
Description: Celestine waited by the lake until dew wetted her dress and stars faded away, but the young man didn't come.

Name: Eternal Starshine
Description: How could a fairy and a sanguine live together? Hatred kept them apart until their promise was forgotten in time.

Name: Starfall Dream
Description: The patrol fairies found a few sanguines in hiding and killed them before they could fight back.

Name: Astral Recall
Description: She hoped that Eric didn't keep his promise and moved into the Shadow City, instead of being killed by a cold arrow.

Name: Boat of Return
Description: Celestine finally felt the candle of her life burning out, all her regrets and love coming to an end.

Name: Starlit Promise
Description: To Olivian's surprise, a man resembling the knight was waiting for someone by the fountain.

Name: Cosmic Vastness
Description: True love stood the test of time, as starlight traversed the vast universe only to reach you.

Name: Starlit Destiny
Description: In the starlit garden, Olivian clasped her hands and sincerely wished for peace for the nation and its people.

Name: Stellar Hope
Description: A valiant knight brought the people a new hope. Olivian thought maybe he could save the kingdom.

Name: Veiled Fantasy
Description: Her dreams continued every night. As war broke out, worry began to grow in Olivian's heart.

Name: Radiant Gleam
Description: It was a long tale of love and death, but the details had been lost in the years of retelling.

Name: Midnight Ritual
Description: The knight led their army to victories. In his accolade ceremony, his armor shone brighter than the stars.

Name: Starlight Tears
Description: The knight returned to battle, but the invaders began plotting against him by bribing his servant.

Name: Veiled Starlight
Description: It's you...' they spoke at the same time. The two stars finally crossed paths again, leaving no regrets.

Name: Stairway to Victory
Description: The knight won the war but died during his return. Tears rolled down her cheeks when she saw his bloodstained emblem.

Name: Distant Lovesong
Description: Every flapping of wings is a heartbeat. Together with the wind they write a love song only the sky understands.

Name: Enduring Brilliance
Description: The rainbow connected the world with its gentle arms. Every color is a story of love and longing.

Name: Trace of Promise
Description: The birds flap their wings, leaving a trace of love, of silent promise that echoes in the sky.

Name: Fluffy Birth
Description: The broken shell marks the start of a new life. A brace embrace of the world despite the teetering steps.

Name: Scent of Sunlight
Description: Someone put a giant crepe with a chicken fillet...on his head? The girl stared wide-eyed at the school gate.

Name: Pastoral Delight
Description: The class went outside the city to help harvest crops. Whichever team picked the most fruits would receive a prize.

Name: Budding Legume
Description: The girl got a new idea from the bitter melon sunglasses she won and drew a design sketch for a bag.

Name: Virescent Charm
Description: Cloudria lifted the hem of her dress to catch fish in the lake, but the figure on her mind was nowhere to be seen.

Name: Summer Flare
Description: Who was the man? Did she know him? Cloudria threw a lotus to draw his attention but hit the back of his head instead.

Name: Elegant Poise
Description: As the crowd sang and cheered, Cloudria looked around curiously and a figure among the lotus leaves caught her eyes.

Name: Exuberant Ripples
Description: The man turned with a confused yet not angry look, asking who threw the lotus, his face unfamiliar yet handsome.

Name: Jubilant Leap
Description: His voice drew everyone's attention. Cloudria blushed with embarrassment, but thankfully, her sister helped her out.

Name: Lotus Rendezvous
Description: Cloudria rowed under a lotus leaf and saw the man again. She offered freshly picked lotus seeds as an apology.

Name: Pisces Embroidery
Description: Cloudria returned with an empty basket. Lotus roots were still muddy, but she refused to say where they came from.

Name: Fragrant Dream
Description: Cloudria had cuts on her fingertips but still insisted on gathering lotus seedpods from the lake.

Name: Lakeside Nelumbo
Description: The next day, Cloudria rowed out again to look for the man, but he had already set out on his way home.

Name: Stop Motion
Description: She never defends herself and only answers with her work. She's always on the road, looking for the shining moments.

Name: 往日回忆
Description: 轻轻晃动的流苏被风吹起，荡漾着旧时的回忆。逝去的时光不再，眼前的景色却一如往昔。

Name: 挽花心意
Description: 纯手工制作的颈饰，用金色的花朵点缀，似把流水落花挽留在当下，定格成春日记忆。

Name: 溯空讯号
Description: 雷达传来的情报如起伏的潮汐，莉恩的脑海里浮现出战场上的每一处细节，让她立于不败之地。

Name: 荣耀之诺
Description: 金色的勋章是荣耀的象征，不论何时，莉恩追逐胜利的信念从未改变，斗志在踏上战场的瞬间便被点燃。

Name: 未来守护
Description: 高冷的外表或许是因为不善言辞，当莉恩主动伸出手的那一刻，就代表你已经获得了她珍贵的友谊。

Name: 机源侧翼
Description: 知名设计师量身打造的装备，腰间侧翼在作战时会自动展开，让莉恩如流星般降临战场，划破沉闷的长夜。

Name: 溯空讯号·雷鸣
Description: 当她终于完成试炼，雷鸣如无尽的擂鼓，力量汇聚于她的身上，莉恩感受到了雷暴对她的臣服。

Name: 荣耀之诺·雷鸣
Description: 勋章代表的是过去的荣耀，而她会不断创造新的辉煌，当勋章被别上胸口时，就代表她又有了新的征程。

Name: 未来守护·雷鸣
Description: 她的双手掌握着雷暴的力量，炫目的闪电为她加冕。在战斗中莉恩会将队友护至身后，直面最猛烈的攻击。

Name: 机源侧翼·雷鸣
Description: 能源充能已全部完毕，突破极限的莉恩感受到前所未有的强大力量，少见地露出了微笑。

Name: 溯空讯号·风暴
Description: 风暴呼啸怒号，莉恩在狂风中听见了无数人的呐喊，听见了战场上的悲歌，还有那一声声坚定的宣誓。

Name: 荣耀之诺·风暴
Description: 那些声音化作信念的微光，在混沌的风暴中为莉恩指明前行的方向，支撑她抵达胜利的彼岸。

Name: 未来守护·风暴
Description: “凌空的莉恩”代表着对力量的无限追求，每一位选择她的玩家都可以在游戏中体验到她的故事。

Name: 机源侧翼·风暴
Description: 金色的阳光穿过风沙洒在她肩头，替她披上胜者的战袍。风暴为莉恩带来了全新的力量，推动着她继续前行。

Name: 幸福箭矢
Description: 乐声流连，她渐渐习惯有他隔窗相伴的午后。或许正因如此，白妮这些日子做出的巧克力格外香醇。

Name: 恋恋心语
Description: 恋爱前的紧张与惴惴，恋爱中的热烈与羞涩，心绪总在苦恼中带着甜蜜，这或许都是制作巧克力的特别秘方。

Name: 幸福箭矢·蜜桃
Description: 也许这就是思念的心情，白妮看着巧克力发呆。客人说巧克力的味道没有变化，可她为何还是尝到了苦味？

Name: 恋恋心语·蜜桃
Description: 她售卖着代表幸福的巧克力，等待飘扬的琴音归来。无数的巧克力中，她永远留有最特殊的、独属于他的那一块。

Name: 幸福箭矢·抹茶
Description: 他将礼物轻轻放在白妮面前，爱心包装的巧克力，用漂亮的丝缎装饰，能够看见包装的人留下了一些笨拙的痕迹。

Name: 恋恋心语·抹茶
Description: 收下这块手工巧克力吧，或许制作者的手艺笨拙，或许它并不完美。但这无比珍贵的心意，能让人感到幸福。

Name: Flap Fluff
Description: It was the first time she looked closely at a bee. It didn't have pretty wings, but it was cute in its own way.

Name: Nest of Wonder
Description: Shadie woke up to the warm sunlight. She walked out, rubbing her eyes, and saw her mom packing up for her.

Name: Sunward Relish
Description: The sun shone on the rusty gate of the botanical garden, while the thriving plants around drew all the attention.

Name: Tendril Stretch
Description: Lined inside the factory were glass jars of golden and sticky honey that filled the room with a sweet aroma.

Name: Sylvan Spring
Description: Shadie followed her mom down a path shaded by evergreen trees, while birds chirped among the leaves.

Name: Brimming Glee
Description: Do you want to meet the goddess of spring?' Her mom winked at her and took her on a bus to the botanical garden.

Name: Momentary Flare
Description: Shadie ran to a beaten trail in the daisy field for her mom to take a photo, when she suddenly heard a buzz.

Name: Breezy Garland
Description: Shadie held the camera to photograph the bees. 'Look, a honey factory!' she noticed an amber-colored building.

Name: Ambrosial Bloom
Description: Past a pebble stone road was a large field of daisies, their white petals like clouds and yellow florets like amber.

Name: Honey Torsade
Description: Ah, the bees! Shadie noticed some collecting nectars in the field. Quietly, she got closer without alarming them.

Name: Azure Sunbeam
Description: In a brilliant show, the glory isn't just for the lead; every honeybee deserves the audience's applause and cheers.

Name: 频道锁定
Description: 在年幼的梅绮眼中，新闻播报员几乎知道全世界所有的事，她也想成为新闻播报员，为人们讲述世界的万千变化。

Name: Pursuit of Dream
Description: 一个梦想在梅绮的心中扎了根，她想穿过那一方小小的屏幕，去看缤纷多彩的大千世界，去体验不一样的生活。

Name: 白金访谈
Description: 面对女孩的再三询问，村长叹了口气，摸了摸她的脑袋，没有回答。那时女孩不明白，为何村长的神情那样无奈。

Name: 每日热讯
Description: 后来梅绮逐渐长大，而成为新闻播报员的梦想，和电视上的广阔世界一样，始终被一重又一重的山脉阻挡。

Name: 频道锁定·黄
Description: 成为一名新闻主播，这个从前对梅绮而言近乎梦幻的理想，对现在村里的孩子们来说，已经不再那么遥不可及。

Name: 追梦之心·黄
Description: 梅绮排除万难，实现了自己幼年时的梦想，如今见过森罗万象的她，正在向世界介绍生她育她的家乡。

Name: 白金访谈·黄
Description: 而在墨亚索山的背后，还有更多深邃未知的山区，更多贫苦荒僻的村庄，以及更多一生都囿于崇山峻岭的人们。

Name: 每日热讯·黄
Description: 但是没有关系，只要这份追梦之心传递下去，绵延无尽的阳光终将穿过那扇窗，照亮深山中每一处晦暗之地。

Name: 频道锁定·粉
Description: 长达数月的拍摄结束后，领队找到梅绮和她父母，询问梅绮是否愿意跟随团队离开墨亚索山，前往城市学习深造。

Name: 追梦之心·粉
Description: 梅绮的纯真活泼令团队成员们莞尔，大家热情耐心地为她科普，梅绮对学习新知识十分开心，一路上兴致盎然。

Name: 白金访谈·粉
Description: 纵然有千般不舍，梅绮的父母依旧支持她走出深山，其他村民也纷纷为梅绮准备了临行礼物。

Name: 每日热讯·粉
Description: 那一天，车辆的引擎声响彻山谷，生于山野间的花朵，终于渐渐长出花苞，等待某一日的绽放。

Name: 频道锁定·蓝
Description: 从实习开始，一步步前行。无论采访任务多么艰辛，梅绮都不曾抱怨，能看到世界的更多面，让她乐在其中。

Name: 追梦之心·蓝
Description: 踏实勤恳、细致耐心，这个从深山中走出的女孩展现了她非凡的意志力，越走越远的梅绮也从未忘记自己的来处。

Name: 白金访谈·蓝
Description: 一封封书信犹如归鸟，翻山越岭、不远万里飞入墨亚索山间。梅绮以她的方式，为村民们讲述了山外的世界。

Name: 每日热讯·蓝
Description: 无数个黑夜，少女曾在山间苦苦等待日出，如今她已见到阳光，便想让其余仍在拼搏的人也能看到光明与希望。

Name: Summoned Eagle
Description: Natasha's friend, a beautiful eagle, circled above to guide the tribe so they wouldn't get lost in the desert.

Name: Distant Totem
Description: The tribe drifted from place to place and many died, as the desert seemed to provide no shelter for them.

Name: Natural Habitat
Description: No priestess was born after the last one died decades ago. They lost the blessings of nature and spiritual guidance.

Name: Oasis Search
Description: Let's go back!' one night, Natasha spoke, 'We'll go back where we came from! It's where we belong!'

Name: Scattered Seal
Description: We'll contact the other tribes.' Natasha's voice was determined, 'Let's unite our powers, and we can win!'

Name: Iridescent Glimmer
Description: People had lost hope and didn't believe Natasha's words, but they had no choice but to fight for one last chance.

Name: Blade of Time
Description: They were not the only banished tribe, and those that stayed lived in constant fear and dread.

Name: Voyage of Nature
Description: Unlike the other priestesses, Natasha wasn't spiritually blessed, but she gave people courage and hope.

Name: A Cozy Sweet Spot
Description: The sheep wished the boy happy birthday, who stared in surprise with a look of excitement glistening in his eyes.

Name: Unforgettable Bond
Description: Lilisa decided to leave town in case her secret was revealed. The boy came to stop her before she could leave.

Name: Freedom's Shore
Description: No one should be limited by their identity or talent. The town protected Lilisa so she could have a future.

Name: Berry Tart Clouds
Description: All magicians must serve the royal family. Lilisa would be punished severely for her pursuit of freedom.

Name: Tender Aroma Magic
Description: White cream spewed out into a fluffy sheep. It raised its sleepy eyes and bleated softly.

Name: Delicate Croissant
Description: The sheep rose to its feet and started dancing on Lilisa's palm, chasing the boy in cheerful steps.

Name: Cirrus of Snow
Description: Her cream magic became a secret between Lilisa and the town. She showed them more magic outside of work.

Name: Cloudtop Dreams
Description: Sweet cream danced in the air, turning into various images: sheep running on a ranch and slumbering on the cloud.

Name: Mellow Relish
Description: Lilisa treasured her time as a baker in the small town, but one early morning, she was robbed of this special joy.

Name: Artful Touch
Description: On a shopping trip, Lilisa saw someone familiar. She tried to hide her track, but the person still noticed her.

Name: Sweet Adornments
Description: Soon the royal guards came to the remote town. They put up notices looking for a magician who fled here.

Name: Sweet Dreaming Lamb
Description: None of their questioning and interrogations went anywhere. Lilisa could finally reopen her shop after the crisis.

Name: Serene Dream
Description: The townsfolk decided to work together to protect Lilisa—to repay the joy she brought to their life.

Name: Secret of Aroma
Description: Lilisa decided to take a risk for everyone. Together they fooled the guards into believing she had left town.

Name: Graceful Swirl
Description: Without a spotlight or orchestra, the dancer moved with the rhythms in her heart, each step full of life and grace.

Name: Curtain Call
Description: It was a dance with no audience but the stars in the night sky. Now a golden dawn awaited her.

Name: Stellar Stream
Description: The dancer tiptoed on the stars' reflection in the theater fountain, dancing with a delicate rose in her hand.

Name: Swan Suite
Description: The dancer's shadow would leave on quiet nights, tiptoeing and gyrating like a flower blooming under the moon.

Name: Soaring Plume
Description: Birds would often perch on the dancer's hair or arms. She envied them for being able to soar freely with wings.

Name: Everlasting Ardor
Description: One day a senior came from afar and put a red rose into the dancer's palm. 'May your wish come true.'

Name: Graceful Shadow
Description: The dancer had seen many dances, the classical ones in the theater or children's freestyle. They all fascinated her.

Name: Cinema Wonder
Description: In a sea of stars, the audience would see a rose-like stardust through a porthole and hear the protagonists' cheers.

Name: Wish of Tomorrow
Description: A young warrior roamed the desert as a ballad played under a starry sky. This time, he had the audience by his side.

Name: Chord Focus
Description: What's a perfect ending? Everyone has their own answer. People leave the theater, imagining what works for them.

Name: Outside Pictures
Description: A swordsman walked into a theater, a genius girl wandered in a supermarket, while a superhero had to go to school.

Name: Crunchy Magic
Description: People asked the staff member how to make the magical popcorn and only got the answer that it was a secret.

Name: Starlight Shimmer
Description: Popcorn would be finished when the movie ended. People would wave goodbye and forever remember the experience.

Name: Drifting Sorrow
Description: As time passes, only she stands still with a heart of sorrow, listening to the flute song and waiting for a reunion.

Name: Plum Elegance
Description: Rivers deep and mountains high, yet the longing remains unchanged. Plum trees will bloom again when snow falls.

Name: 远空传讯
Description: 舰桥上的人们还没有那么快反应过来，他们仍各司其职，尽己所能地，引导着这艘飞船飞向未来。

Name: 空间飞行
Description: 环境剧烈摇晃，刺耳的警报接连响起，各处受损的情况被不断反馈到舰桥，同时，一条条命令飞快且准确下达。

Name: 宇宙舷窗
Description: 但她并不打算现在就停止这次模拟，就算失败，这次航行也会为数据库带来有效且庞大的信息。

Name: 数据同屏
Description: 飞船驶入了小行星带，很快，人们就发现与计算的不同，无数碎裂的天体正无序且高速地运动着。

Name: 能源传导
Description: 随着她的声音响起，光幕上的曲线逐一消失，最后只剩下一条仍然泛着光芒，飞船的图标也随之出现在原点。

Name: 永恒视界
Description: 环境逐渐稳定下来，模拟中的飞船顺利起飞。无垠的宇宙就在舷窗之外，生命如同沧海中渺小的一粟。

Name: 隐匿端口
Description: 舰桥环境完全模拟了正式起飞时的状态，失重、耳鸣、眩晕……所有人都能清晰地感觉到，他们正在起航。

Name: 平均曲率
Description: 即便如此，在混乱的宇宙环境中，飞船的受损程度很快就超过30%。几分钟后，最重要的能源舱也损毁了。

Name: 无声巡梭
Description: 因为小行星带的存在，这条航线并非废墟孤岛的首选，但在其他航线模拟失败后，它成为了最佳选择之一。

Name: 寻知之环
Description: 但飞船的速度并未减缓，反而在不断提升。他们做好了最糟糕的准备——飞船的起航在末日来临之时。

Name: 时间棱镜
Description: 工作人员有条不紊地操作着面板，微光却微微摇头，她的计算已先一步得到结果，这次的模拟也会以失败告终。

Name: 视觉航标
Description: 官方科学院并没有发布任何相关信息，但参与研发飞船的人总怀着一种不安：毁灭将要降临的，或许是整个时空。

Name: 脉冲信号
Description: “出现小行星带，根据计算，将在三十分钟后到达小行星带边界。”“放出探测器，继续前进。”

Name: 湮灭恒星
Description: “小行星带的数据太少，当变量远远超出我们的预估，此前的所有计算都会变得毫无意义。”

Name: 时空棱镜
Description: “根据刚刚得到的数据，重新进行计算。”微光身形闪烁，很快消失不见，“五天后，准备第十二次航线模拟。”

Name: 未知界域
Description: 模拟的舰桥逐渐消失，熟悉的空间重新出现在众人面前——这里是废墟孤岛官方科学院的航线模拟实验室。

Name: 深梦祝福
Description: 亲爱的毛绒小熊，能否帮助她重新找回家人？午夜最深的梦里，她依稀听到了神明肯定的回答。

Name: 未来希冀
Description: 泪水沾湿了枕头，她将小熊紧紧拥在怀里，梦中神明的承诺，赋予了她继续坚持的勇气。

Name: 甜心茶会
Description: 只要努力生活，总有一天会得到想要的未来，望着窗前的第一道曙光，她决心认真而坚定地走下去。

Name: 形影相依
Description: 腰间系上蓬松的蝴蝶结，裙角绣上精致的花，即使现状不尽如人意，也要打起精神认真过好每一天。

Name: 暖心祝福
Description: 毛绒小熊背上的蝴蝶结，是她亲自挑选了缎带花色，在生日那天小心翼翼系上的。

Name: 深梦祝福·华丽
Description: 一名温柔安静的男孩，尤其喜欢陪伴在她的左右，无论打扫房间还是烹饪三餐，他总会来帮些小忙。

Name: 未来希冀·华丽
Description: 月光弥漫的夜里，她还在窗前构思新的小熊款式，父母留下的那只毛绒小熊，站在窗边静静陪伴着她。

Name: 甜心茶会·华丽
Description: 儿时梦中神明的话语，依然激励着她努力前行，她期待着长大后的自己，能拥有一个属于自己的家。

Name: 形影相依·华丽
Description: 经历岁月变迁，毛绒小熊已经旧了很多，她依旧喜欢不时将它拥在怀里，如同怀抱着最珍贵的宝藏。

Name: 暖心祝福·华丽
Description: 小熊毛茸茸的触感，总会让她感觉又回到了童年，在温暖午后的摇椅上，听母亲哼唱童谣。

Name: 深梦祝福·珍稀
Description: 她亲手制作的毛绒小熊，受到了所有孩子的喜爱，听到大家说想学习制作小熊时，她微笑着答应了。

Name: 未来希冀·珍稀
Description: 曾经依赖她的少年，如今依然陪伴她打理一切，甚至在不久前的某一天，认真对她表达了爱意。

Name: 甜心茶会·珍稀
Description: 午夜时分，她看着怀中的小熊，回忆起一路走来的风风雨雨。往事如水，如今的她，已经有了能遮风挡雨的家。

Name: 形影相依·珍稀
Description: 父母留下的毛绒小熊，依旧被她珍重地摆放在床头，十余年来的相依相伴，小熊早已成为她的亲人。

Name: 暖心祝福·珍稀
Description: 求婚的那一天，少年拿出一个自己亲自设计制作的小熊，小熊的原型显而易见，就是他心爱的她。

Name: 深梦祝福·茗
Description: 一届届的孩子们离开了孤儿院，她的店铺也开遍了城市，但有关父母的消息，还是从未曾传来。

Name: 未来希冀·茗
Description: 一个寻常的夏日午后，她在新开的店铺里乘凉，忽然见到两位年过半百的老人，蹒跚着走到了吧台前。

Name: 甜心茶会·茗
Description: 阔别多年，他们有太多思念要向彼此倾诉，毛绒小熊静静坐在一旁，微笑地见证着这一切。

Name: 形影相依·茗
Description: 上天突如其来的馈赠，令她不知所措地呆在原地，笑容还未来得及浮上脸庞，泪水就先湿了眼眶。

Name: 暖心祝福·茗
Description: 奶茶店推出了新口味的奶茶，尝过的客人都说，弥漫的茶香里，仿佛能喝出久别重逢的悠长滋味。

Name: 深梦祝福·寐
Description: 某日下班回家，她收到了动画负责人的消息，两位年过半百的老人，来到电视台坚持要见她一面。

Name: 未来希冀·寐
Description: 怀着某种预感，她认真打扮前往赴约，在见到老人们陌生又熟悉的脸庞时，两行泪水潸然而下。

Name: 甜心茶会·寐
Description: 重逢的餐桌上，她笑着聊起从前的岁月，陪伴多年的毛绒小熊被她抱在怀里，见证这感人的一幕。

Name: 形影相依·寐
Description: 命运的捉弄下，他们曾经天各一方，感谢上天的眷顾让他们重逢，从此不必再错过陪伴彼此的时光。

Name: 暖心祝福·寐
Description: 神明的承诺果然兑现，今夜，她抱着毛绒小熊入睡，不必再在梦中幻想与家人团聚的场面。

Name: Tracing Breeze
Description: The rain and the sun take turns to nourish the wilderness. Where there is rain and sunlight, there is life.

Name: Raindrop Journey
Description: The kids were fascinated and described their own idea of it to the teacher, bringing a smile to Lilitha's face.

Name: Clouded Guardian
Description: Her mood brought clouds to the sky as rain fell and children dispersed, which made Lilitha feel even worse.

Name: Azure Glaze
Description: It rained for days in the forest until the sunshine elf came to console Lilitha, bringing a rainbow over her clouds.

Name: Rainbow Drop
Description: A musician wrote a rhyme inspired by the rain that children would sing while stepping in the splashing rain puddles.

Name: Eternal Cycle
Description: The sunshine elf followed Lilitha around the globe and witnessed the cycle of water from the sea to rainfalls.

Name: Drizzle Ripple
Description: The tree that they planted together waves its leaves to greet them. It wouldn't grow up without the sun or the rain.

Name: Circle of Winds
Description: The wind slowly carried the cloud away, as Lilitha hummed and floated with the humid air on a journey of freedom.

Name: Viridescent Whisper
Description: Cuckoo, sun's up and no more rain. Cuckoo, time's up and don't stay.' Ms. Lisa was stopped by the owl's puzzle.

Name: Longing Vines
Description: Ms. Lisa quickly asked the wise turtle for help. 'Home is wherever you are missed.' it answered mysteriously.

Name: Spring Tranquility
Description: Ms. Lisa asked what it meant, but the turtle only shook its head. As the animals left, silence returned to the woods.

Name: Mellow Fairytale
Description: Sorry I startled you.' the girl apologetically patted Ms. Lisa on her fluffy head and kissed her pink nose.

Name: Emerald Aroma
Description: The tea party ended in the scarlet twilight. The balloons were gone, but the sweetness of desserts still lingered.

Name: Woodland Path
Description: It was time to go home, but the way Ms. Lisa came from was now blocked by shrubs. She couldn't find her way home.

Name: Sylvan Whisper
Description: As the sky darkened and the wind whooshed, Ms. Lisa walked alone among the menacing shadows of the trees and shrubs.

Name: Intertwining Vines
Description: Thick vines blocked her way. Suddenly, a loud boom came from somewhere, startling her like thunder.

Name: Lemon Essence
Description: Ms. Lisa rubbed her eyes and realized she was still on the terrace at home, the smell of fresh lemon in the air.

Name: Lemon Aroma
Description: The sunshine? Ms. Lisa asked. The owl nodded. She sat at the table and the crab chef served her a piece of lemon cake.

Name: Rich Fragrance
Description: Before Moria came of age, her sister had made her wine's recipe, with a rich aroma and refreshing floral fragrance.

Name: Sloshing Wine
Description: The wine, Moonlight Rose, would be shared for the first time at Moria's coming-of-age party her sister prepared.

Name: Rosy Spotlight
Description: On Moria's birthday, the chateau owner greeted everyone in a stunningly beautiful gown of white roses.

Name: Dazzling Star
Description: When asked who designed the dress, the owner waved at the center of the dance floor and gently called 'Moria.'

Name: Lonesome Night
