Name: Harbinger of Snow
Description: The princess made her name in the battle. Many wished to challenge her, including a wandering crimson dragon.

Name: Spell of Frost
Description: The princess gladly agreed. She was no longer chained by fate and fear. The world awaited her exploration.

Name: 桃枝盈香
Description: “我不知这桃树有主，路过干渴得厉害，便摘了一颗桃子吃。”少女站起身，面上微红，似是有些羞赧。

Name: 锦绣桃华
Description: 桃实本就善良，全然没有生气，反而劝慰对方不要放在心上。她一边照顾桃树，一边与少女闲聊起来。

Name: 溪谷落英
Description: 少女去过很多地方，那些截然不同的风光引桃实听得入了迷。虽是初见，两人却如相识多年的好友一般。

Name: 澄莹碧玉
Description: 只是桃实还有许多事情要做，少女也即将踏上新的旅途，短暂的相遇之后，便是不知何时重逢的别离。

Name: 时果提篮
Description: 临别之际，少女却不知从何处变出了一枚桃核，她递给桃实，只道是吃了那颗桃子的赔礼。

Name: Moonside Sparrow
Description: Unlike the day, the river at night was serene and quiet like a painting, except for the occasional bird chirps.

Name: Verdant Stream
Description: A small boat drifted by, sending ripples ashore. Flowers and leaves danced in the breeze, as the moon watched above.

Name: Poetic Indulgence
Description: Inspired by the scene, Coralie hurriedly wrote in the pale moonlight: the river shimmers below, the moon glows above.

Name: Hazed Canoe
Description: As her friends left one by one at nightfall, Coralie sat in the boat, contemplating her unfinished poem.

Name: Pristine Gloam
Description: Lost in poetry, Coralie heard a sudden call for help and saw a gentle scholar waving from the shore.

Name: Moonlight Glamour
Description: Coralie moored the boat and learned the scholar's mother needed care, but he couldn't find a boat to cross the river.

Name: Emerald Dewdrop
Description: Coralie let the scholar onto the boat. It rocked violently, but luckily he caught her scattering manuscripts.

Name: Longing Cruise
Description: The scholar's mother recovered days later, so he visited Coralie with ink, paper and rare manuscripts to thank her.

Name: Glaucous Haze
Description: The young scholar read all of Coralie's work and kept praising her talent in poetry, completely in awe.

Name: Veiled Grace
Description: The young scholar slowly quieted down and started blushing. Coralie chuckled, veiling her smile with a fan.

Name: Feather Beacon
Description: Aileen is the best guide in the tribe. With Staro's help, she dares to venture into the unknown and find new paths.

Name: Roaming Steps
Description: Wounds and scars are unavoidable for a guide. They are like medals for her, symbolizing each adventure.

Name: Guardian Bow
Description: Aileen shoots arrows as markers with her favorite bow. It helps her navigate the vast expanse of sand.

Name: Wildland Breeze
Description: Staro takes to the air and gazes at the ground, a vigilant gleam in its eyes, guiding Aileen to safety.

Name: Blessing of Wind
Description: Aileen comes and goes like a wind. People believe that her tattoo is the secret to her speed, guarding her travels.

Name: Feather Beacon - Cyan
Description: Aileen led the caravan to the tribe. The merchant noticed the rare herbs and handicrafts and brought fortune there.

Name: Roaming Steps - Cyan
Description: No one knows for sure where Aileen is. She is an untraceable wind, but she is always where she is needed.

Name: Guardian Bow - Cyan
Description: Aileen's favorite bow emits a lingering sound when the string is plucked. It's a symbol of hope for many travelers.

Name: Wildland Breeze - Cyan
Description: The wind praises Aileen's name. She's a beacon of hope in the desert, leading one forward and finding a way home.

Name: Blessing of Wind - Cyan
Description: Even those who haven't seen Aileen draw similar tattoos, wish to receive her guide and never lose their way.

Name: 甘美灵桃
Description: 桃实哭笑不得，还当是少女的恶作剧，她方才伸手，少女却倏忽不见影踪，桃核自然也掉到了地上。

Name: Totem's Pillar
Description: In silence, blood dripped into the sand. Her noble blood awakened the lupine god from slumber.

Name: Lupine Dream
Description: As death loomed, Henutawi only regretted that she didn't finish her vengeance, instead of fearing the long slumber.

Name: Marvel of Gems
Description: The guards watched as Henutawi fell among the wolves in a pool of her own blood, so they left to report to Celti.

Name: Radiant Shine
Description: Henutawi's heart was more valuable than any treasure on the scales. Under the sun, the god offered her an accord.

Name: Veil of Shadow
Description: The god would lend her his powers to finish her revenge. Then she would offer her flesh and soul as sacrifice.

Name: Faded Twinkle
Description: Henutawi agreed to the deal and transformed into a gorgeous woman traveling in white veils.

Name: Bright Glory
Description: Henutawi returned to the bustling streets of the capital as a mysterious merchant who held immeasurable fortune.

Name: Cerulean Dream
Description: Henutawi played both sides: she contacted her loyal followers, while her fortune attracted those greedy for more.

Name: Emerald Wings
Description: No nobles in the palace could refuse the rare spices and gems she brought. Soon, she became an esteemed guest.

Name: Pearl of the Dune
Description: Henutawi looked up at the hanging moon and closed her eyes. The lupine god smiled, claiming two noble hearts.

Name: Solar Scorch
Description: The wolves howled at the moon every night, breaking the dark silence and striking fear into everyone's heart.

Name: Veiled Visage
Description: Henutawi spread rumors that the wolves were seeking revenge on Celti. Soon it sparked fear in the man.

Name: Sincere Companion
Description: The little fairy was too shy to make new friends, so Annia wondered how she could keep her company for long.

Name: Colorful Folds
Description: Annia had grown from a naughty kid into a young adult, but the little fairy stayed the same.

Name: Picture Book
Description: It was a book of fairytales and proof of Annia and the fairy's friendship, recording the time they spent together.

Name: Sylvan Outlook
Description: She sat in front of the window and let the wind flip her diary to the day when she first met the little fairy.

Name: Endearing Memory
Description: Do you live around here?' Annia extended a friendly hand to the little fairy, 'Wanna hang out with me?'

Name: Mellow Fantasy
Description: Annia made a special friend. They would watch the flowers, feed the animals and enjoy the beautiful days together.

Name: Serene Fairytale
Description: Young Annia didn't know the difference between humans and fairies. She was sincere and passionate about everything.

Name: Dawn Zephyr
Description: For the first time reality hit Annia hard - compared to fairies, human lives are too short.

Name: Ink of Dreams
Description: She found a solution! She picked up a pen and started writing her story: a little girl's adventure with a fairy.

Name: Prismatic Dream
Description: As she grew older, Annia noticed the difference between them - time meant nothing to the little fairy.

Name: Butterfly Grace
Description: If you didn't know what you wanted, she would gently guide you to express your ideas.

Name: Bloom of Wings
Description: After deciding on the color and pattern, you'd hear Lanier clap her hands and then a rustle behind.

Name: Butterfly Dream
Description: Instead of going right to work, Lanier would pour a warm cup of flower tea first and ask your thoughts in detail.

Name: Blossom Fantasy
Description: Lanier would place your hands on a velvet pad, and the butterflies would flutter to a box of nail polish.

Name: Fluttering Butterfly
Description: Before you could turn around, you'd see beautiful butterflies fly around you, flapping their wings.

Name: Glowing Rebirth
Description: Lanier would apply a special top coat for you and put away the tools—you'd see butterfly patterns on the bottles, too.

Name: Secret of Butterflies
Description: Clip, clean, polish, color, and ornaments—the butterflies would soon finish a marvelous set of nails!

Name: Stainless Satin
Description: The butterflies didn't need Lanier's directions to work, as if they could either read her mind or yours.

Name: Peaceful Night
Description: Nicole, let's catch fireflies!' Following her friend's playful idea, she enjoys a summer night aglow with lights.

Name: Lemon-Kissed Summer
Description: What a cute bag! Is it a dumpling?' 'It's a lemon! See the leaves on it?' 'Either way, it's adorable!'

Name: Vanilla Lemon Dream
Description: Lemon, vanilla, milkshake... Nicole instantly falls for this ice cream. Its cool sweetness refreshes the summer heat.

Name: Lemon-Scented Encounter
Description: Make a wish!' A meteor streaks across the sky. Nicole closes her eyes, hoping for a romantic encounter someday.

Name: Lovely Encounter
Description: The fireworks festival never disappoints. Though fleeting, each brilliant bloom leaves a lasting memory in every heart.

Name: Gentle Sea Breeze
Description: At a seaside inn, Nicole gazes at the stars beyond the glass roof. The soothing waves lull her into a dream.

Name: Carefree Waves
Description: The deep sea was always an azure serenity despite the storms above. The carefree days became boring after a while.

Name: Echoing Glass
Description: Besha traveled with fish as the currents brought words from afar. She followed the sea and could always find her way.

Name: Invaluable Experience
Description: The old turtle had left the sea and ventured onto land. Besha asked him, 'What is life like for girls on land?'

Name: Shimmering Sea
Description: They'd travel with friends and try different cuisines. From every leaf and snowflake, they'd learn something unique.'

Name: Ocean Pearl
Description: Besha began her journey alone across narrow, dangerous trenches and found underwater ruins with a telephone booth.

Name: Embrace of the Waves
Description: Besha's call actually reached someone. After learning she was in the sea, a girl named Arina asked what it was like.

Name: Pure White Spindrift
Description: There were bubbling volcanos and secret caves in the depth. For the first time, Besha learned the wonders of the sea.

Name: Murmuring Heart
Description: Besha would tell Arina what she saw while Arina painted it down. The telephone booth connected the girls.

Name: Overlapping Surges
Description: Besha was beyond thrilled to hear a voice from outside, so she looked around and told Arina her truest feelings.

Name: Curious Vision
Description: Arina hadn't left the studio in days. She stared at the ocean through the window until a call came.

Name: Gloomy Cloud
Description: Arina wiped the dry paint off of her arms and rested against a tree. She flipped through her paintings in frustration.

Name: Unfinished Painting
Description: Frustrated that she couldn't capture the best moment of the sea, she heard the waves lapping as if beating her heart.

Name: Sapphire Peace
Description: Arina had painted the sea from its most peaceful moment, to surging waves and dark undercurrents.

Name: Whisper of Sincerity
Description: Drawn by Besha's sincerity, Arina tried to talk to her and realized she had been living in an uncharted ocean.

Name: Pure Emotion
Description: The caller remained quiet for a while before speaking, 'Hello, I'm Besha. Are you living on land?'

Name: Flash of Genius
Description: Besha yearned for land, while Arina wished to know more about the sea, hoping to get new ideas for her art.

Name: Fantastic Picturebook
Description: How should I describe it to you.' Besha muttered. Arina heard murmurs of the sea and felt like floating in the deep.

Name: Aureate Sparkle
Description: Arina saw the ocean in her mind clearly as Besha described it—fish swam by in schools, glistening like floating gems.

Name: Feathery Stroke
Description: Sunlight turned the sea into a wonderland. Arina leaped above the surface with dolphins and saw the unique blue.

Name: Vision of Art
Description: Besha enlightened Arina with knowledge of the sea. With her understanding of the ocean, Arina finished a masterpiece.

Name: Ocean Mosaic
Description: The colorful scroll of the ocean unfolded in her mind with green algae dancing in waves among the corals.

Name: Dolphin Dance
Description: The dormant sea looked tranquil in the pale moonlight. The dolphins playfully tossed a few strange balls around.

Name: Astral Brilliance
Description: A crisis loomed in the shadow. As the visitors talked about the show, someone was planning their heist of treasures.

Name: Gemstone Waves
Description: A kid woke up at night and thought Vivienne was playing with the dolphins, not seeing the rage in her eyes.

Name: Rejoicing Cloud
Description: Vivienne commanded the dolphins on the beach. They worked perfectly together as if they'd done it countless times.

Name: Feather of Romance
Description: The sea embraced everything. The Tulliranians got used to the new life soon as smart dolphins guarded the bay.

Name: Silent Aqua
Description: No wonder the dolphins understand me!' the kids screamed. Vivienne closed the book and said it was time for dinner.

Name: Transparent Cube
Description: Tourists also come to the Tulliranian Bay for Vivienne's Dolphin Inn. It's famed for its location and novel cuisine.

Name: Minty Chill
Description: Vivienne never ran out of creativity. She added a special mint and sea salt flavor to the cake that every kid liked.

Name: Creamy Sweetness
Description: Vivienne blew the seashell as dolphins elegantly leapt above the water, leaving a fantastic curve in the air.

Name: Bayside Festival
Description: People gathered around the bonfire on the beach. A special summer show began with the strum of a guitar.

Name: Feather of Fantasy
Description: The princess paid her price. She couldn't die and continued to roam the forgotten land she loved in the long years.

Name: Aqua Promise
Description: Time slowly erased the sorrow in the princess's heart. She found a path to the future with her love for the land.

Name: Flowers of Wonder
Description: Pages of tears and growth turn as time passes, but the morning of the blooming flowers shall never be forgotten.

Name: Blossoming Hedge
Description: The girl dozed off in the afternoon sun. Inside every morning glory growing on the hedge was a loveable dream.

Name: Feathery Petal
Description: Each blossom was a song of the season. She had always loved the morning glory and wrote down notes of their growth.

Name: Daydream Slumber
Description: The summer sun shone on her notebook and dyed the beautiful handwriting golden, placing her dreams inside each bloom.

Name: Silken Zephyr
Description: Purple elegance dotted the green vines. From the elegant blooms the girl found inspiration for growth and dream.

Name: Evanescent Bloom
Description: The flowers bloomed and adorned the season. Even if one day they wilted, their brilliance would always be remembered.

Name: Diary of Blooms
Description: She knew every flower and recorded their growth, as if the blooms wrote down a romantic diary with her hand.

Name: Skyward Sprout
Description: The blooms seemed fragile but never ceased to reach the sky. Like them, she never stopped to chase her dream.

Name: 童稚手迹
Description: 他们从未体验过如此新奇的课堂，哪怕是最好动的孩子，也在画本前认真执笔，绘着那张属于他的画卷。

Name: 向阳之花
Description: 向日葵盛放时，画册也即将完成。他们共同见证了花朵从青绿变得灿金，向日葵田也从冷清到游人如织。

Name: 向阳篇章
Description: 这是乔娅在海蒂小镇当美术老师的第一年。向日葵将绽之际，她翻开学生们的练习本，发现上面绘满了金色的花。

Name: 落笔斑斓
Description: 稚嫩的笔触是孩子们对向日葵独特的印象，或许每年夏天，小镇这一片金色的海洋早已印入了孩子们心中。

Name: 青涩之作
Description: 那些彩绘的向日葵，尽管歪歪扭扭，却极富生机。看起来，孩子们都很喜欢向日葵呢！乔娅心想。

Name: 图鉴记录
Description: 从沉默抽出的绿茎，到正在孕育的花盘，孩子们用眼睛仔细观察着向日葵生长的过程，眼眸中闪着好奇的光。

Name: 循风捕梦
Description: 大家决定制作一本画册，记录花朵绽放的过程。孩子们兴致勃勃地讨论，纷纷说出自己想画的部分。

Name: 盛夏萦香
Description: 她开始带孩子们外出写生，带他们走进夏日的田野里，观察向日葵如何展叶、如何盛放，又如何追逐阳光。

Name: 向阳花语
Description: 那些风格各异的画作，用笔稚嫩，充满童趣。画上的花朵姿态万千，色有深浅，却都饱含着孩子们最真挚的喜爱。

Name: Wooden Boardwalk
Description: The fish seemed to bid her farewell when it left, but she didn't know their language and could only flash a smile.

Name: Holiday Leisure
Description: She couldn't dive to explore deeper. The bay was busy, and Jennia almost forgot about the stranded blowfish.

Name: Golden Vision
Description: Another blowfish got stranded—like tumbleweed, it was rolling towards Jennia with seaweed caught in its spines.

Name: Innocent Fairytale
Description: She wondered if it was the same blowfish. Then it pouted at her, as if it was a secret signal between them.

Name: Bubble Ring
Description: To return the favor of the seaweed, she picked some blooms and braided a garland for the pouting blowfish.

Name: Castle of Sand
Description: Make the bow hairpin into a little flag atop the castle and decorate it with seashells—the Ocypode Castle is complete!

Name: Cooling Shade
Description: The 1st Beach Art Festival is in full swing! Grab a drink and start the journey of your dream design.'

Name: Starlit Whimsy
Description: Event banners were everywhere on the beach. Bona felt her hairpin—on it was a ghost crab waving its claws.

Name: Moments of Wonder
Description: When Bona came to Mimit Bay with her family, she loved watching ghost crabs digging holes in the sand.

Name: Holiday Plan
Description: Bona would start middle school after the summer. It was time to protect the crabs herself! Bona made up her mind.

Name: Ocypode Medal
Description: Dig a hole, shape the sand with water, and build slowly. Fully focused, the girl worked to realize her grand plan.

Name: Floral Midsummer
Description: The last step was especially hard: the castle needed a beautiful spire, so she had to carefully shape and steady it.

Name: Seaside Awe
Description: The castle was half done when a crab scurried by and hid in a rock, looking cautiously at her with its beady eyes.

Name: Cerulean Wish
Description: Her travel dream came true after years. The virescent woods and glistening rivers captivated Vivisha.

Name: Cloud Remembrance
Description: Her handwritten diary slowly grew thicker, and the cloud kept Vivisha's company in every photo.

Name: Voyage of Dream
Description: Early in the morning, Vivisha lit the flame of departure. With a cheer of surprise, the cloud flew afar with her.

Name: Tender Wish
Description: Vivisha and the cloud became friends. They started preparing to journey the world, for it was their shared dream.

Name: Journey Onward
Description: I can ride the hot air balloon to faraway lands. With hope for the future, Vivisha carefully mended it anew.

Name: Rainbow Moment
Description: As the cloud suggested, Vivisha opened the warehouse and saw an old hot air balloon lying in dust and spider webs.

Name: Unveiled Dream
Description: Miya hadn't taken a day of rest for years. She never halted her steps, determined to achieve greater things.

Name: Blooming Farland
Description: As the golden sunset sank to the sea, Miya lay on the soft bench and fell asleep in the fragrant sea breeze.

Name: Glamorous Lantern
Description: After a full day of work, Miya returned to her office and saw a colorful flyer that stood out in black and white.

Name: Heart's Perch
Description: Summer was a good time for a holiday. Miya was told to consult a travel agency and see if she liked any resorts.

Name: Pristine Brocade
Description: The ticket to the Kradle Resort in her palm was like an invitation from the sea and sun, urging her to set out now.

Name: Refreshing Blueberry
Description: Miya arrived at the Kradle Resort. The sun shone bright and the gauze curtains flapped in the wind as she imagined.

Name: Shimmering Hope
Description: After a nap, Miya woke up to the sound of waves. She was fully relaxed, the joy of freedom bubbling inside.

Name: Forget Me Not
Description: Hesitantly, Miya joined the travel agency's lucky draw and couldn't believe it when told she won the first prize.

Name: Longing Flower
Description: After graduation, Miya joined a famous fashion design company and became the team leader for her outstanding talent.

Name: Fanciful Years
Description: The letters have remained in the mailbox for years. Opening them unlocks memories sealed in time.

Name: Refined Rhymes
Description: A sea of blooming flowers in the wind stirs ripples in her heart, blurring dream and reality.

Name: Embellished Memory
Description: The last sun fades as dusk descends. Amid evening whispers of the breeze, moonlight begins the night's chapter.

Name: Lemon Delight
Description: Nikki, thank you for designing this suit. The starting gun for the final match is firing soon. Cheer for me!'

Name: 落花遮颜
Description: 几个游手好闲的无赖闯入茶馆，粗鲁地打断了评弹，在少女面前胡搅蛮缠，艾思手持长剑，上前将少女护在身后。

Name: 义无他顾
Description: 经过一番比拼，无赖们悻悻离开。少女站起身来，向艾思深深一礼：“多谢姑娘仗义相助，救风竹于水火之中。”

Name: 一尺寒光
Description: 艾思微笑着摆摆手，学着话本中的云端侠客说道：“不必客气，路见不平拔刀相助，本就是江湖儿女的分内事。”

Name: 落花遮颜·竹
Description: “我长大后也想成为像艾思姐姐一样的人！”“为什么呢？”“因为我想保护姐姐，保护更多需要帮助的人！”

Name: 义无他顾·竹
Description: 艾思仿佛看到了自己小时候的影子，她摸了摸云竹的头，说道：“只要你有一颗勇敢的心，就一定能实现愿望。”

Name: 一尺寒光·竹
Description: 夕阳渐渐落下，临别之际，艾思将佩剑解下赠予了云竹，在一片翠绿的竹海中，小小的梦想和希望因此悄然萌发。

Name: 巧思时刻
Description: 蕾丝小帽是南希最喜爱的单品之一，它就像蛋糕最上层的装饰，吸引所有人的目光，成为夺目的一抹亮色。

Name: 匠心设计
Description: 适当留白能令整套搭配更显轻盈，因此南希并没有选择什么繁复的首饰，简约的饰品更能衬托出高雅的气质。

Name: 温柔流年
Description: 南希出门会随身携带纸和笔，便于记录那些一闪而过的灵感。轻巧的提包兼具美观与实用，总能得到她的青睐。

Name: 烂漫时刻
Description: 戴着这样的一顶俏皮可爱的帽子，与恋人相约在甜品店，柠檬蛋糕与对方的笑容，都是点缀夏日的色彩。

Name: 浪漫设计
Description: 空荡的掌心终于牵回远走的恋人，心中的阴霾也渐渐消散，她的笔下，更多灵动美好的设计一一涌现。

Name: 明媚岁月
Description: 南希合上设计图册，她深知，过往的空白很难填补，但只要携手同行，未来还会有更多的美好等待着他们。

Name: 身似游龙
Description: 越千霜身形微动，武器如游龙般在身前划过一道弧线，巧妙地挡住了对方的进攻。兵戈相撞，发出清脆的撞击声。

Name: 势不可挡
Description: 鼓点急促，情况焦灼，越千霜身形忽地向后一闪又如电般疾冲，武器带着破空之声直点女子罩门，胜负瞬间已分。

Name: 应对自如
Description: 欢呼声中越千霜认可了军士的勇猛，随后她留在擂台上，将比试中攻守招式的关窍详细拆解，为将士们答疑解惑。

Name: 寒影孤霜
Description: 忠君守国，越家军深知自己的责任与使命，未有一日懈怠，他们不断磨炼自我，只为守护云端帝国的安宁与繁荣。

Name: Guardian of Piety
Description: Every time she woke up from a dream, she felt uneasy. Her confusion drove her to seek answers from the stars.

Name: Memories Sealed
Description: One night, she finally deciphered the stars' secrets: the dreams weren't the future, and this world wasn't her home.

Name: Reality Re-established
Description: The dreams were the past: Her home was invaded; as she was about to dissipate, her companions preserved her essence.

Name: Power of Slumber
Description: Tranquility dominated the sphere formed by divine power. The Star Goddess regained her strength, nurtured by nature.

Name: Elegy of Departure
Description: Feeling divine power within her, she knew it was time to leave. She must break this sphere to return to her home.

Name: Meteor Wishes
Description: The mountains, ocean, and creatures turned into meteors, shooting all over the sky and granting her power.

Name: Murmurs of Stars
Description: The enemy retreated, tranquility restored. The goddess and her companions gazed up at the dazzling stars above.

Name: Night of Comets
Description: The stars granted her power and the mysteries of the universe. The goddess closed her eyes, anticipating sweet dreams.

Name: Fullness of Moon
Description: The stars and the moon crisscross into a brilliant scroll of the night that captivates countless souls.

Name: Wafting Fragrance
Description: Kui is always fascinated by the human world. Flowers emanate a fragrance of their own, as they sway in the wind.

Name: Haze Dispersed
Description: Smoke coils from homes as the night falls. Kui appears in the sky, drawing the gaze of young and old alike.

Name: Lupine Shadow
Description: They are inseparable. Some say the wolf is Kui's avatar, while others say that they are kindred spirits.

Name: Rejoice in Time
Description: When Kui is on duty, the agile wolf always stays close by her, sometimes lying still, sometimes darting around.

Name: Grand Euphoria
Description: Mansions abound in the sky, but all mansion officials think that Kui is easy to get along with and loyal to friends.

Name: Spirit Essence
Description: Kui can hear a girl's sigh from a thousand miles away and can see a soldier's face as he charges on horseback.

Name: Vigorous Spirit
Description: Galloping across the nine skies, leaving worldly worries behind—that's the way Kui lives by.

Name: Peaceful Rest

Description: “我们不会失败，因为我们的身后是祖国，是亲人，我们绝不能让他们失望！”克蕾索的宣言令战士们气势大振。

Name: 不屈捍卫·将
Description: 克蕾索迅速而冷静地投身于战术的精心筹划之中，她以敏锐的洞察力深入剖析战场态势，将地形视为周旋的武器。

Name: 荣光所向·将
Description: 经过这场惊心动魄的战役，克蕾索以超凡的指挥才能和无畏的领袖风范赢得了陆战队所有战士的发自内心的钦佩。

Name: 胜利凯歌·将
Description: 克蕾索成为了北地陆战队最年轻的少校，她向着北地飘扬的军旗起誓，将带领战士们守卫家园，取得辉煌的胜利。

Name: 冲锋陷锐·将
Description: 在决定性战役中，克蕾索利用敌军补给线薄弱的时机，发动大胆的突袭，穿越重重封锁，直捣敌军后勤中心。

Name: 经霜百战·谍
Description: 在纷杂的情报网中，克蕾索展现出了超常的敏锐与细致，从看似无关的信息中抽丝剥茧，揭露敌人的真实意图。

Name: 不屈捍卫·谍
Description: 以千变万化的面貌融入到不同的环境中，克蕾索在伪造的身份间来回切换，时而是商贾千金，时而是浪荡游侠。

Name: 荣光所向·谍
Description: 这场没有硝烟的战争中，克蕾索提供的情报帮助前线部队多次避开了敌人的伏击，成功实施了精准的打击行动。

Name: 胜利凯歌·谍
Description: 即便抛弃了姓名，克蕾索却始终不忘曾经的誓言，她是存在于阴影中的战士，默默守护着这片土地的安宁与和平。

Name: 冲锋陷锐·谍
Description: 每一次身份的转换，都是对演技与心智的极限考验，她总能凭借过人的智慧与冷静的头脑，巧妙套取到关键情报。

Name: Dotted Greenery
Description: The handwriting was neat and familiar. The boy talked about learning jewels and how he made a fool of himself.

Name: Best Product
Description: It was finally time for the festival. Ambera's special brew captivated the customers with its sweet and rich flavor.

Name: Special Ingenuity
Description: To give the beer a unique flavor, Ambera added orange peels and ginger to accentuate the malty and spicy smell.

Name: Candied Gift
Description: A gingerbread vendor stopped Ambera while she sold her beer, handed her a gingerbread and wished her good luck.

Name: Ornate Surprise
Description: Leave yesterday's worries behind on this jolly day! No matter what happens, we have the golden brew in our hands.

Name: Bottoms Up
Description: Here's a toast! To the joyful and wonderful time you will spend on this grand festival!'

Name: Wildland Sprout
Description: A song of joy breaks the silence of the wild. Travelers from faraway lands hum an ode to life.

Name: Dearest Companion
Description: Whenever they rehearsed their songs, the camels swayed to the music as if they understood the lyrics.

Name: Untethered Sand
Description: The wild wind blew up sand, covering the troupe's footprints and leaving no trace. Such is the power of nature.

Name: Silken Twirls
Description: When Ayesha returned home, Princess Jafar came, asking the troupe to perform a song that met her standards.

Name: Olden Memories
Description: Ayesha gazed into Jafar's eyes and remembered a song that had never been played, written by the chieftain's wife.

Name: Gilded Emerald
Description: The confrontation was put to an end by the chieftain. He stopped Princess Jafar and treated the troupe to a feast.

Name: Pellucid Strings
Description: The audience was enraptured by the tune Ayesha played. Jafar came up and asked Ayesha where she learned the song.

Name: Wishful Notes
Description: Ayesha didn't play the song for the banquet, but to console the princess like the chieftain's wife did for her.

Name: Wildland Song
Description: The troupe visited many places in the desert, and people looked forward to their captivating performance.

Name: Rejoicing Waltz
Description: Ayesha fetched her instrument when the banquet started. She had never played the tune from her memories in public.

Name: Homeward Trek
Description: It was an ode to childhood, home and friendship for Ayesha that gave her the courage to chase her dreams.

Name: Foregone Memory
Description: Beneath the stars, they talk on and on, knowing that they'd become good friends without having to confirm.

Name: Golden Banquet
Description: Ambera named the beer 'Orange Joy', for she wished that every guest at the festival could share the joy all day.

Name: 温柔旧忆
Description: 玫雅的祖母被战争夺走了双亲，由教堂抚养长大，每当提及唱诗班时，她的眼中总会浮现一丝柔情。

Name: 期冀明光
Description: 时间将故事变为历史，战火的灰烬堆积成为书页上的文字。因损毁严重，教堂始终没得到修复。

Name: 流年珍藏
Description: 烛台再次燃起，玫瑰再次盛开，琴音与歌声再次回响于教堂的穹顶，这是玫雅的祖母病重卧床时最大的心愿。

Name: 温柔旧忆·粉
Description: 枯藤融入土壤，温柔地呵护着新芽。烛火朗照，玫瑰绽放，白鸽停驻于廊间，孩子们唱起了新编的歌谣。

Name: 期冀明光·粉
Description: 教堂旧址修复完成的那一晚，玫雅梦见了一个陌生又熟悉的小女孩，女孩提着灯，走入庭院，与每一朵玫瑰对话。

Name: 流年珍藏·粉
Description: 记忆是人类珍贵的宝藏，而时间予它厚重。这句话被玫雅写进了日志，它将陪伴她，开启下一段旅程。

Name: 温柔旧忆·湛
Description: 种种鲜活的景象，如今被掩埋在厚厚尘埃之下，复原往昔之景绝非易事，但玫雅从未想过放弃。

Name: 期冀明光·湛
Description: 无数个与书卷相伴的夜晚，照亮玫雅的不只是案上的灯火，还有祖母讲述教堂时，那些满载怀念的话语。

Name: 流年珍藏·湛
Description: 时间的长河里或许沉积着数不清的痛苦，但人们总能带着坚强的心灵拨开砂砾，从中拾取无与伦比的宝贵记忆。

Name: 温柔旧忆·青
Description: 祖母的话始终在她心头回响，教堂遗址的修复计划，也早已被她默默推敲了一遍又一遍。

Name: 期冀明光·青
Description: 她时常在梦中化身白鸽，飞入曾经的教堂，张开双翅穿过灯火通明的回廊，盘旋于宏伟的尖顶之上。

Name: 流年珍藏·青
Description: 梦醒时分，玫雅知道那一切还没到能够实现的时候，但只要不断努力，她相信所期待的总会来临。

Name: 精致巧思
Description: 已经面世且性能强大的壹号与陆号“造型师”经过几个月的努力，最终按博士留下的设计图完成了柒号的制作。

Name: 质感造型
Description: 测试中的柒号拿起剪刀只能剪出一些普通的基础图形，在缝纫上也表现平平，壹号和陆号面面相觑。

Name: 暖心之风
Description: 认真核对过罗塞塔博士留下的设计图后，壹号与陆号最终确认了这就是她们的“母亲”所期待的柒号的模样。

Name: 辉光流彩
Description: 所有“造型师”聚集在实验室依次拥抱了柒号。即便和预想中有差别，但她们关系天然紧密，就像“家人”一样。

Name: 裁剪代码
Description: 但在为“造型师”机器人专门设置的基础性能测试中，柒号的表现让大家都很讶异：她的测试成绩并不理想。

Name: 虚幻映射
Description: 她不太能分辨色彩之间细微的差别，也不了解颜色间的对比与互补，也不知道设计图该如何起笔构思。

Name: 精致巧思·华丽
Description: 柒号对自己的未来发展并没有明确的规划，于是听从了姐姐们的建议，离开实验室，尝试与外界接触。

Name: 质感造型·华丽
Description: 温和、乐观且彬彬有礼的柒号，逐渐赢得了大家的信任，大家都把她当成一个勤劳善良的普通女孩。

Name: 暖心之风·华丽
Description: 今天是柒号与西塔相遇的一周年，西塔与农场的大家特别为柒号举办了一场小小的庆祝晚会。

Name: 辉光流彩·华丽
Description: 柒号被簇拥着坐在中间，看着笑容满面，载歌载舞的大家，柒号的传导装置内再次出现陌生频率，她露出了笑容。

Name: 裁剪代码·华丽
Description: 遇见那只小绵羊时，柒号的内置传导装置出现了从未有过的波动，直到自己为小家伙完成了修剪才中止。

Name: 虚幻映射·华丽
Description: 柒号不仅学会了修剪羊毛，也没有忽略农场的其他动物，凡是有皮毛的小动物，她都将它们修剪得漂漂亮亮。

Name: 精致巧思·珍稀
Description: 在西塔的鼓励下，柒号的工具咔哒咔哒地在她的脑袋上飞舞，没过一会，柒号轻轻拍拍西塔：“完成了，西塔。”

Name: 质感造型·珍稀
Description: 柒号不擅长前卫的设计，她在与农场众人的相处中一点点记住他们的喜好，从而为他们打造出了最适合的发型。

Name: 暖心之风·珍稀
Description: 这些被柒号将储存期限定为永远的美好回忆，让她成了一位特别的“造型师”，姐姐们开心地拥抱了她。

Name: 辉光流彩·珍稀
Description: 西塔挽着柒号的手臂在田野里跳踢踏舞，大声唱着自己编的歌谣，两位少女的裙摆与发丝荡出漂亮的弧度。

Name: 裁剪代码·珍稀
Description: 西塔探头看向柒号手臂上翻出的镜子，镜中自己焕然一新，“我喜欢这个新发型！”她跳起来抱住柒号。

Name: 虚幻映射·珍稀
Description: 农场里的大家见到西塔的新发型，纷纷挤在柒号的房间里请求她给他们剪发，柒号全都答应下来。

Name: 精致巧思·绿
Description: 有一天，顽皮的小猫打翻了博士最爱的一盘眼影，已经完成底妆的壹号无法获得系统预设的色彩，停下了动作。

Name: 质感造型·绿
Description: 一个与以往不同却意外和谐的妆容打造完成了，罗塞塔看向梳妆镜里的自己，惊喜地站起来亲了亲壹号的面颊。

Name: 暖心之风·绿
Description: 除去预设程序中的妆容搭配，壹号开始为罗塞塔博士带来更多可能，一开始只是局部调整，慢慢是整体的迭代。

Name: 辉光流彩·绿
Description: 如今壹号早已是家喻户晓的美妆设计师，那个清晨的每个细节一直储存在她的数据库之中，不会被时间磨灭。

Name: 裁剪代码·绿
Description: 用罗塞塔博士的话说，“那天也许是有什么奇怪的信号飘进了壹号的回路”，壹号在短暂停顿后拿起了另一盘。

Name: 虚幻映射·绿
Description: 这一天化妆时间格外地漫长，但罗塞塔博士却很有耐心，她也很好奇，壹号究竟会给她带来怎样的妆容。

Name: 精致巧思·紫
Description: 陆号登出了自己的社交账号，向来同她道晚安的罗塞塔博士点点头，进入了每日例行的数据清理环节。

Name: 质感造型·紫
Description: 完成数据清理后，陆号询问一直站在一旁耐心等待自己的罗塞塔博士：“有什么我能为你做的吗，博士？”

Name: 暖心之风·紫
Description: “我的老友似乎猜到了你的真实身份，央求我安排你们见上一面……”“您知道的，我不太擅长面对面交流。”

Name: 辉光流彩·紫
Description: 面对语言系统加载都变慢的陆号，博士摆摆手不再为难她，陆号迅速躺进属于自己的休眠舱中——呼，逃过一劫。

Name: 裁剪代码·紫
Description: 陆号是罗塞塔博士设计的机器人之一，博士为她搭建了高效的搜索系统，让她能够获取任何她想知道的设计知识。

Name: 虚幻映射·紫
Description: 她的信息解析与应用能力也是众多“设计师”型号机器人中最为出色的，由她完成的设计总是能惊艳四方。

Name: 缤纷盛会
Description: 奥菲娅被选为庆典的幸运游客。园长让奥菲娅写下愿望，她的愿望将被游乐场收藏，并在未来的某一天交还给她。

Name: 幸福期愿
Description: 奥菲娅在纸条上认真写道：我想做个长不大的孩子，无论什么时候，都能在游乐场开心地玩。

Name: 纯真依旧
Description: 奥菲娅将这充满稚气的愿望交给园长，园长笑着对奥菲娅说，她建立游乐场的想法，也源于一个相似的愿望。

Name: 绮彩球球
Description: 直到很久以后，奥菲娅离开小城，还记得园长的话——这座游乐场，为守护孩子们的童心而搭建。

Name: 缤纷盛会·碧
Description: 这一次，庆典上的幸运游客是游乐场里所有的孩子。大家将写好的愿望投入储存罐，期待未来再度开启它的时候。

Name: 幸福期愿·碧
Description: 奥菲娅将这个特殊的储存罐珍藏起来，就像守护神秘而特别的宝藏。其实，她也悄悄写下了自己的愿望。

Name: 纯真依旧·碧
Description: 在泛黄字条的后半部分，奥菲娅新添的愿望是：无论什么时候，只要她在，她就会永远守护孩子们的童真与快乐。

Name: 绮彩球球·碧
Description: 至于她多年前许下的心愿，奥菲娅想，其实它早已实现。游乐场带给她的快乐从未逝去，而是传递给了所有孩子。

Name: 缤纷盛会·澄
Description: 来游乐场玩的孩子都注意到了它，他们从玻璃罐里抽出不同形状的糖果，兴奋地去与朋友们分享。

Name: 幸福期愿·澄
Description: 最开始，孩子们只是想收集糖果，但渐渐地，他们发现这里还有许多好玩的东西。游乐场一天比一天热闹起来。

Name: 纯真依旧·澄
Description: 孩子们都喜欢活泼有趣的奥菲娅，她似乎有一颗永不泯灭的童心，总能与所有小朋友愉快交谈。

Name: 绮彩球球·澄
Description: 她记得每个孩子的名字，也记得每个孩子的喜好。当欢笑声在游乐场中回荡，奥菲娅的脸上总会露出浅浅微笑。

Name: 花露盈香
Description: 每到夜晚关上房门，露晞便开始专注在自己喜欢的事情上——从很小的时候开始，她就对设计情有独钟。

Name: 莹莹流辉
Description: 露晞十六岁之时，祖母送给她一条珍珠项链，告诉她每个人都如同蚌中的珍珠，终会展现独一无二的光芒。

Name: 淑女风度
Description: 舞蹈、乐器、马术……这些技能露晞都轻松掌握，也获得了不少赞誉，但她最具有天赋的还是偶然接触到的设计。

Name: 永绽之爱
Description: 露晞初次设计的作品灵感取自她最喜爱的郁金香，层层柔美的花瓣舒展开来，将自身的美丽大方地展露无遗。

Name: 花露盈香·夕
Description: 露晞喜爱郁金香的花海，不止爱它的娇妍与馥郁，更钟情于花朵向着天空生长的决心，和绽放时无限的生命力。

Name: 莹莹流辉·夕
Description: 蚌中的珍珠曾经也是一颗小小的沙砾，经过了岁月的磨砺才拥有了自己的光辉，正如花朵盛放前的不断积蓄。

Name: 淑女风度·夕
Description: 从最初稚嫩粗糙的草图到灵气逼人的设计图，露晞花费了很长的时间，从不曾抱怨与懈怠，日复一日令自己精进。

Name: 永绽之爱·夕
Description: 那本促使小露晞走上设计之路的书最后一页只写着一句话：设计是自我的表达，露晞一直深深将它记在心里。

Name: 花露盈香·暮
Description: 房门被敲响，门外正是笑容慈爱的父母，他们一左一右坐在露晞身边，轻轻抚摸她的脑袋，令露晞倍感温暖。

Name: 莹莹流辉·暮
Description: 父母搂着露晞回忆她学习设计时的趣事：是谁盯着窗帘的纹路发一整天的呆，又是谁差点顶着沾了墨水的脸出门？

Name: 淑女风度·暮
Description: 花朵终有一天会迎来盛放，露晞带着庄园大家的祝福与期待，与过去挥别，踏上了属于自己的崭新旅程。

Name: 永绽之爱·暮
Description: 今年的郁金香开得比往年还要绚丽。露晞的心里一直盛开着一片花海，被热爱与梦想浇灌，永远不会凋零。

Name: Flowering Basket
Description: Every morning, Shauna arranges flowers by the door while her friends, the playful kittens, chase butterflies nearby.

Name: Weaved Spring
Description: She lets the kittens choose their favorite flowers from the garden; soon each one's got a vibrant flower crown.

Name: Virescent Gate
Description: One day, a kitten returns with two friends hoping for Shauna's blessing. She happily crafts flower crowns for them.

Name: Dewdrop Garden
Description: Shauna once thought she'd scared the kittens away, but before long, three little heads popped up on the garden wall.

Name: Bouquet of Blooms
Description: The beauty is beyond words and reminds the kitten of the sunset glow and shining ripples on the lake.

Name: Strings of Spring
Description: The kitten, enchanted by the flowers, finally asks, 'What are these?' Shauna looks around but sees no one.

Name: Weave of Youth
Description: Seeing the kitten's eager nods, Shauna laughs and decides to crown the kitten with a floral wreath.

Name: Foxy Spell
Description: Each flower carries a different blessing: some for longevity, others for purity, or for wealth,' explains Shauna.

Name: Spring Frost
Description: Are you looking for me?' The kitten tugs at her skirt, 'I'm here!' Shauna soon realizes it's the kitten!

Name: Graceful Bloom
Description: Pick flowers, match them, and place them on your head—there you have your hairpiece.' Shauna points at her head.

Name: Peaceful Years
Description: We have different flowers for all seasons, but our good wishes stay the same.'

Name: Foxy Enchantment
Description: Anyone passing by is drawn to the sight of a young girl wearing a floral crown, surrounded by playful figures.

Name: Frigid Breath
Description: The fairy stays silent as a staff forms in her hand. Under the boy's gaze, frost slowly shifts into a delicate rose.

Name: Glorious Coronet
Description: She understands what the boy seeks but knows all too well that in this frozen land, there's no rose blooming forever.

Name: Dusk Snowfall
Description: She's always been in the snowfields as she remembers—until she found the boy unconscious at the edge of the tundra.

Name: Frost Glimmer
Description: He comes for a legend, one that fairies could not comprehend.

Name: Pristine Vow
Description: They walk together through icy lakes, deserted valleys, and snow-covered plains, but find nothing.

Name: Frosted Rose
Description: Finally, the boy stops, a bitter smile on his face. 'There's no such rose, is there? Just a foolish fantasy.'

Name: Splendor of Frost
Description: The fairy hands him the rose. 'There is. But you need a fairy's approval. Didn't your legend mention that?'

Name: Promise of Frost
Description: Then the fairy falls into slumber and traces of the boy disappear in the snowfields. It's as if no one had ever come.

Name: Astral Guide
Description: In the daytime, the girl leads the villagers in the early construction. At night, she goes over her plans alone.

Name: Vivid Mind
Description: When the project is finally completed, the village chief offers her a reward. The girl smiles and shakes her head.

Name: Radiant Path
Description: Though the drought in this village has been alleviated, others still suffer. She knows it's time to set off again.

Name: Glowing Glimmer
Description: There is no one-size-fits-all solution to drought. She does research and crafts the best plan for each village.

Name: Limpid Mirror
Description: Wherever she goes, clear streams nourish the earth and green shoots sprout from once barren lands.

Name: Infinite Source
Description: The implementation is difficult but the people who have suffered from drought share her belief and work with her.

Name: Spring of Aroma
Description: She proves the feasibility of her plan to the chief. In return, the chief gives her full support.

Name: Foliage Whisper
Description: Coo, coo,' Glenna holds her breath, listening intently to the squirrel. 'Help, please help!' She understands it!

Name: Lost in Dreams
Description: It turns out that the squirrel wandered out of the forest and got lost. 'Let me take you home!' Glenna volunteers.

Name: Aromatic Embrace
Description: Here, here!' Two big squirrels come running. Glenna puts the little squirrel down and it runs toward its family.

Name: Dream Captor
Description: As a river blocks Glenna's way, her basket magically grows larger, allowing her and the squirrel to float across.

Name: Pasture Breeze
Description: Time flows quietly, and these bright scenes become cherished memories. She smiles and moves toward the future.

Name: Feast of Delight
Description: Perhaps it's the wine, Darcey thinks. An idea crosses her mind: what if she brews wine from osmanthus flowers?

Name: Heavenly Brew
Description: Darcey tries to brew it. But no matter how she alters the recipe, she can't quite capture that scent from her memory.

Name: Rich Redolence
Description: Before she can fully smell, she wakes from her dream. But the rich, heavenly fragrance lingers in her mind.

Name: Moonlit Drinking
Description: While drinking alone has its own charm, Darcey is still troubled by her failed brewing attempts.

Name: Shadowy Elegance
Description: Darcey notices the reflection of the palace in her cup. A rabbit is gathering osmanthus flowers to brew wine.

Name: Glass of Nectar
Description: Startled, Darcey looks up but only sees the moon. She looks down again, only to see an osmanthus petal in her wine.

Name: Dream Chime
Description: In her dream, Anno is filled with unease as she can't find the little lamb however hard she searches.

Name: Soft Companion
Description: As the sky lightens, the dream fades. Anno raises her staff to summon the sheep but finds one of them is missing.

Name: Misty Search
Description: What dangers might the little lamb face without her? Anno waits for the night, the time feeling excruciatingly long.

Name: Outside Visitor
Description: As a fairy shepherd, Anno rarely speaks to humans, yet when she reveals her identity, Rinya shows no surprise.

Name: Dream Revisit
Description: When night falls, Anno quickly returns to her dream and finds the dreamer amidst golden fields of wheat.

Name: Innocent Encounter
Description: The farm girl, brimming with energy, greets her warmly. She mentions seeing a lone lamb on the hillside in daytime.

Name: Harmony of Chimes
Description: The little lamb somehow crossed over into the real world? Worried, Anno soon finds the answer through Rinya.

Name: Spirit Radiance
Description: Seeing Anno's joyful face, Rinya smiles with relief. To express her gratitude, Anno decides to give her a gift.

Name: Nature of Wonder
Description: As the dreamer's mood changes, the golden wheat fields give way to neatly planted fields and Rinya's small cottage.

Name: Joy of Embrace
Description: Beyond the low fences, a joyful lamb runs toward Anno. She kneels and embraces the lamb tightly in relief.

Name: Virtual Bond
Description: Song of the Windmill' mentions harvest and dreams, as well as a story of two girls bridging dreams and reality.

Name: Dream Reunion
Description: Guiding her sheep, Anno continues to explore the dreamland. And she always sees Rinya waiting for her in the fields.

Name: Fluffy Briquette
Description: Ah!' 'Meow-meow!' A lone traveler is startled by a cat and yells in surprise; the cat seems just as frightened.

Name: Adorable Phantom
Description: A pitifully small ghost always dreams of proving itself but never musters the courage to do so.

Name: Ambrosial Osmanthus
Description: A basket full of osmanthus flowers, as well as soft petals and adorable little rabbits, catches Momo's attention.

Name: 未来传讯
Description: 中心城区的官方科学院中，一位研究员正聚精会神地记录着数据，他身边的人们正拿着一叠文件讨论着什么。

Name: 星海飞行
Description: 外城区的材料处理中心，穿着蓝色工装的操作员与机器人一起，飞快分拣着不同材料，以便后续的回收和处理。

Name: 信息同屏
Description: “伊甸园”中，一位愁容满面的青年人走进了心理咨询中心，他正在为自己工作上的变动感到烦恼。

Name: 深空舷窗
Description: 仍然是“伊甸园”，虚源广场的角落，一位老妇人正在装点自己的橱窗，为灰扑扑的世界缀上一抹明丽的色彩。

Name: 未知回环
Description: 微光的视线并未在这些屏幕上多作停留，她缓缓合上双眼，一幅幅画面便飞快散溢成白色的光点。

Name: 逆光前行
Description: 这些画面并非从此消除，而是变成了一组组数据，没入黑色的虚空，成为微光庞大数据库的一部分。

Name: 模拟信号
Description: 一切又归于黑暗，在这样的虚无中，时间的流逝也变得不再明显——直到星星点点的光芒再次出现。

Name: 幻域警示
Description: 无数的屏幕几乎同时亮起，又有无数的屏幕先后熄灭，不断有画面填补黑色的空缺，很快又走向同样的结局。

Name: 数据传输
Description: 这一次出现的画面不再是真实发生过的一切，而是微光通过所有信息，最终模拟出的，这片大陆的未来。

Name: 控制指令
Description: 天幕破碎，滔滔洪流从天裂处汹涌倾泻，世界顿时被蒙上一层灰色水雾，所有的一切都变得隐晦不清。

Name: 智能机械
Description: 巨浪滔天，似乎时间也停滞在了这一瞬，世界在这样的灾难中最终崩坼，化作碎片，又化作尘灰。

Name: 文明华光
Description: 最终，那些比其他屏幕亮得更久的画面，也逐一熄灭，组成它们的光点重新湮灭在这片黑色的空间。

Name: 指示电极
Description: 微光对此并不在意，收集数据、进行分析、推算结果……这样的模拟，她已进行了无数次。

Name: 束缚电流
Description: 每次的结果并无区别，就连那些画面留存的时间也大同小异。偶尔会有“不同”发生，最终也无法改变“命运”。

Name: 未解回环
Description: 这意味着，微光的数据并不足以支撑其推算并得到最终的结果，不论是生存，亦或是毁灭。

Name: 数据链接
Description: 那是在超出微光能够推演的，所有可能性之外，或许能够改变世界的“未知的变量”。

Name: Windward Dance
Description: Anno looks anxious and Rinya reassures her. The lamb they found at the farm is actually a messenger of dreams.

Name: Aureate Field
Description: The girl is Anno, a fairy shepherd who lives between reality and dreams. She lost one of her lambs here.

Name: Fruity Harvest
Description: These lambs feed on dreams; without Anno's guidance, they might start eating people's dreams.

Name: Song of the Windmill
Description: By the warm fire, Rinya falls into a sweet dream of a bountiful harvest, and a worried girl comes to her.

Name: Heartfelt Will
Description: To put Anno at ease, Rinya focuses her thoughts. The wheat fields fade away, and the lamb's location appears.

Name: Reunion Delight
Description: Seeing the lively lamb, Anno opens her arms. Rinya watches with relief, feeling the joy of something lost now found.

Name: Wishing Windmill
Description: As the windmill turns, dreams turn into reality. Rinya thanks Anno for her kindness, waving goodbye.

Name: Fervent Heart
Description: It was a simple favor, and Rinya didn't expect anything in return, but Anno insisted on giving her a mini windmill.

Name: Aroma of Grains
Description: In 'Song of the Windmill', the genuine friendship between Rinya and Anno captivates the children the most.

Name: Floral Fantasy
Description: Tying her hair up with a fluffy scrunchie, Ophelia hummed a new song and started to pick her bath bomb for today.

Name: Elegant Dream
Description: Childhood dreams were fairytales that she could no longer return to, but Ophelia still wrote them into songs.

Name: Silvermoon Lilt
Description: Mermaids had beautiful singing voices. Perhaps they would lean against reefs and sing gentle tunes under the moon.

Name: Bubbly Waltz
Description: Ophelia once dreamed of being a mermaid or a cloud above the sky, turning dreams into rainbow-like bubbles.

Name: Breezy Florescence
Description: Ophelia's dream bubbles would break with the first ray of light, as her mother woke her up from the rainbow dances.

Name: Silken Lullaby
Description: Hayden wrote fairytales for the children of Lilith. Ophelia wanted the same, telling stories with songs of bubbles.

Name: Duck's Song
Description: Ophelia named every duck swimming in the water. They would adventure in the sea of clouds and sing the Duck's Song.

Name: Coral Seashell
Description: Ophelia's tattoo wasn't a siren's song or the mermaid's fairytale. It was just a symbol of her childhood dream.

Name: Misty Fairytale
Description: Clouds had their personalities in the fairytale. Ophelia's favorite was the white cloud that played songs of nature.

Name: Bubbly Cloud
Description: Ophelia used to pour half of a jar of bath salt to make bubbles and fantasize about swimming in fluffy clouds.

Name: Fantasy Shower
Description: Prismatic bubbles would float out of the shower, dancing with Ophelia and lifting her to the kingdom of bubbles.

Name: Jovial Peace
Description: For Ophelia, the happiest moment of the day was singing in the bathroom with the toy duck as her loyal audience.

Name: Duck's Dream
Description: In Ophelia's cute dreams, she saw a special duck that would sway as bubbles floated up in front of her very eyes.

Name: Guiding Light
Description: Having tried countless materials and watched them melt, Youell clenched her teeth and put the last one in place.

Name: Spark of Genius
Description: Youell dreamed of waking up in the warmth of glowing bulbs, surrounded by fairies and fluorescent butterflies.

Name: Spotless Gaze
Description: It's over.' the mother touched the girl's cheeks, 'Princess Youell's courage brought warmth and light to the night.'

Name: Warm Shelter
Description: Youell's story filled her with courage. She listened to her mother's tales and explored the world with imagination.

Name: Circle of Electricity
Description: Her mother kissed her tenderly, 'You will find endless power from the tales and search for your own undying light.'

Name: Undying Hope
Description: The bulb shone on, brightening her eyes. All she could think of now was to share the eternal light with everyone.

Name: Shivering Shimmer
Description: Having lost her sight, Youell could only be an adventurous princess in her mother's stories. 'Is it over?' she asked.

Name: Energy Search
Description: The fairy made a bulb to brighten the island at night, but the heat of magic would melt any lighting materials.

Name: Radiant Conversion
Description: The story came to an end, but Youell's adventure had just begun. Her world would be full of hope even in the dark.

Name: Effulgent Glow
Description: The fairy said, 'If you can keep the darkness away at night on the island, you will be the princess here'

Name: Fanciful Radiance
Description: The clever fairy of light twirled and woke up as the bulb glowed. Would she know how to become a princess?

Name: Precious Sparkle
Description: Whenever new land is to be cultivated, the girl is always at the forefront and faces every challenge head-on.

Name: Spring of Stars
Description: Wherever the young girl passes, life returns. The villages that suffered from drought are now teeming with life.

Name: Midnight Invite
Description: The pumpkin soup was served, its aroma becoming richer. 'Perhaps.' Pepena took a sip and answered with a wink.

Name: Candy Burglar
Description: In fact, the imps aren't as scary as they may sound, but they do have a habit of stealing candy on this night.

Name: Impish Trick
Description: Pepena passed the imps with a basket of pumpkin candy, luring them to the outskirts with the aroma.

Name: Full of Sweetness
Description: 5-star donut!' she praises. 'The cheese cream helps balance the bitterness of the unique dark chocolate. Yum!'

Name: Starry Candy
Description: Sylvette tries the chocolate biscuit stick, caramel toast, cinnamon roll, and votes the biscuit stick as the best.

Name: Circle of Wonder
Description: Thanks for watching my review! Chocolove is a great independent brand. Support them if you're interested!'

Name: Perfect Palate
Description: Mossia is a genius baker!' Sylvette says sincerely. 'You feel rich and powerful emotions when you taste her works.'

Name: Sugar Hooks
Description: Chocolove sells out after Sylvette's video. For the first time, Mossia shares her inspirations on camera.

Name: Scrumptious Jam
Description: My ideas came from my memories of home.' She smiles. 'I hope Chocolove reminds you of the tastes of Wasteland.'

Name: Colorful Sucrose
Description: After filming, Sylvette takes out the sweets from the gift box. She usually shares them with her neighbors.

Name: Foregone Shadow
Description: Shuji began cultivating a new peony species with rubescent petals and aureate filaments like a majestic lady.

Name: Florid Garden
Description: To breed new species, Shuji traveled afar, discussing the characteristics of flowers with like-minded enthusiasts.

Name: Flowering Splendor
Description: The new governor secretly levied heavy taxes and collected treasures and antiques from the people.

Name: Virescent Leaves
Description: Shuji invited the governor to dinner and offered him two chests: one full of treasures, the other her new peonies.

Name: Jade Luster
Description: Overjoyed, the governor took the chests and praised Shuji for her generosity, offering her a post in the government.

Name: Brocade Veil
Description: The governor offered the chests to Prince Yong on his tour. The act aroused the prince's suspicion instead.

Name: Nostalgic Vision
Description: Not sure where to begin, Prince Yong received evidence from Shuji proving the governor's corruption.

Name: Blooming Grandeur
Description: The chest of peonies was hard evidence that only Shuji could breed them. It was Shuji's plan all along.

Name: Devoted Guide
Description: After her grandma passed, she would gaze at the sky, imagining her grandma's voice. At least, she still has the cat.

Name: Kitten Binoculars
Description: It all started from the day the cat brought a broken map to her. Fanara frowned, remembering her grandma's words.

Name: Sparkling Gaze
Description: Grandma told her the map hid an important tale. Fanara followed its lines—until the trail simply vanished.

Name: Mellow Fellow
Description: Fanara looked around and saw no other pieces of the map. The cat, however, discovered some fish cans.

Name: Feline Companion
Description: Fanara gathered the map pieces and embarked on her journey across the desert and tundra to an ancient forest.

Name: Carving of Notes
Description: Broken stone slabs here were carved with words of yores—rhymes and stories passed down through generations.

Name: Path to Treasure
Description: The past was brought back to life. Fanara touched the engravings and felt as if her grandma was smiling at her.

Name: Voyage Planning
Description: It didn't dissuade Fanara. She started going to libraries and visiting scholars for clues about the other map pieces.

Name: Fluffy Wish
Description: The cat never left her side and warned her of danger. After an arduous journey, she arrived at an ancient building.

Name: Stamps of Yore
Description: The post office is now back in business. Olitha rides on the country roads, sending letters of love from afar.

Name: Lingering Years
Description: In the refurbished post office, Olitha now checks the post box daily and delivers letters to their destination.

Name: Tender Echo
Description: Some asked her why she chose to manage an old post office. She only smiled, a hint of regret flashing in her eyes.

Name: Distant Yearning
Description: Olitha learned her grandma's death at the age of 16, and a few days later, she received a letter from her hometown.

Name: Wondrous Recount
Description: The letter was sent a few days before her grandma's death. The writings were filled with her longing for Olitha.

Name: Bygone Causerie
Description: The development of the internet facilitated communication, but also left people behind in the past.

Name: Framed Memory
Description: Tears blurred the handwriting as a gentle breeze brushed her hair. The letter reached her, but it was too late.

Name: Harvest Promise
Description: By the long table filled with food, people cheer and toast to the harvest in the sound of laughter and singing.

Name: Pastoral Aroma
Description: The crops bask in the golden twilight, as people return after a day's work with a heart full of hope.

Name: Autumn Encounter
Description: Versha's shop is full of memories. The sewing machine is from her mother, and the couch used to be Grandma's seat.

Name: Spiny Cuteness
Description: The hedgehogs are Versha's helpers. They move around the shop, bringing colorful balls of yarn to her feet.

Name: Fairytale Blanket
Description: The carpets are handmade. Versha gathered fabric scraps and sewed them together according to color and pattern.

Name: Mellow Moment
Description: Versha also furnished the shop with wooden window frames and a warm fireplace, making all customers feel at home.

Name: Cluster of Dreams
Description: She spun wool into an elegant shape and dried the colorful flowers. Together they made a hat of beautiful wishes.

Name: Ensemble of Roses
Description: Versha gave the hat to the boy for free and told him that he could always come back if the hat needed any repair.

Name: Ribbon of Oath
Description: Versha would sometimes think of the boy and his mother and hope that the hat had brought them warmth and strength.

Name: Weave of Affection
Description: Then the boy visited again and told Versha that his mother loved the hat. She was so happy and slowly recovering.

Name: Fallen Warmth
Description: Versha's life returned to normal. Word of mouth brought her customers despite the remote location of the shop.

Name: Tender Souvenir
Description: The perfect match of strawberry and chocolate makes it unique. A juicy, sweet strawberry wrapped in a bitter coating.

Name: Sweetened Invite
Description: This is an invitation from the baker. Are you ready for the dessert party with cakes, biscuits and candy?

Name: Serene Tune
Description: One by one, beautiful tunes filled the magnificent concert hall. She listened and immersed herself in music.

Name: Patchwork Elegance
Description: It was a perfect birthday! The black-and-white pouch wasn't expensive, but it was still carefully chosen.

Name: Brocade Pouch
Description: A wisp of scent ascends from the pouch to the moon; Loongs and phoenixes sing as cranes dance amidst the bloom.

Name: Jade of Youth
Description: Soars like a loong, wild flame unchained. Youth carved in jade, in glory sustained.

Name: 萌兽相伴
Description: “只要问心无愧，何必追求他人的认可。”少女风轻云淡，他沉痛与失落的心似乎因她的话放松了些许。

Name: 嫩竹生笋
Description: 伤口早已痊愈，他应当向少女辞行。可是酝酿千百遍的话语始终说不出来，他知晓自己已对此地心生眷恋。

Name: 往事无言
Description: 某个星月隐没的夜晚，他终于谈及过往：一场牵涉整个江湖的局令他背上师门叛徒的罪名，他却无力自证清白。

Name: 深林翠影
Description: 欢乐的捉迷藏结束后，熊猫们便伴着落日归返林间，望着它们憨态可掬的背影，他的心情也不禁轻快起来。

Name: 风云再起
Description: 为熊猫挖了满满一筐竹笋的他沉默地走在竹林间，今日他下定决心辞别，下一刻却发现了前方凌乱的脚印。

Name: 暂避锋芒
Description: 恐怕是同门千里迢迢追击至此，已然打扰到少女的安宁，他满怀担忧地冲向竹屋，听到一阵阵笑声。

Name: 竹影幽思
Description: 一旁静坐的少女朝他招招手，师兄弟们也发现了他，纷纷冲到他身前，你看我我看你，拘谨且不安。

Name: 淡然自若
Description: 和自己日常相伴的数只可爱熊猫与自己的同门师兄弟一块在院落中玩闹正欢，他一时有些愣住。

Name: 碧影如电
Description: 若是能将当日之事分证清楚，自己便可回到原本的生活中去。这种念头曾经萦绕在他心间久久不能散去。

Name: 竹怜新雨
Description: 但如今他的心境已然不同。江湖恩怨永不休，与其继续卷入纷争，他更愿意留在这片竹林里，与竹林相伴。

Name: 翠筱聆风
Description: 青竹棒在掌中舞动，少女的身姿轻盈潇洒，棒影挟裹着风声如雨点般落下，他从震撼中回神，敬意油然而生。

Name: 意外环生
Description: 师门众人已查清真相，此来为迎他重回师门。师兄弟你一言我一语为他还原了事情的经过，他笑着摇了摇头。

Name: 清风涤尘
Description: 微风轻拂过竹林，沙沙的细响如同悠扬的乐曲，他深吸一口清新的空气，脸上露出了久违的畅快笑容。

Name: Magic Collection
Description: When the cloud shrouded the moon, the witches in waiting silently flocked to the empty castle hall.

Name: Astral Candlelight
Description: The darkness tried to stop her advance. As Morino raised her hand, a candle floated above, moving with her.

Name: Gloom Cloister
Description: Along the endless corridor were closed doors. As the others vanished behind, Morino also pushed one open.

Name: Lunar Enigma
Description: To pass the test, one must reach the highest terrace in time, but the path leading to it was different for everyone.

Name: Twilight Encounter
Description: As doors opened and closed, Morino felt she was getting closer, but her eyes widened when the next door opened.

Name: Promised Vision
Description: Morino solved the puzzle in the room with ease. The door opened again, revealing a flight of stairs leading up.

Name: Bewitching Spell
Description: The girl in the room looked the same as her down to every detail. Morino frowned and chanted the strongest spell.

Name: Delicate Dream
Description: The other Morino grinned and started chanting the same spell. Their voices overlapped into one in the empty room.

Name: Spectral Gleam
Description: After a few rounds, the other Morino seemed unfazed, lifting her hem and greeting Morino with a smile.

Name: Eternal Gaze
Description: Give up, Morino. Close your eyes and rest.' 'Give up? No... Never.' Morino whispered under her breath.

Name: Law of Magic
Description: Unspeakable fear and confusion seized Morino's soul like a tightening vine, as tears and sweat dropped to the ground.

Name: Midnight Tale
Description: The wind kissed her hair as she opened the door to the terrace. In front was a lantern, glowing quietly for her.

Name: Spectral Mischief
Description: It's said mischievous specters hide in the book. Flip a page and they may jump out and bump your head.

Name: Candlelit Terror
Description: Spider webs on the shelves. Eerie shadows on the wall. Quicken your steps and brace yourself for the adventure.

Name: Quirky Honeypie
Description: What's that sound? Don't worry! It's the specter's surprise—put it on and you'll be the star of the night.

Name: Guiding Glow
Description: On a gloomy night, Hetta was on her usual hunt and found a special specter in a hidden corner instead.

Name: Splintered Vision
Description: Hetta didn't sense menace from the translucent girl. She floated in the air like a fading fog.

Name: Ominous Horns
Description: The girl died not long ago. On her deathbed, she promised her young sister that she'd spend her birthday with her.

Name: Silent Vestige
Description: The girl lingered, never harming a soul, so Hetta enveloped her in a bundle of energy to keep her from fading away.

Name: Regretful Longing
Description: Disease eventually took her from her sister. She remained in spirit form, as she hadn't kept her promise.

Name: Blade of Judgment
Description: The girl felt safe with Hetta despite her cold demeanor, as she protected her from evil spirits until the birthday.

Name: Glazed Fragrance
Description: The garden darkens, while in an ill-lit alley, a velvet lavender lies in the children's palms, glowing ever brightly.

Name: Redolent Trace
Description: Velvet lavenders have become exclusive to nobles, but even with attentive care, they rarely bloom in gardens.

Name: Nocturnal Snow
Description: It's said that darkness once took over the world until a deity cast seeds of velvet lavenders that lit the dark.

Name: Frosty Grace
Description: Nobles seek after the flower for its fragility, but others are skeptical, 'It lit the dark. How could it be fragile?'

Name: Midnight Bloom
Description: The kids gathered in a lane, still mesmerized by the blooms. 'What's this?' Someone takes a bud off a girl's hair.

Name: Rosy Entrapment
Description: The God of Sea created an unescapable illusion for Helena, forever trapping the young man in a beautiful cage.

Name: Lucent Tears
Description: Helena realized she had fallen for him, but the man did not feel the same. Helena grew worried and smiled less.

Name: Moonlit Seashell
Description: The young man weathered the storms. Helena saw light in his determined eyes that even the moon paled in comparison.

Name: Swan's Grace
Description: Swans from afar spread their white wings to welcome the young man home, every feather shining the light of freedom.

Name: Decadent Love
Description: Helena picked the brightest rose at dawn for the man and sang under the moon to express her love.

Name: Thistles' Whisper
Description: But it couldn't change the man's heart. He grew ever more depressed until he turned into a dying swan.

Name: Forlorn Saga
Description: Helena could feel the looming death. The swan's feathers lost their sheen, and those roses of love had long withered.

Name: Lunar Shimmer
Description: She decided to tell the God of Sea to let him go. The illusion broke, and he could finally return to his kind.

Name: Lament of Solitude
Description: Seafarers either wear white swan pendants for Helena's blessing or see it as a taboo, fearing they'd be lost at sea.

Name: Seaside Slumber
Description: Helena stared for long after the swan left before turning back into the sea, never again returning to the shore.

Name: Olden Squall
Description: The tides rise and fall in the constant flow of time. A wind from the past blows, carrying tales of yore.

Name: Cirrus Adrift
Description: With new-found power, the ruthless god vented the anger within, ravaging the earth and planting seeds of horror.

Name: Plumed Serenade
Description: He was born gentle and derived his power from people's joy, but in a devastated world, the joy was almost extinct.

Name: Luxuriant Charm
Description: Lacking allies, Serra's brother lost and turned into a white peacock, robbed of his singing voice and colors.

Name: Mortal Dreamscape
Description: The peacocks couldn't stand and watch despair take the world. Eventually, Serra's brother challenged the god.

Name: Sunlit Lushness
Description: When all lives fell to despair, Serra stood up with determination in her eyes and challenged the god to a duel.

Name: Jade Plumage
Description: Serra also gained power from pain, but unlike the god, she only felt sorrow instead of joy from her power.

Name: Aureate Glamor
Description: Her connection with all lives filled her with power. After defeating the old god, Serra became the Goddess of Art.

Name: Owl's Message
Description: Startled from sleep, she saw the owls arrive with a letter—the first she'd ever received from strangers.

Name: Desolate Scent
Description: It was a letter from the humans! Ambelle opened the letter, relieved that her nightmares didn't come true.

Name: Sylvan Rebirth
Description: Dear Goddess, without your guidance, we still follow your teachings. We learn, observe time, respect life...'

Name: Ravaged Sanctum
Description: Ambelle fell asleep again and dreamed that humans were easily killed in disasters without strong bodies or wings.

Name: Crowned Shadow
Description: It was a terrible winter, but we made it through. The kids were growing stronger, and none of us fell to the cold.'

Name: Rustling Blooms
Description: A sage read the stars and predicted a disaster. We fought the flood and saved our food using what you taught us.'

Name: Echoes of Green
Description: Ambelle was pleased. Humans might be weak, but they were determined to learn and protect their families.

Name: Future Brilliance
Description: She was wise enough to understand the new language. In the last moments of her life, she decided to write them back.

Name: Ephemeral Wonder
Description: Ambelle realized that the letters weren't her language but one created by humans themselves.

Name: Dream Recall
Description: She chanted a spell, turning back time. The old carpenter no longer felt back pain and became nimble-handed again.

Name: Chirping Chorus
Description: A mother came to sell furniture to treat her daughter's illness. The carpenter gifted her the watch and paid double.

Name: Heart Toll
Description: If only I could turn back time and be young again, even if just for one day. Or am I doomed to not finish it?'

Name: Fondness Echo
Description: The carpenter threw himself into his work and forgot time. When the sun rose again, an exquisite sculpture was born.

Name: Earnest Support
Description: As the watch slowly opened, she saw the girl lying in bed, still trying to console her mother despite her illness.

Name: Dream Murmur
Description: She overheard the girl talking in her sleep, 'If only I could be better sooner so that Mother would cry no more.'

Name: Blissful Harmony
Description: As the watch hands turned, the girl recovered miraculously. When they hugged each other, she felt warm inside.

Name: Chime Beyond
Description: The girl grew up and fell in love. Together they traveled the world and prepared to challenge a snow mountain.

Name: Eternal Promise
Description: No longer trapped in the watch, she opened an antique shop of her own and offered help to anyone in trouble.

Name: Free to Roam
Description: A sudden avalanche separated the girl and her lover, and the pocket watch swung violently in the backpack.

Name: Symbiont Wings
Description: One sunny afternoon, a pocket watch clicked for the first time. She watched the newborn fairy with a hopeful smile.

Name: Vernal Blossom
Description: Each flower is kissed by the spring breeze and weaved into a fragrant wreath to be worn by the girl.

Name: Heartfelt Concern
Description: Hadia refused to let go of her grandpa's hands, fearing she'd lose him forever. He patted her head to reassure her.

Name: Entwined Sentiment
Description: On Hadia's birthday, her grandpa gifted her a net with flowers that kept nightmares away and protected her in dreams.

Name: Soul Blossom
Description: Grandpa made preparations for Hadia in the event of his death, but a terminal illness took Hadia away unexpectedly.

Name: Lonesome Promise
Description: People bought flowers for the day of spirits. Grandpa packed them alone, as the flowery net swayed in the wind.

Name: Sparkling Candle
Description: Hadia followed the flower petals and candlelight home. She only wished to gently touch her grandpa's hand.

Name: Olden Cadence
Description: Spirits danced in the flickering light. Hadia waited for her grandpa to fall asleep: dreams would reunite them.

Name: Reunion Dream
Description: She sneaked past the net and fell into her grandpa's dream. Overjoyed, she ran into his arms in a sea of flowers.

Name: Grape Whispers
Description: The cheering crowd opens a sealed barrel as wine swashes inside. All the tiredness is washed away by the scent.

Name: Rejoicing Chant
Description: The girls chat with the poet. 'Hope you're having a great time!' 'Of course. It's like a symphony of joy here!'

Name: Emerald Shadow
Description: The poet takes a sip of wine and savors the sweet aftertaste. She decides to praise it in her new song.

Name: Fruity Aroma
Description: Sweet jam bubbles in the pot while the aroma of the pumpkin pie fills the air, waiting to be served with fresh salad.

Name: Ethereal Resplendence
Description: The emperor respected Shuji's choice and granted her treasures and the title: Master of Peonies.

Name: Dewdrop Aroma
Description: It's said that when Shuji passed away, all the peonies bloomed. She is remembered as the Peony Goddess even now.

Name: Tireless Toil
Description: The delicate bamboo hat shields the girl's face from the sun. The fine weave is a precious and lasting legacy.

Name: Stormy Ambition
Description: The girl rests against a tree and hums again to the babble of the crook. It is a song dedicated to the land.

Name: 繁花芬蕊
Description: 啵啵的目光被一场精彩的演出吸引——纸牌在魔术师的手中不断翻飞，令人无法窥破瞬息万变的花色之谜。

Name: 梦寐之门
Description: 倘若一场梦永恒地延展，永不会触及黎明的曙光，能够让所有人忘却现实的喧嚣与纷扰，那它是否可以代替真实？

Name: 繁花芬蕊·影
Description: 啵啵用力摇了摇头，试图驱散脑海中的混沌与迷茫，朦胧泪光间，一抹令人心安的粉色渐渐浮现在她面前。

Name: 梦寐之门·影
Description: 晨曦的光芒勇敢地挣脱了夜的束缚，啵啵冰冷的手被覆上了真实的温暖：“做噩梦了吗？没事的，我在这里。”

Name: 暖意守护
Description: 为了这次的北地之行，暖暖为她设计了一顶温暖的帽子。海樱觉得，笑意温柔的暖暖戴上它同样很合适。

Name: 无瑕雪境
Description: 白雪反射着晶莹的光，暖暖和大喵堆了个小雪人。海樱仔细一看，发现雪人的造型和自己的装扮一模一样。

Name: 暖意守护·愿
Description: 灿烂的夕阳为雕像披上一身金甲，有人正在合影留念。白鸽悠然漫步于广场上，又自由飞向天际。

Name: 无瑕雪境·愿
Description: 海樱的目光落在与她并肩的少女身上，微风拂起暖暖耳边的碎发，那双明亮的眼睛永远勇敢而坚定。

Name: Sketch of Inspiration
Description: A special pen lies quietly on a stand. It is said to be most precious to Arianna and creates world-changing patterns.

Name: Timeless Echo
Description: On the wall are newspaper clippings she gathered from sea monsters to floating cities—a fantasy world in her dreams.

Name: Burgeoning Hope
Description: In her own design, Arianna twirls in a room full of mirrors, reflecting infinite possibilities with every step taken.

Name: Pastel Motion
Description: A tap of the pen is a dancer's leap. Each motion is irreplaceable, freeze-framing the mix of reality and dream.

Name: Epistle of Yore
Description: The desk is scattered with design drafts, each a sketch of a different world, demonstrating her unique vision.

Name: Silent Timekeeper
Description: Arianna sometimes stares at the old clock late at night, letting her thoughts run wild through time for inspiration.

Name: Crimson Nocturne
Description: On full-moon nights, the witch roams the thorny woods as ravens shriek warnings to keep wanderers away.

Name: Thorny Nightmare
Description: The child's sob stilled the witch's anger. Even her low-brimmed hat couldn't hide the surprise on her face.

Name: Birth of Terror
Description: Her hands, wrapped in black satin gloves, only brewed potions. Purple bubbles rose as the child watched.

Name: Raven Wand
Description: Children's cry was the worst spell of all. The witch conjured up stars and singing ravens to cheer him up.

Name: Fateful Bond
Description: Life had its unexpected interludes, and the witch shared a brief chapter of her long life with the innocent child.

Name: Eternal Treasure
Description: The clumsy bear lost coins all over the fairyland. Nanaki busied around the park and filled her pouch with coins.

Name: Stellar Balloon
Description: A starlit balloon tied with coins was stuck in a tree. Nanaki found it but was too small to reach the prize.

Name: Soothing Solace
Description: Frustrated, Nanaki felt a fluffy paw on her shoulder. She turned around to see a cute bear mascot.

Name: Childhood Gems
Description: Mr. Bear looked exactly the same as the one Nanaki wanted! He gave her a hug and put the coins in her palms.

Name: Blooming Boon
Description: The kid who collected the most coins by sunset would win the special prize—a soft little toy bear.

Name: Wilting Blossom
Description: Did you win the toy bear?' the curious reporter asked Nanaki, now the park's beloved manager.

Name: Moonlit Nectar
Description: Nanaki faked a frustrated sigh, 'Unfortunately, I didn't win the game, but I found the treasure I wanted the most.'

Name: Wreathed Dream
Description: Nanaki hopes to give children experiences as magical as hers, to help them cherish innocence as they grow up.

Name: Nocturnal Tinge
Description: Her singing helps plants grow, including the dreamshroom. Fina sits under the tree and gently watches the plants.

Name: Breath of Dew
Description: Flowers stretch their leaves in the evening breeze, rejoicing and dancing to Fina's cheerful song.

Name: Obscure Imprint
Description: Fina loves plants but isn't fond of outsiders. If you ever run into her, don't disturb her time with her plants.

Name: Nocturnal Tinge - Dream
Description: Travelers are all careful not to hurt the plants in the forest, in case they anger Fina and get thrown out.

Name: Breath of Dew - Dream
Description: Another group arrives in the depths of the forest, gazing in awe at the fairy standing alone under the moon.

Name: Obscure Imprint - Dream
Description: The fairy's singing flows in the veins of every leaf. Plants shiver in the silent night, telling stories of yore.

Name: Crimson Chant
Description: The witch brushed her hair as the raven brought a gem necklace. The hat fell on her head with a wave of her wand.

Name: Mushroom Stew
Description: Ripe dreamshrooms are precious ingredients to be cooked in the simplest way—boiled and served with fine salt.

Name: Mushroom Stew - Fresh
Description: Wait, it hasn't boiled.' When someone asks worriedly, the mushrooms are already rolling around, 'Not ready!'

Name: Undercooked Mushroom
Description: The inside of the mushroom looks like 'zzz', so people call it the dreamshroom, sleepshroom, or snoreshroom.

Name: Photosynthesis
Description: Mushrooms can't photosynthesize without chloroplasts, so the colorful mushrooms complain, 'That's not a right name!'

Name: Photosynthesis - Dream
Description: But the mushrooms have turned into lamps, so we can help other plants synthesize!' The mushrooms wonder.

Name: Red Muscaria
Description: They look like us, but these aren't edible!' The mushrooms speak at once, 'There will be huge trouble!'

Name: Purple Muscaria
Description: That's worse!' The mushrooms jump up and down anxiously. 'I'm not eating it. I can tell that from the way it looks.'

Name: Sugar Overload
Description: Nikki, is this a world without you...' 'Momo, do you need help?' 'Y-yes... I can't get out meow!'

Name: Bear Fluff
Description: She can't leave the forest and values every chance to talk to outsiders. Don't be shy if you see her on your tour.

Name: Bear Fluff - Mocha
Description: Of course!' Kokia makes her entrance, fluffy ears popping out of the bush, 'Strawberry, chocolate, or milk?'

Name: Wicked Fluff
Description: A furry little creature in a cute outfit stands in front of the adventurers. They can't tell who it is for a second.

Name: Fairytale Gate
Description: Beyond the leaves stands a quaint cabin. In front of it is a small garden full of blooming flowers.

Name: Blooming Palisade
Description: After some discussion, they decide to follow the voice. Of course, they will keep a safe distance from the character.

Name: Sylvan Glade
Description: But this is an immersive play. It can't be too dangerous. Why don't we take a look?' one of them suggests.

Name: Bunny Caper
Description: It seems another group has arrived sooner. They stand in the garden, shielding a girl in a red cape behind.

Name: Gourmet Basket
Description: The adventurers let out a sigh of relief, share a look, and decide to go out and join the other team.

Name: Redolent Satin
Description: The fluffy animal scutters away soon with a roar. The team members stand in a circle, comforting the girl.

Name: Cutesy Costume
Description: Seeing the mascot head Nikki prepared for the guessing game, Momo commented, 'Everyone will know who you are.'

Name: Broken Clues
Description: With a low hiss, the lights in the hall suddenly went out. The music paused as the crowd began to panic.

Name: Puzzling Cinders
Description: Beep—' The passcode to a storage room away from the hall was decrypted. A figure approached the sleeping gem.

Name: Blinding Alarm
Description: Don't panic!' 'Don't run. Watch your steps!' Staff members tried to maintain order while a figure left in silence.

Name: Mind Labyrinth
Description: Shouldn't the security guards be keeping order in the hall? The Gem Burglar was puzzled, 'Why are you here!?'

Name: Mystery Paradox
Description: You've been caught in the act. Save your breath for the police.' Colis handed the Burglar over to the police.

Name: Revealing Moment
Description: I've tracked this case since the first theft and noticed the same MO,' Colis explained patiently.

Name: Extraordinary Grace
Description: Thank you, Ms. Colis,' the host said gratefully, though curiosity about her methods lingered in his mind.

Name: Insightful Theory
Description: Colis first checked the security details for tonight and believed this would be the best moment for arrest.

Name: Gamble of Minds
Description: Colis never feared enemies in the dark. She would find herself in dangerous situations and never back down.

Name: Ingenious Scheme
Description: Detectives have their own styles—and so do burglars. The Gem Burglar was known for exploiting security flaws.

Name: Suspect Analysis
Description: The Gem Burglar was suspiciously calm after the arrest and smirked when he walked by Colis.

Name: Drifting Mind
Description: More importantly, the dreamshrooms are extremely delicious no matter how it is prepared and cooked.

Name: Mushroom Whimsy
Description: The cafeteria of Pedmon School grew them in greenhouses and created a specialty dish that soon captivated the world.

Name: Drifting Mind - Dream
Description: Shroomoo has been staying in the forest for research. Adventurers lucky enough may run into her on their tour.

Name: Mushroom Whimsy - Dream
Description: She is a friendly character who will actively approach adventurers. If you need any help, don't hesitate to tell her.

Name: Gentle Companion
Description: The fluffy white creature looks as calm and gentle as its master, but the girl knows it is a fleet-footed hound.

Name: Romantic Confetti
Description: What's wrong?' The clamor ceases at the sound of the voice as people step aside. The girl looks up curiously.

Name: Everlasting Glory
Description: The name Nakoya means undying light. Even time favors her, granting her extraordinary maturity and grace.

Name: Breeze of Bloom
Description: As Duchess Nakoya approaches her, her heart beats faster and faster, before she bows on one knee with all sincerity.

Name: Elegy of Glamour
Description: A sergeant? Some guests look her up and down, their murmurs like an off-key song, destroying the harmony in the room.

Name: Crimson in the Night
Description: Who would dance with her? Someone raises their voice, but she doesn't argue with them. All she cares is that...

Name: Stellar Affection
Description: As Nakoya and Selly step onto the dance floor, the gentle tune turns into passionate notes to start the ball.

Name: Fairytale Carousel
Description: In her dreams, Tatasie rode on a wooden horse on clouds as stars weaved her a shimmering rainbow-like cape.

Name: Rainbow Starlight
Description: Reluctant to leave, a star clung to Tatasie's hem, swaying with her steps and urging her onward with each twinkle.

Name: Fantasy Stairway
Description: Clouds formed a stairway to the festival. Tatasie waved goodbye and stepped up, lifting her hem as she went.

Name: Dewy Zephyr
Description: Tatasie stepped into a fairyland where the sweet wind brushed her hair and told her stories under the blue sky.

Name: Cirrus Chorus
Description: Stars slid down the rainbow bridge, eagerly offering Tatasie their handmade, masterpiece treats.

Name: Ethereal Shimmer
Description: Tatasie could still see the colors when she woke up. Inspired, she rushed to her desk — she now had a design!

Name: Skyward Invitation
Description: After renovation, the fairyland reopened. The carousel of stars and clouds invited everyone to the sky.

Name: Traces of Inspiration
Description: The assistant opened the studio door to see Tatasie finally smiling again—with a finished carousel blueprint in hand.

Name: Wishing Fairy
Description: Iset brings a unique wish bottle that grants any wish written on a slip of paper in the near future.

Name: Awakened Rebirth
Description: Ace and Elle bring the morning lavender from the Pigeon Kingdom that symbolizes awakening and rebirth.

Name: Moment of Amazement
Description: Nikki is surprised when she walks out of the room. Momo jumps on the table and hands her a cute hammer with a ribbon.

Name: Fuzzy Feeling
Description: Nikki gently cracks open the chocolate egg brought by the Iron Rose. Inside is a birthday cake adorned with stars.

Name: Brilliant Blossom
Description: The pillow from her friends in the Cloud is embroidered with flowers, symbolizing their great wish for her happiness.

Name: Enwreathing Aroma
Description: When the first ray of light shone through the mist, Waverly set out to find water despite the treacherous path.

Name: Ambrosial Carriage
Description: It hadn't rained in months this year. The ground dried up, and even the flourishing apple tree looked withered.

Name: Floral Vitality
Description: As leaves fell and branched dried, Waverly couldn't stop worrying. She didn't want to lose her longtime friend.

Name: Gentle Haze
Description: Tender flowers and leaves formed an oil painting. Waverly lay in the shade, watching the clouds shift.

Name: Cherished Hope
Description: Deep in a remote valley, Waverly found a small but clear crook, as if nature had prepared an answer for the brave.

Name: Scarlet Delicacy
Description: Overjoyed, Waverly carefully scooped water into her bucket and began her journey home at sunset.

Name: Lingering Redolence
Description: On quiet evenings, Waverly would sit by the apple tree as usual, sharing her day or singing a gentle song.

Name: Blooming Aspiration
Description: Though fetching water was tiring and repetitive, Waverly never complained—she only wished for the tree's recovery.

Name: Redolent Ballad
Description: One morning before departure, Waverly was surprised to see new sprouts on the apple tree's branches.

Name: Emerald Magic
Description: A plump red apple fell into Waverly's arms. She took a bite from the tree's present, and it began to work wonders.

Name: Afterglow Leisure
