Description: Its refreshing aroma bears witness to Waverly's friendship with the tree, watching over her innocence and kindness.

Name: Feline Receptionist
Description: The cat grew fond of Saki's mother, rubbing against customers' legs and allowing gentle pets from familiar hands.

Name: Delightful Treat
Description: To spoil the cat, her mom baked its favorite food—fish cookies. People started calling it Fish since then.

Name: Exclusive Devotion
Description: When her mom was baking cakes and fish cookies, Fish would sit quietly by her side, awaiting its special meal.

Name: Pastry Guardian
Description: As time passed, Fish became the guardian of the shop, patrolling the pantry, kitchen and tables every day.

Name: Cordial Atmosphere
Description: Worried Fish might occupy a dining spot, Saki offered discounts at tables where Fish chose to nap.

Name: Convivial Treat
Description: Saki refurnished the shop after she took over. On reopening day, she baked a new flavor of cookies for Fish.

Name: Delicious Compensation
Description: Fish now loves sleeping under tables, and customers lower their voices to avoid disturbing the beloved old cat.

Name: Elegant Elephant
Description: The elephant carried Mikari to a wonderland. Here, she was no longer a lonely girl but a brave adventurer.

Name: Plaited Clouds
Description: Seeing Mikari upset, her grandma lovingly crafted toy elephants with her warm, dexterous hands.

Name: Adventurous Anecdote
Description: Beyond the soft clouds lay the magical park in the sky, where wonders awaited the curious young girl.

Name: Liberating Venture
Description: Mikari and the elephants cleared challenges and found treasures hidden in the park. She never felt such joy before.

Name: Frosting Badge
Description: Mikari shared the dream with her grandma, who patted her on the head, 'I hope you'll always smile like this.'

Name: Devout Wish
Description: Mikari looked at the mirror behind her grandma and saw the upward curve of her own lips, her eyes shining with joy.

Name: Innocent Dreamland
Description: She adored the toy elephants, naming each one and crafting creative clothes and accessories just for them.

Name: Hook of Luck
Description: Inside the dark forest are heavy mist, strange mushrooms, and bubbling swamps... Infinite wonders abound.

Name: Underwood Memory
Description: Lorora's interest was piqued. She asked where the creek was and set out to find the fish first thing in the morning.

Name: Medal of Courage
Description: They came to a glade in the forest where a huge tree towered over them. Lorora stepped closer and asked nicely.

Name: Tacit Support
Description: Lorora and her cat feared no difficulties, but as they adventured farther, they started to lose their direction.

Name: Adventure Fellowship
Description: Follow where my tallest branch points, and you will find the deepest creek.' The tree praised their courage.

Name: Treasure Voucher
Description: Lorora parted vines and finally saw the creek. The special red fish swan gracefully in the shimmering water.

Name: Rekindled Dream
Description: How did Tiya know what she wanted? She tasted the pudding and felt joy for the first time after Tiya left.

Name: Candlelight Twinkle
Description: She felt empty inside after Tiya left with her mother. Now there was no one to share dreams with.

Name: Golden Sconce
Description: On her birthday, she received an unexpected gift—a strawberry pudding with the letters 'Happy Birthday' on it.

Name: Crown of Faith
Description: She continued to learn art and design. The dream of becoming a designer with Tiya was her guiding light.

Name: Tomorrow Fantasy
Description: She would receive the same candle before her birthday. On her 16th birthday, she wished to get into her dream school.

Name: Candle Bloom
Description: A magic circle glowed beside a desk of books and manuscripts. The girl's face was lit by the candle flame.

Name: Enduring Vow
Description: Candle Fairy, share Sana's wishes with me! Even if we're not together, I want to realize a wish for her every year.'

Name: Poetic Fragrance
Description: The garden became alive—lilacs and roses turned into fairies and held Laruna's hem, inviting her to an adventure.

Name: Illuminating Insight
Description: Laruna floated up in the evening breeze. The dark sky seemed within arms' reach, as if she could touch the stars.

Name: Crescent of Dreams
Description: She rode the golden crescent along the river of stars, each whispering a secret of the past.

Name: Midnight Palisade
Description: Laruna took a step ahead and saw a ferry to the sky river. In the shimmers berthed a golden crescent boat.

Name: Sparkling Blossom
Description: Stars jumped into Laruna's boat with drops of water, sharing brilliant ideas with her. The girl smiled with joy.

Name: Chorus of Strings
Description: She reached into the river of stars and found shimmering verses. As she chanted them, the stars shone even brighter.

Name: Nostalgic Ballad
Description: Through thick clouds, the boat suddenly shook violently. Laruna with the stars and verses all plummeted below.

Name: Stellar Ripples
Description: The crescent boat flowed and left ripples in the river. Laruna arranged the verses into a brilliant chapter.

Name: Serene Frolic
Description: Nobody knew how the cave was formed. Tavania speculated that an overwhelming power had been sealed within the forest.

Name: Shattered Memory
Description: Tavania began looking for a solution. She opened a rift in the seal of the forest, slowly releasing the power within.

Name: World of Yore
Description: The phantoms around Tavania were lives lost in the cave. They weren't even spirits, just projections from the past.

Name: Nightmarish Bloom
Description: Immense power brewed in the sealed realm until the cave formed, enveloping the forest in a looming shadow.

Name: Verdant Renewal
Description: Soon, because of the rift, a human explorer discovered the forest. She was the first visitor in a thousand years.

Name: Evening Zephyr
Description: Tavania is glad with the result. The corrupting power is slowly dying, while humans bring new life to the forest.

Name: Shades of Time
Description: Sometimes Tavania feels lonely, too. She is shy and a bit timid, so she only has very few friends.

Name: Pacific Storm
Description: It makes Tavania sad that due to the cave and her mysterious power, explorers are afraid of running into her.

Name: Crystalline Glow
Description: If explorers come here, I'll politely tell them not to go near the cave. Tavania wonders if they'll be her friends.

Name: Hazy Hoar
Description: Tavania lives alone near the cave in the depths of the misty forest, where humans and other animals seldom visit.

Name: Loyal Audience
Description: Sheryl is an important character who appears early in the tour. She's pure-hearted with a love for dance and music.

Name: Fountain of Magic
Description: Sheryl is a fairy living in the forest who's equally friendly to everyone instead of only adventurers.

Name: Curtain of Wonder
Description: At the end of a show, she might ask adventurers to gather materials for her to design new decorations for the stage.

Name: Burgeoning Mirage
Description: No matter the result, Sheryl would compliment anyone who helped her and gift them some adorable souvenirs.

Name: Hymnal Blossom
Description: Sheryl has made friends with the bunnies, bears, hamsters, and more. She would make your adventure extra fun!

Name: Serene Chapter
Description: As the wind and music die down and light illuminates the stage, the audience realizes the show has ended.

Name: Silent Whisper
Description: If you have Sheryl's approval, she'll give you a small gift—a flower bookmark, leaf envelope, or mushroom badge.

Name: Effulgent Wonder
Description: Adventurers seeking close interactions with Sheryl may be disappointed—she's quite busy.

Name: Galactic Bond
Description: If you run into any trouble, don't hesitate to blow Sheryl's whistle. Her friends will come to your aid at the sound.

Name: Euphoric Flutter
Description: In the pale moonlight, Sheryl waves her hands—and this time, her friends join the dance too.

Name: Wings of Vision
Description: After the adventurers arrive at the last scene, Sheryl often appears in the distance before the final departure.

Name: Loyal Companion
Description: She gives adventurers simple but fun quests, such as helping her animal friends choose their outfits.

Name: Murmuring Bloom
Description: Flowers sway in the breeze by the sides of the forest trail. Every bloom has its own story to tell.

Name: 绒绒回忆
Description: 在所有的小动物里，少女最喜欢的就是兔子，她笑着将玩偶抱进怀里，灯火落在她的眸中，闪烁着对未来的希冀。

Name: 妙趣时光
Description: 她想起老师送给自己的第一份礼物，是一只小兔子发圈。她已经长大，但在对方眼中，或许自己还是那个孩子。

Name: 萌兔伴侣
Description: 火车在轨道上疾驰，风景于窗中飞速倒退，摇摇晃晃的车厢里，她抱着小兔子陷入了香甜的梦境。

Name: 绒绒回忆·织
Description: 无数网友在评论区留言，希望拥有一只可爱的同款小兔。这使她信心倍增，她又设计出了更多的兔子玩偶。

Name: 妙趣时光·织
Description: 家中的陈列架上，摆满了她亲手设计的编织作品，第一格却只有标签“小镇的兔子”，没有物品。

Name: 萌兔伴侣·织
Description: 她将自己编织的第一只兔子玩偶寄给了老师，感谢老师对她鼓励与支持——最初的玩偶陪伴她走过了漫长的旅程。

Name: 绒绒回忆·静
Description: 小说开始连载后，很快受到了读者的喜爱，看到大家围绕着剧情热烈地讨论，她感受到前所未有的成就感。

Name: 妙趣时光·静
Description: “小兔的梦境”成为了畅销榜上的新晋作家。她将自己的作品寄给了老师，感谢老师对自己的文学启蒙。

Name: 萌兔伴侣·静
Description: 灵感并非源源不断，她常常构思剧情直至深夜，或许未来的道路不会一帆风顺，但她不会轻易放弃。

Name: 绒绒回忆·音
Description: 她认真练习演唱，尝试学习更多的乐器，单曲被发布在音乐网站上后，收获的播放量和评论与日俱增。

Name: 妙趣时光·音
Description: 新专辑好评如潮，她成为了最受欢迎的新星歌手之一。她将专辑寄回小镇，感谢老师对自己的音乐启蒙。

Name: 萌兔伴侣·音
Description: 每天闯入脑海中的灵感，正等着在她的创作中化为现实。或许前路还有无数挑战，但她对未来满怀希望。

Name: 心仪之解
Description: 塔莉并未因此感到焦躁，她依靠自己的专业素养，成功搭配出了一套令顾客满意的服装。

Name: 幸运指引
Description: 塔莉笑着将打包好的新衣递给对方，并热情欢迎她的下次光临。顾客离开后，塔莉偷偷抽出一张牌——危机解除！

Name: 优雅珍藏
Description: 小包里装着揭示之牌，塔莉将它们随身携带。倘若朋友们有占卜的需求，她很乐意为他们提供牌面的指引。

Name: 心仪之解·森
Description: 塔莉冲进家门，只见家中一片狼藉，小猫正无辜地坐在打碎的花瓶旁。她松了口气，完全没有责备的心思了。

Name: 幸运指引·森
Description: 塔莉将窗户关严，小心地清理干净地上的陶瓷碎片，象征性拍了一下小猫的脑袋后，温柔地将它抱进了怀里。

Name: 优雅珍藏·森
Description: 坏事发生时，塔莉会寻找其中积极的一面。保持乐观的心态，是应对揭示之牌各种预示的最好方法。

Name: 心仪之解·朱
Description: 一只被雨淋湿的小猫瑟瑟发抖地依偎在塔莉脚边，饥寒交迫的可怜模样令塔莉心中一片柔软。

Name: 幸运指引·朱
Description: 塔莉伸出手，小猫乖巧地舔了舔她的掌心。难道这就是揭示之牌所指引的吗？雨停后，塔莉把它带回了家。

Name: 优雅珍藏·朱
Description: 生活中充满了不期而遇，将每一场美好的相遇都当成命运赠予的礼物，这是塔莉心中的答案。

Name: 心仪之解·风
Description: 下课后，老师微笑着来到正在整理笔记的塔莉面前，告知她之前提交的作品已经通过了设计大赛的初审。

Name: 幸运指引·风
Description: 这一定是揭示之牌预告的惊喜吧！塔莉心花怒放，向老师表达感谢后，她迫不及待地与朋友们分享了这个喜讯。

Name: 优雅珍藏·风
Description: 祝贺的话语从电话中传来，在这一刻来临之前，揭示之牌的预告，就已经让塔莉拥有了一整日的快乐。

Name: 瑰影迷离
Description: 静谧的夜晚，菈佩诺偶然间听见父亲对母亲发出的叹息，他遗憾地提到，家传的调香秘籍似乎注定要后继无人。

Name: 寒烟不寂
Description: 菈佩诺心怀愧疚，但更渴望实现成为优秀园艺师的理想。她决定在恰当的时机向父母坦露自己的真实心声。

Name: 瑰影迷离·华丽
Description: 既然凶手盗取了秘籍，那他定与调香界有着千丝万缕的联系，菈佩诺相信只要深入探查这一线索，定能揭开真相。

Name: 寒烟不寂·华丽
Description: 为了复仇，菈佩诺毅然重拾起调香之术，尽管她的心中并无热爱，只是将这门技艺视作通往复仇道路的必经桥梁。

Name: 瑰影迷离·珍稀
Description: 她无力回应赫迪深情的目光，行走在复仇之路上，她需要的是一把刺向黑暗的匕首，而不是修饰幸福的园艺剪刀。

Name: 寒烟不寂·珍稀
Description: 菈佩诺悄然离去，或许她的命运早已被阴霾笼罩，既然如此，她便要坚守这份决绝，将摧毁她生活的人拖入深渊。

Name: 瑰影迷离·芜
Description: “你愿意留下来吗？让我们一起等待，见证这片土地上的种子破土而出，迎接新生的那一刻。”赫迪认真地询问。

Name: 寒烟不寂·芜
Description: 菈佩诺点了点头，眼中闪动着光芒。荒芜的原野终将在季节的更迭中重新绽放出绚烂的花朵，她的人生也应如此。

Name: 瑰影迷离·焚
Description: 铁证如山，巨擘没有任何的辩解空间。舞台中央的巨擘陷入了癫狂，在无尽的质问中承认了自己的罪行。

Name: 寒烟不寂·焚
Description: 会场布置典雅的鲜花与装饰，都在警笛声下成为了无关紧要的背景板，菈佩诺看着远去的警车，轻轻呼了一口气。

Name: Chef's Hat
Description: The custom-made chef's hat is adorned with colorful dessert patterns. Every kid gets to have one for free.

Name: Ingenious Craft
Description: Sweetness helps release stress. If you are feeling down, head to the Bear's Bakery for fun and satisfaction.

Name: 交错闪光
Description: 她见过璀璨耀眼的滑板明星，自信而轻盈地翻过一道道障碍，征服了速度和引力，赢来掌声与鲜花。

Name: 勇者宣言
Description: 玻维尔渴望自己也成为滑板上的勇者，在喧嚣的夜风中起舞，征服一道又一道险峻的难关。

Name: 星驰电掣
Description: 玻维尔眼中的滑板就像是夜航的船，在混沌的黑暗中，永远驶向前方。

Name: 交错闪光·迷彩
Description: 她踏上滑板，好像踩在世界的边缘，高速的风吹乱了她的头发，她的身侧就是深渊。

Name: 勇者宣言·迷彩
Description: 这段飞行并不漫长，但玻维尔觉得时间的流速似乎被无限延缓，身边的一切杂乱模糊，她的大脑却从未如此清醒。

Name: 星驰电掣·迷彩
Description: 玻维尔眼中的滑板就像是一柄利刃，能够划破世界的边沿，在风暴与雷鸣中，指向一片未知的新天地。

Name: 交错闪光·炽焰
Description: 她为每一次成功的尖翻、回转、腾跃而欢欣不已，学得的技巧与成就感充实着她的内心。

Name: 勇者宣言·炽焰
Description: 玻维尔不在乎有过多少次失败，只要能够登上一次顶点，那过往的痛苦都只是她前进的阶梯。

Name: 星驰电掣·炽焰
Description: 玻维尔眼中的滑板就像是通往内心的钥匙，她与自己对话，发现真正的自我，发掘出自己拥有的无限潜能。

Name: 栖月酣眠
Description: “姐姐长大后想做什么呢？”面对活泼的妹妹，文静稳重的栗娜只是微笑着摇了摇头。

Name: 闪光回忆
Description: “好啦，美梦时间到，晚安孩子们。”慈爱的母亲走进房间关掉夜灯，两姐妹互道晚安后陷入了沉沉梦乡。

Name: 甜梦心事
Description: 这天晚上，瑞娜做了一场梦。在梦里，她是白蜡树学院的优秀毕业生，馨香的花瓣纷纷飘落在她身上。

Name: 居家时光
Description: 这天晚上，栗娜也做了一场梦。在梦里，她走在一片朦胧的雾中，未来尚不明晰，但有隐约的光亮在指引她向前。

Name: 栖月酣眠·幻
Description: 正如幼时的畅想，她如愿成为优秀毕业生，前往威尔顿做独立设计师。可渐渐地，她发现自己的灵感在枯竭。

Name: 闪光回忆·幻
Description: 小镇是瑞娜的家乡，也是她设计的母题。她恍然发觉创作不是无根之木，而自己已与熟悉的风景分离太久。

Name: 甜梦心事·幻
Description: 她订下最近一班的车票，乘上开往小镇的列车。在车轮滚动的隆隆声中，一场安稳的梦接住了她疲惫的灵魂。

Name: 居家时光·幻
Description: 在梦里，她回到了某个童年的午后。午睡醒来的她睁开双眼，温柔的风拂动窗帘，栗娜就依偎在她的身边。

Name: 栖月酣眠·雾
Description: 日复一日的教学中，不论是学生解开难题时露出的笑容，还是毕业时流下的泪珠，都让栗娜难以忘怀。

Name: 闪光回忆·雾
Description: 当胆怯的学生在她的鼓励下决定勇敢追梦时，栗娜的内心被温暖充盈。曾经那模糊的前路，逐渐清晰起来。

Name: 甜梦心事·雾
Description: 静谧的夜晚时分，栗娜常常会想起远行的妹妹，瑞娜足够勇敢也足够坚韧，但栗娜仍会担心她是否有照顾好自己。

Name: 居家时光·雾
Description: 一次深夜备课，栗娜抵挡不住困意沉沉睡去。梦中她回到了童年，瑞娜还在她身边，和煦阳光勾勒着对方的脸庞。

Name: Sprouting Meadow
Description: Mornian only realized it was midnight when she finished work. The prettiest flower was still blossoming alone.

Name: Ardent Blossom
Description: The first customer knocked on Mornian's door and bought a white lily for the Goddess. The second chose the iris...

Name: Devoting Dream
Description: Mornian awoke to a graceful woman in a hazy light, her gorgeous hair shining like the glow on the mountain peaks.

Name: Daydream Boon
Description: It was morning when Mornian woke up again. She came to the garden and noticed that the prettiest flower was gone.

Name: Sunrise Sparkle
Description: Overjoyed, Mornian offered the prettiest flower to the Goddess, who accepted it as the petals kissed her fingertips.

Name: Gentle Revelation
Description: The woman thanked Mornian's work with a gentle smile. Still in a daze, Mornian suddenly realized who she was.

Name: Budding Dream
Description: How she wished to offer the flower to the Goddess. But the festival had ended. Mornian went to sleep with regrets.

Name: Midwinter Bliss
Description: Birds brought peculiar objects to adorn Tana's windowsill, from star-shaped hair pins to colorful pebbles.

Name: Fateful Nocturne
Description: The fox had a bigger task. A magician lived by a hot spring in the deepest of the woods where no animal ventured.

Name: Magic Insignia
Description: The spring was said to cure all illnesses. On the holy night, the fox set out on its journey to find the spring.

Name: Purest Dedication
Description: The squirrels wove twigs into a big basket, filled it with their best acorns and placed it in front of Tana's home.

Name: Rejoicing Snowman
Description: Tana was ill? That's terrible.' the white-bearded magician had heard her singing, too. 'Give her the spring water.'

Name: Ephemeral Dream
Description: From gentle speaking to lively motions, Luoyun taught the kitten how to disguise as a human and hide herself.

Name: Shadowy Verdure
Description: Overly excited, the kitten let out her tail accidentally caught the new crystal chandelier, and shattered it.

Name: Ethereal Odyssey
Description: The crystal chandelier was key to the show. In a panic, the kitten thought of Luoyun's brush that could fix anything.

Name: Rosebud Shadow
Description: The kitten worked hard and went to the dance hall early to clean it. Luoyun leaned on the cupboards and listened.

Name: Spiritual Embrace
Description: The brush on the desk fixes anything; the lamp can turn back time; the old phone is one call away from other worlds.

Name: Tender Greetings
Description: Luoyun explained that some had sentimental value and weren't for sale, so the suspicion gradually went away.

Name: Ingenious Marvel
Description: The last customer left as the night fell. Luoyun blew out the candle and suddenly heard the sound of crashing beads.

Name: Archaic Artistry
Description: Luoyun went upstairs and saw the bead curtains swaying. A girl was lying on a chair with tears on her cheeks.

Name: Twilight Haze
Description: She learned some basics about human behavior and language from an older waitress and managed to stay here.

Name: Wishful Echo
Description: Please Luoyun... Help me.' Before the girl finished her words, two cat ears popped out and a tail dangled behind.

Name: Jade Iridescence
Description: Holding a cup of tea, the girl explained how she found a waitress job in the Jasmine Hall nearby.

Name: Gem Dazzle
Description: The kitten begged and promised she'd bring the best jewel one day. She just needed Luoyun's brush and her help.

Name: 菡萏有情
Description: 荷叶迎风而举，迎接着每日的朝阳，途经莲池的行人都不由驻足，因这抹生机盎然的新绿而心生愉悦。

Name: 清雅风姿
Description: 水面如镜，波光粼粼，倒映着池中莲叶的清雅风姿，远望如美人精心裁剪的绿罗裙，随风微微摇曳。

Name: 菡萏有情·悠
Description: 风过莲池，送来一阵阵渺远清幽的芳香，有人行至僻静处凭栏而坐，沉浸在香气中露出安然微笑。

Name: 清雅风姿·悠
Description: 精巧的画船载着红裙绿裳的女子们划入池中，此时烟雨微微，笙歌一片，裙摆都沾染了荷香。

Name: 菡萏有情·灵
Description: 你出一句词，我编一段曲，崭新的采莲歌便由此诞生，口耳相传，成为姐妹间相互陪伴，相互扶持的情谊象征。

Name: 清雅风姿·灵
Description: 霞光万千洒落水面，莲瓣与莲叶都镀上柔和的光晕，采莲女们朝同伴用力挥手，约定明日再相见。

Name: Ethereal Shadow
Description: Crowned by the night as the master of dreams, she saw visions and heard every secret wish and silent hope.

Name: Crescent Whisper
Description: Lovers reunited. Those consumed by fear or pain worried no more. Sorrow faded into oblivion.

Name: Drifting Haze
Description: A river of stars carrying hopes and memories flowed through dreams, driving out terrors with a harmonious finale.

Name: Feathery Breeze
Description: The audience was a group of blind kids. Their teacher hoped that music could show them the beauty of the world.

Name: Dream Timbre
Description: The show started on time. There was no spotlight or Arya's dream stage, but a sky full of twinkling stars.

Name: Dream Embrace
Description: The children sat quietly in their seats, with the most attentive and touching look of anticipation for the performer.

Name: Lustrous Bloom
Description: In her singing, stars were musical notes dancing under the sky, while fireflies shimmered in the serene, open wild.

Name: Starlit Glide
Description: The singing turned into pairs of invisible wings, carrying the children to the boundless sky of shining stars.

Name: Candid Embrace
Description: Since then Arya has been to many places for shows, but she still remembers the night and those meaningful tunes.

Name: Stylistic Solo
Description: The unique guitar has been with Chilu for long, from his loneliest moments to his achievements under the spotlight.

Name: Metallic Hum
Description: After a short break, it's time for the mysterious guest. The stadium erupts into cheers when the audience sees Kaja.

Name: Opposing Wings
Description: Chilu explains to Cali his inspiration for the concert, 'Contradictions make up the world and our lives.'

Name: Dance of Strings
Description: Day and night, front and back, black and white—the audience dances and cheers as the melodies and beats clash.

Name: 世事逐云
Description: 某日晚课结束，她回到自己的小院里，却发现满树繁花下坐着一个不速之客，抱着酒坛朝她大笑招手。

Name: 尘间绝笔
Description: 满树落花飘飞在夜风中，陈朝举起酒盏一饮而尽，二人皆不语，只是一杯接着一杯，直至天光破晓，山岚散尽。

Name: 渺渺是非
Description: 陈朝称他师兄，声音竟与往昔无半分差别。李潋有瞬恍惚，到嘴边的“表妹”一转，成了声带笑的“小师妹”。

Name: 世事逐云·华丽
Description: 幼时相亲的玩伴也会兵刃相向，曾经最信任的朋友也会反目成仇，无数血淋淋的闹剧落幕后，只会有一个赢家。

Name: 尘间绝笔·华丽
Description: 陈朝直言自己不知，临渊君摇了摇头。陈朝并非不知法门，只是眼下正紧紧抓住胸中执念，无意内视己身。

Name: 渺渺是非·华丽
Description: 没有人在意失败者的去向。有人一蹶不振，有人疯魔至今，也有人暗自发誓要将曾经战胜自己的人踩在脚下。

Name: 世事逐云·珍稀
Description: 陈朝搞不懂他。李潋就和小时候一样，把话给她掰开了揉碎了讲，讲到月亮爬上青山云台，照见他满腔热血成灰。

Name: 尘间绝笔·珍稀
Description: 李潋跟她说不通，拎着酒坛子气咻咻地走了，陈朝在他身后大喊：不问输赢地活着，与行尸走肉何异？

Name: 渺渺是非·珍稀
Description: 最后李潋问，赢了的人得到了什么？赢就一定好吗？陈朝翻了个天大的白眼。不然呢，不赢的话难道要输吗？

Name: 世事逐云·雪
Description: 师兄李潋提酒来贺，杯里盛一轮明亮的满月，笑贺她大胜一场，不过赢的不是旁人，而是赢过了自己的执念。

Name: 尘间绝笔·雪
Description: 眨眼间数十名弟子已被打趴，众人指天发誓下回定要赢，陈朝翘着腿坐在演武场最高处，托着腮露出淡淡笑意。

Name: 渺渺是非·雪
Description: 陈朝出现在演武场上时，大家纷纷上前叙话，笑言此番回山她好似平和不少，通身气质竟像一块圆润的玉石。

Name: 世事逐云·弈
Description: 尘世妖孽横行，竟为祸王庭，令朝中动荡不安人人自危。陈朝借家族势力而上，妙计克敌，为众人扭转败势。

Name: 尘间绝笔·弈
Description: 偶尔望向厅堂镜中自己凝重的脸，陈朝都会陷入恍惚，一旁的姐姐轻轻覆上她的手背，替她接上未尽的商议之语。

Name: 渺渺是非·弈
Description: 外敌退而内忧起，陈朝打理着繁重的俗事，每日睁眼便要穿过门庭应对想法各异的众人，挖空心思不教人看轻。

Name: Drifting Warble
Description: The praise of life never stops. Be it day or night, spring or winter, the melodies flow with endless passion and joy.

Name: Euphoric Beats
Description: A musical score floated in the air. With Melodie's guide, the students soon noticed the incorrect notes.

Name: Track of Life
Description: Two musical notes overlapped, while one hung at the edge of the score, as if it would fall at any moment.

Name: Fantastic Symphony
Description: Melodie told her students that everything had its own song. Listen carefully to hear every dancing note.

Name: Dream Navigation
Description: The students cheered as the wilting plant thrived again, budding quietly in the sound of music.

Name: Missing Curse
Description: Melodie waved her wand and chanted a spell to move the misplaced notes. A gentle song echoed in the room.

Name: Rejoicing Snow
Description: The girl's dress twirled like a flower blooming in the snow. People were transfixed by the perfect dance and music.

Name: Starlit Foliage
Description: For the Night Festival, the girl would be dancing under the largest adorned tree lit for the whole night.

Name: Earnest Present
Description: Cheers and claps surrounded her after a song. A small figure pushed out of the crowd and lunged into her arms.

Name: Ursine Cuteness
Description: The girl felt as if she were dancing on a cloud and saw a snow bear coming to life and nodding at her approvingly.

Name: Vivid Fairytale
Description: The audition was a week before the Night Festival. She practiced and sewed her dress with carefully picked clothes.

Name: Guiding Pearl
Description: Overworked, she caught a cold from the wind. Fortunately, her friends got her to the hospital in time.

Name: Silvery Jingle
Description: Tomorrow was the Night Festival. Disappointment almost crushed her as she walked in the sound of holy carols.

Name: Moonlit Gaze
Description: The messenger brought a pile of packages, from a portal speaker, CDs, sweets from her hometown to starry ribbons.

Name: Nocturnal Glimmer
Description: Her friends and family cheered her up. She wiped away tears as an idea slowly formed in her mind.

Name: Brilliant Festivity
Description: She felt her unfinished dress and the audition poster still lying on the table, when a knock broke the silence.

Name: Snowflake Charm
Description: Her students stared as Verssia calmly waved her wand, until waterdrops froze into snowflakes floating in the air.

Name: Gale of Snow
Description: It was time for the students to practice. Some recalled her steps and started practicing, while some needed help.

Name: Crystalline Shine
Description: Don't rush,' Verssia slowed her movements to show the details, 'Move in order and chant the spell accurately.'

Name: Frostland Fantasy
Description: The students would continue to discuss what they learned. They all felt that Verssia was actually very gentle.

Name: Silent Promise
Description: Thankfully, Verssia came to the rescue. She shielded the nervous student behind and melted the icicles with a wave.

Name: Gentle Croon
Description: Sorry, Ms. Verssia... I failed.' Verssia patted him on the shoulder, 'It's always good to try, so don't be afraid.'

Name: Magic of Silence
Description: Imagine elements of water gathering at the tip of your wand and freezing...' She guided her students to feel magic.

Name: Effulgent Snow
Description: Glimmering snowflakes were reflected in the students' eyes. The breathtaking view seemed to have stopped time.

Name: Chapter of Nature
Description: Verssia carefully guided every student. With each chant of the spell, snowflakes bloomed in the classroom.

Name: Sparkling Prayer
Description: Suddenly, someone screamed. A nervous student lost control and accidentally made dangerous, sharp icicles.

Name: Frozen Splendor
Description: With Verssia's encouraging words, the student calmed down and waved his wand again—a perfect snowflake bloomed.

Name: Snowy Night Magic
Description: The Magic Academy Fantasies has been a hit since its publication. Verssia is one of the most liked characters.

Name: Frosty Shrine
Description: Vianna would listen to their wishes in the sea of flowers and send the emissary of snow to spread her blessings.

Name: Meandering Peaks
Description: Since then, the townsfolk would bring flowers to the foothills during the Night Festival to thank the Goddess.

Name: Echoing Stars
Description: Children have whimsical dreams while others pray for their loved ones... Each tugs at Vianna's heartstrings.

Name: Blessed Snowflake
Description: The Goddess blessed everyone in town, but when the festival ended, she heard a girl's disappointed sigh.

Name: Pious Heart
Description: If only I could give this flower to the Goddess!' the girl had the sincerest wish that reached the snowy peaks.

Name: Midnight Breath
Description: The girl didn't deliver the flower in time. I should visit her instead! Vianna made up her mind with a smile.

Name: Starlight Vision
Description: The peaks glowed silently as the girl slept soundly in the warm room, a sweet dream awaiting her.

Name: Crystalline Frost
Description: The girl spent all day preparing flowers for others to offer the Goddess and missed the festival herself.

Name: Rosy Redolence
Description: The exquisite bag is the first New Year's gift: elegant design and romantic colors adorned with fragrant roses.

Name: Dual Space
Description: Their collaboration ignites the show, and Chilu's new song Echo makes the best response to the audience's passion.

Name: 飞箭炽燎
Description: 耳畔传来破空之声，无数飞箭射来，越千霜躲过了这一波箭雨，身边的人却被击中不少，躺倒在地。

Name: 监兵神君
Description: 越千霜的身后也传来金戈相交之声，没有一刻犹疑，越千霜冲在队列最前，带着剩下的精兵扑入敌方的营地。

Name: 凤翎明焰
Description: 除了那一轮飞箭，越千霜并没有受到更多的阻挡，营地中也没有什么守兵——这都在越千霜的预料之内。

Name: 琼玉朱组
Description: 就在她拔下敌方阵营战旗的下一秒，山野间属于自己的营地也传来了代表军演结束的号角。

Name: 横戈跃马
Description: 越千霜与祝若笙围在沙盘边，重新推演今日的战局。一方输了，却言笑晏晏；一方虽赢，却好似压抑着怒火。

Name: 勠力同心
Description: 好在越千霜也知祝若笙对自己了解甚深，早有所感，再者她带领的奇兵人数更少，动作更快，这才略胜一筹。

Name: 藏锋敛锷
Description: 己方进攻，对方的主将不在，被动防守，祝若笙有信心可以攻破守卫，先夺战旗，赢下这一次军演。

Name: 长夜蹀躞
Description: 兵法有云：“凡战者，以正合，以奇胜。”祝若笙知道越千霜向来喜欢出奇制胜，便也针对性地布置了战术。

Name: 神机妙策
Description: 她故布疑云，造出大部队还在营中的假象，拖缓越千霜的脚步，自己则带着己方军士进行奔袭。

Name: 凤翎流焰
Description: “行军作战，须有敬畏之心；面对强敌，当有谨慎之态！若今日当真是在战场，难不成还能从头来过么！”

Name: 锦笺呈祥
Description: 皓月高悬，华灯辉煌，漫天烟火绚烂，千家万户共此良辰美景，祈愿来年万事如意，和乐康泰。

Name: 风摇福铃
Description: 她眼花缭乱，流连忘返，归家时荷包空空，腹中鼓鼓，抬头一望，两盏大红灯笼映着檐下的冰棱，分外温馨明亮。

Name: 灯彩锦绣
Description: 人喜天亦喜，冬日暖阳不遗余力地送来新春的温暖，旧年残雪渐融。这一日人们相聚只为欢庆，辞旧岁更望新年。

Name: Carefree Sway
Description: Starlet guessed the girl was a poacher and challenged her to a styling contest, asking to set the birds free.

Name: Guardian of Blooms
Description: Surprised but not offended, the girl explained that she was a healer who helped animals hurt by poachers.

Name: Entrapped Wings
Description: Starlet noticed the caged birds were badly hurt, their wounds covered in white gauze. They needed protection.

Name: Carefree Sway - Hidden
Description: Maybe the stars answered her prayer or the forest heard the birds. The girl cried when Starlet returned in time.

Name: Guardian of Blooms - Hidden
Description: The girl ground the Whispergrass and fed it to the birds. As their eyes lit up again, they both relaxed.

Name: Entrapped Wings - Hidden
Description: Starlet waved goodbye to the girl and the birds and looked at the stars. Maybe they didn't lead her astray this time.

Name: Wonderland Parade
Description: Ms. Bunny's notebook gradually became a source of wonders, like a dreamland full of whimsical ideas.

Name: Fluorescent Mirage
Description: The girl sitting quietly in a coffee shop could be Ms. Bunny lost in imagination. What would the next story be like?

Name: Ethereal Vision
Description: Ms. Bunny invited Starlet to the troupe's new show. Beautiful scores guided the audience into a world of fantasies.

Name: Poem of Tomorrow
Description: Applause erupted at the end of the show. It was so amazing that Starlet decided to stay and watch the next one.

Name: Wonderland Parade - Maple
Description: Starlet always gets lost on her journeys, but thanks to that, she's made friends and has lots of stories to tell.

Name: Fluorescent Mirage - Maple
Description: Starlet's stories gave Ms. Bunny new ideas. She wrote them down in her notebook but refused to show Starlet.

Name: Ethereal Vision - Maple
Description: It wasn't until the new show that Starlet knew that Ms. Bunny wrote it for her, named The Lost Seer and Her Friends.

Name: Poem of Tomorrow - Maple
Description: The seer's journey put smiles on everyone's faces, and Starlet had a new story to tell—her experience in the troupe.

Name: Bear Cookie
Description: Ennie invited Starlet to dinner. Starlet was on cloud nine among toy bears after having the cream of mushroom soup.

Name: Whispers of the Night
Description: Ennie spoke gently, 'Sleep, for your journey is in the dreams.' Starlet thought dozily that she sounded magical.

Name: Fluffy Camaraderie
Description: When Starlet opened her eyes, two toy bears were waving at her. They tugged her sleeves, inviting her to the castle.

Name: Bear Cookie - Foamy
Description: Starlet thought for a while and said, 'I like myself and my life. Besides... I don't know this prince.'

Name: Whispers of the Night- Foamy
Description: The next day, Starlet bid farewell to Ennie, who offered her a toy bear to accompany her on her journey forward.

Name: Fluffy Camaraderie - Foamy
Description: Starlet patted the bear's fluffy head and whispered, 'Thank you, but I think they'd prefer staying with you, Ennie.'

Name: Adventure Helmet
Description: You are still on your way after commissions and routes, as endless stars witness your intrepid expeditions.

Name: Peachy Freshness
Description: Finally, Peacho stared at the blue planet through the dark porthole as tears rolled down her cheeks. She was home.

Name: Spring Firecrackers
Description: Bid goodbye to the last year with fireworks and cheer! Is that thunder? No, it's my firecrackers of good wishes!'

Name: Bunny Cheers
Description: The toy bunnies Ruby and Kane were Luluko's first fans. Their long ears danced to her singing as if cheering her on.

Name: Stage of Excitement
Description: In the brilliant neon lights and waves of cheers, Luluko took a deep breath and stepped onto her dream stage.

Name: Perfect Vigor
Description: When she was a kid, Luluko saw an idol's performance on stage. The gorgeous dress and bright smile captivated her.

Name: Childish Imitation
Description: Dressing up in a sheer curtain and dancing with a rolled-up magazine—it was young Luluko's favorite game.

Name: Heart of Passion
Description: Brighter than the stars was Luluko's smile. Her shared joy and energy must have reached the cheering audience.

Name: Childhood Vision
Description: Tears of joy replaced days of anxiety when she got a reply from the idol project. Her dream was finally coming true.

Name: Perfect Rendition
Description: As the audience chanted for an encore, Luluko smiled with tears in her eyes and wished the song would never end.

Name: Scattering Wish
Description: Luluko wasn't disappointed with no more spotlights, because those glow sticks would shine on in her heart.

Name: Radiant Sweetheart
Description: No more rolled-up magazine, Luluko grabbed the microphone and made her intro—I'm Luluko, and welcome to my show!

Name: Stellar Bloom
Description: Her time as a trainee wasn't always fun. After being asked to do it again, she'd hide and cry. Then... try again!

Name: Tomorrow's Reunion
Description: The manager took Luluko's phone to stop her from going on Tide. Her schedule was packed the next day!

Name: Zephyr Murmur
Description: It's dark and time to go home. The leaves rustle in the wind and sing a lullaby. Explore the autumn in warm dreams.

Name: 日暮记忆
Description: 逐渐暗淡的天色下，星星点点的花朵悄然盛开。少女走过花香弥漫的小径，耳畔传来晚风温柔的呢喃。

Name: 重逢约定
Description: 从首饰盒中找到了朋友去年赠与的礼物，把它系在颈间，去赴今日这场期待已久的重逢之约。

Name: 流年期许
Description: 明净的玻璃窗外夜色繁华，灯火辉煌的宴会厅里，宾客们身着华服，笑语盈盈，共同举杯欢庆这美好时刻。

Name: 巧心秘密
Description: 小巧的单肩包有着独特的设计，这是一位新锐设计师的作品，一经发售便迅速风靡整个大陆。

Name: Glacé Memory
Description: Myra felt happy for her. She gave her a big bar of coffee chocolate and wished the best for her new life in Cicia.

Name: Hazelnut Biscuits
Description: Linno seemed hesitant outside, so Myra invited her in. She said she wanted to confess her feelings to her crush.

Name: Cream Gummies
Description: Why not give him handmade chocolate?' Myra helped Linno make a heart-shaped chocolate and wished her good luck.

Name: Cream Honey
Description: Momo, there's no fish-flavored chocolate!' 'Fine. Let's try mint, strawberry and this lemon flavor together!'

Name: Luscious Cocoa
Description: The day was coming to an end. Myra was preparing to close the shop when a pink-haired girl and her cat came in.

Name: 满目琳琅
Description: “有、有小偷！”“快抓住他！”人群一阵喧哗。福记果子铺的柜台后，梳着双团髻的少女一声清叱，纵身而出。

Name: 清溪丰壤
Description: 少女身轻如燕，只消一瞬，便将已经跑远的“窃贼”制于掌下——原来，这是一个泥猴似的小男孩。

Name: 瑞犬迎福
Description: 福记糖球被奉为佳节必不可少的点心，不仅因其本身味道可口，还源于福小武一直以来对城中人们的守护。

Name: 红尘无缺
Description: 福小武打量了男孩一番。见到男孩瘦弱的身形与身上破旧的衣衫，她便明白了一切。“福宝，先看着他。”

Name: 一念侠行
Description: “对不起，”在人群批评的目光中，男孩稚嫩的脸涨得通红，“我……”他的肚子响起了一连串“咕噜噜”声。

Name: 福宝绒绒
Description: 通体雪白的小狗福宝端坐于队伍边，神情威严，观察着人们的一举一动。“汪汪！汪汪汪！”它突然大叫起来。

Name: 悬灯结彩
Description: 待糖球出锅，满盘山楂明艳、糖霜莹白，犹如红梅傲雪之胜景。此时福记果子铺的招牌灯笼下，也已然排起长队。

Name: Midwinter Bloom
Description: She trudged in the snow in threadbare shoes and blazed a trail on the perilous northern peak.

Name: Fragrant Dawn
Description: It was not until dawn that she saw the red plum trees blooming for miles, covering the precipice in a dreamy brocade.

Name: Brocade of Dreams
Description: She clenched her teeth and prayed for the remainder of the trip. She was so close when she fell and blacked out.

Name: Splendid Grace
Description: A decade passed, and it was winter again. She walked alone in the snow, but this time, the trail was beaten and firm.

Name: Crystalline Snow
Description: She woke up in a warm, dry cave. The plum blooms had shriveled, leaving only one petal in her hand.

Name: Fading Scent
Description: With no floral fragrance, the red blooms on the peak were actually handkerchiefs with exquisite embroideries.

Name: Nostalgic Dream
Description: Despite the howling storm, she took out a red handkerchief and tied it with a ribbon to a withered branch.

Name: Dream Bubbles
Description: She was Carpia, with gorgeous golden and red scales exactly like the one in the story, but she always lazed around.

Name: Crimson Jade
Description: The koi fish began to ask if it was really what they wanted. It was a path to success, but also filled with pain.

Name: Tender Illusion
Description: In their training, the red koi and golden koi met a new friend who always stayed in the corners and never socialized.

Name: Sunlight Dazzle
Description: Carpia made two friends, even though she looked reluctant. They practiced together and shared pearls and snacks.

Name: Gemmed Glimmer
Description: The river was drying. The koi fish were too small to notice it at first, and the river was the whole world to them.

Name: Bejeweled Fan
Description: The red koi came to help, so Carpia asked her, too. She wanted to protect the others so they wouldn't get hurt.

Name: Lucent Felicity
Description: Carpia asked why she wanted to become a Loong. The golden koi shed a tear and answered she wished to see the sea.

Name: Tailored Breeze
Description: That night, Carpia let the snowy moonlight shine on her and leaped over one towering wave after another.

Name: Tune of Devotion
Description: Every koi fish has its reason to be a Loong. Through countless trials, they struggle and challenge themselves.

Name: Euphonic Serenade
Description: The koi fish that turned into a Loong had never left. She'd seen every mountain and sea and returned to the river.

Name: Earnest Promise
Description: Carpia used her Loong power to clear the sludge from upstream. It all went back to normal as the water returned.

Name: Rippling Reverie
Description: It wasn't until the golden koi got hurt that they realized the river was drying out. Time was changing everything.

Name: Transient Eternity
Description: A giant Loong appeared, with a solemn voice echoing under the moon, asking if she was ready to leave the river.

Name: Shadow of Destiny
Description: Greed misled the once-wise nobleman. He abused his power and wealth, gilding even the floors of his manor.

Name: Dauntless Wings
Description: The girl in the tower believed in Verka's lie until one day, an injured falcon brought a blood-stained family emblem.

Name: Frigid Blaze
Description: She thought it could be a clue. Following the emblem, she found her father's old subordinate and learned the truth.

Name: Effulgent Leaf
Description: The starving population and the truth of her father's death. With seething rage, she set out on a journey of revenge.

Name: Pristine Glory
Description: A few days ago, she faked a report about an uprising in another region to lead Verka away from the castle.

Name: Silent Recital
Description: As the castellan, she ordered the banishment of Verka's family, which was carried out by her close followers.

Name: Blazing Splendor
Description: But it was far from enough. Rofona didn't have enough wealth or power if Verka returned with his army.

Name: Glimpse of Yore
Description: Verka's reaction was unexpected. His letter seemed calm—he thought she was coerced by her father's followers.

Name: Triumphant Return
Description: The hubristic man was still stuck in the past. The web of lies he wove for Rofona eventually ensnared him as well.

Name: Fearless Oath
Description: Verka took our wealth, and I'll get it all back for you!' Rofona swore an oath to her followers at sunrise.

Name: Midnight Blizzard
Description: Darlene would come to the park every night after that. Like an unspoken agreement, the violin would play.

Name: Snowfall Promise
Description: The wait felt endless in the snow. Darlene was about to give up when the man shielded her with a black umbrella.

Name: Vow of Life
Description: Seeing Darlene's tears, he couldn't hide his feelings anymore, 'I'll protect you from now on. You won't wait again.'

Name: Snowfall Moment
Description: A welcome party held him up. He was out of breath after running in the snow, begging for Darlene's forgiveness.

Name: Silent Aspiration
Description: Darlene loved writing, but her work left her no time to put ideas to paper. Yet tonight, he wanted to be her reader.

Name: Lingering Chorus
Description: Darlene listened as he played, while he read all her poems. They were each other's first audience.

Name: Snow-Night Oath
Description: A lily always lay on the bench she sat on. Darlene would turn her gaze to the violinist playing with flushed ears.

Name: Midwinter Comfort
Description: Darlene sent her poems to publishers, and the violinist signed up for the open recruitment of an orchestra.

Name: Pristine Feeling
Description: Darlene found fame with her beautiful writing, while the violinist impressed everyone with his amazing skills.

Name: Sacred Inscription
Description: The day Renata left, birds surrounded her like always as she leapt by the old tree, oblivious to the glowing runes.

Name: Immortal Saga
Description: She woke up before the birds and slept cradled by vines. One day, the envoy whispered, 'Call me Mother.'

Name: Ligneous Sanctum
Description: One day, as Mother brushed Renata's hair, she said, 'It's time. You're ready for your three missions.'

Name: Primeval Sentiment
Description: Renata came to the first impoverished country. Following Mother's instructions, she gave them fertile grounds.

Name: Sylvan Tales
Description: People in the second country were brave but reckless. Renata crafted the sharpest weapons for them as told.

Name: Caged Wish
Description: The third country was obsessed with magic powers. Renata taught those with potential what she learned from Mother.

Name: Hillside Smelter
Description: When Mother heard Renata murmur in her sleep she felt lucky to be by her side, the look on her face seemed uncertain.

Name: Starlit Splendor
Description: Renata rushed back and saw golden runes glowing by the tree. Worried, she ran to Mother but was pushed away instead.

Name: Spiritual Sigh
Description: Renata somehow felt worried seeing people in their euphoria, but it faded when birds brought a gift from Mother.

Name: Wilderness Elegy
Description: Fertile land couldn't defend itself; weapons led to war; magic broke the balance of power. The countries collapsed.

Name: Surreal Dream
Description: The birds carried lights to the outside world, sharing warmth and calmness with those struggling in hatred and war.

Name: Midnight Reverie
Description: In the safe haven of a comfortable dream, time loses all meaning, leaving only two inseparable hearts.

Name: Snowfall Vow
Description: A sweet kiss melts the winter chill as snowflakes fall, forming two hearts forever entwined.

Name: Ardent Passion
Description: A red rose witnesses fiery love on a snowy night, its imprint eternal and unyielding.

Name: Mirror of Time
Description: The mirror belongs to the castle and the Star Seer. Unfortunately, there's nothing she needs to know through it.

Name: Frosty Splendor
Description: On the balcony, Hirst leans casually on the sofa with a book in his hands, but his gaze lies somewhere else.

Name: Seasonal Cycle
Description: Starlet lies in a tall and fluffy bed in the well-decorated bedroom, frowning as if debating something important.

Name: Florescent Shadow
Description: As candlelight flickers in the church of the Pigeon Kingdom, the Holy Maiden prays on her knees with her closed eyes.

Name: Sparkling Dew
Description: In Apple Federation, the magician bows in thunderous applause and cheers as colorful confetti bursts and falls.

Name: Splendid Vestige
Description: As stars illuminate every corner of the continent, ripples spread in the mirror, showing images from afar.

Name: Anecdote of Time
Description: The vision in the mirror becomes a blur of falling stars and fading moonlight, leaving only silent darkness.

Name: Fate in Mirror
Description: In the forgotten corner, time turns into ripples in the mirror. Only blooms and springs sing rhymes of yore.

Name: Herald of Spring
Description: The flower said: I'd seen others looking for the garden but leaving in disappointment. Did you also come from afar?

Name: Iridescent Garden
Description: The traveler sat by a stone pillar. To her surprise, there was power left in the wilted vines where a flower budded.

Name: Vernal Eternity
Description: The traveler was tired, thinking the dead garden was fate's prank, telling her that all her efforts were in vain.

Name: Temporal Reflection
Description: The traveler couldn't answer that. Her journey began so long ago, and she'd left footprints all over the world.

Name: Aromatic Prelude
Description: The traveler wandered the world and saw prosperity and desolation. The initial joy of traveling had long faded.

Name: Floral Rhetoric
Description: The flower waited, swaying in the frigid gale as if it'd be blown away the next second. The traveler answered yes.

Name: Florid Companion
Description: A gust of wind blew the flower into the traveler's palm. It asked: Will you stay? We can create another spring.

Name: Garden Strings
Description: But the traveler was too tired. She stared at the desolation, unsure of an eternal spring. Would there ever be one?

Name: Sprouting Verdure
Description: The flower said: Sorry, spring had long left. Take your rest and leave. You may find an eternal spring elsewhere.

Name: Eternal Tendrils
Description: The fairy was long gone, but she left a way to preserve spring. The traveler decided to stay and rebuild the garden.

Name: Garden Rhapsody
Description: But she didn't leave and felt the vines with warmth in her gaze. She'd walked too long for the promise of spring.

Name: Locks of Felicity
Description: Herbal wine is the goddess’s favorite, filled with the scent of spring, symbolizing hope and prosperity.

Name: Aureate Splendor
Description: As the fireworks bloom, the goddess blesses the world with peace and prosperity and wishes for abundant times ahead.

Name: Fortune Cauldron
Description: A fortune sprite gifted her a cauldron to share blessings and wishes as she serves as the new year’s guardian.

Name: Heavenly Auspice
Description: The snake goddess prepares for all wishes—reunion, love, health, wealth, or luck—for the coming year.

Name: Nephrite Wish
Description: Firecrackers awaken the sun lord as people don new outfits, ready to embrace a prosperous new year.

Name: Brimming Vigor
Description: After Miu landed, the bloated toast slowly shrunk and turned into a warm light, leaving only the sweetness of butter.

Name: Faith in Tomorrow
Description: I'm sure you've made it to school on time. Hope the magic helped. And don't sleep late again. —Bakery Owner'

Name: Tales of Fortune
Description: It all happened so suddenly that Miu thought she was dreaming. She shook the empty bag and found a note inside.

Name: Toast Magic
Description: Riding the giant piece of toast, Miu finally made it to school before the last moment.

Name: Fondness Overload
Description: Miu is a character in Morning at the Bakery. It's a children's book about a bakery owner using magic to help kids.

Name: Fireside Tea
Description: After preparing melted snow and tea leaves in the yard, Roro brought more fruits to treat her guest.

Name: Fragrance in Snow
Description: The snow died down, but Roro was still worried. If her guest didn't come, she'd bring some treats to the mountain.

Name: Flimsy Dream
Description: After reading about brewing tea with melted snow, Roro climbed the mountain to collect some—but slipped and fell.

Name: Bundle of Snow
Description: As she brushed away the snow, a flurry little creature stuck its nose out and rubbed the snow off of her cheeks.

Name: Snowland Fairy
Description: Roro was surprised to see her guest had arrived—a ferret was waving at her on the unlit stove, taking it for a seat.

Name: Enwreathing Mist
Description: The ferret followed Roro wherever she went. It watched with its head tilted, then led her to a secret plum forest.

Name: Crucible Haze
Description: Roro lifted the ferret away and lit the stove. Soon, a pleasant scent wafted out of the pot of snow and tea.

Name: Scented Snowfall
Description: Roro gathered snow with the smell of plum blooms and invited the ferret to tea tasting. To her surprise, it nodded!

Name: Dormant Warmth
Description: The ferret followed Roro home before bidding its goodbye. Roro watched until snow covered its tiny footprints.

Name: Emerald Resplendence
Description: At sunset, the ferret rubbed on Roro's fingertip and scampered away—perhaps they'd meet again the next day.

Name: Banquet Vestige
Description: A waiter walked to Allison with drinks. She took one and saluted to someone behind the crowd.

Name: Stairs of Glory
Description: Like that, Allison got away from the crowd. Beside the elegant spiral stairs, a waiter invited her to the lounge.

Name: Glowing Spectacle
Description: Everyone turned their gaze to the middle-aged man. Allison's next investee? They wondered and gathered around him.

Name: Urban Neon
Description: The marble floor reflected the neon lights and stars outside, as an intoxicating aroma filled the room.

Name: Amber Whisper
Description: Her assistant put a coat on her and whispered, 'We found proof that her design got stolen. Are you helping her?'

Name: Aureate Daze
Description: Allison doesn't mind bootlickers. She knows wealth attracts vultures like carcasses. They'll never forget the taste.

Name: Emerald Canticle
Description: This is my newest design. What do you think?' the young man smiled flatteringly, 'Nothing beats it!'

Name: Scented Treasure
Description: Of course.' the young man apologized. 'You must have more than this.' Allison didn't mind, 'I'll take them all.'

Name: Cosmic Symphony
Description: Allison raised her eyebrow, 'I run a legitimate business, sir. The tax I paid is enough to build three Times Towers.'

Name: Empyrean Shine
Description: Lives fell to the empress's wrath. Blood on the guillotine didn't dry for months and the blade split time and again.

Name: Lakeside Arcade
Description: The girl was invited to the palace with respect. She felt no joy or sorrow, so nobody could see through her.

Name: Frosty Willow
Description: There was no more secret in the world. The girl needed no excuse or proof, for she knew it all.

Name: Cosmic Liberation
Description: But the empress didn't ask her everything. The girl was confused as to why the empress pretended to not spot a lie.

Name: Purge of Evil
Description: The empress smiled, no longer young, 'You know the world, but not people.' Then she added, 'It's not a bad thing.'

Name: Ravine Echo
Description: As time passed, the once vigorous empress aged. She lay in bed, only her eyes still as bright as usual.

Name: Serene Luster
Description: Before she made her choice, the new empress came to butter her up, 'If you're tired, you can return to Frostleaf.'

Name: Timeless Finesse
Description: Instead of explaining, the empress talked about other things that fascinated the girl even though she knew them all.

Name: Curious Virtuosity
Description: She sighed after a while, 'Leave if you don't want to.' The girl was confused. She thought she wanted her to stay.

Name: Misty Cirrus
Description: Do you want me to help the new empress?' the girl asked, even though she shouldn't stay. The empress hesitated.

Name: Drifting Cirrus
Description: Frostleaf disappeared over time, leaving only a handful of small lakes scattered over the map.

Name: Meteor Whisper
Description: Go home, before the stars all fall. You need rest.' Starlet nodded and then shook her head. She couldn't promise it.

Name: Verdant Canto
Description: Her teacher pushed the Stellar Codex toward her, 'We'll be waiting here, like today, and you'll find your way back.'

Name: Scentful Slumber
Description: Starlet was beckoned over to her teacher. She stood there as her teacher flipped through the Stellar Codex.

Name: Clouded Echo
Description: You must be tired after a long journey.' The teacher pulled Starlet to sit by her—a memory she didn't recall.

Name: Resplendent Stars
Description: As Starlet closed the door and turned around, she saw the ship Lilith Star flowing in the sea wind.

Name: Vision of Innocence
Description: At dawn, she sat with Amphithea News flapping in the wind, the date on which already leapt to months later.

Name: Garden Adventure
Description: The past, present and future were marbles scattered on the ground to her. There was no point in finding a pattern.

Name: Lingering Memory
Description: There had to be something to base reality on. Starlet felt the Stellar Codex and tried to sort out her mind.

Name: Luminous Starlight
Description: Would her past and future selves help with her current wish? When Starlet looked up again, the sky had turned dark.

Name: Stellar Coronation
Description: She seemed to have caught the star's tail for a brief moment. Would it be her way home or lead her astray again?

Name: Eternal Blessing
Description: Brenda would lie on the armor during breaks, wiping her sword while babbling on about palace anecdotes.

Name: Drifting Petals
Description: Bloody roses bloomed all over the Royal City. Brenda who grew like a sprouting tree hastened past the hedgerow.

Name: Nocturnal Echo
Description: The girl's sword accurately hit between the breastplates with a clang. She cheered, ignoring the pain in her hand.

Name: Crimson Edge
Description: Brenda commissioned a heavy sword as advised. The hilt was engraved with the same patterns as the armor.

Name: Innocent Wonder
Description: Brenda defended her kingdom with her sword. Under her leadership, they fended off invaders again and again.

Name: Pristine Vision
Description: The armor spun around and showed Brenda a blooming red rose on the tip of the blade, 'Well done, Brenda.'

Name: Iridescent Twinkle
Description: The king died after a raid at night. Fire and smoke of war spread across the kingdom in place of red roses.

Name: Pristine Oath
Description: She knew the soldiers must have felt the same. The armor exhausted its soul, sharing its power with everyone.

Name: Frigid Silence
Description: Blue decided to look for White. The spirits studied the travelers' books for three days before seeing her off.

Name: Fluorescent Era
Description: White usually returned after a few days, so the spirits grew worried when she didn't return for months this time.

Name: Vow of Loyalty
Description: When Blue said that, White would sigh with a smile and let her wrap around her arm as they watched the clouds surge.

Name: Veiled Moon
Description: The human world was much more lively. She followed a pleasant smell and found the sweet cake she read in the books.

Name: Nephrite Charm
Description: Blue tilted her head in confusion when asked to pay, so the vendor offered her a small piece resignedly.

Name: Enwreathed Ridge
Description: The human world was not as dramatic as the books. Their lives were simple but colorful as they worked and rested.

Name: Hazy Precipice
Description: Spirits don't eat these. Blue thought to herself, but drooled over it. How could the humans make such delicacies?

Name: Emerald Shimmer
Description: Humans feared the unknown, nature and whims of fate, but they were also brave, living as if they were never afraid.

Name: Lotus Verdure
Description: Blue remembered what her sister told her. Spirits grew up in rain and storms, but never had to worry about death.

Name: Godsbane Oath
Description: She was no envoy of the gods but a fallen angel, cursed with eternal life, bound by trees and mountains.

Name: Mirror of Miracles
Description: As the candles dim, the vision in the mirror fades in ripples. The sound of the gates opening echoes in the corridor.

Name: Banana Satchel
Description: She always wears a banana-shaped satchel. Some say inside is delicious candy, while some say interesting stories.

Name: Floating Clouds
Description: People were told where the medicine came from. Since then, the wild cranes have become a symbol of the ancient city.

Name: Dreambound Whisper
Description: The final stop was the Crane's dwelling place. The wind rustled the reed leaves, and a crane stood in the water.

Name: Cheerful Breeze
Description: A cup of morning tea carries the scent of lemon groves, each breath filled with nature's calm and hidden delight.

Name: Blazing End
Description: Why did he leave? Drawn by beauty, he was burned by the fire within. An insecure soul can never face the flame.

Name: Lost Memory
Description: Helen recalled her mythic namesake—both trapped by beauty, their fates chosen by a world beyond their control.

Name: Drowning Dream
Description: She dreamed of fire roaring through an ancient city. Its light in her eyes, and the illusion of beauty vanished.

Name: Time Glimmer
Description: Helen stepped into the spotlight. Her red dress flared like fire with each spin, burning away every unseen chain.

Name: Flicker Mirage
Description: Beauty was never the sin—it was desire and illusion that fed the blame. Rumors only revealed their fragile souls.

Name: Mirror Gleam
Description: At the banquet, Helen nodded with a calm smile—he was a stranger now. But in his eyes, longing still lingered.

Name: 绚烂畅想
Description: 餐桌上回荡着她们的笑声，在对未来的美好畅想中，她们相约毕业后一起去温特蒙参加设计师茶话会。

Name: 雀跃之诗
Description: 夜已深，莉菈回到宿舍，在暖色灯光下翻开日记本，认真记录下这一天的心情。她热切期待着人生的全新篇章。

Name: 祥云瑞霭
Description: 村落里人心温暖，阿珠心中却仍然一片荒芜。日复一日跟大家跳着祈福的舞蹈，她却始终无法找到自己的愿望。

Name: 灵华归心
Description: 某日阿珠忽然发现，自己照料的花苗在寒意仍未离去的大地上探出了嫩芽，生机勃勃的几点新绿点亮了她的双眼。

Name: 皓雪映霞
Description: 春天来的时候，花园里开出了第一朵花，那一天的风格外暖，大雪尽数融化，阿珠忽而想起多年前的一个雪夜。

Name: 纯净之愿
Description: 祖母牵着她的手走过雪原，走向家。每留下一个脚印，祖母便重复一遍愿望——阿珠平安长大，阿珠天天快乐。

Name: 朝圣之途
Description: 滚烫的热意让冰冷麻木的掌心回温，缭绕的茶烟中，沉默的阿珠用力眨了眨眼睛，一滴眼泪悄无声息地滑下。

Name: 风吟祈佑
Description: 阿珠在村子住了下来。她和村民们一起唱祈福的歌谣，也在热心阿婶的指导下逐渐学会了如何种植花草。

Name: Dreamlike Flutter
Description: A butterfly landed on the girl's shoulder before flying to the roses, fascinating her with its glittering wings.

Name: Flitting Butterfly
Description: Does love always feel so bitter-sweet? She believed that she'd met the one and wished to fall in love sooner.

Name: Untold Feelings
Description: It might be time to confess her feelings amidst the butterflies and blooms, but the girl didn't know how.

Name: Earliest Blossom
Description: A cold wave swept across the town. The roses that were blooming yesterday lost their colors in the gale.

Name: Springtime Wonder
Description: Butterflies huddled around the roses in the bitter cold, each thin wing shielding the blooms from the wind.

Name: Devout Prayer
Description: She prayed for the roses to survive the night and for the butterflies to leave for warmer lands.

Name: Prismatic Wings
Description: The girl tried to keep every bloom warm while the butterflies danced around, unaware of the approaching danger.

Name: Colorful Flickers
Description: Under the warm sun, the girl danced with the butterflies amidst the roses, creating their romantic fairytale.

Name: Bunny Pawns
Description: Unlike the bunny pawns on the chessboard, Bena was surprised to find out that she didn't have to follow the rules.

Name: Ingenious Move
Description: In the blink of an eye, a giant hand placed Bena on a black-and-white chessboard. Around her were bunny pawns.

Name: Monochrome Dream
Description: It's just a dream.' Bena nodded cheerfully, 'I'll be your soldier and guard every inch of the kingdom for you.'

Name: Silent Midnight
Description: Bena led the white bunnies to knock off their enemies one by one, like a light shining through the silent dark.

Name: Soldier's Glory
Description: Bena took down the enemy rooks, captured their king, and earned her queen's praise, 'You're an excellent soldier.'

Name: Charging Blade
Description: Bena never got a bunny chessboard. She was excited that she could finally have one, but she was also worried.

Name: Unbreakable Oath
Description: A designer created the bunny chess after a whimsical dream. Bena loved it but could never afford one.

Name: Supreme Praise
Description: You can have me now.' The queen agrees, 'Tomorrow afternoon, visit your favorite thrift shop. I'll wait there.'

Name: Fairytale Waltz
Description: The queen seemed to have misunderstood. Bena did win, but it had nothing to do with being an excellent soldier.

Name: Fairytale Twirl
Description: Every move on the chessboard calls for meticulous planning, but in the land of dreams, the only rule is to have fun.

Name: Astral Weave
Description: They stood shoulder to shoulder under the fireworks, like how they once crawled under one blanket in their dorm.

Name: Galactic Dazzle
Description: Tabisha couldn't help but yelp with joy. Like stars, the fireworks cast happiness and blessings for the night.

Name: Resplendent Blaze
Description: Three, two, one—the moment she opened her eyes, she saw a sky lit by fireworks as brilliant as a sea of flowers.

Name: Dancing Shimmer
Description: The memories intertwined but never faded. They shared a knowing look, laughing heartily just as before.

Name: Wondrous Serenade
Description: Their memories of every adventure, every clash and mix of inspirations, seemed ever so vivid and never lost in time.

Name: Fulgent Stars
Description: Tabisha's friends dragged her off the terrace and gathered the guests to reveal their wedding gifts.

Name: Reminiscent Stars
Description: Tabisha looked in the mirror to put on a glistening necklace and cracked up seeing her friends make faces.

Name: Sweet Lullaby
Description: In the gentle breeze under the stars, Tabisha tossed the bouquet of happiness as everyone cheered.

Name: Effulgent Daze
Description: Our dearest friend, between the stars and the sparks, we weave for you a never-fading dream—a life full of love.'

Name: 雪境风清
Description: 祖母的离去让阿珠身上的时间不再流动。无论她在做什么，心与灵魂仍每时每刻徘徊在她与祖母生活过的地方。

Name: Dream Companion
Description: Elanie leans back in her shell chair, dreaming of the sea—dolphins at play, fish gliding beside her.

Name: Free Voyage
Description: Elanie turns off her jellyfish lamp and closes her eyes—wishing to hear the sea's whisper in her dreams.

Name: Starlit Whispers
Description: At school, wishes go in drift bottles. Send them afloat—some say the water will make them come true.

Name: Neon Ray
Description: In pajamas, Elanie leans on her bed. Moonlight touches her photo wall—the leaping manta ray looks so free.

Name: Sea Treasures
Description: Elanie leaves her curious friends and heads to the riverside, carefully writing her long-held wish.

Name: Mist Drop
Description: The bottle floats away. If my wish won't come true, Elanie thinks, then go see the sea for me.

Name: Gleam Shell
Description: Elanie begins her drift bottle shopping—glass jars, scented paper, rainbow stars, and ribbons for a perfect wish.

Name: Prism Glow
Description: Could it be true?' Elanie wavered. 'But imagine the bottles reaching the sea!' Her friend's eyes sparkled with zeal.

Name: Glimmer Sprite
Description: One clear night, Lumi rose with the waves. The tide whispered, and the sea breeze carried distant laughter.

Name: Bottled Wish
Description: Lumi uncorked the bottle. Inside, a child had written: “I want to grow up and explore the world’s end!”

Name: Crystal Hope
Description: A drift bottle washed up before Lumi, moonlight glinting on its glass. Curious, she wondered—what could be inside?

Name: Stardust Gleam
Description: But Madam Orca never stayed long—she loved the surface more than the deep. Lumi wondered, what could be up there?

Name: Shell Whisper
Description: Where is the world's end? In the deep sea, or beyond the sky? Strange thoughts, yet they fascinate her.

Name: Pure Whisper
Description: Some letters hold first love, some brief wonders, but most carry heartfelt wishes from their senders.

Name: Tide Relic
Description: Since that night, Lumi rises whenever moonlight glows bright, opening drift bottles to read the wishes within.

Name: Dream Net
Description: Lumi is enchanted. The letters paint the human world vividly, making the quiet sea below feel dull in comparison.

Name: Egg Wonder
Description: The bunnies are always looking for eggs, but they seem to have never thought how to bring them home.

Name: Bunny's Birth
Description: Mom, what's the world like beyond the fields?' 'No bunnies in our family have traveled that far, my child.'

Name: Burgeoning Wonder
Description: I heard there are crows envious of your red eyes, hungry beasts, and mountains and rivers standing in your way.'

Name: Sprouting Wish
Description: Reba always leaped on the mound to stare at the horizon where the sun sank, wondering about the world beyond.

Name: Colorful Journey
Description: She traveled outside the fields to the mountains. There were hungry wolves and squirrels adventuring with her.

Name: Dandelion Yellow
Description: But I want to see it!' One night, Reba followed the dandelions' seeds on a secret adventure of the unknown.

Name: Flourishing Wish
Description: The garden grows fragrant with the wishes. It is said to be a mysterious ritual that turns wishes into flowers.

Name: Blossoming Dream
Description: Flore asks her customers to write down their wishes with a smile. The floral-scented notes seem to hold secrets.

Name: Guardian of Hope
Description: Ten years ago, the town was destroyed by merciless floods. People thought it had no hopes of reconstruction.

Name: Mellow Glow
Description: Now, Florawishes bloom still. The girl who lost her parents in the floods has built a garden upon the ruins.

Name: Zephyr of Dawn
Description: Florawishes are beautiful hopes, but without Flore's care, how could those buds bloom in the end?

Name: Dashing Grace
Description: No setbacks or hardships can deter her. She will always chase her dreams with the same determined, fearless passion.

Name: Emissary of Romance
Description: A pink bowtie and ribbons around the tail! Whisper sweet words of romance and be the star of the ceremony.

Name: Kitten Whimsy
Description: A gift inspired by The Star-Struck Kitten, the interesting fairytale that sparked the love between the newly-weds.

Name: Sea of Roses
Description: Each rose, wet with dew, emits a rich aroma, as the wedding dress leaves a gentle kiss on it when the bell rings.

Name: Fluttering Heart
Description: Countless worries woke Nightwisp up from her respite. The girl's woeful wish stirred up waves in her heart.

Name: Cocoon of Love
Description: The girl buried her innocent feelings deep in her heart, hoping for the gods to watch over the one she loved.

Name: Hazy Passion
Description: Nightwisp saw shapes of souls and traveled dreams and reality to listen to every girl's unspoken love.

Name: Endearing Murmur
Description: May your love shine eternally like the moon and guide your path.' The moon cast its glow upon the girl's face.

Name: Tranquil Repose
Description: Nightwisp reached out, almost touching the tears on the girl's cheeks, but was afraid of waking her up.

Name: Entwined Dreams
Description: Dreams change like a kaleidoscope: from cities bustling like a never-ending movie to nature teeming with lives.

Name: Heartfelt Prayer
Description: Even if everyone faces the end alone, the memories that they share with those they love still shine true.

Name: Spotless Heart
Description: A stage manifested before the girl's eyes. The person she held dearly wished that she'd achieve her dream there.

Name: Hazy Remembrance
Description: The girl dreamed of a heartbreaking departure. A familiar figure moved farther away as she waved her hand.

Name: Blazing Serpent Soars
Description: Legends say the serpent, sacred to fire, soars where the deity descends, bringing fortune to the world.

Name: Rites of Gilded Flame
Description: At year-end rites, twelve brocade drums thundered as masked priests danced with bronze bells around the altar.

Name: Crown of Grace
Description: The high priestess danced alone atop the altar, each final step aligning perfectly with the Flame Wyvern star.

Name: Chime of Grace
Description: On the altar, a jade scepter gleamed as flames spiraled from the cauldron marked 'Serpent Fire Brings Eternal Light.'

Name: Serpent in Firedance
Description: Solemn priests poured wine at the divine tree's roots; flames burst forth like a spirit serpent leaving its lair.

Name: Jade Sparks
Description: Palace musicians struck bronze chimes in a flowing rhythm, echoing the Flame Wyvern deity's eternal power.

Name: Torch of Order
Description: A 100-foot bronze tree stood at the altar's center, hung with lamps and etched with the Flame Wyvern star chart.

Name: Amber Omen
Description: The sky cracked open, bleeding amber light. Lirain's charms spun wildly, sensing the storm long before the town did.

Name: Featherlight Shade
Description: Her father's parting gift swayed in the breeze, waiting—so afraid of rain. Lirain turned back, sprinting home.

Name: Raining Bells
Description: She rang the bell, ignored... Until the first winds shattered rooftops, sending the town fleeing underground.

Name: Floodwalker
Description: Rain-drenched linen, water rising past her ankles. She reaches for the severed string, the charms barely holding on.

Name: Seaside Bloom
Description: Lirain lived alone by the sea, as her father wandered the lands. The townsfolk, warm and kind, became her family.

Name: Gentle Refuge
Description: The storm passed, leaving the town unscathed, its guardian gone. The old oak vanished, and with it, Lirain.

Name: Stormproof Joy
Description: Father brought home two sun charms, their cotton smiles warmed by light. 'With these, you'll never fear the rain.'

Name: Harbor Reunion
Description: A ship docked at last—Lirain ran to the pier, where her father stood, weary yet smiling, the sun on his back.

Name: Secret Medkit
Description: Nurse Bubblin is unique, overlooking discarded pills and pretending not to see Elva sneaking by during night shifts.

Name: Quiet Reverie
Description: The next day, her friend was gone. Bubblin's sigh held regret: 'Elva's surgery came sooner than expected.'

Name: Timeless Escape
Description: Elva left behind notes like maps—true to her explorer's heart. Heeding them, Moony stood before the iron door.

Name: Whispered Dreams
Description: Cold lights flickered beyond the door. Elva smiled from the operation table, pure and serene, untouched by memory.

Name: Scarless Fate
Description: That empty smile haunted Moony. Elva had become a blank slate, wiped clean of everything they once shared.

Name: Fading Ink
Description: You won't be punished tonight. Go back.' The words were kind, but Moony only shook her head.

Name: Bright Spark
Description: Someone grabbed Moony's hand mid-sprint. Bubblin's eyes shone with worry as sweat dripped down her face.

Name: Cure's Secret
Description: Moony hid Elva's notes. Now, she had to escape too, before the surgery. There was no one left to trust but herself.

Name: Blank Experiment
Description: Bubblin hesitated, then smiled. A final touch on Moony's cheek, a quick swipe of a keycard—the door clicked open.

Name: Love's Prescription
Description: Night fell as Moony slipped through corridors. The hospital exit was within reach, but she was spotted.

Name: Chaotic Pulse
Description: The children loved Bubblin who listened. She soothed their worries, weaving their wildest dreams into stories.

Name: Velvet Choice
Description: One night, Elva burst in, breathless—'Run! This place isn't...' But hands grabbed her, cutting the warning short.

Name: 咖啡巧遇
Description: 原来独特的风味源于一场偶然的巧合：店主在制作咖啡时不小心重复放入了某种原料，竟引发了预料之外的反应。

Name: 特调创意
Description: 店主担心她会因为这场意外而不悦，芙拉雅却露出了由衷的笑容，还对咖啡独特的风味表示了赞赏。

Name: 潮流心得
Description: 芙拉雅向店主分享了自己的心得：有时候一成不变反倒会让美味褪色，不断地创新或许更能留住顾客的味蕾。

Name: 限定咖啡
Description: 每一款特调咖啡都有鲜明的风味与个性，芙拉雅向店主许诺，她会帮忙宣传这款新品咖啡。

Name: Clamorous Blaze
Description: Her plumed crown ignites the night, sending the fire of freedom through the rejoicing city amidst all the noises.

Name: Stellar Iridescence
Description: The city celebrates the night with the heat of the sun. The stars shimmer in the sky with a golden, splendid luster.

Name: Crescent Dazzle
Description: Through a thin layer of clouds, the moon casts its light upon the girl, shimmering in the shape of a star orbit.

Name: Feathery Phantom
Description: As the tail feather brushes the masks, the night devours the shadow of her dance, turning the dark into a carnival.

Name: Aurora Blossom
Description: The flowers and leaves sway in the breeze at dawn, as if whispering the hopes and expectations of spring.

Name: Youthful Secret
Description: A pair of earrings shaped like tiny locks recalls a chest of youthful diaries, a must-have for vintage style lovers.

Name: Ample Harvest
Description: The wind writes verses in dewdrops as summer opens the earth's journals in the sweet fragrance of fruits.

Name: Idyllic Saunter
Description: Since the first seed sprouted, Caroro has been imagining a fruitful harvest and rejoicing over every small change.

Name: Fruitful Verdure
Description: Caroro carefully tends every seedling as green spreads across the field and fills its heart with happiness.

Name: Fresh Berry Aroma
Description: Plump strawberries dot the verdant leaves like rubies, dancing in the wind like lost notes in an old nursery rhyme.

Name: Captivating Sweetness
Description: She bites into a fresh strawberry. Sweetness fills her taste buds and melts her heart like a confession of love.

Name: 翻飞蹴鞠
Description: 比赛的日子越来越近，裴云除了料理布庄，日日寻得空闲就练习蹴鞠，她在后院草地上跑跳，蹴鞠于她膝间翻飞。

Name: 有喵来嬉
Description: 赛场上，裴云的身姿灵动轻捷，但其他蹴鞠高手的表现同样精彩……咦？怎么还混进来了一只小猫咪？

Name: 花绽芳茵
Description: 蹴鞠表演比赛的告示一经发出，华锦布庄就收到了许多报名信，城中百姓也对这场别开生面的表演比赛充满期待。

Name: 橘黄翠华
Description: 裴云迫不及待将自己的想法告诉姐姐，裴雨笑着夸赞她的奇思妙想，并揽下挑选与裁剪布料作为彩绸选票的工作。

Name: 茜绡翩舞
Description: 在比赛上，每位观众都可以得到一块小小的彩绸，作为选票投给心仪的选手，借此直接接触到布庄的布料。

Name: 碧波疏影
Description: “我想出了这么好的法子，阿姐可有奖励给我？”裴雨敲了敲妹妹的额头，只让她好好准备，到时候自有惊喜。

Name: 玲珑佩帏
Description: 比赛的日子到了，临上场前，裴雨塞给妹妹一套崭新的衣服，轻便灵动，红绸飘扬，是她为妹妹设计的惊喜。

Name: Dewy Fragrance
Description: Alina believed Grandma's story and scattered petals in the lake. The ripples seemed like the fairy's whisper.

Name: Flowery Shades
Description: At 16, Alina left to study in City Oren. In dreams, she'd see the flowers and ripples that she missed dearly.

Name: Redolent Glow
Description: A glowing blue bloom turned into shimmering sparks the moment she touched the water, weaving an ethereal dream.

Name: Amidst Blooms
Description: She returned years later to the same blooms and lake. Only Grandma's voice was nowhere to be heard.

Name: Reverie of Wings
Description: In the bleak palace, the girl covered in dirt and scars moved closer, her eyes set on the broken sword by the throne.

Name: Timeless Pledge
Description: The young Inara loved the garden of astral roses, where her mother would gently tell her stories of the stars.

Name: Arbitrary Throne
Description: The kingdom turned into ruins with people imprisoned in fear, but none caved in and betrayed the princess.

Name: Crown of Sword
Description: The demon had eyes in the shadows, searching for the royals. She dodged them, her hand gripping the dim thorny sword.

Name: Soundless Grace
Description: The sword beamed as it pierced the palm, turning the demon's eyes into dust. 'I hereby summon the morning star!'

Name: Swirl of Blooms
Description: The thorny sword with astral roses glowed in her hand, while butterflies flitted about in starry twinkles.

Name: Midnight Starbeam
Description: Illuminating the dusty ruins, thorny vines sprouted from Inara's wounds, merging with the thorns on the sword.

Name: Twinkling Murmur
Description: I'm willing... to sacrifice all for my people. Inara whispered, a heart pounding with endless passion and power.

Name: Trial of Thorns
Description: To summon the morning star, you must pay the price. Are you willing to forever suffer such pain?' a voice asked.

Name: 青空展翅
Description: 大自然中这场相遇本就在她意料之外。望着在洞外自由飞翔的恐龙，她知道，离别的时刻已经到来。

Name: 远古生灵
Description: 那是艾格第一次见到小恐龙。传闻中早已灭绝的族群竟还有幸存者，荒无人烟的雨林成了它们最后的庇护所。

Name: 不羁翱翔
Description: 小恐龙带艾格回到了族群栖居的洞穴，然而大恐龙对外来者十分戒备，低吼着让她离开。小恐龙难过地垂下脑袋。

Name: 繁茂林海
Description: 醒来时，艾格发现身边坐着一只奇怪的小动物，它叼来了叶片和浆果，睁着一双琥珀般的眼睛好奇地打量着她。

Name: 无字誓约
Description: 小恐龙与艾格依依不舍地道别，艾格目送它回到丛林的深处，匿去了踪影。“该回家了。”她轻声说。

Name: 奇光幽境
Description: 然而几天之后，艾格在探索山崖时却发现了从高处跌落的小恐龙，它稚嫩的鳞甲被划开，奄奄一息躺在地上。

Name: 森林守护
Description: 从那之后，少女在雨林中探险时，身边多了一只圆眼睛的小恐龙。她们成了真正的伙伴，一同守护古老的秘密。

Name: 勇者之证
Description: 第二天她将痊愈的小恐龙送回洞穴。这一次大恐龙没有驱逐她，它送给了她一颗明亮的宝石。

Name: 原始歌谣
Description: 艾格为小恐龙处理了伤口。夜晚时分，天际升起明月，小恐龙趴在她手边，轻轻蹭了蹭她的手腕。

Name: 自然共鸣
Description: 电影结束时，碧蓝天穹中有恐龙展开双翼，自由的身影划过天幕。那一幕是如此真实而动人，让人久久不能忘怀。

Name: Cuddle Mate
Description: A cat-paw mic glowed. Her voice filled the stream. Cheers flickered onscreen—her fans' love never faded.

Name: Particle Burst
Description: More than a livestream—it's a harbor of warmth. Fleeting joy, yet heartwarming moments linger forever.

Name: Virtual Cube
Description: Golden pixels build a dazzling virtual world. Every 'Little Fish' brings joy to the fans who stand by them.

Name: Prism Flash
Description: Orange, blue, purple lights dance to the beat. Comments leap like musical notes—audiences' heartfelt cheers.

Name: Glitz Wish
Description: Day two brings a famed singer—voice like crystal springs. Requests flood in as tender melodies carry the night.

Name: Meow Pulse
Description: Games she loved feel fresh in Little Fish's hands. Late at night, she shares the thrill and joy with the stream.

Name: Chroma Patch
Description: She savors 'Little Fish's' voice—sometimes bright, sometimes soft—smiling at each warm fan interaction.

Name: Sugar Oath
Description: A new stream begins. She waits as tonight's shy “Little Fish” prepares to solve a cube on screen.

Name: GameCharm
Description: In the “Little Fish” stream, even classes come alive. Professors join in, learning turns fun and engaging.

Name: Meowtel Receiver
Description: As she conquers the final challenge, cheers flood the screen—a shared dream chased, a breath released.

Name: Glitch Quest
Description: 4x4, 5x5, one-handed, blindfolded—each harder than the last. Tension builds as viewers cheer her on with hope.

Name: Code Pop
Description: Once a star dancer, now standing after surgery—can she reclaim the rhythm of her soul?

Name: Neon Mirage
Description: Little Fish's' stream—now a kaleidoscope of warmth. Watching others bloom, her own spark quietly reignites.

Name: Meow Charge
Description: Each stream inspires fans. Magicians debut new tricks, and photographers share tips—all through “Little Fish.”

Name: Starlight Index
Description: For races abroad,' she whispers—click, click, click—a cube conquered between hope and fear.

Name: Byte Bloom
Description: She signs up as the next “Little Fish” and, while waiting to stream, repeats the dance she once knew by heart.

Name: 沉默年华
Description: 有时她幻想自己是一个战士，画笔就是她的武器；有时她又觉得自己是个游吟诗人，不断向世界描绘自己的内心。

Name: 不灭星芒
Description: 过往的作品像无数耀眼的宝石，毋庸置疑，她一定会成为最优秀的设计师。所有人都如此相信着，包括琳萨自己。

Name: 引领风潮
Description: 离开学院之后，琳萨加入了向往已久的工作室，她怀揣着许多奇思妙想，摩拳擦掌要把每一个点子都变成现实。

Name: 决策时分
Description: 直到许多年后琳萨都无法忘记那时的心情，她像一个年轻而无畏的舵手，在苍茫夜海中起航，唯有理想熠熠生辉。

Name: 沉默年华·真
Description: 缪尔告诉琳萨，女爵选择她是因为喜欢她的风格。女爵欣赏的，是独属于琳萨的，某一部分闪闪发光的灵魂。

Name: 不灭星芒·真
Description: 琳萨心中的迷雾消散，那一刻她无比清楚，她可以继续做一个战士、舵手、游吟诗人，因为这是独属于她的理想。

Name: 引领风潮·真
Description: 琳萨很快完成了新的设计稿交给女爵，这一次她融合了自己一贯的风格。晚宴上，前卫而优雅的设计惊艳了全场。

Name: 决策时分·真
Description: 翌日，工作室的大家送给琳萨一束鲜花，鲜花在明媚的阳光下格外美丽。而琳萨悄悄抽出一枝放在了缪尔桌上。

Name: 沉默年华·藤
Description: 她心中的幻想宫殿也随着日复一日的成长而不断变换着，见到了更大世界的风雨，琳萨开始思考自己最想要什么。

Name: 不灭星芒·藤
Description: 恰好这时，琳萨接到了一份特殊的设计委托。一位女爵十分欣赏琳萨的风格，希望她能为自己设计一款礼服。

Name: 引领风潮·藤
Description: 这份委托让琳萨兴奋又紧张，她向工作室的前辈缪尔讨教了不少礼服的设计经验，又仔细研究了女爵往年的风格。

Name: 决策时分·藤
Description: 一连几个晚上，琳萨都泡在工作室。她仿佛又回到了学生时代，活力满满地追逐飘忽不定、转瞬即逝的灵感。

Name: 沉默年华·檀
Description: 沮丧的琳萨将设计稿折成纸飞机，扔向垃圾桶。缪尔恰好看到这一幕，有些好笑地捡起纸飞机，一点点将它展平。

Name: 不灭星芒·檀
Description: 琳萨有些紧张地坐直了身体，一瞬间她又变成了那个等待导师评价的学生，心里惴惴不安又有一点小小的期待。

Name: 引领风潮·檀
Description: 缪尔没有对设计稿做出任何评价，出乎琳萨的意料，缪尔拉着她一起去吃晚餐——琳萨这才发觉自己的确饿了。

Name: 决策时分·檀
Description: 热汤和甜点宽慰了琳萨的内心，她暂时从繁重的日常中逃脱出来，像是航船停靠在风平浪静的港湾，夜色宁静。

Name: 璀璨之歌
Description: 王廷的金碧辉煌绵延亘古，但这里的爱与忠诚却转瞬即逝，随着华贵冠冕走向永恒的，似乎只有权力。

Name: 盈彩辉映
Description: 乔琳在史官严厉的目光中垂下了头，但从那一刻起，却有一个小小的愿望在她心中生根发芽。或许不该是这样……

Name: 照夜心语
Description: 乔琳想要改变这一切，她不愿重蹈覆辙。很快，乔琳就有了第一个机会：王储要为自己选择骑士。

Name: 璀璨之歌·华丽
Description: 第三位骑士跪在乔琳面前，向她宣誓自己的忠心，但那些虚浮的花言巧语简直不堪一击，轻而易举就被戳破。

Name: 盈彩辉映·华丽
Description: 或许她不该妄想找到一个真正的骑士。乔琳想，那不如就让那个花了整整半天吹嘘龙鳞的人来当自己的骑士好了。

Name: 照夜心语·华丽
Description: 就在乔琳陷入沮丧之时，一个清瘦的身影走进大厅——那是个其貌不扬的女孩，身上的甲胄看起来也比别人更旧。

Name: 璀璨之歌·珍稀
Description: 乔琳被这个出格的骑士吸引了。她问伊芙，骑士的精神是什么？她听过许多答案，这一次她想知道伊芙的回答。

Name: 盈彩辉映·珍稀
Description: 伊芙思考了很久，勇敢、正直、忠诚，这些都无比重要，缺少其中任何一个的人都无法被称为骑士。但还有一点。

Name: 照夜心语·珍稀
Description: 伊芙说，要做一个骑士，就能要永不背叛自己的心；她的灵魂应当有一部分坚如磐石，绝不被这个世界改变。

Name: 璀璨之歌·绯红
Description: 人们总认为乔琳不够强大，他们总觉得年轻的女子是容易被蒙蔽的。乔琳从未因此动怒，只是一笑而过。

Name: 盈彩辉映·绯红
Description: 时过境迁，乔琳即将迎来属于自己的加冕仪式。这时伊芙却传来消息，乔琳的一位叔父收买了许多贵族。

Name: 照夜心语·绯红
Description: 象征着权力的冠冕是如此迷人，而这座古老的王廷永远金碧辉煌。在这里，人心随着时间而变得深不可测。

Name: 璀璨之歌·夜海
Description: 伊芙跑上台阶，她从远方的小镇给乔琳带了一只粗糙又可爱的玩偶，比起华美闪亮的龙鳞，乔琳显然更喜欢这个。

Name: 盈彩辉映·夜海
Description: 太阳升起之时，加冕仪式正式开始。代表着权力的冠冕在阳光之下焕发光彩，而乔琳悄悄看了一眼王座后的玩偶。

Name: 照夜心语·夜海
Description: 或许史官说的没错，王廷永远会有争夺，但是乔琳知道，她不会孤身一人，伊芙将会与她并肩而立，永远不变。

Name: 静谧午后
Description: 某个偶然的清晨，一朵野生的玫瑰挂住了她的衣摆，露水打湿的玫瑰花瓣微微卷曲，每一片都有自由的弧度。

Name: 指尖芳影
Description: 空白的画本渐渐被不同姿态的玫瑰填满：或风中摇曳，或攀上花篱，或走向枯萎……每一朵都生动而浪漫。

Name: 浪漫诗行
Description: 父亲在院子里用竹篱圈出一个小小的花圃，蓓儿种下了第一株玫瑰花，等待记录下花朵绽放的秘密。

Name: 静谧午后·炽
Description: 浸入染缸轻轻搅动，花布上的玫瑰在时间的酝酿下渐渐染上独特的色彩与纹理，仿佛一场热烈而浪漫的魔法。

Name: 指尖芳影·炽
Description: 晾晒的花布于风中翩飞如蝶，斑驳的光影里，蓓儿忽然读懂了玫瑰花瓣蜷曲的弧度——那是阳光拥抱过的形状。

Name: 浪漫诗行·炽
Description: 草木是天然的染色剂，蓓儿剪下花圃中初绽的玫瑰，细细捣碎加水煮沸，染缸中的那抹红也染上草木的温度。

Name: 静谧午后·绮
Description: 玫瑰在她的笔下绽放，仿佛又回到童年的时光，一道道浪漫的线条，将蓓儿与小时候趴在缝纫机旁的自己相连。

Name: 指尖芳影·绮
Description: 蓓儿对玫瑰的喜爱一直没有改变，从儿时延伸到她后来的很多设计，它们仿佛都生根于童年那个小小的花圃。

Name: 浪漫诗行·绮
