Description: 当妈妈提起给暗淡的布料重新染一次色时，蓓儿却摇了摇头，玫瑰即便凋零，留下的回忆依旧美好。

Name: Best Cheer Squad
Description: One photo captured Nikki's adorable smile, another had great composition. Choosing was difficult for Momo!

Name: Best Friend Forever
Description: I always introduce myself solemnly, 'I'm Momo, Nikki's best friend, and I'll accompany her anywhere.'

Name: Future Daydreams
Description: Nikki and I talked again about the legendary kingdom of grilled fish. I believe we'll find it one day!

Name: Leisurely Moments
Description: I was close to reading the words at the top... Wow, I'm as tall as the sign! Nikki always knows what I need.

Name: Vivid Chic
Description: Every bow was specially designed and adjusted repeatedly. Of course, I provided careful guidance!

Name: Meowgical Clip
Description: Nikki thinks the hairclip is as cute as me... Denied! Its cuteness is a hundred grilled fish behind mine!

Name: Sweet and Cool Vibe
Description: At the last second, Nikki put on this special necklace. I certify it completes today's outfit.

Name: Colorful Memories
Description: Journeys have surprises, but with Nikki's experience and my cleverness, we can handle anything.

Name: 流光金羽
Description: 闲暇时三人聊天，莉亚回想自己从小就对闪闪发亮的宝石情有独钟，薇萝也赞同那美妙的光晕总能吸引自己驻足。

Name: 金叶熠熠
Description: “要成为最特别的设计师，为喜欢珠宝的大家带来直击心灵的作品！”蓓可的话让另外两人也露出了肯定的笑容。

Name: 鎏金之誓
Description: 时光飞逝，转眼间到了毕业的季节，三人都做出了满意的毕业设计，共同约定以后要成为理想中的自己。

Name: 流光金羽·幽
Description: 作品以寓意幸运与抚平紧张的橄榄石为主要材料，莉亚希望这抹翠光能陪伴年轻人从学校初入社会的迷茫时期。

Name: 金叶熠熠·幽
Description: 辅以智慧的猫头鹰形象装饰，作品整体轻盈又不失稳重，寄托着莉亚的祝愿——我们会运用自己的智慧克服难题。

Name: 鎏金之誓·幽
Description: 这个主题会被认可吗？这份策划案会被通过吗？在看见导师脸上赞许的笑意时，莉亚得到了自己期盼已久的答案。

Name: 流光金羽·茜
Description: 在小小的新品发布会上，薇萝推出的作品“怒放”吸引了大众的目光，颇具张力的繁复设计令人着迷。

Name: 金叶熠熠·茜
Description: “色彩万千，丰富多变，不变的是其中蕴含的生命力，无论何时，我们都能以自己想要的状态自在盛放。”

Name: 鎏金之誓·茜
Description: “怒放”系列一举成功，但薇萝并不满足于现有的成就，她悄悄告诉莉亚，自己已经在着手设计新的珠宝系列了。

Name: 流光金羽·愿
Description: 综合考虑了母女的偏好后，蓓可为这个女孩设计了一条精致的紫水晶项链，希望能为她离家后的生活带去幸运。

Name: 金叶熠熠·愿
Description: 来找蓓可定制珠宝的顾客越来越多，大家都赞许蓓可的设计既富有美感，也蕴含着充沛的情感。

Name: 鎏金之誓·愿
Description: 回顾自己的经历，蓓可觉得她做出了正确的选择，自己的作品既能为大家带来满足与欢乐，也能让自己感到幸福。

Name: Celestial Melody
Description: After that, Lainie often slipped into the sanctuary unseen. Her life was hunger and cold, no hymns or sacred songs.

Name: Vow in Bloom
Description: Outside the halls, nobles squandered while slum children survived by stealing. Lainie spoke of it without sorrow.

Name: Crown of Seasons
Description: The sanctuary wept in prayer, yet never reached out. For the first time, Isua doubted its flawless light.

Name: Tear of Ephemera
Description: With Lainie's help, Isua secretly gave food to poor children. She even asked to fund shelters with sanctuary gold.

Name: Earnest Blessing
Description: The sacred halls watched their heir in silence. Soon, Isua's freedom was gone, and contact with Lainie was forbidden.

Name: Radiant Crown
Description: The sanctuary grew into a burden on the land. Wealth poured in. King and beggar alike bowed beneath its shadow.

Name: Sacred Benediction
Description: Years later, she was crowned anew. She knew pain still lived in the world—but vowed to protect those close to her.

Name: Elegy for the Lost
Description: She left there at last. What she saw was fire and ash—her homeland now torn by the enemy's war—so she acted.

Name: Arcane Pact
Description: Meluthiel's power drove the invaders back. In the cheering crowd, she saw Vanessa again—now a brilliant commander.

Name: Veil of Dusky Mist
Description: How long had it been? When young Vanessa arrived, time rushed in—and the blooming garden withered.

Name: Lustrous Stream
Description: Furious, Meluthiel confronted her. Vanessa must restore every flower before she'd be allowed to leave.

Name: Heartlight for the Lost
Description: So much time had passed. Meluthiel hadn’t even apologized. What had happened since she came here?

Name: Forsaken Lament
Description: The girl kept her promise and sailed away. The flowers bloomed, but Meluthiel felt no joy this time.

Name: Shackles of the Shade
Description: Go… just go. Meluthiel thought. Go see the world as it is now—see what still remains, or has been lost.

Name: 踞啸山河
Description: 这个世界正在处于剧烈变化的时期，虽没有获得任何明确的指示，但越千霜亦能隐隐感到那种不安。

Name: 五兵不鸣
Description: 或许在很多年前以前，也曾有士兵站在这里，想念遥远的故乡吧。思及此处，越千霜觉得胸口一阵热意翻涌。

Name: 羽檄飞驰
Description: 这次的军演也正是为了防止未来可能会出现的危机……护国佑民是越家一直以来的责任，也是越千霜的坚守。

Name: 对酒当歌
Description: 今朝痛饮千杯，烈酒入喉，饮下塞外万里风；他日再贺捷音，露布天下，威震寰宇六合同。

Name: 击鼓其镗
Description: 但在这个古老的国度，幸或者不幸，那古老又神秘的誓约仍然存在，于是这里保持着往日的规则。

Name: 瀚海栖云
Description: 这样的和平还能持续多久？每每有此疑问，越千霜都会一阵心悸，不过她从未有过丝毫退缩之意。

Name: 霜天雁行
Description: 她仍记得幼时的自己曾许下的誓言，她会披坚执锐，守护云端、守护生活于此的人们……一刻也不曾忘怀。

Name: 关山千重
Description: 曾经笼罩于这片大陆的诅咒，又或者保护，已经被打破，驳杂又庞大的力量早已充盈天地之间。

Name: 我武惟扬
Description: 她明白，越是时局动荡，她越不能有半分迟疑。她手中所握，既是冲锋的霜矛，亦是止戈的利刃。

Name: 羽檄交驰
Description: 微弱的晨曦撕开了厚重的天幕，朝阳正在升起。不过须臾，朝霞如绮，薄云尽染……新的一日，到来了。

Name: 筑梦巴士
Description: 飞驶而来的巴士打开崭新的车门，粉发少女跃入车厢的下一秒，就被密友热切的拥抱和熟悉的欢笑声包围。

Name: 伴星邀约
Description: 少女在友人的惊呼中抬起头，绚丽的流星行迹恰好落入她的眼底——那么及时许下的心愿，也一定会实现吧？

Name: 璀璨心花
Description: 旅途中的点滴都化作润雨与甘露，滋养了少女的灵感之花，每片花瓣都尽情舒展，枝叶间流动着自由的轻风。

Name: 浪漫遐想
Description: 你一言我一语，拼凑出友人初遇时青涩又不失直率的可爱模样，大家屏息对视一瞬，而后笑着闹成一团。

Name: 馨香萦怀
Description: 盛绽的花朵将怡人的香气悄悄染上少女的裙摆，旅程中时常藏着这样的小惊喜，令她心生柔软的喜悦。

Name: 璇霄颉颃
Description: 年少时心无挂累，连脚步都是轻快的。同分一壶酒，每个人杯中都似浮着一盏月亮，以为一生都会有这般好光阴。

Name: 珠辉玉映
Description: 有时三五好友辩论，青岚只愿这一生安稳快乐，而她最好的朋友锦书却觉得，人活一世定要功成名就，立于云巅。

Name: 寂月疏风
Description: 世上有这样一个人，与她如此相像却又如此不同。这或许是世间最隐秘、最深刻的一种缘法，共沐此世明月高悬。

Name: 孤云栖野
Description: 修行途中，小小的争论无伤大雅，她们仍将对方视作知己，在无忧无虑的少年时光中如同一对双生子，彼此相照。

Name: 璇霄颉颃·华丽
Description: 锦书对青岚每日的行踪再了解不过，她提前布局，伪造证据，最终成功取走云鹤令，嫁祸青岚。

Name: 珠辉玉映·华丽
Description: 青岚似乎有很多话想问，但锦书已经不愿回答了。她一直都知道，自己想要的是功成名就、万人之上的一生。

Name: 寂月疏风·华丽
Description: 青岚身受重伤，坠入深谷。她耳畔风声呼啸而过，恍若时光飞驰倒流，而她们永远停在年少时最亲密无间那一刻。

Name: 孤云栖野·华丽
Description: 那些夜观星河、笑谈天下的年岁，终成水月镜花。锦书挥出一剑，剑光似水，像极了当年酒盏里一触就碎的月光。

Name: 璇霄颉颃·珍稀
Description: 云隐并未多问，也猜到青岚当日为何身受重伤，世上恩仇爱恨总归是差不多的戏码，只是人人都以为自己不一样。

Name: 珠辉玉映·珍稀
Description: 伤口痊愈之后，青岚却并未离开，她已经找不到修行的意义了。云隐便挥袖拂开云雾，层叠的远山显露真容。

Name: 寂月疏风·珍稀
Description: 那句话像敲开了冰冷的土石，沉眠地下的种子在一声春雷中惊醒，抽芽生长。从此，青岚开始随云隐修行。

Name: 孤云栖野·珍稀
Description: 云隐的声音淡淡的：这里没有权势纷争，没有尔虞我诈，万物照样生长轮回，它们各行其路，从不为外物所动。

Name: 璇霄颉颃·紫烟
Description: 锦书败于青岚剑下，却恍惚间忆起那年山外的溶溶月色，与青岚望向自己的眼神。原来她们有过那样好的时光。

Name: 珠辉玉映·紫烟
Description: 青岚没有杀她，锦书却迎上了剑尖，她面庞上泪水划过，轻声道：“若有来生……”声音飘散在风里，无人应答。

Name: 寂月疏风·紫烟
Description: 风霜尽，她在林中煮茶，杯中月影婆娑，只是身边再无少年知己，唯有白鹤作伴。明月高悬，照见她心如寒山。

Name: 孤云栖野·紫烟
Description: 青岚带着云鹤令回到了云隐身边，她将那块令牌永远封印在山谷中。所谓至高权柄，无上修为，都会被时间遗忘。

Name: 璇霄颉颃·寒潭
Description: 青岚修行大成时，云隐托付给她一件事。他请求青岚为自己夺取云鹤令。青岚浑身发冷，难以相信自己的耳朵。

Name: 珠辉玉映·寒潭
Description: 权势如毒果，竟无人能过此关。昔年知己为了云鹤令将她推下山崖，而悉心教导她的云隐，要的原来也是云鹤令。

Name: 寂月疏风·寒潭
Description: 云隐沉默许久。直到日暮向晚，他望着云间层峦，缓缓开口，给青岚讲了一个熟悉又陌生的故事。

Name: 孤云栖野·寒潭
Description: 白鹤不知道这两人之间发生了什么，傻傻地追着青岚要米吃。青岚摸了摸鹤的脑袋，决心要找云隐问个清楚。

Name: 圈圈涟漪
Description: 尤曼将信将疑，但还是把面端给父亲。父亲捧住汤碗，不言不语地尝过，泪水蓦然坠落，在红油里晕开一圈漩涡。

Name: 独家秘方
Description: 直到有一日，一位女子手捧汤面登门来访。她说，听闻尤曼在四处寻找父亲爱吃的面，也许这一碗他会喜欢。

Name: 悠享时刻
Description: 尤曼向女子讨教做法，女子说，这面名为解忧。因汤头辛辣，强忍不舍与忧愁的人，便能借此寻得流泪的契机。

Name: 解忧汤面
Description: 父亲去过的面馆早已停业，女子听闻尤曼想开一家面馆时十分赞许，只语气中流露出几分对过往的感慨。

Name: 鸳鸯汤底
Description: 也许在尤曼亲手熬煮的汤面中，父亲放下了满心牵挂。尤曼拿起汤勺，还未品出滋味，发现自己早已泪流满颊。

Name: 圈圈涟漪·姜黄
Description: 男人再度来到面馆，说这是最后一次点咖喱面。妻子若见他这副模样，想必也会失望。他已决心振作，搬离这里。

Name: 独家秘方·姜黄
Description: 左邻右舍的叹息，渐渐飘入尤曼耳中。他们曾是前程似锦，琴瑟和鸣的眷侣，妻子因意外离世，男人便消沉至今。

Name: 悠享时刻·姜黄
Description: 这日他衣衫笔挺，没有任何酒味。他来感谢尤曼，那碗似曾相识的咖喱，鼓励他重建秩序，找到继续生活的勇气。

Name: 解忧汤面·姜黄
Description: 也许所谓解忧，不过是找个地方安放思念。就像这碗永远热气腾腾的面，她为无数人熬煮，自己却不曾再尝一口。

Name: 鸳鸯汤底·姜黄
Description: 暮色渐浓时，又有新的客人推开木门。风铃轻响，百味交织的雾气漫过门槛，将人间悲欢熬煮成永不冷却的温柔。

Name: 圈圈涟漪·柠香
Description: 女孩一心要去远方闯荡，从而证明自己。她怀揣梦想出门远行，在城市街头支起画摊，靠为往来行人速写谋生。

Name: 独家秘方·柠香
Description: 妈妈说，人生就像一碗面，有苦有酸，甜蜜与辛辣都在其中。从淡淡酸涩与清苦里品出滋味，才更过得好这一生。

Name: 悠享时刻·柠香
Description: 那时母亲眼里的失落与挽留，女孩早已察觉，却任性地不曾放在心里。母亲并未说什么，只为她做一碗汤面送行。

Name: 解忧汤面·柠香
Description: 她笑着与尤曼挥手，决心回到家乡。她已明白什么才更重要，心中不再有遗憾。也许学会舍弃，才能更好地获得。

Name: 鸳鸯汤底·柠香
Description: 解忧面馆的柠檬尝不出苦味，女孩思念母亲并不完美的面。酸涩鲜香的气息，早已成为记忆深处不可分割的眷念。

Name: 晴风花音
Description: 一曲终了，灵鸟与少年都十分动容，他的琴声与她的歌声相合无间，高山流水遇知音，是世间难得的好事。

Name: 命途交织
Description: 少年在仙山脚下的小草屋住了下来。从此琴音与歌声常常交织于仙山之间，歌声不息，则琴声不绝。

Name: 此生相伴
Description: 雪色染上少年发鬓，枯瘦的手无法如昔时那般抚动琴弦，他黯然自责，灵鸟笑着摇头，依偎在他身畔轻唱旧日歌。

Name: 来世知音
Description: 世世知音，莫失莫忘……他喃喃着昔日约定，手渐渐变得冰冷，灵鸟没有放开。她拭去眼角泪水，暗暗下了决心。

Name: 晴风花音·华
Description: 休整时二人坐于营帐篝火旁，琴师说自己儿时便擅长音律，坊间四邻皆笑言他前世必得了仙人亲授，公主莞尔。

Name: 命途交织·华
Description: 琴音在夜中响起，为疲惫的军士们送去慰藉，公主随着音律轻轻哼唱，二人相约待战火平息，尽兴交流乐中真意。

Name: 此生相伴·华
Description: 一时巧计难以扭转实力悬殊的战局，王城终被攻陷，被放飞的鸟群久久盘旋在寂静一片的焦黑城池上不愿离去。

Name: 来世知音·华
Description: 伤重的公主目送鸟儿离去，露出释然的笑意，用最后的气力轻轻抚过已经崩断的琴弦，将它紧紧攥在手心之中。

Name: 晴风花音·弈
Description: 黑白棋子纵横交错，两个灵魂亦在命运的经纬中彼此追寻，每一步试探皆有回应，棋盘上早已不止输赢。

Name: 命途交织·弈
Description: 随着棋局深入，沉睡的记忆如春水融冰般苏醒，在对方震惊又释然的目光中，她确信他也忆起了一切。

Name: 此生相伴·弈
Description: 比赛以和局收尾，两人并肩走出赛场。这一世不再仙凡有别，也没有战火阻隔，安稳是命运给予他们最好的礼物。

Name: 来世知音·弈
Description: 两个身影说笑着渐行渐远，树枝上的鸟儿齐声鸣唱。执着的灵魂无论经历多少淬炼，依旧会铭记横跨百年的约定。

Name: Frost Lotus
Description: In fall, Lynn gifted crème brûlée; in spring, Linsy returned a frost lotus. White graced Lynn's garden.

Name: Newborn Star
Description: The two grew close, always seen together. As the design contest neared, Lynn's sketches shone like a rising star.

Name: Faded Echoes
Description: In the ruins, only one frost lotus remained. Linsy designed a white gown with a full-bloom frost lotus at its heart.

Name: Bloom in Ruins
Description: A jealous rival set the fire—designs were burned, and Lynn lost her sight for the colors she once mastered.

Name: Tender Hope
Description: Onstage, she exposed the culprit and shared her vision: Flowers will still bloom even in a world washed of color.

Name: Blessing Sparks
Description: Fireworks spark different emotions with each magic potion. This one... 'Bang!' It takes away sadness and brings joy.

Name: Secret Silver Dust
Description: Flora is a witch born with a gift for fire magic. For her, creating magical fireworks is a delight.

Name: Nocturne Spectacle
Description: A girl walks into Flora's shop. She comes to town for the fireworks but doesn't expect to live to see the next show.

Name: Tales of Magic
Description: Instead of the magic ingredients and herbs, the witch only wants Flora's magical fire broom to soar into the sky.

Name: Radiant Bloom
Description: The girl loves fireworks like Flora loves the magic. She wants to fulfill the girl's dream and help her regain her health.

Name: Astral Guard
Description: Flora promises to hold a grand firework show for the girl and secretly decides to cure her before the show.

Name: Dream Spiral
Description: She opens an old grimoire and stirs the brew of marigold and unicorn tears three times anticlockwise, but it explodes.

Name: Iridescent Starlight
Description: After her last crucible explodes, Flora props the grimoire back under the desk and flips open her witch contacts.

Name: Magic Effulgence
Description: Like a rosy nebula or a river of stardust, the fireworks glow brilliantly as if the gods parted the night's veil.

Name: 繁花栖露
Description: 曾经虚无的想象如今已变为清晰勾勒出的花朵的轮廓，可蓓儿总觉得自己的设计还不够完美。

Name: 柔情回忆
Description: 玫瑰花画了一张又一张，当她苦恼地求助时，妈妈却温柔地告诉她：“或许你可以先让想象在现实中绽放。”

Name: 花篱初染
Description: 蓓儿从阁楼里翻出了落满灰尘的老旧织布机，木梭在纺线间穿梭，她想象中的玫瑰花纹一点点在织物上重现。

Name: 繁花栖露·炽
Description: 当最后一抹晚霞轻吻绽放的玫瑰，晒好的花布晕染出一种极尽温柔的颜色，空气里仿佛浮动着若有若无的花香。

Name: 柔情回忆·炽
Description: 妈妈惊叹于玫瑰花布的美好——还不能说是完美，却能感受到玫瑰的温柔与生机，她决定用它为蓓儿做一条裙子。

Name: 花篱初染·炽
Description: 仲夏月光笼罩的小屋，妈妈踩着缝纫机轧出波浪般的弧线，玫瑰仿佛在水波中浮动，而蓓儿枕着想象沉入了梦乡。

Name: 繁花栖露·绮
Description: 世界上有没有完美的设计呢？蓓儿想应当是没有的，它们只是同样在传递美、舒适或温暖，如玫瑰之于夏日。

Name: 柔情回忆·绮
Description: 画本上完成的设计并不复杂，现在蓓儿已不再执着于追寻美的极致，花的凋零与盛放都具有同样的美。

Name: 花篱初染·绮
Description: 老式缝纫机车过的痕迹就像时光的留痕，蓓儿忽然懂得：绽放或许会走向凋零，而美却会在记忆中永恒。

Name: Mystic Pact
Description: When the last rose finally bloomed, Vanessa asked Meluthiel to keep her promise—but another test awaited.

Name: Lanternlit Path
Description: A boat made of aged cedar, sealed with amber oil, bore a lantern to light her way beyond the mists.

Name: Vessel of Fate
Description: Vanessa, many paths lead to the garden, but only a boat built by your hands can carry you beyond the mist.'

Name: Farewell in Bloom
Description: Vanessa labored tirelessly. When the boat touched water, silent ripples spread—she prayed time was not too late.

Name: Oaths Beyond Measure
Description: The garden withered at the touch of an outsider; the witch said: 'When the last bloom returns, you may leave.'

Name: Thorns Bloom Bright
Description: Vanessa soon found the witch not as feared; in the scent of tea, Meluthiel began to linger more and more.

Name: Crimson Amber
Description: The witch indulged Vanessa's curiosity, teaching her spells like turning roses to gems, treating her like a pupil.

Name: Edge Over Heart
Description: The garden revived, but a storm clouded Vanessa's heart; war still looms, haunting her sleepless nights.

Name: Echoes of Chimes
Description: That night, the moon stayed silent as time began to flow; the witch stood watching while Vanessa sailed away.

Name: Splendid Glimmer
Description: Colors are never confined to clothes. They can be a rain of lights, dyeing the sky hues of splendor.

Name: Radiant Starlight
Description: Like a comet, the girl lives to be the brightest version of herself, her existence a manifesto of confidence.

Name: Wayward Cadence
Description: She believes in one thing in life: fear no judgment and do whatever you want. Nothing changes her decision.

Name: Colorful Decoration
Description: Passionate dancing gives life to wild imagination. Even the colors on the streets seem to be dancing to the beats.

Name: Nautical Memory
Description: She fell asleep on the showcase and woke up to see an old photo in the logbook showing familiar faces.

Name: Oceanic Whisper
Description: She thought it was a dream until she found a conch in her palm, fine salt falling from its hard shell at her touch.

Name: Redolent Impression
Description: Pies made of fruits and edible flowers are the most popular, sold out as soon as they hit the shelves.

Name: Basket of Wishes
Description: Food carries the best wishes of its makers. Its purpose is to bring people happiness and satisfaction.

Name: Crusty Moment
Description: Take one bite of the shiny, fragrant crust—the taste reminds one of a wheatfield rolling in the golden sunshine.

Name: 鼠予甜梦
Description: 开一家甜品店远比想象中困难。小茜遇到了很多难题，但每当她做出精美的蛋糕时，都会感到最纯粹的快乐。

Name: 抹茶卷轮
Description: 祖母做好一份精美的甜品，由她来在蛋糕上点出漂亮的奶油尖尖。那些镌刻在记忆中的味道，是她童年的美好。

Name: 芳香莓果
Description: 她无数次重复着熟悉的动作，像祖母一样，将甜品的每一步都做到极致——或许细致和耐心正是祖母的独家秘方。

Name: 奶油蕾丝
Description: 甜品店的客人络绎不绝，他们对小茜的蛋糕赞不绝口，年轻的甜品师和她的祖母一样出色，能做出相同的味道。

Name: 软糖缎带
Description: 渐渐地，这样的称赞却像一座大山压在小茜心中，作为一个甜品师，她至今还没找到属于自己的，独创的甜品。

Name: 悠然茶歇
Description: 某个下午，她留下了当天的最后一份抹茶蛋糕，恰好店里有新鲜的草莓，她在蛋糕的奶油尖尖上放上了一颗。

Name: 春樱灵感
Description: 小茜为此十分苦恼，甚至开始怀疑，自己想要的改变是否从一开始就是错的。她无法像祖母一样做出自己的甜品。

Name: 春樱印象
Description: 在忙碌充实的日子里，小茜仍会埋头研究新的配比。抹茶蛋糕是征途的起点，而未来小茜又会带来怎样的惊喜呢？

Name: Elegant Lotus
Description: Lights ripple on her skirt; lotus blooms surround the boat. For a moment, the girl feels she is in an immortal realm.

Name: Melody of Dusk
Description: It should be time to return, yet she lingers. The misty landscape unfolds before her, too beautiful to leave behind.

Name: Misty Rainfall
Description: Mountain weather shifts fast. Blue skies suddenly turn gray. Before she reacts, raindrops fall onto her bamboo hat.

Name: Blossoms of Jade
Description: Rain drapes the boat like soft silk. Everything turns misty. Through layers of lotus, she continues her journey.

Name: Ripples of Heart
Description: Raindrops strike the pond. Frightened fish flee to the depths, leaving lotus blossoms swaying in slanted rain.

Name: Lotus Flower Jade

Name: Carefree Nocturne

Description: Thanks to Yvette's efforts, another designer who had once declined finally agreed to attend.

Name: Ripples of Time
Description: This morning's rain left tiny pools under the rosebushes, and drifting petals rippled across them.

Description: 芙瑞莉在自己的小基地里不停踱步，忽然哀叹一声扑进了角落的沙发里，抓起一只抱枕苦恼地揉来揉去。

Name: 不羁印象
Description: 盘腿坐在地板上的芙瑞莉入神看着堆在一起的喷绘罐，忽然被一声微弱的猫叫吸引了注意力，她抬头望向窗台。

Name: 潮流宣言
Description: 芙瑞莉刚打开窗户，小花猫就钻了进来。等等……少女定睛一看，小家伙的胡须和爪子上都沾满了浆果汁液！

Name: 个性绘彩
Description: 是每天都会在街区附近出没的小花猫！它是不少艺术家的好朋友，总会神不知鬼不觉地跳上窗台来拜访大家。

Name: Magical Garden
Description: Camille's garden flourishes under her care, green and bountiful. Everyone loves to come here to pick their produce.

Name: Veggie Hairpin
Description: One day, a weary traveler arrives at the garden, drawn by its lush crops, and asks to rest for a while.

Name: Fragrant Bloom
Description: Camille welcomes him and offers some fruit to refresh him. In return, he gives her a bag of seeds before leaving.

Name: Colorful Fruits
Description: No one has been able to grow these before. Perhaps you, skilled gardener, can make them bloom,' he says.

Name: Skilled Handplant
Description: The birds chirp, 'Give up! Give up! Don't waste your time!' But she shakes her head and tends to the seeds with care.

Name: Basket of Fresh Delights
Description: By next spring, the seeds finally sprout, sending long vines up the fence and bearing clusters of unripe tomatoes.

Name: Whimsical Kettle
Description: The fruits grow bigger than pumpkins, glowing red and hanging proudly. 'The biggest tomatoes ever!' people marvel.

Name: Meow Summer
Description: Inflatable pool, pro goggles, a special float, and custom cool drinks—it's a cat's grand summer splash adventure!

Name: Sweet Dream
Description: Maybe it could grant wishes. But Bebena felt it shouldn't be trapped in a glass tank for that.

Name: Summer Girl
Description: As nets came out to catch the stranded Dreamfish, Bebena stood, pulled off her shades, and said: 'Beat me first!'

Name: Dewdrop Charm
Description: The crowd stared at the girl in shock—someone gasped, 'It's Bebena, that trending stylist everyone's talking about!'

Name: Color Clash
Description: The tale of the Dreamfish was hard to resist—just a legend, perhaps, but some still believed it might bring luck.

Name: Starfish Murmurs
Description: Bebena gently lifted the Dreamfish, settled on her flamingo float, and drifted as it slipped into the sea.

Name: Swift Flash
Description: When she bought the convertible, Abby chose this bold color——each mile toward freedom rekindling her joy.

Name: Coconut Breeze
Description: At sunset, Abby stops, barefoot on the shore, savoring the sea breeze and sweet, cool coconut air.

Name: Summer Bliss
Description: Leaving the shore, Abby met a painter—vibrant hues on canvas, her heart unfurling like a bloom.

Name: Sharp Vision
Description: By the fire, music lit Abby's heart. She danced with the band, then slept beneath a sky full of stars.

Name: Nature Muse
Description: Art answers the heart and nature. Remembering this, Abby's pencil meets paper—her spark quietly returns.

Name: Poetic Notes
Description: Abby captures each fleeting moment in her sketchbook—messy, lively lines that trace her journey and growth.

Name: Cool Sip
Description: The numb self is gone, swept away by the journey's breeze. Abby sips her drink, calm and free in the golden light.

Name: Lake Dream
Description: Soft rain veils the world like a filter—fantasy needs no sharp lines. Countless rains shaped her bond with the lake.

Name: Rain Bloom
Description: Each rainfall draws her to the ripples. Nature taps its rhythm, and her heart follows, dreaming with every drop.

Name: Ripple of Memory
Description: Melutin thought long—loud or quiet scenes passed her mind. In the end, she chose the small lake outside her window.

Name: Serenade in Rain
Description: A drifting heart was suddenly pulled. Before Melutin knew it, “Registration Successful” flashed on the tiny screen.

Name: Abyssal Hues
Description: To Melutin, it was music she loved—and a mirror of quiet days. Even the plainest moments held a hint of shining joy.

Name: Emblem of Dreams
Description: On slow afternoons, she creates freely. Each small joy is “ideal” made real in daily life.

Name: Unspoken Vow
Description: Months later, Rain Over the Lake by virtual idol Ruither went viral—its gentle tune and lyrics touched many.

Name: Prism Interlude
Description: In the song, people rediscovered quiet emotions lost in daily life—like stars softly glowing in a dark night sky.

Name: Luminous Prologue
Description: On quiet afternoons, Melutin wrote by the window. Stuck for words, she looked to the shimmering lake.

Name: Sapphire Oath
Description: Rain Over the Lake marked Melutin's start as a songwriter. Years on, she still remembers the nerves of hitting send.

Name: Forsaken Echoes
Description: Back then, Aria didn't grasp what “monster” meant to the villagers. She just felt hurt—and vanished with a spell.

Name: Mossy Traces
Description: She escaped and sat by the stream, fixing her hair and tail. The villagers saw her and shouted, chasing her off.

Name: Wispfire Glade
Description: Joy from escaping faded fast. Stuck in a trap, Aria thought, the world’s too complicated—maybe I should go home.

Name: Abandoned Spire
Description: Such trials wouldn’t stop her. Aria had learned the spells—and that night, she reached the human world at last.

Name: Luminous Solitude
Description: The young woman was different—her gentle, bright eyes reminded Aria of the moon in Qingqiu's mist. She took Aria in.

Name: Hushed Cosmos
Description: She cared for Aria and made chicken soup. Smelling it, the little fox lit up, tail wagging with joy.

Name: Unstill Depths
Description: Aria gifted the young woman her jade pendant. They became close friends—sunbathing, picking mushrooms after the rain.

Name: Phantom Fire
Description: Aria thought it just another day, skipping after her aunt's shadow as she left the lively human world.

Name: Wavering Exile
Description: Her eyes stayed kind, but tears shimmered. Aria didn't understand goodbye—she just wiped them away.

Name: Jade Veil
Description: The human girl had clever hands; Aria, in contrast, was clumsy. Her playful ways often made the girl laugh.

Name: Spirit Tail
Description: The elders of Qingqiu found out. Soon, Aria's aunt took her home, but she promised to return when she could.

Name: Celestial Azure
Description: Since then, Aria explored with caution, doubting her choice to leave Qingqiu—until she met a young woman.

Name: Oneiric Tail
Description: On her way home, Aria passed a sunlit meadow. Girls laughed in the grass—she thought, we were like that once too.

Name: Petalfall Ephemera
Description: War came before the bloom. Bevelyn fled with her vase, past smoke and farewells, as fire swallowed her town.

Name: Shattered Moon
Description: After countless tries, Bevelyn's vase was born one rainy morning—perhaps her one perfect creation.

Name: Dew Blossom
Description: Through war, perfection kept Bevelyn going—until a child's scream. She turned; a hoof hung in the air, ready to fall.

Name: Silent Verse
Description: Without pause, she raised her vase. Instinct moved faster than thought—even she was surprised.

Name: Renascence Vow
Description: Beneath shattered glass, a seed took root. Though it grew on a battlefield, untended, the flower still bloomed.

Name: Sigh & Shine
Description: The child was saved, but the perfect vase lay in pieces—scattered in the dust, now worth nothing at all.

Name: Lilac Sonata
Description: No time for sorrow—the vase was gone. Bevelyn grabbed a single shard and hurried back on the road.

Name: Scented Time
Description: This time, what drove her wasn't a need to protect perfection, but something deeper—something she couldn't yet name.

Name: Fragrant Past
Description: Most of glassmaster Bevelyn’s work is lost to time, yet the shattered vase is still remembered.

Name: 幽然会心
Description: 谷雨时节的宁州城总会栖在一帘朦胧的雨幕中，细雨滋润着万物，与茶香一同润泽了啵啵的心田。

Name: 心田寄愿
Description: 一瓯春露长留客,两袖清风几隐仙。在细雨之春，与三两好友于屋中品茶谈心，忘记忙碌与奔波，享受悠然惬意。

Name: 幽然会心·霁
Description: 啵啵和暖暖一起在薄薄的纸灯上写上名字，又一同把爪子沾上墨汁的大喵抱起，可爱的爪印留在了灯的正中央。

Name: 心田寄愿·霁
Description: 纸灯被夜风托起，承载着两人一喵的期待缓缓上升，啵啵仰起头深深注视远去的灯，无声许下了自己的心愿。

Name: 幻光回环
Description: “抱歉，今天要去伊甸园一趟。”海姆达尔露出遗憾的神色，“需要做个测试，下次吧。”

Name: 递归解析
Description: 天色渐暗，夕阳的余晖斜铺在桌面上，同事来到海姆达尔身边：“我发现一家不错的餐厅，要一起去试试吗？”

Name: 幻光回环·邃
Description: 还是被巡查系统探测到了，看来程序还有优化的空间。海姆达尔记下测试结果，按下了终端上的退出键。

Name: 递归解析·邃
Description: 海姆达尔垂下眼帘，静静地观察着巡逻机器人，随时准备修改它的数据。但小机器人绕了两圈，还是转身离开了。

Name: 热浪沙堡
Description: 黄昏成为沙堡落成的见证者，翻涌的浪花似乎也在为欢呼的身影庆贺，那是一整个永不凋零的海边长夏。

Name: Seafoam Whispers
Description: Hanna recalled her route: palm trees, beach chairs, an ice cream truck. The beach was her last stop in the search.

Name: Coastal Search
Description: Claire patted Hanna on the shoulder and helped her recall where she'd been. 'I'll help you find it. We'll get it back.'

Name: Iridescent Vision
Description: The beach was dyed orange as the sun sank lazily below the horizon. The girls searched every corner of the beach.

Name: Sweet Star Wish
Description: Claire blinked her sore eyes and suddenly caught a sparkle in the sand. She rushed over. '...Hanna! Come over here!'

Name: Dreamweaving Shovel
Description: Claire waved goodbye to Hanna in the moonlight. Next morning, Claire found a few sparkling shells on her front steps.

Name: Roseate Berries
Description: People chat over local cuisine and toast to a wonderful holiday, forgetting all worries in cheers and laughter.

Name: Dessert Spirit
Description: The girl's eyes light up the moment she sees the lovely earrings. She slips them on, brightening the special holiday.

Name: Summer Sparkle
Description: Before the holiday ends, enjoy a cool glass of coconut water! Let its sweetness linger as a lasting memory of the summer~

Name: Stellar Moment
Description: As the sun sets, Jinyi closes her notebook full of notes, wipes away sweat, and runs to her friends at the pier.

Name: Time of Silence
Description: Aunt Liu wants a couch, Uncle Chen is selling his shop... She notes everything that has happened on Iris Street.

Name: Spectacular Life
Description: Grown-ups ask curiously what the kids are discussing, but they all cleverly beat around the bush.

Name: Starry Glitter
Description: One morning, the grown-ups wake up to find a newspaper titled Iris Daily lying quietly at their doorsteps.

Name: Unbridled Zest
Description: Info on leases, discounts, lost pets... The handwriting may be childish, but the design is creative and full of doodles.

Name: Manifesto of Time
Description: The phone rings at the Star Weekly's office. 'You want to talk to Chief Editor Jinyi? Sorry, her schedule is full...'

Name: Sunset Glamor
Description: Ten years passed in the blink of an eye, and neon lights now shine along the Iris Street lined with tall buildings.

Name: Windfall Surprise
Description: As friends share the gifts from Jinyi, one taps her on the shoulder, asking, 'How's it going? Still too busy?'

Name: Glorious Road
Description: With everyone's praise, a dream starts budding in her heart, waiting to one day sail away to a bright future.

Name: Echoing Memories
Description: The girl steps out of a taxi, with shopping bags in her hands and a cellphone held between her ear and shoulder.

Name: Cosmic Exploration
Description: She mused about whimsical inventions, dreaming of a jetpack to soar to great heights where clouds and stars entwine.

Name: Sea of Starlight
Description: Wumei imagined herself as a shepherdess on vast grasslands, running with sheep friends like her little Lambie.

Name: Signal of Aries
Description: What wonders lie in the boundless sky? No one suffers sleepless nights there, and stars spend each evening laughing.

Name: Woolen Whispers
Description: Wumei felt that Lambie understood her. The little sheep gazed back at her, and its ears would twitch in reply.

Name: Engine of Fantasy
Description: The meteor shower never came. Only a few faint stars scattered across the night. This wasn't what she imagined.

Name: 无忧相伴
Description: 朋友在踏上新的旅程前，送给悠竹一台虚拟游戏设备，希望能在自己无法陪伴她的日子里，给她提供一份慰藉。

Name: 璃竹小调
Description: 悠竹忐忑地接入游戏设备。修竹茂林，叶影婆娑，曾经只能在脑海中想象的画面，此刻清晰地展现在眼前。

Name: 萌趣滚滚
Description: 游戏设备的礼盒上印着翠绿的竹林，竹林中有三三两两的大熊猫或打滚嬉戏，或闭目小憩，无不憨态可掬。

Name: 无忧相伴·华丽
Description: 悠竹试着将手放在那只厚实的爪掌，感受着阿盼手心传来的温度，萦绕心间的落寞与孤独都在这一刻烟消云散。

Name: 璃竹小调·华丽
Description: 阿盼带着悠竹结识了许多动物朋友：活泼好动的猴子、优雅伶俐的山鹊、还有只机敏的狐狸，总来向她讨蛋糕吃。

Name: 萌趣滚滚·华丽
Description: 自此以后，悠竹每天都会进入游戏世界。她和阿盼一起在园中嬉戏，寻找最鲜嫩的竹笋，感受拂过竹林的风。

Name: 无忧相伴·珍稀
Description: 悠竹的目光落在卧室里早已变成摆设的竹笛上，那场大病之后，她沉浸在沮丧之中，放弃了曾抱以热忱的音乐。

Name: 璃竹小调·珍稀
Description: 清越的笛声随着美好的记忆缓缓流淌，终于，灵石重现光华，小动物们从角落里跑了出来，围绕着悠竹欢呼雀跃。

Name: 萌趣滚滚·珍稀
Description: 但在虚拟的竹园里，在动物朋友的陪伴下，经历了无数次的探险之后，悠竹好像也找回了曾经的热爱与梦想。

Name: 无忧相伴·研
Description: 熊猫玩偶憨态可掬地趴在设计师手中，设计师眉眼弯弯：“最重要的原因还是，它实在太可爱啦！”

Name: 璃竹小调·研
Description: 设计师欣慰点头：“我一直希望玩家能从我的游戏中获得心灵的触动，谢谢你，让我知道我的初衷得到了实现。”

Name: 萌趣滚滚·研
Description: “我们精选了一些游戏评价，其中一位昵称叫悠竹的玩家讲述了这款游戏为她带来的改变。”记者指向虚拟光屏。

Name: 无忧相伴·庆
Description: 悠竹接过花灯，欣喜与感动在心中交织，她取出早已买下的另一套游戏设备：“我也有礼物要送给你！”

Name: 璃竹小调·庆
Description: 满园花灯下，悠竹和阿盼托着下巴，听朋友讲述着那些旅程中的奇妙经历，月影横斜，照亮了女孩们欣悦的笑容。

Name: 萌趣滚滚·庆
Description: 暮色四合，悠竹牵起友人的手，在阿盼的迎接下走进了小竹园，琳琅满目的花灯高高挂起，随风轻轻摆动。

Name: Shadow Court
Description: Fury burned in Kasim's eyes. Zahra showed no fear, sounding the horn—her long-awaited call for revenge.

Name: Dreaming Lights
Description: Hooves closed in. Zahra cloaked herself in her mother's starry veil, fading into shadow, unseen by the hounds.

Name: Hanging Moon
Description: Zahra slipped into the palace. Her veil parted like mist—her blade flashed, piercing Kasim's heart.

Name: Silent Nightfall
Description: From despair grew resolve. Zahra returned to a city ruled by Kasim's hounds, its glory lost to fear and blood.

Name: Golden Gleam
Description: Shadow was her shield. Zahra gathered loyal hands in secret, weaving a cold, burning web of vengeance.

Name: Midnight Glow
Description: Horns rose like Kasim's final song. He lunged—steel flashed, but the blade struck his own traitor's heart.

Name: Still Night
Description: Kasim is dead! Lay down your arms!' Zahra's voice rang out as dawn broke through the clouds.

Name: Luminous Gold
Description: Veiled in shadow, she forged her blade in blood and wrath. Yet she ruled with wisdom. All sang her name—Zahra.

Name: Chestnut Voyage
Description: One night, Lilico was half asleep when she heard a small voice anxiously calling to her, 'Lilico! Lilico! I'm here to help!'

Name: Gourmet Overload
Description: The wind chime rings whenever a customer comes in. Most of these regulars have watched Lilico grow up.

Name: Choco Memory
Description: A good mood matters most in a bakery!' the small voice said firmly. Lilico remembered it even after waking up.

Name: Whimsical Baking
Description: Your grandma always hummed while working the dough.' Aunt Martha said, 'Her smile would cheer me up, too.'

Name: Delightful Promise
Description: The old mailman pats Lilico on the head. 'Follow that voice in you. A happy Lilico can do anything she wants.'

Name: Ardent Trace
Description: Lilico tries to hum her grandma's favorite tune as the dough softens, filling her mind with joy and happiness.

Name: Redolent Moment
Description: Lilico picks up a freshly baked chestnut bun, and Aunt Martha's daughter cheers. 'It's like the one Mom used to buy!'

Name: Rejoicing Croak
Description: Of course! Glad you like it! See you again tomorrow morning.' The frog leapt cheerfully and left.

Name: Verdant Stage
Description: The frog took a bow and was about to jump into the lake when she asked, 'Will you sing again tomorrow?'

Name: Frolic Frog Beret
Description: For the next few days, she came to the lake to listen to the frog sing. The frog said it was a concert only for her.

Name: Fresh Dewdrop
Description: On the last day, she bade her farewell, saying she had to return to the city and couldn't hear its songs again.

Name: Emerald Reverie
Description: The frog didn't know what a city was, but still sang a farewell song. Its lively croaks echoed in her heart.

Name: Floaty Bubble
Description: Her cute and refreshing design won rounds of applause at the contest. The frog's singing echoed again in her mind.

Name: Virescent Ripples
Description: The frog theme added life and childlike fun to the design, making it lovable and delightful like the Frog Song.

Name: Pellucid Foam
Description: She planned to visit the lake again, but the journey was too long and too costly, so she had to put it off.

Name: Sugar Sweet Whisper
Description: The melody echoed in her dreams until she saw the poster for a design contest, offering a prize enough for her trip.

Name: Coruscating Lantern
Description: On a hazy rainy night, Qingyan was spacing out when she heard the sound of water. A girl waded across and sat by her.

Name: Cosmic Triviality
Description: The wind rustled the trees in the falling rain. 'Think of me as the spirit of these lotuses.' A smile bloomed on her face.

Name: Glazed Enigma
Description: The girl had pure, ethereal eyes unlike any Qingyan had ever seen. She hesitated before asking, 'Who are you?'

Name: Unsoiled Lotus
Description: Qingyan told the girl about the locked painting and how she still missed the feeling of creative freedom.

Name: Glimmering Fireflies
Description: The brief encounter felt like a dream, so she picked up her brush again to recreate the lotuses and the girl's smile.

Name: Unburdened Heart
Description: Qingyan did everything she could to help and even sold all her paintings, except for one hidden deep in her case.

Name: Mistborn Splendor
Description: Time on the mountain was peaceful until days of heavy rain flooded the town, leaving the people homeless.

Name: Wintry Breeze
Description: The last proof of Lotus vanished, but despite the passing of time, Qingyan still remembered that smile in the pond.

Name: Aureate Marvel
Description: The lasting rain cast shadows of despair. That night, all the lotuses suddenly bloomed, a familiar figure among them.

Name: Hushed Mountain
Description: The girl might have a name, but Qingyan never probed and just called her Lotus, as she had requested.

Name: Ingenious Karma
Description: She watched the blooms with Lotus under the moonlight. The girl said, 'Paint what you want, not what you're told to.'

Name: Cinnabar Grace
Description: Qingyan grew skilled in painting as more sought after her works. Still, she continued practicing daily by the pond.

Name: Will of Destiny
Description: After the night, the rain and flood finally stopped. Qingyan heard a gentle whisper as the lotuses swayed in the sun.

Name: Brilliance Doomed
Description: The emperor heeded a jealous minister's words and feared Huashu's achievements. She was framed and died in prison.

Name: Cosmic Awakening
Description: Her first life, Huashu was born in war, and with her martial skill, led armies to countless victories.

Name: Register of Souls
Description: In her second life, Huashu traveled around to heal the poor at no charge and saved many lives.

Name: Myriad Fates
Description: To save the souls from the cycle of suffering, Huashu was willing to use up her powers and fall into endless samsara.

Name: Wistful Dismay
Description: Still, some diseases were incurable. The families blamed Huashu and drove her out. Eventually, she died on the road.

Name: Ceaseless Dreaming
Description: In her third life, Huashu weaved her passion and hopes for the world into exquisite embroideries.

Name: Stolen Renown
Description: However, a jealous competitor stole and altered her embroideries and published them, earning fame and fortune.

Name: Lonesome Bloom
Description: After a hundred lives, Huashu learned sorrows and regrets and transcended them, her pride and will unchanged.

Name: Secular Troubles
Description: Secular troubles hide the truth of the world like a fog. Life is a game full of enigmas and deceptions.

Name: Causality Chaos
Description: The rich and powerful ruled the world, while kindness was repaid with evil. The world was in a mess of injustice.

Name: Phantom Blossom
Description: The kind-hearted is led before Huashu as she asks with a smile, 'Will you trade this life for peace in the next?'

Name: Order Unseen
Description: The world rewarded the evil and talentless while the good was ignored. Such unfairness cuts to her heart like a knife.

Name: Fleeting Grandeur
Description: Huashu gathered evidence and sued the thief. The truth eventually came out, but rumors followed her like a ghost.

Name: A Vein in Jade
Description: As bells under the eaves chime in the wind, a faint light shimmered between the bookshelves of her study.

Name: Celestial Guidance
Description: No wandering souls remain. Kindness is blessed; the wicked fear retribution. It's a peace paid with Huashu's sacrifice.

Name: Nirvana Blaze
Description: Bathed in dewdrops gathered from the white rose garden, the mute girl was washed of all dust and turned snow white.

Name: Brilliant Precept
Description: Peris is your name, for you are the chosen intercessor. Silent you may be, your hands will weave salvation for all.'

Name: Empyrean Pledge
Description: Peris lived at the top of the temple in the smell of spices and herbs and wore jeweled gold symbolizing her divinity.

Name: Fateful Astrolabe
Description: Grateful for the gods' love, Peris fulfilled her duty, believing she'd pass the spindle of fate to everyone else.

Name: Engraved Aphorism
Description: Each night, she knelt before the oracle slab, tracing with her fingertips until blood formed constellations.

Name: Blessing of Genesis
Description: On Saints' Day, Peris recited divine words with hundreds of gestures like fluttering doves, praying for the believers.

Name: Meteor Dream
Description: They gazed at the star between her brows, seeing not the sunlight reflected, but an escape from life's cruel truths.

Name: Astral Vestige
Description: Faith couldn't cure corruption. As Peris recited oracles, the minister was amassing wealth on the bones of the poor.

Name: Eternal Aurora
Description: In blood-stained wheatfields, the starving populace fought over moldy bread. Peris's pleas only earned her shackles.

Name: Starlit Shadow
Description: When the emperor finally raised his noble head from mead, the minister blamed Peris for the people's suffering.

Name: Cosmic Cycle
Description: We built an ivory tower and offered an ocean of gold and pearls, but she couldn't even turn leaves into bread.'

Name: Throne of Embers
Description: Peris was sentenced to death. In whips and swearing, she tried in vain to speak before finally closing her eyes.

Name: Fateful Prayer
Description: When she awoke, runes enveloped her and gold flowed in her eyes. The kingdom shrank to the size of her palm.

Name: Blessed Spirit
Description: The flood swallowed the king and minister, when a gentle light shrouded those supporting each other on the roofs.

Name: Glorious Wreath
Description: Peris turned into a star in the sound of prayer, as birds flew past each wheat ear and breathed life into it again.

Name: Nirvana Blaze
Description: Bathed in dewdrops gathered from the white rose garden, the mute girl was washed of all dust and turned snow white.

Name: Brilliant Precept
Description: Peris is your name, for you are the chosen intercessor. Silent you may be, your hands will weave salvation for all.'

Name: Empyrean Pledge
Description: Peris lived at the top of the temple in the smell of spices and herbs and wore jeweled gold symbolizing her divinity.

Name: Fateful Astrolabe
Description: Grateful for the gods' love, Peris fulfilled her duty, believing she'd pass the spindle of fate to everyone else.

Name: Engraved Aphorism
Description: Each night, she knelt before the oracle slab, tracing with her fingertips until blood formed constellations.

Name: Blessing of Genesis
Description: On Saints' Day, Peris recited divine words with hundreds of gestures like fluttering doves, praying for the believers.

Name: Meteor Dream
Description: They gazed at the star between her brows, seeing not the sunlight reflected, but an escape from life's cruel truths.

Name: Astral Vestige
Description: Faith couldn't cure corruption. As Peris recited oracles, the minister was amassing wealth on the bones of the poor.

Name: Eternal Aurora
Description: In blood-stained wheatfields, the starving populace fought over moldy bread. Peris's pleas only earned her shackles.

Name: Starlit Shadow
Description: When the emperor finally raised his noble head from mead, the minister blamed Peris for the people's suffering.

Name: Cosmic Cycle
Description: We built an ivory tower and offered an ocean of gold and pearls, but she couldn't even turn leaves into bread.'

Name: Throne of Embers
Description: Peris was sentenced to death. In whips and swearing, she tried in vain to speak before finally closing her eyes.

Name: Fateful Prayer
Description: When she awoke, runes enveloped her and gold flowed in her eyes. The kingdom shrank to the size of her palm.

Name: Blessed Spirit
Description: The flood swallowed the king and minister, when a gentle light shrouded those supporting each other on the roofs.

Name: Glorious Wreath
Description: Peris turned into a star in the sound of prayer, as birds flew past each wheat ear and breathed life into it again.

Name: Pristine Spray
Description: On an ordinary night, her familiar space was invaded. A green-eyed young man came out of the mirror.

Name: Verses of Fragrance
Description: The magic begins!' A vortex appeared as his magic wand waved. Dull bell tolls warned of the invader.

Name: Sparkling Spray
Description: Who told you that!? She wanted to object: I'm just a bottle of perfume. I'd die soon if not well kept!

Name: Dream of Fragrance
Description: Her 'roommates' were drawn to the tunnel. Before disappearing, she heard the man say, 'Freedom will be much better.'

Name: Waltz of Whispers
Description: In the vortex, she saw fragmented images, from the collapse of a star, to a butterfly breaking its cocoon...

Name: Subtle Blossom
Description: She saw her maker shearing off a budding flower at dawn, and the woman who bought her playing a song of a lost time.

Name: Enigmatic Emotion
Description: She saw the ebb and flow of tides, the birth and death of lives, memories woven into her botanical soul.

Name: Daylight Remnants
Description: She fell into slumber in the ever-changing time. Time in the vortex felt like an instant, or thousands of years.

Name: Elegy of Time
Description: She also saw the green-eyed man, closely connected to this world, until she heard the elegy of fate at nightfall.

Name: Cute Stylist
Description: Kimi showed talent in design and styling at a young age, made clothes for every toy, and even curtains for her.

Name: Dollhouse Playtime
Description: She studied Schiller to see if seriousness was heritable, but he looked so happy when they were playing together.

Name: Dream House
Description: Kimi had little expression even when playing with toys, and only looked her age when sound asleep in her arms.

Name: Furry Confidante
Description: The big furry bear was one of Kimi's closest friends. The bear wasn't too big. Kimi was just too little then.

Name: Bunny's Gift
Description: Crescent designed cute accessories. She tried placing a rabbit-inspired hat on Kimi's bedside. It was a surprise!

Name: Pinkish Wish
Description: Kimi is so adorable! She should have more cute accessories! Does Schiller even know how to take care of her?

Name: Cloud Resonance
Description: Kimi once believed toys were alive. She'd hate to admit it, but had secret hopes. The hat appeared out of the blue!

Name: Magic of Love
Description: Is there really magic in the world? Little Kimi asked her friends, but the toys didn't answer. But in her heart: Yes! There is!

Name: Tea Party Glee
Description: Unlike before, the toys gathered together for a tea party and spent a wonderful time on their own.

Name: Mirror Adventure
Description: Under the pale moon, little Kimi fell into a gentle dream. She was at a cozy cottage where everything felt reassuring.

Name: Primal Chronicle
Description: She crawls from under the bones and explores the silence around. No response to the names she calls.

Name: Glimmering Cage
Description: She returns to where she awakened and gazes at the bones, tears streaming down as she caresses the frame.

Name: Verdure Pool
Description: The bones should have turned to ashes with her memories. Why did she wake up? How could the remains be restored?

Name: Viridescent Vines
Description: She finds the Leaf of Life among verdant vines. Except for its occasional glimmer, it looks like any other leaf.

Name: Sylvan Fragrance
Description: Time flows again with the leaf. She may have lost her power with no knowledge of this world, but she's alive.

Name: Pearls in Breeze
Description: The leaf sometimes brings in air from outside. Power envelops her in warmth and flows through her veins.

Name: Emerald Fragrance
Description: She was filled with power stronger than before, but it soon ebbed away, leaving her empty.

Name: Lingering Gloom
Description: She tried to destroy the leaf. She tore it apart, drowned it, buried it... But nothing worked.

Name: Flowing Hues of Clouds
Description: A miracle that brings back time and awakens life. How could the leaf be so easily destroyed by her?

Name: Prophecy of Frost
Description: She'd tear up at the thought. The leaf brings not only powers, but emotions held within, either sadness or joy.

Name: Wildland Bones
Description: The leaf never minds. It only absorbs and spreads powers, cleansing the world with the rise and fall of emotions.

Name: Timeworn Bones
Description: No longer leaning against the bones, she rises like a warrior, determined to destroy the leaf and escape this verdant cage.

Name: Cordial Warble
Description: The man searched around and found no one. Finally, he hesitantly eyed the unnoticeable bird statue in the corner.

Name: Nest of Dreams
Description: You are a genius singer! You understand my emotions, right?' The man spoke excitedly with a flush.

Name: Windward Wings
Description: Was it you?' Newly conscious, she didn't understand the shy feeling within. Unable to move, she gave a faint reply.

Name: Hopeful Renewal
Description: Outside the bathroom came another deep voice: 'Your Majesty, do you need assistance?' 'No, thank you.'

Name: Praise of Plumage
Description: Albert looked upset and shrugged: 'Fun never lasts. I have a lot of work to do. It'll be another sleepless night.'

Name: Whimsical Freedom
Description: She wondered why. She knew people answered to him, so why didn't he just stop working if he didn't want to?

Name: Tears of Sorrow
Description: Let's sing together tomorrow!' Albert promised the statue. 'But I have to finish something first.'

Name: Ebb of Time
Description: You are a lady, right? I have to do something, or it would be rude.' The next day, a few craftsmen were led there.

Name: Radiant Afterglow
Description: By the way, how did they manage to sing those songs so... you know!' The servants would sometimes gossip.

Name: Starlight Bond
Description: You don't understand! She thought, Albert sings so well with such a unique voice! You don't know how special it is.

Name: Misty Weave
Description: Craftsmen came to work on the shower screen—a serious task ordered by His Majesty to protect their privacy.

Name: Empyrean Wings
Description: His Majesty would sing with a lady when he showered. It became a myth in the palace, because nobody saw the lady.

Name: Ode to Feathers
Description: If only you could fly,' Albert gently traced the marks on her feathers. 'Far and high, free to do whatever you wish.'

Name: Untethered Fantasy
Description: Albert made no promise that day. He never came back since then. It's okay, she thought. Maybe he'll return tomorrow.

Name: Scented Veil
Description: Criticism and doubt only grew louder, leaving Korina helpless and in pain. Only Elle stood up for her.

Name: Timeless Wish
Description: Old rivals became friends. Elle helped Korina sort her drafts and notes and submitted them to clear everything up.

Name: Scented Drizzle
Description: The raging storm quieted down. Only Korina remembered the dangerous sails and Elle, who helmed the ship with her.

Name: Unfallen Bloom
Description: Before leaving, Elle gave Korina a beautiful eternal bloom. It bathed in the sun, reminiscent of their time together.

Name: Soulbound Pact
Description: Soon, the young designers graduated, wrote down their beautiful hopes, and left the Institute full of memories.

Name: Scented Veil - Rain
Description: Korina fell quiet. The eternal bloom was their shiny adolescence. Elle was the firm, fearless captain at the helm.

Name: Timeless Wish - Rain
Description: She started to secretly help Elle like the reckless but brave girl she once was. Soon after, Elle had her own studio.

Name: Scented Drizzle - Rain
Description: Korina sent Elle an eternal bloom, the everlasting petals frozen with secrets and their adolescent dreams.

Name: Unfallen Bloom - Rain
Description: Korina and Elle donated the eternal bloom they co-designed to the auction, as their blessing for all young designers.

Name: Soulbound Pact - Rain
Description: Korina wrote: We are boats that once sailed together, and I hope no storm can stop you in the ocean of life.

Name: Glimmer of Ember
Description: The summer soon passed, and the flames of war raged on. The kingdom fell into chaos, and the young royal lost all.

Name: Bygone Glory
Description: Only the guard stood quietly in the showcase. The young lady stared at her, wondering who she's protecting now.

Name: Engraved Time
Description: The ballroom became a shelter for survivors. Luxury jewelry was only worth a bag of bread. She lost everything.

Name: Glimmer of Ember - Legacy
Description: Visitors halt to read the illustrious introduction, and the guard just stands in silence amidst the discussions.

Name: Bygone Glory - Legacy
Description: The wind brushes the last trace of glory on her brim. She's still a guard, protecting her kingdom or a child's dream.

Name: Engraved Time - Legacy
Description: She's taken home by a little girl, who asks: 'Will you protect me?' The toy guard can't answer, but she nods in her mind.

Name: Cloud Murmurs
Description: For years, the bear remained her best friend and the most loyal listener. She drifted into dreams holding it.

Name: Book of Curiosity
Description: Reality was not the perfect life the girl created on paper. Outside work, only writing fairytales brought her joy.

Name: Bear Companion
Description: She decorated the windowsill with flowers, tied a ribbon around her beloved bear, and sketched a happy fairyland.

Name: Cloud Murmurs - Matcha
Description: People in the fairytales found true happiness, filling the girl's heart with hope and courage to face reality.

Name: Book of Curiosity - Matcha
Description: Her writing moved the readers. She moved out of the attic and wrote more stories to pass on the courage.

Name: Bear Companion - Matcha
Description: Now the bear has a responsibility, too. It has witnessed a girl's growth, and will help more resilient young souls.

Name: Dark Dreamscape
Description: Fierce bidding ends in the late-autumn rain, leaving the chandelier shining lazily in the haze of luxury.

Name: Crimson Brew
Description: Lights flicker off, startling a servant into glancing over, his dish slipping with a clash that draws everyone's attention.

Name: Moonlight Luster
Description: A pulsating crimson red fills the wine cup in the painting. The simple contour and lines radiate with color.

Name: Hushed Lament
Description: But as the lights flicker on, the captivating brilliance is nowhere to be seen. It seems it only blooms at specific times.

Name: Gleaming Stream
Description: With map and pack, Dalf and the little one set off. The fish bid farewell, and the stream rushed ahead to scout.

Name: Fairytale Guest
Description: Dalf stroked the little one's back and said, 'I know stories of rivers and lakes. Let me help you find a new home.'

Name: Flowing Waters
Description: To Dalf, lakes were painters sketching the sky and rivers were travelers racing to the sea. Every puddle was unique.

Name: Gentle Waves
Description: They met a stream tossing the little one off balance. Dalf chuckled, 'It seems we need to find calmer waters.'

Name: Swaying Petals
Description: They arrived at a tranquil forest marsh. A pudgy axolotl released bubbles, then floated up and shook its head.

Name: Unknown Realm
Description: The little one's kin arrived at their new home. To thank Dalf, they picked the most beautiful flowers for her.

Name: Crystal Gleam
Description: The little one swam joyfully, blowing happy bubbles toward Dalf, 'This is the place! Our new home!'

Name: Fragrant Ripples
Description: On hot days, the little one would swish its tail, stirring ripples and breezes to bring Dalf a touch of coolness.

Name: Dreamer's Companion
Description: Blossoms encircled Dalf, merging into a romantic sea of flowers conveying gratitude to the girl.

Name: Thief's Invitation
Description: Good night. May the moon and stars grant you sweet dreams.' With a graceful leap, the girl got on a hot-air balloon.

Name: Heartbeat Heist
Description: On a city rooftop, roses rained down. Two wary factions looked up as a figure slid down the balloon's rope ladder.

Name: Momo Balloon
Description: The balloon was reportedly crafted after a cheerful late-night talk between the Troupe's prop master and its leader.

Name: Under the Moonlight
Description: Countless heart-shaped balloons erupted to blur the crowd's sight. She seized the treasure swiftly.

Name: Nocturnal Fantasia
Description: A fragrance drifted on the wind as ornate invitations fluttered down like snow, revealing the thief's next move.

Name: Starlit Trace
Description: A cheer broke the quiet. The Troupe saw Milia clutching props, dashing to the rehearsal hall.

Name: Free Spirit
Description: With keen senses to track lost treasures and achieve goals, the girl bows to no power, chasing only what's amusing.

Name: Dazzling Moment
Description: As the lights dimmed, a spotlight split the dark. Cloak flared, and Milia, the Phantom Thief, stepped into glory.

Name: Prelude to Tomorrow
Description: The girl toyed with a gem, watching the factions quarrel on the rooftop. She laughed to herself.

Name: Finale in Splendor
Description: Countless clever touches wove into a stunning show, Milia's effort gifting a feast for the eyes.

Name: 绛珠摇光
Description: 绿蔓秾阴紫袖低，客来留坐小堂西。醉中掩瑟无人会，家近江南罨画溪。

Name: 翠羽明垱
Description: 寂寂青山一鸟啼，紫藤花落午风微。不知刻漏长多少，但觉桐阴半日移。

Name: 秀润天成
Description: 竹宫琐窗云雾垂，紫藤花发何葳蕤。仙家驻景出异供，横掩桃李无晶辉。

Name: 流霰云珠
Description: 均之胎、釉皆细，均之釉无论深浅浓淡皆浑然一律，均窑之天青色者，肆人呼为月白，盖仿柴之雨过天晴也。

Name: 窑炼千色
Description: 僧寮偶见双耳瓶，黛色浓淡光泠泠。异哉均州旧时造，几经兵燹犹完形。

Name: 青泽承露
Description: 进入西南山，七里长街现，七十七座窑，烟火遮住天，客商天下走，日进斗金钱。

Name: 含明隐迹
Description: 台之下植石为矶，可坐而渔，曰钓。往北，地益迥，林木益深，水益清驶，水尽别疏小沼，植莲其中，曰水花池。

Name: 金石遗韵
Description: 自此绕出梦隐之前，古木疏篁，可以憩息，曰怡颜处。又前循水而东，果林弥望，曰来禽囿。

Name: 乌金拓本
Description: 又东出梦隐楼之后，长松数植，风至泠然有声，曰听松风处。

Name: 竹涧鸣珂
Description: 池上美竹千挺，可以追凉，中为亭，曰净深。循净深而东，柑橘数十本，亭曰待霜。

Name: Glimmering Starlight
Description: Starry sky mirrors in her eyes, igniting a light that sees through all things. Past vows stirred within her soul.

Name: Astral Hush
Description: The path unfolds in silence. She steps forward as starlight floods her trail, whispering waves of distant warmth.

Name: Veil of Stars
Description: Stars fade and bloom in endless rhythm, stirring tides of light. The distant horizon glows with radiant promise.

Name: Distant Stardust - Glow
Description: Stars burn bright in the silent sky, tracing the unexpected fate, shattering into dust, and reborn in the fall.

Name: Infinite Cosmos - Glow
Description: Stars cast their light across distant space. Even the most ordinary night is a miracle of the universe, she thought.

Name: Starlight of Memory - Glow
Description: Even only for a fleeting moment, the twinkling stars left the most brilliant memories amidst the dark.

Name: Starlit Drift
Description: Even in the sea of fallen worlds, a glimmer of hope remains—hidden in stardust, glowing on forgotten paths.

Name: Sleepless Abyss
Description: The young woman stumbles on—past shattered stars, through collapsing despair—racing toward the night sea's far shore.

Name: Lucent Dream
Description: Silent waves crash as she reaches the shore. Breath held, starlight blooms in her palms—alive with infinite dawn.

Name: Secret of Innovation
Description: Star Weekly is a famous magazine in Lotusville. Its founder Jinyi is known for her progressiveness and great vision.

Name: Ashen Cobweb
Description: Like most soil, it holds within a seed of life that has endured thousands of years and the ever-changing time.

Name: Cake Chase
Description: For the best strawberry cake in the world, Momo can run at a speed beyond your wildest imagination!

Name: 轻梦浅语
Description: 希雅喜欢这样的生活，她脸上总是洋溢着笑容，那时候的她还不知道，这些简单的小事，正是她梦想的起点。

Name: 甜果诗篇
Description: 某个阳光明媚的午后，希雅和姐姐一起缝制小帽子，她告诉姐姐，自己的心愿就是让所有娃娃都穿上漂亮的衣裙。

Name: 悠然歌谣
Description: 有风吹过窗外的老橡树，树叶沙沙作响，如同岁月深处凝结的无字歌谣，或许要在许多年后，人们才能听懂它。

Name: 轻梦浅语·樱落
Description: 日复一日的练习中希雅逐渐感到茫然，她抛弃了自己轻盈灵动的风格，却无法学会姐姐精致的线条与沉稳的色彩。

Name: 甜果诗篇·樱落
Description: 四季的风穿过老橡树，城中再度举办服装设计大赛，希雅带着作品踏上旅途，怀揣着和姐姐同样的兴奋和紧张。

Name: 悠然歌谣·樱落
Description: 评委对她的作品点头称赞，然而希雅没有获得像姐姐那样优异的名次——这些精致的衣裙终究欠缺了创作的灵魂。

Name: 轻梦浅语·童话
Description: 在一个明亮的早晨，城中一位记者敲响了希雅的门，记者偶然看到希雅给娃娃做的衣裙，惊讶于她的灵感和手艺。

Name: 甜果诗篇·童话
Description: 那些承载着童心的设计，轻盈而灵动的剪裁，一切都像在无声描述着小镇的宁静岁月，那是独属于希雅的故事。

Name: 悠然歌谣·童话
Description: 风吹过老橡树，如同一阵絮絮的低语，希雅仍旧坐在阁楼上为娃娃们制作新装。她没有成为别人，而是成了自己。

Name: 轻梦浅语·薄荷
Description: 女孩们从未见过这样别出心裁的设计，看似矛盾的布料和色彩碰撞出独特的风格，让每一个娃娃都显得十分特别。

Name: 甜果诗篇·薄荷
Description: 她们的眼睛闪闪发光，围着希雅叽叽喳喳：“我要一条有很多蝴蝶结的公主裙！”“我想要有猫耳朵的斗篷！”

Name: 悠然歌谣·薄荷
Description: 希雅怔了怔，忽然笑了。她打开封存许久的箱子，将还未完成的手稿重新取出，窗外，老橡树在风中沙沙作响。

Name: 双星交照
Description: 一只纸飞机忽而落到了艾洛膝上，她好奇地打开，上面画着在窗边发呆的自己，还有个龙飞凤舞的签名——丽斯。

Name: 皎皎月影
Description: 对面的丽斯正朝她挤眼睛。艾洛想了想，将此刻笑容明媚的丽斯画在纸的另一面，折成小船，鼓起勇气递了回去。

Name: 星辉密证
Description: 丽斯和艾洛性格是如此互补，又充满着默契，她们很快变得形影不离，时常会分享只有彼此了解的奇思妙想。

Name: 星愿纪梦
Description: 她们就像两颗骤然相遇的星辰，互相陪伴，互相照亮。艾洛在心底默默许愿，自己与丽斯能永远像现在这样要好。

Name: 无声诺言
Description: 和丽斯相遇，让艾洛的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化，她紧紧牵着艾洛的手，与艾洛一起体验这个广大斑斓的世界。

Name: 双星交照·静夜
Description: 艾洛打开一看，里面静静躺着一只缀满星星的发簪，丽斯余光瞥到椅背上的礼服，露出“果然如此”的神情来。

Name: 皎皎月影·静夜
Description: 下一刻，艾洛夺眶而出的泪水让丽斯慌了神，她连忙握住艾洛的手连连道歉，艾洛也哽咽喃喃是自己不对。

Name: 星辉密证·静夜
Description: 两人同时向对方低头，却一下撞在了一起。泪眼朦胧的艾洛揉着额头与动作一致的丽斯对望，忍不住笑了出来。

Name: 星愿纪梦·静夜
Description: 艾洛抿嘴笑着摸了摸额头，没有回答丽斯，只是悄悄挪动身体，让自己离失而复得的星辰更近了一些。

Name: 无声诺言·静夜
Description: 丽斯和艾洛挤在一块，认真研究如何修复礼服。紧皱眉头的丽斯忽然疑惑地戳戳艾洛的额头，问她怎么还在傻笑。

Name: 双星交照·星沙
Description: 送走医生后，艾洛细心地为丽斯掖好被角，丽斯催促她快换上礼服赶去今晚的舞会，艾洛却好似没有听见一般。

Name: 皎皎月影·星沙
Description: 如果不能出席舞会，两人修复好的礼服便失去了绝佳的展示机会！丽斯仍不放弃，再次试图以此说服艾洛。

Name: 星辉密证·星沙
Description: 艾洛终于慢吞吞地放下书，拿起了礼服。礼服既华丽又合身，艾洛变得光彩照人，像是天幕中最耀眼的星辰。

Name: 星愿纪梦·星沙
Description: 小小的空间里，少女舞姿轻盈，裙裾像花一般盛开。窗外星辰闪烁，是两位少女友谊不变且耀目的见证。

Name: 无声诺言·星沙
Description: 少女缓缓提裙，朝丽斯行了一个优雅的礼，而后笑眯眯地告诉丽斯，这便是这件礼服最应当出现的时刻。

Name: 双星交照·糖心
Description: 艾洛下意识握住身边丽斯的手，不期然撞进了对方失落的眼中，艾洛张了张口，丽斯却用笑容将她的话堵了回去。

Name: 皎皎月影·糖心
Description: 星空辽阔，仿佛能包容所有复杂心绪。和丽斯来到山顶露营的艾洛望着好友认真架设相机的背影，心底有些酸涩。

Name: 星辉密证·糖心
Description: 相机会定格所有想要捕捉的瞬间。丽斯将镜头对准艾洛，笑着让艾洛摆个造型，艾洛沉浸在心事中，木着脸摇头。

Name: 星愿纪梦·糖心
Description: 盛大的流星雨如期降临，彷徨无措的艾洛却无心抬起头看一眼。她想，或许自己即将失去最为珍视的星光了。

Name: 无声诺言·糖心
Description: 时间似乎在此刻凝滞，月色下，丽斯的脸覆上一层冷白，回过神来的艾洛没来得及拉住快速钻回帐篷的好友。

Name: 闲适悠梦
Description: 喜爱亲近自然的克罗妮偶尔会带着贝尔蒂去河里摸鱼。贝尔蒂学着姐姐的样子卷起裙摆，感受河水带来的清凉。

Name: 绮丽时光
Description: 贝尔蒂总能在弥漫着墨香的书库找到塔芙利，小女孩总被书架上的服装图册吸引，静静地坐在姐姐身旁仔细阅读。

Name: 纯净之声
Description: 时光就像环绕菲尼酒庄的小河，在不经意间悄然流逝，在家人守护与宠爱的魔法下，贝尔蒂无忧无虑地成长着。

Name: 无忧守护
Description: 远方传来了哒哒的马车声，“爸爸妈妈回来了！”贝尔蒂推开庄园大门，像只可爱的小鸟飞进双亲的怀抱。

Name: 闲适悠梦·华丽
Description: 塔芙利总是有着讲不完的故事，她会绘声绘色地给大家讲述有趣童话中的哲学隐喻，贝尔蒂捧着茶杯听得入迷。

Name: 绮丽时光·华丽
Description: “姐姐又看了好多书呀！”“因为我想成为教师，将知识讲给和你一样可爱的孩子！贝尔蒂未来想做些什么呢？”

Name: 纯净之声·华丽
Description: 姐姐们的鼓励中满是期待：“了不起的梦想！如果能穿上贝尔蒂设计的服装，一定是这世界上最棒的事。”

Name: 无忧守护·华丽
Description: 贝尔蒂紧紧抱住了怀里的画册，大声说：“我要成为服装设计师，把世上所有漂亮的纹样，都点缀在服饰上！”

Name: 闲适悠梦·珍稀
Description: “午茶”系列裙装是贝尔蒂打磨了大半年的得意之作，灵感来源是自己在酒庄时与姐姐们共度的下午茶时光。

Name: 绮丽时光·珍稀
Description: 比赛当天，盛装的姐姐们如约来到后台，穿过堆叠的衣物与喧闹的人声，终于找到了她们曾一同呵护长大的小鸟。

Name: 纯净之声·珍稀
Description: 忽然像是察觉到什么，贝尔蒂抬起头，对上了两位姐姐欣慰的目光，快乐的小鸟欢呼一声，扑向了亲人的怀中。

Name: 无忧守护·珍稀
Description: 贝尔蒂正叼着定位针，全神贯注地为预备上台的模特调整服装，她直起腰擦了擦汗，轻声为模特送出鼓励的话语。

Name: 闲适悠梦·沁
Description: 塔芙利下定决心成为一位教师，她在花园中模拟授课，不断磨炼自己的能力，而姐妹们则是她最忠实的听众。

Name: 绮丽时光·沁
Description: 收到妹妹的设计大赛观赛邀请函时，克罗妮也拿到了心仪学校的聘用书，从此，她将在新的花园里培育幼苗。

Name: 纯净之声·沁
Description: 也许总有一天我们会为梦想而出发，但无论走得多远，家永远是我们出发的原点，是心与灵魂终将回归的栖所。

Name: 无忧守护·沁
Description: 关于自己第一堂课的主题，塔芙利想了很久，在花园里姐妹们常聚会的桌旁待了一整天后，她决定选择“家”。

Name: 闲适悠梦·醇
Description: 起初这个过程并不顺利。某天，克罗妮偶然在做甜品时发现了梦寐以求的宝藏——海蒂当地特级奶酪中的菌种！

Name: 绮丽时光·醇
Description: 新的菌种为菲尼酒庄的经典葡萄酒增添了一抹别样的风味，葡萄酒的回甘中依稀能尝到丝丝缕缕的甜润的奶香。

Name: 纯净之声·醇
Description: 顶尖的品酒师大加赞叹克罗妮酿造的这款葡萄酒——仿佛躺进了最信任的家人的怀抱，令人感到无比安心与惬意。

Name: 无忧守护·醇
Description: 收到妹妹的设计大赛观赛邀请函时，克罗妮正在筹备次日菲尼酒庄新品葡萄酒的发布会，眼中闪烁着自信的光芒。

Name: 馨馥回忆
Description: 某天，水晶宫殿的使者叩响了门扉，带来了令人惊喜的消息——薇安被宫殿的主人选中，成为她的学生。

Name: 初绽花蕾
Description: 喜悦与期待填满了少女的心，曾经无数夜里她遥遥望向月光下的美丽宫殿，却没想到自己真的有一天能走进其中。

Name: 皎月银辉
Description: 冰雪般澄澈透明的大门缓缓敞开，宫殿的主人微笑着向她伸出手，那一幕如同烙印，自此铭刻在少女薇安心中。

Name: 幻梦轻羽
Description: 自此，薇安有了全新的生活。她开始学习古老的文字，聆听蕴含力量的乐曲，练习那些只在传说中出现过的魔法。

Name: 薰风咏颂
Description: 而奥罗拉总温柔地陪在她身边，为她披上温暖的斗篷，在火炉前教她阅读古老的魔法书。水晶宫殿成了她的家。

Name: 馨馥回忆·华丽
Description: 于是某次出行，薇安给奥罗拉带回了一朵花，真实的色彩、香气与触感超越一切文字，奥罗拉的眼睛亮了起来。

Name: 初绽花蕾·华丽
Description: 那只是一朵普通的花，它沐浴晨曦、拥抱朝露，不需要高深的魔法与古老的乐曲，便可在自然的滋养中生长绽放。

Name: 皎月银辉·华丽
Description: 奥罗拉太喜爱那朵花了，她想用魔法使它永远盛开。然而魔法的力量无法干预生命的循环，鲜艳的花瓣终于凋零。

Name: 幻梦轻羽·华丽
Description: 即便是外面世界里最平凡的东西，似乎也离奥罗拉很远。她始终生活在水晶宫殿里，如同美丽樊笼中的囚鸟。

Name: 薰风咏颂·华丽
Description: 薇安没有再说什么，她在奥罗拉身边坐下，大魔法师从窗口望向远方，在沉默中陪伴她们的只有冰冷如水的月光。

Name: 馨馥回忆·珍稀
Description: 她又回到了年幼时那个梦境中，冰冷的银月始终照彻空荡荡的殿堂，无边的空寂里，时间已永久凝固。

Name: 初绽花蕾·珍稀
Description: 在梦境里，薇安无法走动，只能凝望着静谧的银色月光，某种磅礴的情绪席卷了薇安的心，让她不自觉泪流满面。

Name: 皎月银辉·珍稀
Description: 曦光初现，薇安开始了远行，她旅居各地，从云雾缭绕的山谷到金色的麦田，从古老的城邦到海边的小镇。

Name: 幻梦轻羽·珍稀
Description: 人们被薇安的谈吐和学识吸引，许多人开始相信她的言语，将希望寄托于己身，他们对水晶宫殿的虔信随之淡去。

Name: 薰风咏颂·珍稀
Description: 辽阔的世界在少女脚下铺展，然而每个夜晚，少女总会想起多年前水晶门扉敞开那一刻，奥罗拉向她伸出的手。

Name: 馨馥回忆·湛空
Description: 水晶宫殿的消失在最初引起了慌乱，人们失去了内心的支柱和信念，曾经膜拜的强大与永恒烟消云散。

Name: 初绽花蕾·湛空
Description: 薇安走遍大陆埋下的种子在此时萌芽，短暂的惊惶过后，人们用各自的方式寻找着希望与信念，重建精神的寄托。

Name: 皎月银辉·湛空
Description: 它们有的宏大又虚渺，如古老的哲思，穹宇的尽头，有的微小而切实，如一首优美的诗，一朵初绽的花。

Name: 幻梦轻羽·湛空
Description: 奥罗拉不再是高高在上的神明，她和薇安一起踏上了旅途，走遍世界的每一个角落，为每一份微小的幸福而欢喜。

Name: 薰风咏颂·湛空
Description: 水晶宫殿的传说随着吟游诗人的琴音飘过大地与海洋，人们传唱着这温柔的歌谣，怀抱着希望走向前路。

Name: 馨馥回忆·青藤
Description: 离当初那场仓促的分别已经过了很多年，薇安不再是哭闹不休的少女，奥罗拉望着她的眼睛，缓缓讲了一个故事。

Name: 初绽花蕾·青藤
Description: 很久很久以前，经历永暗之灾的人们渴望着希望与光明，一位强大的魔法师筑起了水晶宫殿，庇佑迷茫的人们。

Name: 皎月银辉·青藤
Description: 为了维持宫殿，魔法师耗尽了自己的一切，离开前她选择了天赋极佳的奥罗拉作为继承人，继续背负这份使命。

Name: 幻梦轻羽·青藤
Description: 她选择了薇安作为自己的继承人，茫然的少女踏入沉寂的宿命，得到她的悉心教导，也将背负那重若千钧的责任。

Name: 薰风咏颂·青藤
Description: 然而面对那朵凋零的花，奥罗拉后悔了。她将薇安推回了那个温暖、鲜活的世界，她不想少女的生命也在此枯萎。

Name: 幻瞳灵猫
Description: 考古学家从梦中醒来，他依旧在自己的帐篷中，未行一步，但古堡的方位和大致模样已清晰地印在脑海之中。

Name: 流金秘纹
Description: 落日时分，考古学家按照梦中的指引，在沙漠中找到了古堡的遗迹，他即将揭开一段璀璨文明的神秘面纱。

Name: 幻瞳灵猫·绚
Description: 商人丢掉了所有金币，也许真正的财富并非金银珠宝，他想。迷梦随之散去，沙漠开阔的夜空映入他的眼底。

Name: 流金秘纹·绚
Description: 商人放弃了寻找宝藏的念头，他带着平和的心离开了沙漠，回到家人身边，以辛勤和智慧经营着自己的行商事业。

Name: 幻瞳灵猫·斓
Description: 画家被眼前的美景震撼，他拿起画笔，疯狂地在画布上挥洒着色彩。最后一笔落下，黑猫发出了满意的叫声。

Name: 流金秘纹·斓
Description: 画家从梦中醒来，眼中重新燃起了希望的光芒。他拿起画笔，根据梦中所见所感画出了一幅震撼人心的画作。

Name: 远山云影
Description: 她的世界被苍茫大地和碧蓝天空包围，每一朵云、每一阵风似乎都在对她低语：去远方，去更远的地方。

Name: 旷野天星
Description: 祖母的故事如同不曾停息的长风吹动着她的心，安娅不曾见过海洋，可是生命的潮汐已无数次牵动她的思绪。

Name: 浮光曦色
Description: 小羊一天天长大，安娅也在心中暗暗发誓，总有一天她要去看更遥远的世界，去经历、去感受，抱拥热烈的生命。

Name: 远山云影·归
Description: 有人说她在最接近那颗星星的地方化作微风。有人说她仍骑在白马背上，每当草原起风，就是她又一次回到家乡。

Name: 旷野天星·归
Description: 也有人说，她留下了一本手札记录着一路的见闻。生命的潮汐从未停止，牵引着一代又一代人叩问自己的命运。

Name: 浮光曦色·归
Description: 像曾经的安娅一样，稚嫩的孩子们都期待着遇到自己的白马，她们终会踏着风声启程，在世间寻找生命的自由。

Name: 远山云影·寻
Description: 在迷雾深处，安娅遇见了一匹受伤的白马，它有着一双温柔的眼睛。安娅轻轻安抚着白马，为它包扎伤口。

Name: 旷野天星·寻
Description: 在安娅的精心照料下，白马终于重新站了起来。就在那一刻，遥远的夜空被流星照亮，白马低下头蹭着她的手臂。

Name: 浮光曦色·寻
Description: 白马带着安娅踏上了新的旅途。或许那里没有干旱，没有迷失，只有无尽的自由。穿过呼啸的风，她一路向前。

Name: 时尚引领
Description: 如何牢牢固定布料，如何既能保持舒适又能增添服装的立体感，在无数次实践后，茉利斯终于掌握了设计的精髓。

Name: 坚定视线
Description: 茉利斯常和同学们一起讨论色彩搭配的创新——怎样才能让温柔的粉色更具独立感，让冷郁的蓝色更具有侵略性。

Name: 可爱趋势
Description: 在毕业典礼上，证书被老师正式颁发给茉利斯，它见证了一个少女所有的努力和成长，还有同学间深厚的情谊。

Name: 缤纷沁饮
Description: 同学与老师一起为茉利斯举杯，庆祝她成功完成了人生中的第一次蜕变，祝福她在未来的人生里不惧怕任何困难。

Name: 时尚引领·檬
Description: 茉利斯在人台模特上尝试了多种设计，不管是碎花点缀的修身裙装，还是松弛飘逸的职场套装，总难令自己满意。

Name: 坚定视线·檬
Description: 创意陷入僵局，昏头涨脑的茉利斯轻啜了一口朋友送来的柠檬气泡水，灵感如晨曦穿透云层，一切豁然开朗。

Name: 可爱趋势·檬
Description: 采用柠檬明亮的黄色为主色调，巧妙地将清新活力与职业感融为一体，让人一眼望去便觉得精神焕发，干劲十足。

Name: 缤纷沁饮·檬
Description: 当实习生穿上这套匠心独运的职场套装时，她的脸上绽放出惊喜的笑容，不住称赞茉利斯高水准的剪裁与创新力。

Name: 时尚引领·萄
Description: 格纹是文艺工作者喜爱的经典元素，眼前的深色布匹恰好适合打造优雅的下装，再配一顶简约的帽子，相得益彰。

Name: 坚定视线·萄
Description: 紫色西装明艳大胆，用于上镜再好不过，一条同色领带作为主题点缀，恰到好处地展现了记者的专业与品味。

Name: 可爱趋势·萄
Description: 这场发布会不仅让记者在荧幕中大放异彩，更让茉利斯的品牌在各界名流中声名鹊起，赢得了广泛的赞誉与认可。

Name: 缤纷沁饮·萄
Description: 茉利斯的设计，不仅为每个年轻女孩的职场之路增添了自信与风采，更在无数成功的瞬间，书写自己的时尚传奇。

Name: Afternoon Tea Break
Description: Clink! Lottie set down the teapot a little too hard, nearly toppling the tea tin. Bono sighed, paw to his forehead.

Name: Detective Bono
Description: Bono was a true detective: steady, calm and sharp. No clue, no matter how small, could escape his watchful eyes.

Name: Lady's Etiquette
Description: Mind your manners...' Bono began, as Lottie shoved her hat down over unruly hair and tore open the letter.

Name: Curious Enigma
Description: Madame Dupont wrote in distress from her manor. Her treasured gem brooch had vanished, leaving her sleepless.

Name: Silent Testimony
Description: Lottie soon won the hearts of the staff. The head maid said the Madame's kitten, too, had disappeared recently.

Name: Elegant Style
Description: Bono found the cat on the cupboard, batting the brooch like a toy. Madame gave it an affectionate, helpless pinch.

Name: Vivid Encounter
Description: Lottie found the grieving Madame in the garden. Her witty comfort brought a smile, lifting the gloom bit by bit.

Name: Secrets Unveiled
Description: Bono's investigation revealed some clues: tiny paw prints on the table, snagged curtains, a slightly opened window…

Name: Tea-Time Whispers
Description: Mystery solved. Sunlight bathed the procelain cups. Busy detectives? Now, they're tea-sipping lady and gentlemen.

Name: Retro Reflection
Description: Lottie and Bono compare notes in the hall. Paw prints, fabric snags, the missing cat… Could the culprit be…?

Name: Graceful Poise
Description: Lottie narrowed her eyes in comfort. Solving cases is delightful, but so is a warm cup of tea under the sunshine.

Name: Purehearted Moments
Description: Lottie always keeps her cheerful sincerity. With that open heart, she often uncovers the most useful clues.

Name: Verdant Terrace
Description: From Lantis's poise and grace, people gradually guessed her true identity, yet chose to guard the princess's secret.

Name: Veil of Dawn
Description: A relentless plague swept through the kingdom. Windows and doors were shut tight. The bustling streets fell silent.

Name: Crystal Dewfall
Description: Ignoring all pleas, Lantis drove the carriage meant for her safety straight toward a mysterious, perilous valley.

Name: Verdant Gleam
Description: The horse carried Lantis back. Unconscious, she still clutched the withered lantis flower and its seeds.

Name: Golden Radiance
Description: Amid sheer cliffs bloomed the flower she sought. She climbed on, rocks tearing her hands, yet she never paused.

Name: Glistening Teardrops
Description: Even if it was a myth, Lantis vowed to find the flower bearing her name, risking everything for a thread of hope.

Name: Dawnlight Veil
Description: People cheered the kingdom's salvation and rejoiced at Lantis's awakening. Her tale was passed down through ages.

Name: Petal Heartlock
Description: Irena's words float like feathers. Lonna sees a sea of roses as fairies bring a chest with her long-awaited health.

Name: Radiant Verses
Description: Dawn and dusk pass. Encouraged by Irena, Lonna lifts the watering can, watching sunlight turn droplets into rainbows.

Name: Garden Fragrance
Description: With Irena's support, Lonna finally steps from the room and sows fragrant flower seeds into the soft courtyard soil.

Name: Clustered Blossoms
Description: Sitting among flowers, Irena holds Lonna, telling her tales of bees or humming songs about the blossoms.

Name: Prelude of Breeze
Description: How to check humidity, prune leaves, and care for buds… Irena is both a skilled gardener and a gentle guardian.

Name: Leisurely Daydreams
Description: On the night the last bud blooms, Lonna waits patiently, watching fairies surround a flower spirit beneath the moon.

Name: Waltz of Roses
Description: Time passes quietly. Buds fill the branches, and now Lonna can crouch to watch them grow herself.

Name: Tender Secret Vow
Description: Moonlight pours down, briefly revealing the flower spirit's face. It is Irena, with her warm smile and tender eyes!

Name: Splendid Poem
Description: Morning breeze drifts through the garden, carrying the story. Each blooming rose becomes a tender poem in time.

Name: Rosy Zephyr
Description: The roses bloom hundreds of times. In a sudden wind, Rosalina sees her teacher close her eyes with a gentle smile.

Name: Romantic Paean
Description: The song embraces the flowers like the spring's gentle touch. Finally, the slumbering roses start to bloom.

Name: Scentful Wings
Description: Maybe love, companionship and music can awaken the spring. They embrace the girl playing the violin, like invisible wings.

Name: Redolent Dew
Description: People know Rosalina, but not her teacher, who was as brilliant, yet had never left a rose garden in her life.

Name: Blooming Promise
Description: Rosalina asks every doctor but finds no cure. She can only watch as her teacher's life wilts away.

Name: Vivacious Lilt
Description: It could be for nothing, but Rosalina starts playing in the garden. A melody as sweet as spring flows through the air.

Name: Glorious Variation
Description: Her teacher insists on returning home. She'd stare outside the window at the roses that still refuse to bloom.

Name: Unfinished Tune
Description: Rosalina thinks of the Sound of Spring. Countless musicians tried for many years, but none could succeed.

Name: Street Whispers
Description: Eddie looks around alertly to locate the low growls. With a metallic screech, a giant shadow suddenly leaps out.

Name: Discerning Moment
Description: A metallic beast? The girl tenses up, but soon her nerves turn into surprise. It's a group of small animals.

Name: Confidential Archive
Description: She scans the tags on the animals and quickly taps on the keyboard to pull their experiment records.

Name: Unbound Spirit
Description: Experiment 347: all 30 subjects showed enhanced skin durability and physical strength after injection of metallizers.'

Name: Tip-Tap on Leaf
Description: Cecilia decides to wait behind the burrow first. But what if Miana still doesn't like cats and refuses to take her gift?

Name: Home Underground
Description: We must be friends now!' Cecilia brings a small cake to Miana's home and knocks on the door.

Name: Woodland Ballad
Description: The mouse peeks her head out to see the inviting cake. The cat by her door smiles, 'Shall we go on an adventure together?'

Name: Fragrant Sonnet
Description: Cecilia is an adventurer who dreams of traveling to every corner of the forest, but this time, she's in big trouble.

Name: Little Blessing
Description: Plants can become dangerous traps in the rainy season. Cecilia loses her balance and rolls to the edge of a cliff.

Name: Kitten Charm
Description: A branch catches Cecilia in midair. She meows with fear, her head still dizzy and ears flattened in panic.

Name: Friendship Bond
Description: Carried by the wind, Cecilia floats safely to the ground on the dandelion glider, but Miana runs off once again.

Name: Bluebell Dream
Description: What now? Cecilia holds onto the branch in despair, and then she sees the small yet powerful figure that is Miana!

Name: Curvy Tail
Description: Tying large leaves with dandelions, Miana leaps between branches and ties the handmade glider to Cecilia's tail.

Name: Decadent Banquet
Description: The girl's fate transformed. Shadows from the past fire seemed to vanish as the lady led her into sunlight.

Name: Traces of Memory
Description: Noble life was arduous. The lady hired top teachers for Audrey. Heavy etiquette had to be mastered from scratch.

Name: Flickering Candlelight
Description: Every child hoped to be adopted by her. This noble lady chose Audrey from the orphanage's many expectant children.

Name: Curtain of Fate
Description: In a poor orphanage, Audrey met an elegant, luxuriously dressed lady who captivated the children.

Name: Scattered Pearl Light
Description: Audrey blossomed under strict tutelage into the beautiful, elegant, and clever renowned Flower of the Kingdom.

Name: Fleeting Old Dream
Description: By day, Audrey was graceful, but in dreams, she remained the little girl crying in the burning village.

Name: Glistening Moon
Description: Audrey's grand coming-of-age ceremony was witnessed by nobles. Afterwards, her adoptive lady revealed a secret.

Name: Eternal Star
Description: From then, revenge burned. The air again smelled of scorched earth and blood. She never forgot that night.

Name: Sweet Dirge
Description: She received the Duke's invitation. Audrey stored the card, knowing her final grand feast was about to begin.

Name: Elegy of Years
Description: Audrey felt increasingly tormented, often wanting to knock on the lady's door and ask: what did I mean to you?

Name: Unspoken Omen
Description: She attended more banquets, thriving from years of training, quickly becoming the events' indispensable soul.

Name: Rosetone Oath
Description: Audrey executed her plan steadily. The lady never interfered, making her suspect this was exactly what she wanted.

Name: Rosefire Doom
Description: The great fire was a noble's plot, not natural. Fate's gears turned. Audrey looked up but saw not a single star.

Name: Blood and Tears
Description: The bell chimed, and the banquet began. The crystal chandelier refracted lights, like thousands of stars scattered.

Name: Blossom of the Grand Court
Description: Her noble adopter needed an heir, not a daughter. It wasn't love, but an artist sculpting a masterpiece.

Name: Ripples of Time
Description: Flames spread from somewhere unknown. Chaos ensued as crowds fled. Only Audrey walked forward, calm and unhurried.

Name: Silent Dreams
Description: She stepped over the motionless Duke, paused amidst the chaos, and calmly took a pastry.

Name: Gloomy Night
Description: Why waste it?' she laughed, settling gracefully. She had never forgotten the days when hunger clawed at her.

Name: Toll of Extinction
Description: The raging flames mirrored the village fire years ago, grimly equalizing commoners and nobles alike.

Name: Delusive Feast
Description: A familiar voice called her name: 'Audrey!' She glanced back. The figure in her eyes was unmistakably known.

Name: Echo of Memory
Description: The ever-graceful lady rarely showed such an expression. Disheveled and stained, she moved through the flames.

Name: Guttering Candle
Description: Sin and hatred dissolved in ashes as city bells echoed. 'What did I mean to you?' Audrey already held the answer.

Name: Curtain of Destiny
Description: In the flames, the lost soul found salvation. The Flower of the Kingdom bloomed amidst blood and fire.

Name: Sweet Trap
Description: Sweet cakes and wine. Love, hatred and desire swirling like a stormy sea... Are you ready to join this feast?

Name: Curtain Unraised
Description: The world has cold spectators, and perfect role-players. On fate's stage, tragedies and comedies shift endlessly.

Name: Fleeting Luminescence
Description: Does this path bring happiness?' Such doubts often make us hesitate and wall us away from the joy we seek.

Name: Guardian Pledge
Description: Will you accept my trial to become the bravest warrioress?' Her voice rang cold like an unceasing, frigid wind.

Name: Everlasting Faith
Description: On the expanse of snow stood a warrioress in ancient armor, holding a spear with a banner flapping in the wind.

Name: Snowswept Spear
Description: Sigrun used the broken spear as a weapon to practice charging and combat. That night, she suddenly woke from a dream.

Name: Midnight Ruins
Description: The ancient broken spear was tied to a worn banner. Sigrun didn't recognize the pattern but felt its fighting will.

Name: Eternal Sanctuary
Description: Sigrun nodded with no hesitation. As the warrioress vanished in a blink, the snowfield turned into a moonlit glade.

Name: Frostplume Glint
Description: Sigrun leaned to dodge the wolf lunging at her. As it clawed her shoulder, she pushed her dagger into its throat.

Name: Ribbon of Honor
Description: The cavalry in silver armor rode fast. Sigrun took a few hits and finally shot her opponent down with her spear.

Name: Ode to Silvermoon
Description: The glade became a battlefield where the enemy vanguard charged at her. Sigrun swung her spear and pushed them back.

Name: Glacial Guardian
Description: You are now a brave warrior with unwavering faith and willpower to pass all trials.' The warrioress praised her.

Name: Wintry Trial
Description: Sigrun always stood back up until illusions cleared. The warrioress reappeared and laid a hand on Sigrun's spear.

Name: Triumphant Valor
Description: As the sky cleared, Sigrun noticed the broken spear was anew. She took it with her and joined the guards.

Name: Momo's Delicious Adventure
Description: People are celebrating the festival at the fair! Follow the smell of malt and find Momo in a pile of food!

Name: Creamy Foam
Description: The glass brims with creamy foam. Take a gulp and indulge in the crisp and rich smell of malt—another one!

Name: Country Celebration
Description: People smile with hope amidst the cheerful songs. Put on the traditional green felt hat and join the celebration!

Name: Gourmet Snack
Description: Get in line for the special smoked sausage. Top-notch taste with crispy casings and juicy meat.

Name: Misty Silhouette
Description: Bai murmured, 'To restore peace, we have to clear the plague. There's one more ingredient for the cure...'

Name: Immaculate Moonlight
Description: Yan tightened his grip. Seeing the pain on his face, she changed the subject and smiled, 'Let's go home.'

Name: Celestial Mirage
Description: People still remembered the night years later: a strange, blinding light on the mountain that vanished in a blink.

Name: Healing Codex
Description: The next day, strangely enough, Yan shared a remedy with the town, and all the patients were cured within months.

Name: Celestial Blossoms
Description: The city was restored to its former bustle. People thanked Yan but tacitly avoided one thing: the absence of Bai by his side.

Name: Vanilla Brew
Description: The coffee shop's signature is Vanilla Brew: sweet vanilla blends smoothly with the gentle bitterness of coffee.

Name: Butter Foam
Description: As ideas form in the rich aroma, she takes out her notes and writes down her feelings at the moment.

Name: Hazelnut Mocha
Description: The tiredness of the day melts away in the gentle sunset. She sips on the mocha, enjoying the moment of happiness.

Name: Fluffy Puppy
Description: Every morning, Pete wakes the girl with his wet snout and warm breath and then wags his tail to play innocently.

Name: 流彩凝香
Description: 浅蓝、淡紫、粉金……画中色彩既丰富又和谐，自由流畅的笔触描绘出了花朵的形态，它们融入了水面的涟漪间。

Name: 灵感之舟
Description: 睡莲池带给了他无穷无尽的灵感。每一天，甚至是同一天的不同时刻，睡莲池都会呈现出独特而绮丽的光彩。

Name: 湖光莲影
Description: 在画家笔下，水是睡莲的栖息地，也是光的容器，他热衷于描摹阳光与微风亲吻过的湖面每道涟漪的光影。

Name: 霓霞芳菲
Description: 绽放的莲瓣如升腾的火焰，画家借自然的造物抒发自己内心的情感，用创作传达自己对生命与艺术的领悟。

Name: 栖露琼英
Description: 《睡莲》并未选用传统的地平线视角，而是聚焦在池塘表面，创造出空间上的模糊感，让观者恍若置身水景之中。

Name: 绮想印记
Description: 睡莲本身便隐喻着生命轮回。盛绽的莲瓣象征着生机与希望，而没入水中的叶盘暗合凋零之意，二者密不可分。

Name: 碧潭晴花
Description: 天空沉入水中，而睡莲悬于水面，现实与虚幻的界限在涟漪中瓦解，此刻，整个宇宙仿佛都浓缩于这片水域。

Name: Quirky Inspiration
Description: In the humid wind, Aya hums off-key and heads home with a shopping bag. Something good's about to happen!

Name: Casual Charm
