Description: Aya feels a pat and turns to see her friend back from her trip! Dragging a suitcase, she makes a silly face at Aya.

Name: Free Imagination
Description: Her friend came back early just to fulfill Aya's small wish—to watch the fireworks show tomorrow with her best friend.

Name: Future Course
Description: They talk and laugh until Aya suddenly thinks of something and opens her bag, revealing two bottles of seltzer.

Name: Striped Impression
Description: Puddles still dot the road, and leaves glisten with fine droplets. The girls skip along hand in hand, laughing as they go.

Name: 馥郁往事
Description: 渐渐的，笑意重新出现在他的脸上，薰风的吹拂之中，他回到桌前，拿起画笔，流畅的线条从笔端流泻而出。

Name: 琳琅华灯
Description: 男子拧着眉，似乎遇到了什么烦心的事，他放下手中的古籍，踱步走到窗边，眼神投向葳蕤的庭院。

Name: 鎏晶璃彩
Description: “你说呢，雷蒙德？”男子转过身，他的眉目柔和，正是年轻时的萨耶王，似乎是听到了回答，他微笑起来。

Name: 慵懒小憩
Description: 琉璃的光影让眼前的画面再次变得迷蒙，当一切重新清晰，出现在眼前的男子似乎变得年长了一些。

Name: 隽永情韵
Description: 眼前的光影再次晕染成一片繁丽的色彩，再次睁开眼时，男子已经垂垂老矣，正靠在椅中，闭目思考着什么。

Name: 靛青秘语
Description: 一阵敲门声响起，暖暖顺着萨耶王的视线看去，少女有些拘谨地从半开的门后探出头：“老师，我有些问题……“

Name: 昔日纪念
Description: “老师，萨耶王给您的建议究竟是什么意思呢？我还是感觉不太理解。”似乎有人在遥远的地方发问。

Name: 朦胧夜色
Description: “你在这里的想法很好，不过……”萨耶王轻轻点了点手中的设计图，细致地讲解着，少女捧着笔记，频频点头。

Name: 幽杳流辉
Description: “老师，我还有一个问题想问。”少女略带犹豫地开口，“我近来总是感觉缺乏灵感，您有什么建议吗？”

Name: 黑白谶言
Description: 萨耶王温和地笑了：“孩子，那是我们一生的课题，但于我而言，灵感就是此时此刻，以及每时每刻。”

Name: 清幽往事
Description: “在鲁尔特丹初遇萨耶之后，我和他一起踏上了一段奇妙的旅程。我们看过北地的雪原，听过寒雾海的潮声。”

Name: 迷离盏影
Description: “收到你的来信后，我去展馆附近走了走，一些我本觉得忘却已久的记忆忽然浮上心头，我想也许你会感兴趣。”

Name: 暮光璃彩
Description: 少女拿起另一封信笺，白蜡树底纹衬着流畅而洒脱的笔迹，那是雷蒙德校长寄来的回信。

Name: 慵懒浅眠
Description: 脑海中的思绪万千，少女抬起头，望向窗外，澄澈的天空下回荡着孩童的欢笑，清风捎来花朵的芳香。

Name: 雍容闲雅
Description: “旅途的最后，我们又回到了这里。把自己关在书房里数十天后，他带着一沓设计图找到了我，眼里满是喜悦。”

Name: 瑰色秘话
Description: “设计图里有冰原上的风和神色凛冽的战士，有宁州城的月亮和等待归人的女子，有我们看过的每一处风景。”

Name: 旧日谶语
Description: 无数记忆与话语如同繁复的彩窗，能否从那些过去的时光中折射出一个真实的萨耶王呢？少女并不确定。

Name: 晓风微雨
Description: “他一张张翻给我看，情绪随着那些设计而起落。那一刻我意识到，每走过一步，他都在用心与这片大陆对话。”

Name: 熠目璨光
Description: 绚丽的光影仿佛又在眼前变幻轮转，时光的长河徐徐流动，少女向上游望去，岁月的迷雾之中，似有辉芒亮起。

Name: 莹澈记忆
Description: 那似乎是无数琉璃碎片，在岁月之河的粼粼波光中缓缓凝聚，少女闭上眼，让那璀璨的璃光轻轻落在她的掌心。

Name: Pitter-Patter on Leaf
Description: The rain stops! Drops of water roll from the leaves into the soil, as sunlight paints them a light shade of gold.

Name: Secret Dwelling
Description: Miana dislikes cats for their excessive energy and curiosity. She's never thought she'd cross paths with Cecilia.

Name: Forest Chorus
Description: Tender shoots break through the soil, flowers bloom, and the forest awakens. In the breeze, nature sings a song of life.

Name: Fate's Weave
Description: Seeking, guiding, unspooling fate—she says every answer is woven into the vast sea of stars.

Name: Midnight Lament
Description: The silence breaks: a hooded man enters, greed flickering in his eyes even in the dark.

Name: Dream Mirage
Description: She pushes the coins aside, tracing the crystal as starlight shapes a lonely, trembling figure.

Name: Zephyr's Oracle
Description: Evil… Perhaps, in this kingdom, there is nowhere to hide.' Her voice drifts like a far-off wind.

Name: Crossroads of Night
Description: He ignores her warning. Enraged, he shatters the crystal ball, a knife flashing toward her.

Name: Radiant Nightfall
Description: A beggar's cane blooms into a sword; beneath the cloak, royal silver armor and a solemn face.

Name: Gleaming Shadow
Description: In a blink, she stands outside. He lunges and misses—the blade meets an approaching figure.

Name: Glimmering Compass
Description: Fortune-teller,' he demands, 'prove your gift. Use your compass to find me a truly safe haven.'

Name: Evening Benediction
Description: May starlight always guide you.' She touches the blade, then becomes a bird and vanishes into night.

Name: Star's Miracle
Description: When calm returns, the knight turns to her. She lifts a hand—broken starlight mends the crystal.

Name: Warm Romance
Description: Feeling a bit chilly…' The traveler sips coffee, letting warmth and food chase away fatigue and cold.

Name: Fluffy Wishes
Description: The painter stays at a mountain inn, pondering new works in the hot springs to bring the scenery to more people.

Name: Puppy Sprint
Description: One day, Hazel receives a new order for 'a cure for loneliness.' She stares at it and ponders for a long while.

Name: Brisk Ride
Description: The fan whirs in the room as Buddy naps on the floor. Hazel hums and starts work. She's got a good idea.

Name: Speckled Time
Description: Years ago, Hazel was a quiet girl who always sat alone in the park, watching the beautiful sunset hues.

Name: Safe Sentry
Description: She was lonely but didn't know how to make friends. Then she chanced upon a mysterious express delivery service.

Name: Pink Bubble Gum
Description: Though skeptical, Hazel placed an order. She didn't wish for much—just to not watch the sunset alone.

Name: Temporal Whisper
Description: One afternoon, a quirky girl stopped before her, holding a chubby puppy and smiling at her in the sunset.

Name: Metallic Chic
Description: When the girl left, Hazel offered to continue the job for her. They shared a smile as Buddy rolled around.

Name: Delightful Boon
Description: The girl became Hazel's first friend. She learned the city's many secrets: discounts at night and delicious sodas.

Name: Primal Longing
Description: The girl let the traveler rest in a dry, warm cave and gathered herbs for him every day.

Name: Wayward Spirit
Description: She often visited him while he rested. Stories of heroic warriors and clever merchants always engrossed her.

Name: Ferocious Fang
Description: Later, I grew to understand her.' The traveler pokes the fire. 'The forest might be lonely, but it was her home.'

Name: Robust Physique
Description: The girl didn't appear the next day. Ready to leave, he found food and water left beside his belongings.

Name: Marine Fantasy
Description: Upon closer look, her smile is blurry on the phone, but the flowers are perfectly clear… Fidira laughs hard.

Name: Heartfelt Snapshot
Description: A faint blush rises on the young man's ears as he lifts his phone, capturing the girl sipping coffee, unaware.

Name: Romantic Tea Time
Description: Look, I caught a cute little fish!' she shows him a photo of him and a clownfish looking at each other.

Name: Azure Windowpane
Description: Snap! Lost in the underwater world, he turns, eyes wide, and Fidira giggles, snapping several more photos of him.

Name: Graceful Dart
Description: Their meeting is still a bit away. Imagining his delight seeing the fish makes Fidira's heart even sweeter.

Name: Joyful Whispers
Description: A familiar figure appears, the well-dressed young man hurries over, his hand trembling slightly from nerves.

Name: Threads of Love
Description: Noticing him eyeing her necklace, she leans closer for a better view. He blushes at her beauty, waving his hands.

Name: Elegant Essence
Description: A playful thought sparks. Fidira takes out her phone and aims it at her boyfriend, absorbed in watching the fish.

Name: Seeing Starlight
Description: As expected, his eyes light up as he sees the magical underwater world, like a lake reflecting sparkling stars.

Name: Aromatic Moments
Description: Fidira knows the café menu by heart. Her vivid, personal commentary brings a smile to his face.

Name: Key to Charm
Description: In the final photo, Fidira strikes a 'Yay' pose, fish swimming behind her, while he gazes at her with gentle focus.

Name: Echoing Chirp
Description: Serpents had tough scales and sharp fangs, so agility alone wasn't enough. How could they reclaim their land?

Name: Broadleaf Thicket
Description: At seventeen, Nadia met a traveler with a rucksack and hiking pole, who cleared bushes with practiced ease.

Name: Sunlit Glade
Description: Nadia grew up listening to stories of the rainforest and set her heart on leading her people back home.

Name: Fluffy Ears
Description: The clan gathered around the traveler, listening to his stories of crossing seas and seeing the world.

Name: Whispering Wind
Description: The traveler showed them fascinating objects from the outside world, from a golden compass to a jeweled dagger.

Name: Shimmering Vision
Description: The traveler spoke of bustling bazaars in city-states, oases in deserts, and exciting adventures across azure seas.

Name: Dazzling Wonder
Description: He told them of human civilization. But how did humans survive and prosper without claws or fangs?

Name: Prismatic Brilliance
Description: Nadia met all kinds of people in strange kingdoms. Clever merchants could negotiate any deal.

Name: Aureate Radiance
Description: Fascinated by the traveler's stories, Nadia could almost see the world beyond the rain and fog of the forest.

Name: Languid Respite
Description: Despite the elders' warnings, Nadia took human form and ventured beyond the rainforest.

Name: Peak Mastery
Description: Curiosity took root in Nadia's heart like a seed and eventually grew into an irresistible urge.

Name: Runes of Wisdom
Description: Nadia realized humans held the key to defeating the serpents. Reclaiming their land was no longer a dream.

Name: Drifting Serenade
Description: On a quiet afternoon, the cubs listened to tales as Nadia rested on a bough, swaying her tail.

Name: Gleaming Hope
Description: Under Nadia's lead, they embraced the outside world, reviving their forest with human wisdom.

Name: Lush Foliage
Description: They surrounded the traveler, but he greeted them warmly as if nothing was unusual.

Name: Ancient Trade Port
Description: After learning the truth, the City Lord banished the aristocrat and granted Jalifah half his amassed wealth.

Name: Jade-Tinted Ripples
Description: Jalifah let the servant follow the aristocrat's plan while she prepared another batch of spices for the Lord.

Name: Splendid Curios
Description: The aristocrat couldn't wait to report her when her boat docked, unaware that he was walking into his own trap.

Name: Dreamlike Redolence
Description: Jalifah told the Lord someone had ruined her other batch meant for the people and asked him to investigate.

Name: Glamorous Poise
Description: Her brilliance also led to jealousy. Eyeing her wealth, an aristocrat hatched a despicable plan.

Name: Lustrous Pearls
Description: The aristocrat sent a servant to buy her exquisite goldware, then replaced it with gold-painted copperware.

Name: Ambrosial Boon
Description: Jalifah once helped the servant when he was down on his luck, so he revealed the aristocrat's entire plan.

Name: Resplendent Glow
Description: In court, the aristocrat accused Jalifah of passing off copperware as gold. Jalifah calmly sent for a witness.

Name: Aureate Brocade
Description: When the truth came out, the crowd cheered for Jalifah as the aristocrat faced punishment for his scheme.

Name: Delicate Clasp
Description: The resentful aristocrat sent a servant into Jalifah's caravan to spoil the spices she was selling to the Lord.

Name: Lavish Splendor
Description: Lies cannot hide the truth. Jalifah revealed hidden marks on her goods, while the copperware bore none.

Name: Glamorous Charm
Description: Merchants still follow Jalifah's wisdom: 'Wealth, like water, must flow. Still waters fade; flowing fortunes grow.'

Name: Shimmering Pearls
Description: The trade routes she blazed crossed seas and deserts, bringing wealth and prosperity along the way.

Name: Starlit Tranquility
Description: A deity woke up to the sound of prayers. She pitied human suffering but didn't know how to save mortals.

Name: Resplendent Light
Description: Above, the weather changed at her will. She had never experienced chaos nor understood what they wished for.

Name: Unceasing Devotion
Description: With curiosity and sympathy, she shed her crown and descended upon the mortal world as an ordinary girl.

Name: Stellar Radiance
Description: The weather was fine when she came. Villagers welcomed her and shared their forecasting methods.

Name: Time's Reverie
Description: But the night stretched on. Fear and insecurity spread among the villagers, and soon a storm hit the village.

Name: Gilded Blue Amber
Description: Food rotted in the rain while hunger loomed. Villagers had to brave the dark to hunt.

Name: Distant Shadows
Description: If only we could foresee the sunrise and ensure crops grew, so no hunter had to go out in the dark.'

Name: Sands of Ages
Description: Hearing their wishes, the deity bade farewell and returned to her temple to bring order to days and seasons.

Name: Sincere Paean
Description: She had never experienced chaos or suffering and thought mortals were happier than herself.

Name: Reverent Prayer
Description: After dark, people sat around fires to talk and share food. Their joy even moved the deity herself.

Name: Unceasing Prayer
Description: People rejoiced, for the sun and moon rose in harmony, and they no longer feared prolonged darkness or heat.

Name: Stellar Refulgence
Description: Children grew healthy as day and night followed their order, and farmers sowed and harvested by season.

Name: Reverie of Time
Description: People built a temple on the highest hill for the deity's blessing and prayed for the order and hope she brought.

Name: Spirit's Blessing
Description: She looks at the praying girl and raises her hand. A gentle light flashes, restoring color to her pale, weary face.

Name: Ancient Tree Spirit
Description: Her gown is made of pure white snow and ice, drifting behind as she walks, scattering snowflakes everywhere.

Name: Crown of Hope
Description: Her presence fills the town with warmth and hope. Each year, the square hosts a grand festival for her.

Name: Jade-Green Crystal
Description: People send her ice sculptures of vivid animals and grand palaces, filled with their heartfelt blessings.

Name: Sacred Gleam
Description: She adorns the town with ice magic. Ice flowers dangle from rooftops as crystal ice arches rise.

Name: Tender Vigil
Description: She has answered too many prayers and now must sleep. People guard her tree in shifts. Someone is always there.

Name: Spring Herald
Description: Against dark magic, people stand with weapons raised. She is their guardian and their dear and trusted friend.

Name: Jade-Kissed Ice
Description: An evil mage hungers for her power. He lurks in the dark. The vigilant people catch him before he strikes.

Name: Healing Spell
Description: The people's sincere care is her best medicine. She smiles. 'But there is something more urgent right now.'

Name: Lasting Blessing
Description: The battle wakes her from slumber. She rises, drives back the darkness, and bathes the people in healing light.

Name: Pure Radiance
Description: The town holds another festival. The spirit sings with the people, offering a pure and wonderful blessing.

Name: Ethereal Cloudscape
Description: Silk and jewels were offered to the envoy, but he continued to ransack households for more.

Name: Radiant Harmony
Description: No more dancing around bonfires. Ariya gazed at the sky, thinking the deities shouldn't do this to people.

Name: Hills and Dales
Description: He said the tribe should serve him perfectly, or the deities would punish them with disaster.

Name: Morning Serenity
Description: Later, he demanded they offer up children as slaves. Ariya confronted him with her people and cast him out.

Name: Celestial Resonance
Description: Enraged, the envoy cast a cruel spell: if they didn't kill the disrespectful one, the tribe would suffer for eternity.

Name: Blessed Grace
Description: Maybe the deities heard her prayer. Moments later, Ariya rose into the air, overlooking the vast world.

Name: Enigmatic Fate
Description: From that day on, the sun scorched, and the desert stretched wherever Ariya's tribe migrated.

Name: Starlit Serenity
Description: The wind carried rain afar, breathing life into everything and blessing her people living by the water.

Name: Whispering Hills
Description: She recounted the envoy's sins and her people's suffering. 'It must change, even at the cost of my life.'

Name: Glimmering Chime
Description: The people didn't blame Ariya, but she couldn't bear their suffering. She left quietly on a starlit night.

Name: Brilliant Sunrise
Description: Seeing her people panic after her disappearance, Ariya sent the truth as a breeze brushing their cheeks.

Name: Puppy Mischief
Description: Liko's puppies have smooth hair, wear cute bows, and make faces at the camera. Her albums are full of their photos.

Name: Trail of Paws
Description: At the end of the alley is Wintermount's most beautiful beach, where the puppies leave a string of paw prints.

Name: Guardian Puppy
Description: Pups Power On! Rain or shine, they always wag their tails and run to Liko when they see her from afar.

Name: Breezy Summer
Description: In the refreshing ocean breeze, the puppies sing a lovely duet on their first boat ride as Liko laughs with waves.

Name: Star Coordinates
Description: Liko often forgets her fluffy hairclip, and the smart puppies can even bring it back before she notices it's gone.

Name: Cozy Cuddle
Description: In the bright sunshine in Wintermount, the puppies sprint to the beach while Liko chases breathlessly behind.

Name: Whimsy Overload
Description: Liko is a haven for the puppies. Exhausted, they lie side by side by the girl, rubbing their heads on her palms.

Name: Tidebound Rhyme
Description: The strange alley is a maze of flowers. They flow in the wind like a purple tide, mesmerizing the lost girl.

Name: Yanyue the Jiao
Description: That night, she releases Yanyue into the stream and whispers, 'Go. Be free. May we both find where we belong.'

Name: Delicate Coral
Description: Yanyue thinks she's met a girl shining like a pearl, ambitious and seeking more than comfort.

Name: Dawnlit Silhouette
Description: Yanyue uses her remaining energy to take human form. She finds the girl on a rocky trail, a pack on her shoulder.

Name: One of a Kind
Description: The traveling girl grows into a legendary florist. Yanyue returns each spring to see her shining pearl.

Name: Legacy in Bloom
Description: She shares her garden freely. Whoever follows the scent to her is welcomed and offered all her knowledge.

Name: Unheard Tidings
Description: Yanyue hears no news of her for five years. Some say she vanished seeking seeds; others say she rose into the sky.

Name: Floral Grace
Description: She searches high and low, but never sees her friend again. The unspoken goodbye traps her heart and soul.

Name: Blossom's Devotion
Description: Spring comes again. In a daze, Yanyue sees her once more, the girl vowing to her mother to be the best florist ever.

Name: Sunshower Tears
Description: She stays in the garden her friend left until it becomes a landmark, with her flowers blooming in every home.

Name: Phantom Spirits
Description: What's he doing? Kuro is puzzled. He holds the poster and lags behind the group, trying not to draw attention.

Name: One-Eyed Specter
Description: Ah! Is he pretending to be a monster? Kuro suddenly realizes and glances again, thinking he's actually quite cute!

Name: Illusory Shadows
Description: The group dwindles as monsters vanish into the whirlpool. The boy moves on, hearing the witch's voice before home.

Name: Otherworld Path
Description: At the crossroad of the otherworld, energy flows chaotically, yet lost souls sense the path home clearly.

Name: Crimson Haze
Description: Hmm?' Kuro pauses, noticing a curled human shadow cast by the moonlight at the corner ahead.

Name: Flowing Heartstream
Description: His breath quickens, faint sobs escaping. Clearly alarmed, he seems to have entered this world completely unprepared.

Name: True Guidance
Description: He looks around, eyes landing on a worn poster on the wall. He tears it down and presses it against his face.

Name: Illusionary Trail
Description: Oh!' 'Awoo!' 'Clatter!' Strange little monsters respond one by one, their chaotic minds awakening in Kuro's magic.

Name: Frightful Shackles
Description: A human drawn here… Kuro walks on, glancing at him. Though his face is hidden by the poster, he is clearly a boy.

Name: Lingering Wraith
Description: Kuro notices the boy shiver, watching her through his fingers. He stands slowly but doesn't follow right away.

Name: Starlight Trace
Description: Stay close! Once we pass the crossroad, you'll see the door home!' Kuro teases. 'Lose track and you wait ten days!'

Name: Flickering Crimson
Description: We will meet again… Humans call it fate, I hear. But I think it might also be a curse of the white moon!'

Name: Nocturnal Batling
Description: Batsy packs her things and gets ready. What nightmares will she catch tonight to feed the little bats?

Name: Nightmare Captor
Description: Batventure Night is a popular fairy tale in Lilith. The protagonist Batsy can catch nightmares and guard dreams.

Name: Windward Echo
Description: Her pointy ears are as sharp as a bat's. All she needs to do is twitch them to catch every sound in dreams.

Name: Dreamcatcher Plumes
Description: Batsy has a magical case to help her catch nightmares. She always wipes it with a fine cloth to keep it shiny.

Name: Dreamland Boundary
Description: As the portal to the dream world opens, she makes her grand entrance. Oops! Almost slipped on the cloud…

Name: Somber Midnight
Description: Batsy hums as she patrols at night, when she hears a sob. A girl trapped in a nightmare frowns and murmurs.

Name: Drifting Phantom
Description: The pumpkin lantern the girl made with her mom turns into a huge cloud, carrying her into a dark forest.

Name: Endless Enigma
Description: Howling ghosts from her cartoon books scare her so much that she can't say a word until she sees Batsy.

Name: Midnight Frenzy
Description: As for the naughty ghosts... Don't worry. They're trick-or-treating. Batsy shares the marshmallow with them.

Name: Dream Reversal
Description: It's almost dawn. Batsy pats her full case, glances at the little girl smiling in her dreams, and flies away.

Name: Quantum Microcore
Description: The new defense module, Norsen, known as the 'Phantom of the Void,' secures all data in the abandoned file center.

Name: Autonomous Consciousness
Description: Norsen learns quickly, analyzing each enemy attack and instantly devising the optimal defense strategy.

Name: Data Seal
Description: Enemies strike again with mixed methods; data floods in like tides, triggering piercing system alarms.

Name: Error Code
Description: Data streams back into the attackers' systems. Error codes surge like snowflakes, instantly crippling their devices.

Name: Precision Analysis
Description: Calm and swift, Norsen dissects attack patterns and sources. Every data set and signal falls under her scan.

Name: Cyber Phantom
Description: Meanwhile, Norsen's playful ghost face suddenly appears on the enemy screens, laughing at their foolishness.

Name: Ghostly Lantern
Description: Don't be fooled by the warm glow! Mischievous ghosts hide behind it, waiting for their next game of trick or treat.

Name: Prophecy of Night
Description: They say on a certain night, stars and moon fade away as the veil of night covers all… And the ghosts awaken.

Name: Sweet Trick
Description: A bag full of surprises. Go ahead and pick one! Will you take the clever bunny doll or the sweetest candy inside?

Name: Blossom in Ripples
Description: Their gazes meet like flowers blooming or a lake rippling. They sit shoulder to shoulder, talking like the old times.

Name: Fragrant Date
Description: They meet up in the floral aroma and share their stories as promised. The afternoon becomes etched in time.

Name: Sparkling Feather
Description: A dove lands beside the coffee cup and tilts its head, as if curious about the girls' secrets.

Name: 适意偃仰
Description: 白日的喧嚣渐渐沉淀为晚时的静谧，糕点铺即将打烊，眼看天际一轮明月升起，明舒合门落锁的动作微微一顿。

Name: 简古小案
Description: 门外探进一张小脸，正是挎着竹篮的邻家小童。篮中瓜果饱满鲜妍，犹含清露，烛火照映下莹莹如珠。

Name: 桂影繁香
Description: 女孩团子似的脸颊透出薄红，细声与她问好，只道母亲托自己来送瓜果，祝愿明舒佳节快乐，四时安康。

Name: 风月入怀
Description: 她并无家人，知交亦少，然而夜凉渐起时，她并不觉凄清，反而自顾自剥开一只石榴，品尝粒粒清甜的晶莹果实。

Name: 素晖流照
Description: 一盏清茶、一笼糕饼，后院小亭，乘凉独坐，明舒在藤椅上遥望当空月色，晚风拂过，送来案上瓜果的清冽淡香。

Name: 清景满怀
Description: 明舒正欲为女孩寻些糖糕，却倏然拥入果香满怀。女孩踏着青石板“哒哒”跑远，留下明舒抱着果篮，错愕失笑。

Name: 秋风清露
Description: 风过竹梢的簌簌作响，茶汤倾注的涓涓细流，以及与圆月相对无言的寂静，这便是明舒的中秋。

Name: 蟾宫芳华
Description: 远处依稀飘来家家户户欢聚团圆的笑语和煎炒烹煮的烟火气，而明舒院中唯有袅袅茶烟升入空中，与月华相融。

Name: Moon Palace Pestling
Description: Like this?' Momo turns to Yutu, the rabbit herbalist master. 'Wonderful!' Yutu nods with a smile.

Name: Blessed Clouds
Description: The bright moon bathes the world in silver as auspicious clouds bring blessings to all with cheer.

Name: Crown of Legacy
Description: A crimson glow flickers in the distance. Riene advances, but a skeleton with its crown askew blocks her path.

Name: Flawless Heartwing
Description: Facing madness with her last hope, resisting claws with a broken blade, Riene strikes the undead crown in one blow.

Name: Sword of Valor
Description: The slumbering miracle awakens. The dim gem flickers in Riene's scarred hands, its crimson glow breathing to life.

Name: Choice of Glory
Description: Curse of the undead echoes in the dark. Riene pauses and kneels solemnly, lifting the kingdom's long-lost treasure.

Name: Bloodwing Journey
Description: I sacrificed all, yet could not save it…' laments the undead, calling the crown a shackle, the gem a tombstone.

Name: Scarlet Vow
Description: The undead vanish silently. Riene grips the gem and sword, knowing it's not the end, but the dawn of a new journey.

Name: Ruler of Spirits
Description: Between practices, Nadia discussed tactics with her clan's advisors to gain a timing advantage.

Name: Shadowed Thorns
Description: In autumn, the young man regained his health. Before leaving, he gave Riche a diamond and promised to return for her.

Name: Eternal Petals
Description: Young love filled Riche's heart, making her ignore his fine clothes and sword, which were unfit for a village man.

Name: Midnight Dreamshade
Description: Soon, moved by Riche, the youth let his guard down. They wandered through the fields, watching the sunset together.

Name: Silent Spirit
Description: The duke plotted an assassination, but years of nobility had made Riche cautious. Her innocence had long since faded.

Name: Duskfall Light
Description: Villagers held a feast for them with gifts and blessings. They danced late into the night like a fairy tale ending.

Name: Fading Dreamwing
Description: His temper wore her down, and he soon grew bored of her commoner background. Their love eventually turned bitter.

Name: Aesthetic Riddle
Description: A year later, the youth returned in fine clothes bearing a family crest. It turned out he was a wealthy young duke.

Name: Crystal Vision
Description: If the story ended there, everything would remain lovely and memories shine forever. Yet life is never so perfect.

Name: Eyes of Longing
Description: Former lovers clashed. Darkness swallowed fond memories. Amid the intrigue, the duke ultimately lost his life.

Name: Void Whispers
Description: The duke's portrait was replaced with a new one of Riche, elegant yet cold, her gaze shining like a diamond.

Name: Silent Wanderer
Description: Shivering, Riche asked, 'Wasn't there a painting?' The butler shook his head. 'Never. Perhaps it was your dream.'

Name: Artistic Riddle
Description: Riche woke, eager to turn her dream into a horror novel. Before leaving, she paused at the empty wall.

Name: Azure Flame Shade
Description: The traveler loses track of the path in the moonlight. Where to next? The answer glimmers at the end of darkness.

Name: Myriad Phenomena
Description: Seeing all truths and illusions dulls life. Fate fascinates only in the unknown, so she seals the all-seeing eye.

Name: Homeward Promise
Description: Follow the trail of golden petals back to the warm, familiar light. See if the one you miss has grown well.

Name: Playful Disguise
Description: For today's meeting, a perfect plan: grab a grinning pumpkin, make the strangest face, and step through the door!

Name: Soul Symphony
Description: Dressed in bright colors, we sway through the streets. Music rises. Our love and memories make us eternal.

Name: Autumn Brew
Description: Autumn gathers the year's labor. Fruits ripen with fragrance as gentle winds whisper blessings to everyone.

Name: Warming Light
Description: Banners sway at dusk. The scent of food opens the feast. Friends lift their drinks, laughing under the golden glow.

Name: Day of Harvest
Description: The earth stays silent, yet it rewards all labor with golden fruits. People see the same joy of harvest.

Name: Heavenly Runes
Description: Amid devout chanting, smiles lit up every face. Perhaps the deity, too, would smile at such a blissful sight.

Name: Karma Chains
Description: He realizes something and struggles up. Ignoring the sweat soaking his clothes, he runs off without looking back.

Name: Moon of Insight
Description: Good or bad? Shiro turns, gazing at the high moon, calm as ever. Before the story's final chapter, no one can know.

Name: Nocturne City
Description: Shiro, Follower of the Moon, watches him in silence. Another reckless human has arrived in the city, she thinks.

Name: Obscure Rain
Description: Whoosh—A white barrier comes between him and the moon. He regains focus slowly and sees a pure white umbrella.

Name: Ghostly White
Description: The pupil shimmers with bizarre colors. Past, present, and future flow within, making one forget to breathe.

Name: Dustweb Trap
Description: In the next moment, the boy collapses, clutching his chest and gasping. If he saw his face, he'd know how pale he is.

Name: Dirge of Ruins
Description: After a while, or maybe just a moment, a gust of wind stirs, and the girl's gaze falls toward its source.

Name: Drifting in Mist
Description: The girl stays silent, watching him until he looks up. The chaotic energy calms, and everything falls silent.

Name: Skeletal Wings of Time
Description: The girl in white descends from the sky, landing atop the streetlight. Behind her, a pair of bone wings slowly folds.

Name: Entangled Realm
Description: The breeze stops; stillness falls. The gears of fate turn as the girl finds a gap in the cage of the white realm.

Name: Wings of Bygone Age
Description: Legends say that on starless nights, you should avoid the white moon's gaze, or you'll be drawn into another world.

Name: Joyful Melody
Description: Sunset lingers while torches light the night. The crowd flows like a lively river into the square.

Name: Starcatcher
Description: The child brings back the pumpkin, apologizing. Stars sparkle, and the pumpkin looks like a full autumn moon.

Name: Autumn Glow
Description: A playful child knocks a basket. Pumpkins roll down the path. He leaps and stops its journey.

Name: Autumn Promise
Description: Flickering fire warms everyone. Loxie flits like a happy bird, and all praise her pumpkins.

Name: Life Like a Play
Description: At the premiere, crowds marvel at her charm, weep at her trials, and cheer the perfect ending, as always.

Name: Waves of Clamor
Description: Questions ring on. With the mic in hand, she means to give rehearsed answers, yet a weariness rises within.

Name: Blooming Wings of Heart
Description: Before countless cameras, gentle Ivanna suddenly flicks her hair and smiles, a mischievous grin beyond the script.

Name: Flickering Glow
Description: She recalls the role that chose to flee a gilded cage. A bold, playful idea sprouts in her heart.

Name: Brilliant Moment
Description: Like a swift bird, she darts past the stunned crowd, leaving all behind, her hair flying like a classic slow motion.

Name: Impromptu Performance
Description: Thank you for the support. The bonus scene will be shown by me~' She waves, lifts her skirt, and runs away.

Name: Unfinished Script
Description: The story on the screen ends, but Ivanna's own vivid, real chapter has just begun.

Name: Final Curtain
Description: THE END' lights the screen. Thunderous applause erupts as Ivanna steps onto center stage to roaring cheers.

Name: Fragrant Eaves
Description: It is her favorite fairy tale. Each morning, a girl with a flower basket hops in the forest, sharing scents with all.

Name: Breezy Voyage
Description: Miss Sparrow decorates her house with flowers. Mr. Fox puts them on his tail. Grandma Rabbit makes cakes with them.

Name: Fragrant Basket
Description: She thinks all night and slips The Girl with the Flower Basket into a large envelope, with a flower bookmark inside.

Name: Fragrant Eaves - Dream
Description: Mr. Fox pulls out a pretty straw hat from nowhere, places it on Lulu, and adds a beautiful flower to the brim.

Name: Breezy Voyage - Dream
Description: Lulu stands amid her animal friends, gazing at her reflection. Her cheeks flush pink, eyes sparkling with delight.

Name: Fragrant Basket - Dream
Description: The basket is already overflowing with flowers from her animal friends. Lulu laughs. It's time for photos!

Name: Lucky Knits
Description: Waiting for the studio to set the scene, she weaves a headband, green and full of her hopeful excitement.

Name: Wishes Captured
Description: Finally, her appointment arrives. Nervous, Kashira enters the studio. The moment she opens the door, she's stunned.

Name: Pinecone Gift
Description: Could this be time-travel magic? Behind the plain little door lies a vast, tranquil forest!

Name: Lucky Knits - Berry
Description: The forest feels like a natural maze. She follows the squirrels, weaving vines and branches to find the perfect spot.

Name: Wishes Captured - Berry
Description: Sitting beneath a tree, she hugs a squirrel and smiles at the camera. The flash captures her most cherished fantasy.

Name: Pinecone Gift - Berry
Description: Like waking from a dream, she leaves the studio thrilled and reluctant to go. She's already imagining the next scene!

Name: Vintage Chic
Description: She opens the studio door. The dress hanging on the rack is dreamlike, flawless under any scrutiny.

Name: Silent Memories
Description: When she stands before the mirror, she sees a woman seemingly step out of the past, embodying timeless elegance.

Name: Ripples of Past
Description: Neon signs flicker over bustling streets, echoing a century-old splendor. The perfect setting sparks her inspiration.

Name: Flickering Shadows
Description: Everything pulls her into an era of centuries ago. She no longer hesitates, ready to embark on a journey to the past.

Name: Grace Preserved
Description: The photos capture not just an elegant figure in a vintage gown, but a bygone era hidden in the busy streets.

Name: Vintage Chic - Violet
Description: Beneath the hat, carefully styled hair forms gentle curves, reviving the elegance and refinement of that era.

Name: Silent Memories - Violet
Description: Crystal chandeliers shed light over stacked champagne cups. Gowns spin with the music. Light shimmers near her ears.

Name: Ripples of Past - Violet
Description: Pearls are no longer just an ornament. Their sheen becomes the most striking color of the vintage scene.

Name: Flickering Shadows - Violet
Description: She's gradually captivated by the studio. The camera is her only audience, capturing every moment of her in the era.

Name: Grace Preserved - Violet
Description: The carefully woven dream nears its end. After the shoot, she sighs. This truly is a place that 'realizes any dream.'

Name: Inspired Glow
Description: The crowd is thrilled by her inspiration, yet she quietly fades from the world. Rumors stir: another fleeting show.

Name: Captured Beauty
Description: Three years later, a collection appears. Buds on ice, smiles in deserts… Miracles were born in those silent years.

Name: Dreams in Bloom
Description: The flash sparkles like stars. Freya walks the red carpet. Flowers on her gown bloom as before, now known by all.

Name: Journey Treasures
Description: Applause fills the air. People admire her rare talent, inspirational touch, and her courage to travel the land.

Name: Dream Chaser's Proof
Description: People may get tired of the cliché of beauty, but there are countless views worth recording in the wrinkles of time.

Name: Peaceful Melody
Description: Miracles are not created by me, but live on their own,' she says firmly. 'I'm fortunate enough to witness them.'

Name: Dazzling Starwish
Description: The golden trophy glimmers in her hands. She strokes its base, knowing this night is a new prologue, not an end.

Name: Jingle Star Bell
Description: The Christmas Eve party is about to start. Momo hesitates, 'Huh, is this Nikki? Did she change her hairstyle?'

Name: Zephyr Grace
Description: She always listens to her customers with a warm smile and arranges the most unique and beautiful bouquets for them.

Name: Serene Breath
Description: On special days, she would pick flowers and dry them, as if sealing those beautiful moments into fragrant memories.

Name: Surprise Confetti Popper
Description: Momo wants to hide inside a confetti popper and surprise Nikki. But alas, the popper's just too small to pull it off!

Name: Honeyed Affection
Description: Momo decides to bake a cake for Nikki with soft chiffon, rich cream, and fresh berries. It's the sweetest gift of all!

Name: 霜华星冠
Description: 寒风无情地吹打着花枝，厉声提醒蔷薇不属于此刻，她注定无法进入冬季。索菲亚手臂微展，眷恋地伸向雪花。

Name: 雪夜蔷薇
Description: 不甘的情绪在不断加快的舞步中积累，乐声也渐渐高亢，蔷薇下定了决心：纵使饱受苦痛，也要追寻真我与本心。

Name: 盈光绶带
Description: 索菲亚不停旋舞——蔷薇怒放，向风雪展示它顽强的生命力，若从没有在严冬绽放的蔷薇，它便要成为第一朵。

Name: 优雅终幕
Description: 剧目在鲜花与掌声中谢幕，热情的观众为索菲亚送上了象征认可的绶带与冠冕，赞叹她为大家带来的无尽感动。

Name: Veiled Elegance
Description: The woman wears a familiar dress with a veil over her face. Somehow, she feels the woman's gaze upon her across the crowd.

Name: Hazy Enigma
Description: With blooms her voice drifts away, Like butterflies fluttering to stay.' The woman sings the song from her dream.

Name: Forlorn Lilt
Description: Tears roll down her cheeks before she realizes it. The woman bows to her, as if in thanks or farewell.

Name: Soothing Moonlight
Description: The figure fades away as swallowtails flap their wings under the moon, leaving her alone in the abandoned theater.

Name: Hummed Refrain
Description: That night, she dreams she is a Cloud designer, only known for the swallowtail butterfly dress she designed for a friend.

Name: Final Elegy
Description: Her friend treasured the dress. It witnessed her rise to fame and watched as she stepped onto the grandest stage.

Name: Fluttering Grace
Description: However, flames of war spread to the town. The songstress still decided to go on stage and perform for the enemy.

Name: Bakery Encounter
Description: The familiar door was suddenly locked. Granny fell ill, leaving an old baking pan lying quietly on the counter.

Name: Puffy Cream
Description: Seeing Granny on her sickbed, Florie worked up the courage and stepped into the empty, dust-laden shop.

Name: Rainbow Flavor
Description: Icing dusted Florie's cheeks and nose tip. She might still be clumsy, but her eyes had never looked more determined.

Name: Tentative Taste
Description: Freshly baked waffles filled the room with a familiar aroma. Florie let out a long breath and sank into the sweetness.

Name: Velvety Present
Description: Florie pulled her 'masterpiece' out of the smoky oven. Her first plate might be burnt, but she wasn't giving up.

Name: Coffee Crepe
Description: She wore an apron like Granny did and, with a cream whipper, led flour and eggs to a waltz in the bowl.

Name: Cocoa Waffle
Description: She poured cream and syrup and decorated the waffles with chocolate dollops and two croissants.

Name: Dreamful Repose
Description: Granny doted on Florie and made croissants just for her. She worked magic into the dough and baked dreams of love.

Name: Radiant Dreamscape
Description: Gems scatter like stars; feathers dance at hem. She holds her breath. No wonder this studio 'makes all dreams real.'

Name: Floating Whispers
Description: Most wondrous are the floating mannequins, dreamlike guests bowing midair, ushering her to the dress.

Name: Luminous Horizon
Description: The narrow stairwell is filled with fabric; needles glide as if alive. Inspiration rests in every corner here.

Name: Stairs of Wishes
Description: She can hardly believe her eyes. Moonlight turns to cool silk; air becomes soft tulle. Fantasy becomes reality.

Name: Frosted Feathers
Description: The gown is exquisite, yet something is missing. Fingers brush gems as the young designer falls into thought.

Name: Hymn of Blossom
Description: Rejected sketches return to her mind, along with late nights before blank paper. She fears drawing the first line.

Name: Mind Voyage
Description: Light becomes butterflies swirling around them. The muse embraces Gloria, and new ideas light up her eyes at once.

Name: Starlit Misty Isles
Description: A phantom descends the long stairs… It's the muse as Gloria imagines, winking like a longtime friend.

Name: Marvelous Muse
Description: Her needle flies with ease. Hazy visions turn real as the gown gains details unique to Gloria.

Name: Silvered Feathers
Description: The studio adventure becomes her dearest memory. She hopes to realize others' dreams with her design.

Name: Swaying Blossoms
Description: Celia stood amid her friends, winking at her grandma in a rocker. The kindly elder smiled and nodded in praise.

Name: Messenger in White
Description: With a flick of her wrist, little Celia skipped a pebble. A silver arc danced on the lake, and she cheered.

Name: Blooming Secret Haven
Description: White, fragrant flowers lined the shore. Grandma walked with Celia hand in hand. Her hug also carried the soft scent.

Name: Dreamlike Lakeside
Description: Sometimes she dreams of the lake, her friends, grandma's embrace, and cool drops on cheeks, vivid even after waking.

Name: Innocent Bud
Description: Independent and steadfast. She learns the flower's meaning as an adult, but the one to share it with is long gone.

Name: Old Dream Encounter
Description: Life's toil carved lines in Grandma's hands. Yet she still drew beautifully, teaching her light, shadow, and colors.

Name: Words of Affection
Description: Changed into her dress, Celia sits by the lake. The shimmering water glows like the warm memories grandma left her.

Name: Fragrant Petal Drift
Description: Golden flecks ripple on the lake. Celia stands in the frame, skirt lifted by the breeze. Hmm… Something is missing.

Name: Heart's Radiance
Description: Tears fall as memories embrace her. Though time changes all, love and blessings never truly leave her.

Name: Bloom in Heart
Description: Flowers may wither and lakes may dry, but the cherished happiness makes life no longer lonely or desolate.'

Name: Cherished Moments
Description: Birds fly in, bringing a delicate dress and hopping by the camera. Thinking of old times, she pulls herself together.

Name: Butterfly in Blossoms
Description: She never seeks reward, helping the suffering as she can, unaware that such kindness builds the steps of her ascent.

Name: Veiled Haze
Description: Though upset by her leaving, people see her off with blessings, like watching geese destined to migrate south.

Name: Glimmering Chrysanthemum
Description: For years she bears no leaves or blooms, only withered branches entwined, yet the old man still tends her with care.

Name: Dew-Kissed Branch
Description: The old man runs a street shop. His handmade sweets always draw children, whose laughter rouses her from long dreams.

Name: Emerald Droplets
Description: Plants have hearts too,' he murmurs, as if to her. 'All are guests in this world; feelings can connect.'

Name: Mossy Path
Description: She understands a sick granny's moans, tears of a girl forced from school, and a woman's sigh at an empty rice jar.

Name: Moonlit Hidden Bloom
Description: A tale spreads through town: The chrysanthemum that never blooms houses a kind spirit who aids the distressed.

Name: Clear Azure Waters
Description: She leaves herbs for the granny, tuition fees for the girl, rice for the poor. Seasons pass; she helps more.

Name: Shattered Pearls
Description: One evening, lights glow in the sea mist. A ship crosses the eerie sea, and a young sailor comes before Tano.

Name: Seashell Throne
Description: Perhaps no one can make it. Tano forgets the vow. In a deity's long life, kingdoms rise and fall like dust in wind.

Name: Eternal Echo of Tides
Description: Tano studies him in surprise. His life is fragile, yet he alone defeats the tides. By the pact, she hears his wish.

Name: Brilliant Hymn
Description: The sailor comes from a distant land, ruined by war. He begs for wealth and power to save his shattered home.

Name: Starry Sand Chant
Description: A breeze ripples the sea as he speaks of his dreams. Moved by his vision, Tano fills his ship with treasures.

Name: Phantom in Long Night
Description: Her dull eternity gains a spark. Tano grants his wish. Gratitude fills his young face as he vows a gift in return.

Name: Timeworn Soul
Description: Again and again he takes advantage of her, learning even a goddess can be deluded. The seed of greed takes root.

Name: Sacred Treasure
Description: His desires grow harder to satisfy, and Tano indulges them all, until he asks for divine power and eternal life.

Name: Fateful Tide Song
Description: Soon he returns through the mist with gifts. His people thank the goddess and craft offerings with care.

Name: Terrace in Blossoms
Description: The world is a map waiting for color. Erin lifts her brush, marking destinations ahead and dreaming of new sights.

Name: Floral Echoes
Description: Hearing that she'll travel, friends joke about getting postcards. She nods seriously, keeping the promise in mind.

Name: Fragrant Touch in Dream
Description: The brave young traveler stumbles at first, lost on strange platforms and streets, yet meets many kind souls.

Name: Dews on Blossoms
Description: A granny brings her soup. An innkeeper slips a hand-drawn map into her bag. A fellow traveler gives her a lucky coin.

Name: Warmth Remembered
Description: Warm moments scatter like starlight on her journey. Beyond scenery, brief and sincere encounters stay with Erin.

Name: Springtime Verses
Description: She records each sight and shares them with friends in postcards. Erin feels they aren't apart, but travel together.

Name: Flourishing Blooms
Description: Spring's first breeze wakes the world; Erin returns home. Time, the best gardener, fills the terrace with blooms.

Name: Fragrance of Dream
Description: Laughter stirs the lily of the valley by the window, peering at the warm light and smiling faces in the room.

Name: Past Floral Years
Description: The puppy softly whimpers and leaps from Ava's arms, as if this new world brings it joyful comfort.

Name: Classic Grace
Description: Back then, she studied alone in a strange city. Buried in work and introverted, she never had close friends.

Name: Elegant Old Times
Description: It jumps onto the sandalwood chair, wagging its tail. Its lively cuteness leaves Ava momentarily dazed.

Name: Warm Bliss
Description: During a field trip, she rescued the little puppy curled in a box. Since then, it had become her constant sunshine.

Name: Bright Wishes
Description: Click! The camera captures the moment. The puppy perches on the armrest. She can't help smiling, stroking its head.

Name: Refined Melody
Description: Playing on the grass, she lies with the puppy, watching the sunset. Colors of inspiration fill her eyes.

Name: Thoughtful Charm
Description: Flash! The second photo. She lowers her eyes and pours the tea, and the puppy sits nearby, forming a serene scene.

Name: Cup of Fragrance
Description: After graduation, she is lost and uninspired. The puppy jumps, tugging her skirt, urging her outdoors again.

Name: Together Always
Description: Caring for the puppy makes Ava's life orderly. Walks and exploration bring her new scenery and a few friends.

Name: Verdant Vines
Description: Keep going. Your real surprise lies deeper!' Bobo winks and takes Nikki's hand. 'This time, we're with you!'

Name: Fragrant Whirl
Description: Ribbons on the garden gate dance in the breeze, greeting Nikki as she walks the path with a heart full of anticipation.

Name: Blossom Radiance
Description: A familiar figure hides behind the hedges. It's Debbie! She runs over and gently tucks blooms onto Nikki's dress.

Name: Spring Courtyard Steps
Description: Light, cheerful music drifts from afar. Curious, Nikki follows the melody around the garden's bend.

Name: Starlit Brilliance
Description: The record turns softly. Mela stands by the gramophone, smiling gently as she nods a warm greeting to Nikki.

Name: Breeze's Soft Murmur
Description: What other surprises await? Heart brimming with joy, Nikki slips past the bushes, and her view suddenly opens wide.

Name: Floral Hymn
Description: Gauzy drapes sway in the warm wind. Girls gather around a long table of treats, their laughter echoing through the garden.

Name: Gorgeous Moments
Description: By the window stands Ace, dressed as a knight. She turns at Nikki's voice and waves with a radiant smile.

Name: Pure Heart's Melody
Description: At the garden's center stands a flower-decorated window. Sunlight streams through, scattering colors in Nikki's eyes.

Name: Devotion's Tribute
Description: Beside the flower, Ransa sets out delicate desserts. Sherry stands near her, a bit shy, yet soft-eyed and gentle.

Name: Heartfelt Verse
Description: Our birthday girl is here!' Bestt and Besan link arms with Nikki. 'Do you like the surprises we made for you?'

Name: Beauteous Years
Description: Joy warms her heart. In the glow of candlelight, Nikki smiles, believing her wish will surely come true.

Name: Sweet Rendezvous
Description: The delicate desserts sit on the shelves. With permission to help themselves, guests eagerly take a cream tart.

Name: Perfumed Hours
Description: Many praise the studio's floral tea. Fragrant and sweet, one sip instantly lifts the spirit and calms the mind.

Name: Grand Overture
Description: After the shoot, every guest finds a small silk-tied cart at the door, a gilded letter resting quietly atop it.

Name: Blooming Passage
Description: Rich aromas fill the porch, warm lamps sway gently. It marks the end of a dream and the start of a fresh life.

Name: Sweet Rendezvous - Grace
Description: Savoring the desserts, guests relive the date with themselves, memories, or the future, smiling softly.

Name: Perfumed Hours - Grace
Description: The tea is always perfectly warm, wisps rising like a delicate veil, separating dream from reality in a subtle haze.

Name: Grand Overture - Grace
Description: Thank you for visiting! May this time bring you real joy and fulfillment, and we look forward to our next meeting.'

Name: Sunlit Snow Bridge
Description: Her zhu sound rises and falls, like a gurgling spring, or clashing swords. Time passes unknowingly in her melody.

Name: Sound of Drifting Snow
Description: Lang Shuang carries her qin to the plum garden. Suddenly, clear zhu sounds of a girl reach her, like shattered jade.

Name: Blossoms Frozen in Ice
Description: Feelings are hidden in melody. Not knowing the girl's name yet, she wishes to meet, know and harmonize with her.

Name: Moonlight on the Hill
Description: A kindred heart is always rare. The two feel close at once. One plays qin, the other strikes zhu, perfectly in sync.

Name: Affection in Chords
Description: Later, they both become famous, yet separated often. Lin Yao is always busy, drifting through feasts and banquets.

Name: Colorful Inspiration
Description: Looking at her friend's back, Mimi feels confused, realizing she has forgotten to offer her treasured herbal tea.

Name: Exquisite Craft
Description: How much effort is needed to make clothes that fit? Thinking her work might never be worn, Mimi feels a bit sad.

Name: Creative Spark
Description: I have an idea!' Miss Rabbit's eyes light up. She says she needs to prepare and rushes out before Mimi can ask.

Name: Whimsical Pom-pom
Description: After breakfast, Mimi hears a noise outside. She opens the door and finds Miss Rabbit with a group of forest friends.

Name: Graceful Etiquette
Description: Is it true you have the most beautiful clothes?' The curious crowd peeks inside, eyes sparkling with hope.

Name: Unique Design
Description: The lively elephant lifts a hat, the quiet bird touches a sheer cape, and the shy bear gently asks to try on a suit.

Name: Thread of Vine
Description: Sure!' Mimi adjusts the bear's suit with needle and pins. Soon, it fits him perfectly. Everyone claps in delight.

Name: Ribbon of Time
Description: Seeing interest in her work, Mimi's joy overcomes nerves as she invites everyone in. The room fills with laughter.

Name: Innocent Companion
Description: Mengyao takes in the town. The little bear lifts her over shining lakes, candy lanes, landing at an ice castle.

Name: Everbloom Ice Flowers
Description: Dwarfs tip their hats, a princess by the lake smiles, and a bard strums verses. Snow drifts down; all feels magical.

Name: Tender Magic
Description: A ball fills the castle. Guests warmly welcome her, guiding her step by step to dance in the sparkling lights.

Name: Dazzling Ice Crystals
Description: Amid laughter and lively music, she smiles. The little bear holds her hand as they dance through the crowd.

Name: Whimsical Snow House
Description: They dance on and slip from the bright hall to a moonlit terrace, where only snowflakes and starlight surround them.

Name: Delicious Stew
Description: To Master Goose, it should be another peaceful day in the magic forest, so it made cream soup like it usually did.

Name: Finest Choice
Description: Before the cream soup was done, an eccentric girl popped up, trying to cover Master Goose in a giant pot.

Name: Master Chef
Description: After a chase, Master Goose and Kaoru fell on the ground. A gentle breeze brought back peace for a brief moment.

Name: Limited Cuisine
Description: Kaoru's eyes lit up: isn't the goose the most special ingredient in the magic forest? She tiptoed closer.

Name: Raincloud Bread
Description: No ordinary goose can make soup. Kaoru finally realized Master Goose was a gourmet, not an ingredient for food.

Name: Aromatic Ingredient
Description: Why are you chasing me?' Master Goose panted, 'You want a sip of my cream soup? I'll admit it's tempting...'

Name: Magic of Flavors
Description: It's not easy to be my apprentice.' Master Goose didn't say yes. It just agreed to teach Kaoru a traditional dish.

Name: Amber Candy
Description: A legendary gourmet was more exciting than a unique ingredient. Kaoru rushed over, scaring Master Goose away.

Name: Vegetable Blend
Description: Can I be your apprentice?' Kaoru's eyes shone with hope, 'I'll work hard!' Master Goose looked hesitant.

Name: Flavorful Voyage
Description: This gourmet had been an industry legend who always came up with unique combinations and delicious recipes.

Name: Palatable Secret
Description: Kaoru explained herself and made a chef's hat for Master Goose, who finally decided to forgive the ignorant human.

Name: Tasteful Journey
Description: As the gentle sun brushed Kaoru's face, she opened her eyes and sat up in bed: 'That's how a tofu pot is made!'

Name: Stellar Glimmer
Description: Matty feels as if she's been sent back in time, gazing at the stars of her childhood that once gave her endless strength.

Name: Cosmic Gaze
Description: Mankind is but a speck of dust in the universe, but it can still talk to the stars and shine with its quest for truth.

Name: Starlit Banquet
Description: The sea of stars twinkles in the girl's eyes. Matty suddenly remembers her first dream was born under the stars.

Name: Starry Awakening
Description: The vast universe unfolds before her as stars float quietly in the dark. All her worries evaporate in that moment.

Name: Nocturnal Roses
Description: Matty wishes to be freed from endless meetings and just gaze at the stars and discover the secrets of the universe.

Name: Gloomy Variation
Description: Is my dream meaningful? Or is it just more trouble for my family? Matty keeps asking herself on sleepless nights.

Name: Cosmic Murmurs
Description: At a dinner party, Matty finds a quiet corner for herself. She always feels out of place at these social gatherings.

Name: Pearly Radiance
Description: Matty sets the focus somewhat clumsily and feels a rush of emotion when the first star appears clearly in her vision.

Name: Classical Times
Description: Explore the unknown, solve mysteries of the universe, and search for truths. These dreams will never be meaningless.

Name: Chapter of Purity
Description: The wind rips the cotton of life out of the bear. Betty's eyes glisten with tears as she shields the bear behind her.

Name: Bear Guardian
Description: A worn teddy bear sat in the corner, the seams on its arms and head split open, with bits of cotton peeking out.

Name: Fluffy Defender
Description: As wings spread behind the girl, Betty's tears turn into soft feathers, patching up the bear's wounds.

Name: Warm Patch
Description: Betty carefully examines the bear and a lingering dream flashes in her mind, but nothing can distract her now.

Name: Tender Touch
Description: The girl focuses on patching up the bear as silver needles and fine threads dance on the fabric she found.

Name: Soothing Dream
Description: The patch on the bear glistens like a badge of honor. The fine needlework and unique design show Betty's care for it.

Name: 桃源春
Description: 雪径上印着浅浅足迹，友人捧起一团雪泼洒至空中，又纷纷扬扬落在少女发间。两人面面相觑，忽而大笑起来。

Name: 岁末近
Description: 两人嬉闹追逐，分享点心，哼唱同一支曲调……待夕阳西下，才恋恋不舍地归家。雪冷情却灼，谊深共岁长。

Name: 今日快讯
Description: 说干就干！夏洛特一头扎进机械师朋友的工坊，在堆满杂物的角落里翻找出几个旧轮胎和一堆叮当作响的零件。

Name: 风驰电掣
Description: 夏洛特懊恼地叹了口气，一辆汽车在眼前疾驰而过，少女眼前一亮——她有了个绝妙的主意！

Name: 元气邮差
Description: “你要做什么呀？”机械师好奇地问。夏洛特自信地宣布：“我要亲手创造一位陪我送信的好伙伴！”

Name: 曜黑光影
Description: 精心设计了图纸，将各种各样的零件在工作台上分类完毕，夏洛特拿起扳手，摩拳擦掌：“开始吧！”

Name: 精准投递
Description: “要怎么解决平衡性问题呢……”夏洛特蹙眉沉思许久，突然一拍脑袋，“对了！给它加个扶手好了！”

Name: 明媚朝阳
Description: 数日的埋头苦干之后，夏洛特灵巧的双手成功让零件们各就各位，她试着踩上踏板，却总觉得不太稳定。

Name: 拂晓欢歌
Description: 时间在不知不觉间流逝，薄暮降临时，夏洛特终于站起身，伸了个大大的懒腰：“完工了！我的新伙伴！”

Name: 亭亭明玕
Description: 自小志向远大的岑缨，为了能够更好地进行自己的研究，在野外行走勘察，一直勤练身手。

Name: 时令茶果
Description: 她虽称不上武艺超群，但寻常自保已是绰绰有余！

Name: 黄金飞天鼠
Description: 飞天鼠正如其名，可以飞行，但翅膀平日是隐藏起来的。它们是较为弱小的妖族，一般生活在山林中或田地附近。

Name: 林野小筑
Description: 若对其产生疑惑，她也会将记下的内容带回博物学会中和其他人一起探讨。

Name: 赭霞如绮
Description: 岑缨博物洽闻，对历史、地理和金石学皆有涉猎。

Name: 借箸品味
Description: 虽然当初的志向没有改变，但似乎又融入了不同的东西。

Name: 格古通今
Description: 岑缨的收藏品中有一件西洋怀表，金银材质，镶嵌宝石。她进行过改装，加了表带，戴在手腕上。

Name: 斗转参斜
Description: 岑缨随身携带着小罗盘，是专门找人订制的，方便野外携带，还能借此发现奇奇怪怪的东西。

Name: 共此山肴
Description: 对于未来，岑缨一直有自己明确的想法，而鄢陵之变给了她非同一般的触动。

Name: 寒溪晖夜
Description: 千年以前，云无月为了免于生灵涂炭与同族定约，交出了自己的“声音”，从力量全盛的巅峰跌落。

Name: 缈缈烟汀
Description: 云无月的身上带有黑暗的混沌之息。

Name: 太虚琼华
Description: 通过一场接一场的战斗让自己变得更为强大，是云无月这类妖魔的生存法则。

Name: 千秋月明
Description: 北洛在古厝回廊下方见到的妖，自称“云无月”。

Name: 韶年锦绣
Description: 云无月的额饰是银制品，内嵌蓝色宝石和蓝色虫翅贴片。

Name: 无心
Description: 云无心以出岫。能够分开与聚合的节鞭，攻击威力很大。

Name: 前尘故梦
Description: 如今比之往昔虽仍有差距，她却依然是众多妖魔不敢轻犯的大妖。

Name: 流风遗韵
Description: 昔时旧事，她并无后悔，也未曾有过沮丧，只是不断磨炼与增强着自身的力量。

Name: 魇魅隐幻
Description: 云无月的原型整体纤细，常年笼罩在一片黑雾之中。

Name: 魇魅灵幻
Description: 云无月的原型胸口对穿镂空，里面有一团小小的“声音”闪着蓝光。

Name: Velvet Snowfall
Description: Her forest became a maze of darkness. The wind whispers to her, asking Cera to guide the lost and clear their fear.

Name: Obscure Mist
Description: Cera arrives with a lantern in hand. Guided by its glow, she parts the darkness and alights gracefully before the girl.

Name: Shimmering Wings
Description: A speck of light shimmers in the dark forest, floating firmly toward the lost girl trembling in tears.

Name: Firefly Lanterns
Description: Cera blinks at the girl as sparks dance around her lantern like a gentle whisper. 'Come with me. I'll take you home.'

Name: 致命难题
Description: 设计灵感逐渐告竭，卡米开始不假思索地勾描出相同的妆面，在人们的称赞声里，渐渐出现了负面的评论。

Name: 信号觉醒
Description: 要怎样才能让她设计的妆容永远走在潮流前端，保持新鲜感？卡米停下脚步检视自己，开始思考这个重要的问题。

Name: 灵感容积
Description: 卡米作出了一项重大决定。在找到新的设计灵感之前，她要暂停营业，去寻找、去发现，去感受老师所说的生活。

Name: 机能概念
Description: 老师告诉她，要从生活中找寻。可什么才是生活？卡米惊觉她难以回答，忙碌的日子里，她甚至来不及欣赏日落。

Name: 致命难题·沁风
Description: 卡米好像明白了老师所说的生活：当她跳出繁重的工作，暂放对完美的苛求，去爱和感受时，生活便翩然降临了。

Name: 信号觉醒·沁风
Description: 色彩不再只是色彩，它们蕴含了更多的东西。当一抹粉色出现在她的笔下，它或许是鲜花，也或许是天边的霞彩。

Name: 灵感容积·沁风
Description: 工作室的火爆更胜从前，客人们都说，卡米的妆容会给人带来幸福，它不只是美的表现，也是情感和记忆的共鸣。

Name: 机能概念·沁风
Description: 卡米回到工作室，她重新成为了化妆师，不过她不再只执着于追求新潮，而是想创造更多的美好。

Name: 致命难题·柚夏
Description: 随着渐渐熟稔，卡米发现无论聊得多么欢快，少女都拒绝摘下口罩，也不肯在饮品店之外的地方与青年见面。

Name: 信号觉醒·柚夏
Description: 再次被拒绝的青年落寞地离去了。卡米望向少女，在询问之前，对方先摘下了口罩——一道疤痕烙在她的脸颊。

Name: 灵感容积·柚夏
Description: 南瓜马车过了零点便会消失无踪，魔法也会在妆面卸下后褪去。但或许，卡米心想，这能为少女带来一些勇气。

Name: 机能概念·柚夏
Description: 卡米抚摸着她的伤疤，让她闭上双眼。卡米取出化妆包，像是表演了一场魔法，伤痕在她再次睁眼时不见踪影。

Name: 致命难题·暮海
Description: 正如世界上没有相同的灵魂，个性也无法被某一种性格单独定义，卡米想，不是只有豪爽或刚毅才称得上个性。

Name: 信号觉醒·暮海
Description: 卡米并不认为女孩缺乏个性。她决定为女孩设计一款全新的妆容，这未必能使她得到成功，但或许能让她更自信。

Name: 灵感容积·暮海
Description: 重要的演出在即，女孩的心却从未如此沉静。她看向为她补妆的卡米，轻轻笑起来，眸中似乎蕴藏着无限的力量。

Name: 机能概念·暮海
Description: 女孩的性格安静温柔，舞蹈却并非如此。卡米为她铺上蓝、粉、黄的大胆配色，那是女孩口中，家乡暮色下的海。

Name: 灵机妙想
Description: 她想要拓宽视野，创造甜品更多的可能性！不同的原料，不同的造型，不同的风味，她都想一一尝试。

Name: 甜蜜探索
Description: 从高高的书架上取下更多更厚实的烹饪书籍，她埋头认真地阅读起来，伏案到深夜，意识便逐渐变得朦胧。

Name: 幻梦启程
Description: 一道虹色光晕悄然从书中弥漫开来，渐渐将她包裹其中。一段段充满乐趣的奇妙梦旅即将拉开帷幕。

Name: 灵机妙想·愿
Description: 她也想做些什么，真正参与到庆典之中来。出神地望向手心那把坚果，她灵光一现，快步朝不远处的厨房走去。

Name: 甜蜜探索·愿
Description: 小小的厨房内，慈祥的院长婆婆正熬着香浓的巧克力酱。她将巧克力与坚果巧妙结合，做出了一整盘甜甜圈。

Name: 幻梦启程·愿
Description: 孩子们欢呼着品尝她的创作，庆典在温暖的氛围中拉开序幕，她的心中幸福满满，期待着将美味分享给更多人。

Name: 灵机妙想·游
Description: 神清气爽的她跳下过山车，把落在掌心的糖豆塞进嘴里，小小的糖粒在口中噼啪弹跳，为她带来新奇的体验。

Name: 甜蜜探索·游
Description: 在晚会的甜品台前，她将洒满跳跳糖的蜜瓜甜甜圈捧在手心——没错，这就是她在这场旅行中最重要的收获！

Name: 幻梦启程·游
Description: 酸甜交织的口感，为她带来了崭新的味蕾体验！她暗暗下定决心，要把这种独特的感受分享给更多人。

Name: 灵机妙想·谜
Description: 森林尽头的木屋中竟摆放着十分齐全的厨房用具，她快步扑向制作台，此时此刻，她的专属魔法即将登场！

Name: 甜蜜探索·谜
Description: 大胆、专注、细致、还要加上十足的耐心，她深谙制作甜品的秘诀，一份堆满莓果的多层奶油甜甜圈渐渐成型。

Name: 幻梦启程·谜
Description: 望着造型独特，色泽诱人的甜甜圈，满足感充盈她的心田，她已迫不及待要将自己的作品分享给更多人了！

Name: 晚风玫瑰
Description: 即便是密切相处的成员们也很难找到合适的词语来形容她，非要说的话，丽嘉大概是一个血族般的女孩子？

Name: 璀璨镜华
Description: 一次又一次，表演大获成功。少女们心情难以平复，纷纷跑去后台捕捉丽嘉，要知道，她的行踪可是很难捉摸的。

Name: 魅影奇谈
Description: 月光如水，还没有换下演出礼服的丽嘉靠在窗前，慢悠悠地喝着一瓶草莓汁。这好像是她唯一感兴趣的东西。

Name: 无垠星空
Description: 少女们围在丽嘉身边坐成了一圈，七嘴八舌分享着下次表演的灵感。丽嘉十分苦恼，早知道就早点跑掉了！

Name: 晚风玫瑰·华丽
Description: 街道尽头出现了巨大的影子，它似乎有利爪、尾巴，甚至狰狞的獠牙。夜色里，闪着幽光的眼睛紧紧盯住了她们。

Name: 璀璨镜华·华丽
Description: 前所未有的恐惧席卷而来，蜜亚整个人像被丢进了冰水，她下意识地去抓身边人的衣摆——咦，为什么抓了个空？

Name: 魅影奇谈·华丽
Description: 原本站在她身边的丽嘉忽然出现在黑影面前，紧接着远处噼啪一阵乱响。那个狼人般的影子……似乎飞了出去？

Name: 无垠星空·华丽
Description: 丽嘉回到了瑟瑟发抖的少女们面前，蜜亚呆呆地问：“是新剧排练吗？”丽嘉只是敲了一下她的脑袋，微微一笑。

Name: 晚风玫瑰·珍稀
Description: 神奇的草莓汁成了关系的软化剂，起初冰山一样的丽嘉不再难以接近。至于走到她身边温度降低，那是幻觉吧！

Name: 璀璨镜华·珍稀
Description: 有时候成员们会为了舞台设计争执不休，年轻热烈的心聚在一起，灵感像烟火一样四处迸溅，也会偶尔烫伤彼此。

Name: 魅影奇谈·珍稀
Description: 她们的梦想莽撞又真诚，万千灯光下，想要把自己最闪耀的一面展现给世界，在绚烂的旅途中寻找未来的答案。

Name: 无垠星空·珍稀
Description: 某次争吵后成员们都闷闷不乐，而丽嘉捧着草莓汁走到大家面前，讲出了自己的设想——血族主题的舞台剧。

Name: 晚风玫瑰·流云
Description: 风靡一时的剧团淡出了视野，社交平台上的话题也被更新的潮流淹没。压力之下，投资人将目光投向了丽嘉。

Name: 璀璨镜华·流云
Description: 他们希望丽嘉延续之前的风格，再为组合设计一个相同主题的表演。出乎所有人意料的是，丽嘉拒绝了。

Name: 魅影奇谈·流云
Description: 成员们心中倍感沮丧。曾经任何问题到了丽嘉手中都会迎刃而解，所以她们本能地认为这次也该是一样的。

Name: 无垠星空·流云
Description: 这天夜里，蜜亚抱着丽嘉最喜欢的一款草莓汁穿过走廊。月光将她的影子拉得很长，最终停在丽嘉门前。

Name: 晚风玫瑰·午夜
Description: 少女的心事像草莓汁一样酸涩清甜。丽嘉想，这是她喝过最美味的草莓汁，此后漫长的光阴也永远不会忘记。

Name: 璀璨镜华·午夜
Description: 翌日，全新的舞台设计摆在了少女们面前。沿袭之前的主题，融合更多元素，是一个血族少女追求梦想的故事。

Name: 魅影奇谈·午夜
Description: 成员们感动得又哭又笑，纷纷扑上来抱住丽嘉。对上她求救的目光，蜜亚眨了眨眼睛。唔，血族不怕拥抱吧？

Name: 无垠星空·午夜
Description: 帷幕拉开，观众们屏住呼吸，仿佛跨越了无形的界线。血月的光辉又一次散落在舞台上，欢迎来到另一个世界——

Name: 盈盈暗香
Description: 疲惫的阿萝趴在桌上打了个盹儿，意识沉入梦境之时，画中的水面忽而轻曳，隐约从纸上无声洇出一圈圈波纹。

Name: 絮梦无声
Description: 再睁眼时，阿萝发现自己站在雾气弥漫的小路上。脚下的地面是与画幅同色的米白，幽长曲折，不知通向何方。

Name: 盈盈暗香·华丽
Description: 最后一位顾客离开时，夜色已然降临。柔和的灯光下，少女将最后的几朵花包好，作为小礼物送给了自己。

Name: 絮梦无声·华丽
Description: 少女吃着祖母送来的小饼干，躺在摇椅上长舒一口气，心想：如果当初我没有开一家花店，生活会是怎样的呢？

Name: 盈盈暗香·珍稀
Description: 少女手忙脚乱地从包里掏出相机，调整角度按下快门。她的眼睛闪闪发亮——或许这就是她一直以来追求的作品。

Name: 絮梦无声·珍稀
Description: 回家路上，少女兴高采烈地给祖母分享了今天的见闻，假如自己没有成为一个摄影师，可就要错过今天的风景啦！

Name: 盈盈暗香·兰烟
Description: 阿萝想，祖母赠予她最宝贵的礼物并非画作，而是漫长光阴中无声的关怀和支持，让她有勇气向梦想的远方出发。

Name: 絮梦无声·兰烟
Description: 四周的雾气缓缓升起，旧日天光隐没在视线尽头。阿萝依稀听到耳畔有画纸被风吹动的轻响，像一场梦缓缓苏醒。

Name: 盈盈暗香·林荫
Description: 阿萝的新作品获得了业界的好评，多种风格融合得恰到好处，不同的材质碰撞间迸射出了格外夺目的光华。

Name: 絮梦无声·林荫
Description: 那究竟是一场梦，还是不同世界的另一段人生呢？阿萝笑着摇了摇头，精心收好了那幅画卷。

Name: 午后煦阳
Description: 她会一直等我吗？我要永远与她身上比阳光还要温暖的气息，还有那些懒洋洋蜷在她怀中的午后告别了吗？

Name: 喵喵循环
Description: 蹿过一扇一扇门，我终于在一处台阶前停住脚步。我开始加速奔跑——多么幸运，我闻到了她和家的味道。

Name: 午后煦阳·愉
Description: 她难得闲下来休息时，我可不会像其他猫一样冲过去围在她身边……十分钟都过去了，被摸头的猫也该是我了吧！

Name: 喵喵循环·愉
Description: 她搭起了一个温暖的港湾，我和伙伴们都曾在这座城市里漫无目的地行走，而如今，我们拥有了一个共同的家。

Name: 午后煦阳·欢
Description: 遇到她是一个转折。她打开闪闪发光的大门，让我走进她漂亮的咖啡屋。危险消失了，像阴影消失在阳光下。

Name: 喵喵循环·欢
Description: 这里永远气温适宜，有友好的玩伴，和固定时间会出现的美味罐头……在她身边，巨大的幸福感牢牢将我包围。

Name: 繁花序言
Description: 生机悄然自花园流逝，往日娇嫩的花瓣蜷缩成脆弱的褐色，被悉心呵护的叶片慢慢褪去光泽，犹如蒙尘。

Name: 馥郁旧诗
Description: 茜娅的心也随着凋零的花摇摇欲坠，繁花似锦就在昨日，却像消散成泡影的一场美梦，无处追寻。

Name: 岁月芬馨
Description: 或许是出于对花园的爱护之心，又或是对回忆的不舍眷念，茜娅决心寻找方法，让花园重焕生机。

Name: 花蔓萦系
Description: 花园在暮色下沉默，路过的风卷起枯萎的叶片，卷起一地残骸。茜娅突然想起母亲曾握着她的手，轻轻抚过叶脉。

Name: 繁花序言·萌
Description: 藤蔓顺着木架子攀缘缠绕，开出细碎的小花，在窗台轻轻摇曳。茜娅迫不及待换好衣裳，跑入园中。

Name: 馥郁旧诗·萌
Description: 灿金的迎春花、洁白的玉兰花、红色的山茶花……茜娅慢慢走着，繁花拂过她的身畔，留下久久不散的香气。

Name: 岁月芬馨·萌
Description: 茜娅的目光在枝叶间流连，她感到双眼有些酸涩，眨了眨，竟落下眼泪来。浓绿之中，一朵粉色的花苞还在沉睡。

Name: 花蔓萦系·萌
Description: 终于，茜娅在一棵树前站定，这棵不知品种的矮树，年年都会开出粉色的花——那是她与母亲一同种下的。

Name: 繁花序言·忆
Description: 小小的牛皮纸包自纸页间滑落，茜娅小心翼翼地展开，里面裹着的花种越过时光，为她带来新的希望。

Name: 馥郁旧诗·忆
Description: 按着母亲的手札指引，她收拾行囊，启程前往小镇外的一片树林，据说那儿有一座永不冻结的泉眼。

Name: 岁月芬馨·忆
Description: 茜娅搭起抵挡寒风的防护，坚持每日去打那特别的泉水，她相信，繁花将再次拥抱这片被爱守护的土地。

Name: 花蔓萦系·忆
Description: 温热的泉水渗入土壤，茜娅静静地等待，终于在第七天清晨，看见土壤里钻出一点嫩绿的幼芽。

Name: 峥嵘礼赞
Description: 穿越险峻隘口，避开敌军埋伏，在她准确的指引下，队伍及时将关键情报送达指挥部，改变了战局的走向。

Name: 凯旋乐章
Description: 又一场战斗即将打响，她手握铜号走在队伍中央，相信由音符传递的指令，一定会给王国带去光辉的未来。

Name: 胜利诗篇
Description: 战友们为她补上了入伍仪式，她再次接过那把军号——这是她最喜爱的乐器，此刻又承载了更沉重的使命与责任。

Name: 峥嵘礼赞·夜
Description: 反攻很快被组织起来，敌军无奈撤退。为表彰她的临危不乱，她被提拔为军官，和队长一同讨论战术部署。

Name: 凯旋乐章·夜
Description: 休息的日子里，她认真研读了各类兵法，只为寻找到更有效的战术，为战斗更添一分把握，为胜利增加一份筹码。

Name: 胜利诗篇·夜
Description: 结合队伍的特点与作战需求，她设计了全新的传讯体系，更加灵活机动且难以破译，小队的战斗力更上一层楼。

Name: 峥嵘礼赞·曦
Description: 结束了一天的工作后，她常去街头漫步，重建后的城市欣欣向荣，拿着乐器的孩子们有说有笑地走在回家的路上。

Name: 凯旋乐章·曦
Description: 暮色四合，悠扬的小号声又响了起来，引得行人驻足倾听。天边白鸽振翅高飞，一片洁白的羽毛轻落在她的窗前。

Name: 胜利诗篇·曦
Description: 少时的音乐梦想并未被她遗忘，虽然如今的身份不便登台表演，但她仍私下练习了几首动人的经典曲目。

Name: Floral Symphony
Description: Musellele's songs breathed life into every corner of the forest, but the musician's life inevitably came to an end.

Name: Fantasy Euphoria
Description: Every day, Musellele would play tunes they co-wrote with a floral instrument, and the musician would smile by the window.

Name: Windchime Whisper
Description: Until one morning, a melodious voice rode the wind and fell upon the musician's ear, pulling her out of isolation.

Name: Tender Affinity
Description: Step by step, the musician left the house and saw Musellele. Friendship was born the moment they locked eyes.

Name: Unnamed Ensemble
Description: They became friends who shared inspirations. Musellele brought sounds of nature as they co-wrote songs on trees.

Name: Viny Vibrato
Description: The musician grew weaker and more dormant. Musellele spent every day with her, her tunes turning sorrowful.

Name: Memory Resonance
Description: On a breezy evening, the musician's life came to a rest. Musellele played their songs, longing drifting in the wind.

Name: Echoing Sonata
Description: The music of the wind and flower never fades, and friends will eventually follow the notes of the past to each other.

Name: Breeze's Message
Description: A wounded bird drops into the royal garden, white feathers thick with grime. Its cry tells of ruin in the north.

Name: Tender Verse
Description: Rosalia's father spares her state affairs. She's too soft-hearted and frail to guard the frontier like her sister.

Name: Fragrant Hedge
Description: A sudden disaster strikes the north. The nobles argue endlessly. She holds the bird and gently touches its wing.

Name: Rosy Horizon
Description: Still, she wants to help. Like blossoms over barren land, she moves through shelters and dazed crowds.

Name: Fragrant Messenger
Description: Rosalia visits the camp again. People have packed their belongings and are returning to where they fled.

Name: Radiant Grace
Description: She brings medicine to the sick, wraps wounds, and gives water and bread to crying children. At dusk, she sings.

Name: Scarlet Devotion
Description: A field can wither overnight. But plant a seed of hope, and fierce courage will take root in every soul.

Name: Traces of Bloom
Description: Birds call out with bright voices. Their healed wings spread wide, carrying hoped-for good news from the north.

Name: Surging Tides
Description: One day, Eve sets off alone against all advice. The village mourns. Eve knows her destiny awaits in the deep.

Name: Unceasing Storm
Description: She asks over and over, 'What lies in the depths? Where does the sea end?' Even the wisest cannot answer.

Name: Silent Waters
Description: This is a deity never recorded in any text. To most eyes, she is only a streak of green lightning in the sky.

Name: Shining Reflection
Description: The lone ship meets the storm at last. The dark night brightens. The deity glows in a halo of brilliant light.

Name: Starry Spray
Description: Wind pounds the hull, waves crash, yet Eve grows still. The deity in the void turns and casts a glance her way.

Name: Misty Glow
Description: Green lightning splits the sky as the deity lifts Eve. Ancient wisdom awakens, revealing hidden secrets.

Name: Abyssal Sound
Description: Inside the rift is a place beyond all rules. The deity stands guard so the world is not swallowed whole.

Name: Nocturnal Whispers
Description: Each deity chooses a successor before their power fades and summons them to the deep to share their memories.

Name: Misty Celestial River
Description: The world is scarred by cracks in time beyond repair. As power surges, thunder echoes without end.

Name: Curtain of Clouds
Description: Eve never returns. Years later, a girl sits by the sea, always asking, 'What hides in the deep?'

Name: 雅韵风馨
Description: 旧编残卷对青灯，风庭流霭夜细誊。自有暗香生寒泓，笃行致远此相承。

Name: 寒塘灵影
Description: 醒来的少年并未放下心防，成日里提心吊胆，然而随着时间的推移，传闻中的恐怖奇谈并未在他身上应验。

Name: 流华含香
Description: 书册翻到了末尾，微风吹拂着页角作响。少年的心提到了嗓子眼儿，阿湄敲了下他的额头，说要带他出去走走。

Name: 心火灼魄
Description: 这儿自有一片与外界不同的风景，树木高大，鸟兽徘徊，他们翻过高高的山岭，在崖边一起望向远天明澈的月亮。

Name: 蟾宫怀光
Description: 那一夜的月色仿佛穿越亘古，少年转头去看阿湄，阿湄也在望着他。少年伸手摘下一片树叶，折在唇边吹出了曲。

Name: 万顷天波
Description: 绘制《山川录》时他只是游荡山水的游侠，但江湖的风雨早已沾湿他的衣角，他终有一日要回到自己的命运中。

Name: 故梦阑珊
Description: 阿湄终于学会了那支曲子。她在书册上画了一只小小银蝶，那只银蝶会带着她的心飞出迷雾，飞向世上任何角落。

Name: 银蛇蜕骨
Description: 这一日她将书册还给少年：“你该走了”。她认得当日少年身上的伤痕源于追杀，他来自江湖，也终会回到江湖。

Name: 天音渡水
Description: 阿湄笨拙地也学着拿树叶吹曲子，陌生的小调在林叶簌簌声中摇荡。少年说，那是他家乡的曲子，他只会这一首。

Name: 雾林霜夜
Description: 阿湄问起他为何闯入此地，少年取出一册《山川录》，其中是他绘制记录的名山大川，他想完成一本天下志书。

Name: Fruit of Verdant Peaks
Description: Back home, Grandma steams the brewing starter, humming, 'A soft breeze drifts by; peach blossoms send me wine.'

Name: Budding Aroma
Description: Grandma watches Dai arrange the dew in the yard and smiles, 'Have some sweet rice cakes first. Work can wait.'

Name: Lanternborne Hopes
Description: Tears slid down her cheeks, not from sadness, but from beauty so vivid. The world was far more radiant than she knew.

Name: Light Year Reverie
Description: As colors faded, Snowy's dress turned white again, yet that rosy brilliance still lingered in Tessa's heart.

Name: Crystal Winter Blessing
Description: Awakened by Tessa's love, the fairy within Snowy gathered her strength, hoping to show Tessa true color for a moment.

Name: Frostborne Crown
Description: What color was the world, really? Books described hues she had never seen, none of them matching her own vision.

Name: Rosebloom Whispers
Description: Sometimes she looked to Snowy, unsure whether the colors were real or imagined, and fearing the answer either way.

Name: Embrace of Stars
Description: Unnoticed, the fairy within Snowy watched her too, her power slowly growing through Tessa's gentle, unwavering love.

Name: Velvet Waltz
Description: Snowy couldn't speak, but she longed to tell Tessa: the world's colors are wondrous, and yours are precious too.

Name: Bloom of Devotion
Description: One Christmas, Tessa wound the key again. The music rose louder than ever. Then something miraculous occurred.

Name: Iceflower Bloom
Description: Light burst from Snowy's chest. Crimson swept across the globe like a rose blooming in a world of falling snow.

Name: Innocent Verse
Description: Tessa stared in awe. The colors she had only read about now blossomed before her eyes, vivid as early spring.

Name: Flawless Snowfall
Description: Through Snowy's eyes, the fairy saw Tessa's joys and fears. Her hesitant brushstrokes and her muffled sobs at night.

Name: Luminous Wishes
Description: Whisper a wish to the moonlit magnolia tree. The wind rustles the leaves as a gentle response to all worries.

Name: Eternal Echo
Description: Thank you, Snowy,' she whispered. Inside the globe, the tiny doll smiled softly, as if quietly replying to her.

Name: Drift of Petals
Description: Years later, Tessa became a musician. She never forgot that miraculous night or the rose that bloomed just for her.

Name: Cloudsoft Encounter
Description: She found the wooden box in the attic. Inside, her grandma's hand bell lay in red silk, its mistletoe still lush.

Name: Soft Snowfluff
Description: Bundled in her coat, Loryn stepped into the snow. A few deer startled and bounded away into the pines.

Name: Luminous Melody
Description: Though the wind still blew, coldness no longer froze the town. Falling snows chimed like bells in the winter air.

Name: Dreamy Prelude
Description: The cheerful melody echoed through town, carrying gentle magic. Deer peeked from the pines with curiosity.

Name: Bell Chime Echo
Description: Memories of past felt like magic, lifting her spirits as she played the familiar bell song in the swirling snow.

Name: Snowfall Fairytale
Description: Warm golden lights lit the town like stars. Windows opened one by one as children leaned out, gasping at the sight.

Name: Echo of Winter Wish
Description: People brought out sleighs. Cinnamon sweetness filled the air. Winter lingered, but joy warmed the town again.

Name: Starcrossed Wonder
Description: Children catch falling stardust in delight, lovers embrace under mistletoe; bells in the snowfall carry joy afar.

Name: Melody of Bells
Description: Lights shine like stars, snow drifts like dreams. Lalati sits atop a high roof, admiring the world she loves most.

Name: Carol of the Holy Night
Description: Sometimes Lalati watches children build snowmen; sometimes she sends the wind to deliver longing.

Name: Glittering Hope
Description: Wishes rise to her and turn into glowing stars. Dreams and thoughts sparkle across the night sky with gentle light.

Name: Starlight Over Night
Description: Her song rekindles an old man's memories. He finds his beloved's music box, its melody leading him to sweet dreams.

Name: Festive Charm
Description: Lalati's wand paints bright arcs in the air. Starlight swirls down with her song, adorning the night with wonder.

Name: Heart's Resonance
Description: Bells ring. The child rushes into her parents' arms, the kitten sleeps on the girl's lap, and young love blooms anew.

Name: Starlit Way Home
Description: A child missing her parents rings the bell, and her song crosses stormy seas to guide lost ships safely home.

Name: Tender Wishes
Description: Her voice drifts into a snowy garden. A youth looks up as a red rose falls onto his sill, like a lover blushing.

Name: Shimmering Blessing
Description: The kitten peeks from the girl's arms. Lalati smiles. Little one, from today on, warmth surrounds you.

Name: Tale of Gleaming Light
Description: A stray kitten follows the song into an alley, just as a lonely girl opens her door, meeting it on this winter night.

Name: Gleaming Wish
Description: Warmth fills Lalati's heart. She grants each wish with magic, and people answer with their truest gratitude.

Name: Radiant Vow
Description: Starlight bathes the world. All worries melt in her melody, her blessing guarding every soul till dawn.

Name: 巧心贝雷帽
Description: 打开好友递来的礼盒，里面居然是她一直想要的格纹贝雷帽！耳边响起对方惊喜的低呼，少女不由扬起了唇角。

Name: 巧思偶得
Description: 在妹妹的眼里，几十块拼图碎片像是色彩斑斓的糖果，让她眼花缭乱，菲莉丝耐心引导着她一步步构建起框架。

Name: 素雅格纹
Description: 渐渐地，妹妹开始能够将手中的拼图放在合适的位置，每当此时，她都会惊喜地看向菲莉丝，期待姐姐的夸奖。

Name: 拼图随想
Description: 女孩愉快的笑声中，菲莉丝想，也许拼图的快乐不必源于最终的成功，而在于每一次尝试，在于享受当下的时光。

Name: Starlight Spectacle
Description: This is so good!' Riki exclaims. 'If only I could share the cookie sticks with everyone. I must let them have a try!'

Name: Spark of Inspiration
Description: Frustrated, Riki sits by the window, biting into the cookie sticks from the office. Sweetness lingers in her mouth.

Name: Velvet Dreams
Description: Her wish to share the cookie sticks kindles a flame of passion in her. She's no longer frustrated with her work.

Name: Caramel Crunch
Description: Coworkers excitedly invite Riki to the holiday event at the nearby square, but she kindly declines.

Name: Radiant Vision
Description: As night falls, crowds swarm into the square for the holiday. Only Riki remains in the empty office, drowning in thoughts.

Name: Cosmic Overture
Description: As she stares at the sky, a golden beam ignites the night as rainbow colors bloom outside the window.

Name: 新手上路
Description: 温馨提醒：新手上路要严格遵守交通规则，注意周边行人与车辆；小心驾驶，安全第一哦~

Name: Stellar Rhythm
Description: The colorful sparkles shine on the windows. Riki watches in a daze when suddenly an idea hits her.

Name: 香脆饼干棒
Description: “咔嚓”一口，香脆的饼干棒立刻在唇齿间迸出甜蜜的滋味——烦恼消失不见，想象天马行空。

Name: 悠风颂曲
Description: 点点星光洒落，漾起高塔祭坛下的水波，她依稀听见了星辉没入水面的响声，巨大的命运之手亦在其间轻轻搅动。

Name: 星眠云梦
Description: 浓夜渐褪作荧蓝色，不知不觉，最后一颗星子也眨了眨眼，躲入云间，天边浮起了贝母般皎洁温润的乳白。

Name: 虔挚誓约
Description: 鲜妍的花朵被蝴蝶眷恋，虔挚的心灵得命运垂青。神秘的女人悄然造访，为她带来一副可以窥得星夜奥秘的纸牌。

Name: 晨星之牌
Description: 从遥望星空，到划桨驶入星河深处，她已记住所有星星的名字，而漫天繁星亦一次次呼唤她的名字：罗雅。

Name: 幽蓝夜海
Description: 无数静谧的黑夜，少女独自在星光下悉心学习。她一遍遍轻抚卡牌上的金色星图，聆听风中群星的温柔低语。

Name: 星之奥秘
Description: 为迷途者解惑，使悲痛者忘忧，罗雅排布卡牌，向浩瀚星空寻觅答案，又将它带给那些渴求着答案的人。

Name: 天辉吟唱
Description: 她有时穿着小靴子推着雪橇跑来跑去，有时花一下午堆出歪歪扭扭的城堡，傍晚的天光会为城堡染上绮丽的色彩。

Name: 风雪孤光
Description: 每当夜色降临，风吹过雪原总会发出空灵的声响，像是谁在絮絮低语，小法西安窝在母亲怀里听着风声沉入梦乡。

Name: 冰原行歌
Description: 法西安的梦中也总下着漫天大雪，坐在雪橇上的女孩正恍惚陷入回忆，身下忽而一沉，雪橇歪入了一个大雪洞中。

Name: 晦雪静临
Description: 世界仿佛瞬间安静下来。法西安跌坐在雪洞底部，只觉得四周冰冷而柔软，视线中的一点天色渐渐暗了下去。

Name: 天辉吟唱·夜
Description: 再次醒来时，法西安已经躺在了温暖的被窝里。她茫然地眨眨眼睛，迎上了床边母亲严肃又无奈的面庞。

Name: 风雪孤光·夜
Description: 父母说，他们发现法西安的时候，雪橇静静停在后院的门廊下，而小法西安趴在上面睡得正香，似乎做了场美梦。

Name: 冰原行歌·夜
Description: “法西安，你必须和我保证，没有下次了！”成为晦雪哨站负责人的法西安生动地模仿母亲当时眉毛倒竖的模样。

Name: 晦雪静临·夜
Description: 众人哈哈大笑。法西安偶尔会在闲聊时提起这件有些奇妙的往事，不少同事都笑着打趣她是“冰雪的女儿”。

Name: 贝与星光
Description: 直到某天清晨露比娜醒来，阳光一如既往散落在地板上，一种莫名的空虚感击中了她的心。她想要走出那片迷雾。

Name: 幻心漫游
Description: 少女的心事像水晶般在晨曦中折射出不同的光线，母亲听完露比娜倾诉自己的烦恼，笑着邀请她一起去海边潜水。

Name: 白昼漩洑
Description: 露比娜微微愣住了。她从小生活在海边，大海对她而言是一片沉默的风景，是每天都会经过却从不深入的存在。

Name: 宁谧潮歌
Description: 那是露比娜第一次尝试潜水。当身体缓缓沉入水中，世界像被一只温柔的手翻转过来，只能听到自己的呼吸声。

Name: 贝与星光·幽
Description: 露比娜知道，这才是大海教给她的最重要的一课，她学会了如何与世界相处，如何在迷茫的时刻找回自己的心。

Name: 幻心漫游·幽
Description: 最初只是简单的，一个少女与大海的故事。写作像潜水，需要耐心与对未知的敬畏，在沉静中聆听内心的回响。

Name: 白昼漩洑·幽
Description: 她的文字中蕴藏着大海的呼吸，宁静温柔又潜藏着无尽色彩。读者们都亲切地称呼她为“来自海洋的吟游诗人”。

Name: 宁谧潮歌·幽
Description: 后来，露比娜搬进了属于自己的海边公寓。大海陪伴着她度过无数创作的时光，而她也拥有了无尽的想象与自由。

Name: 碧竹凝露
Description: 每日牧心都会独往春神庙中小坐，静听风过林梢的簌簌低语，细辨草木抽枝发芽的动静，仿佛自然在与她对话。

Name: 枕风眠云
Description: 她尤为喜爱这样宁静的时刻，常在斑驳树影下阖上双眼，枕着徐徐微风与融融春声，不觉间便沉入梦乡。

Name: 蝶憩春时
Description: 待到梦醒时，衣上栖着几只蝴蝶，一时分不清是梦非梦，牧心轻轻伸了个懒腰，只觉得神清气爽，疲倦尽消。

Name: 翠微清晓
Description: 梦里她化作了一株柳树，根须深深扎入湿润的泥土，舒展的枝条轻拂过流云春风，仿佛融入了天地之间。

Name: 碧竹凝露·暖阳
Description: 梦中杨柳依依，她看见柳树的枝条化作万千雨丝，随风飘落入江河湖泊，融入干涸的泥土，唤醒了大地的生机。

Name: 枕风眠云·暖阳
Description: 再度醒来时，耳畔传来久违的淅沥清响，她抬眼望去，春神庙外，细雨绵绵，万千银丝终于笼罩了这片天地。

Name: 蝶憩春时·暖阳
Description: “雨……雨！”牧心激动地扑进乡亲们怀中，发出了她来到这世间的第一个音节，如同惊蛰时节的第一声春雷。

Name: 翠微清晓·暖阳
Description: 她欣喜若狂地奔下山去，任由雨水打湿了衣衫。乡亲们在雨中相拥而泣，孩子们的欢声穿透雨幕，在田间回响。

Name: 金缕绾云
