Description: 等回到家，一股热浪裹着欢闹扑面而来。电视里放着特别节目，热火朝天；厨房锅铲碰撞，香气扑鼻。

Name: 梅绽千瑞
Description: 屋子里都是熟悉的面孔，她一一叫过人，长辈们欢欢喜喜地应了，又七嘴八舌地关心起她在外的生活。

Name: 三冬蕴玉
Description: 那些问题琐碎而重复，声音交织成一片，她有些无奈，却又好似回到了最温暖的港湾，整个人都柔软下来。

Name: 寸锦纳福
Description: 像一块冻得太久的冰，终于在此刻缓缓融化。她无需精心措辞准备什么开场白，便轻而易举地融入这份安宁之中。

Name: 贺新禧
Description: 桌上挤挤挨挨，盘子叠着盘子，碗挨着碗。鱼汤奶白浓郁、炖肉红润醇香、时蔬碧绿爽脆……让人食指大动。

Name: 共佳时
Description: 窗外，不知哪家率先燃起了烟花。“咻——砰！”绚烂的光猛地炸开，映亮了万家灯火，和这鼎沸的人间团圆日。

Name: 历添新岁
Description: 清冽的空气里掺着一丝熟悉的腊梅香，不知从何处来，无声勾起的那些遥远的成长记忆，竟前所未有的清晰。

Name: 折芳寄岁
Description: 少女蓦然昂首看去，夜风拂起了她发间梅簪的流苏，清澈的眼瞳中，映出万千绚烂花火，于天边轰然绽放

Name: 胧月疏影
Description: 远处传来热闹的爆竹声，细雪轻落在少女手中的提灯上。暖光流转间，梅影与霜雪相映，照彻又一年新岁好时节。

Name: Crimson Promise
Description: The racecar tears through the night, symbolizing every woman who pushes her limits, eyes locked on victory.

Name: Fiery Inscription
Description: With the wheel in hand, I control my destiny. Today, I define the ride, as the engine's roar becomes endless cheers.

Name: Swift Message
Description: Racing down life's track, free as the wind, daring each second to floor the pedal, I move toward my heart's desire.

Name: 福喵迎财
Description: “财神开富路，瑞气进门庭！招财进宝年年有，值此佳节，本喵喵财神祝你......八方来财！来大财！”

Name: Pastoral Butterfly
Description: At the end of the trail, a girl sits on a vine swing. The wind sways her gently, her hair fluttering like butterfly wings.

Name: Sunglow Ballad
Description: The sunset glow marks not the end of a journey, but the start of the next one. Let bonfire ballads fill the air.

Name: Dreamy Memories
Description: Her camera quietly captures every memorable moment, turning them into treasures to be cherished.

Name: Brisk Whimsy
Description: Youth blooms like a flower. The girl refuses to let it pass her by and decides to turn it into beautiful verses.

Name: Future Preface
Description: In the dawn's light, a new chapter of youth begins. Write down your story about dreams from the first page!

Name: Dreamward Prologue
Description: Passing the classroom windows, the wind grazes the girl's fingertips as she writes, heralding a season of hope.

Name: Scarlet Grace
Description: A scarlet flower in a porcelain vase blooms in the chill, golden pistils sticking their heads out to welcome spring.

Name: Roseate Brocade
Description: Chunxun bids her farewell, holds the vase, and quickens her steps, imagining the flower in her new home.

Name: 萝萝迎福
Description: 萝萝们热情地拉着暖暖的手，参观一个个精心布置的灯市摊位，高高举起自己写的福字向她展示。

Name: 云幕流香
Description: 暖暖欣然答应花令微的邀请，和她一道逛起了灯市。一路上，花令微给暖暖分享了不少小萝卜的趣事。

Name: 载花携游
Description: 花令微告诉暖暖，一年十二月，月月是花期，因而不论寒暑，无名谷中皆是花团锦簇的热闹样子。

Name: 烟青饮雪
Description: 花令微曾想西行，无论如何也上雪山移栽一朵来，可每每都因放心不下谷中的花花草草，未能成行。

Name: 风雅诗情
Description: 在萝萝们期待的目光里，花令微和暖暖拿起墨笔，在红底金边的纸上留下了不少与今夜灯市相宜的诗句。

Name: 灵岫冰魄
Description: 暖暖得知，这位司花隐者能种出所有她知晓的花，只除了一种，那花长在雪域高山上，不入人间喧嚣处。

Name: 闲墨偶寄
Description: 还有还有呢！另一只萝萝连忙补充，那只小萝卜还承诺，要是日后路过雪山，必要帮花姑带一朵雪域之花回来！

Name: 春泉漱玉
Description: 一只萝萝悄悄和暖暖说，曾有小萝卜误入花谷，误摘了两朵玉簪花，被花令微压着堆了足足半个月的花肥赔罪。

Name: 觅国色
Description: 微风拂过她轻蹙的眉间，似为抚平忧愁而至，丹华发丝间那朵粉牡丹随风摇曳，一缕清幽的香气悄然散开。

Name: 飞花引
Description: 四处遍寻花种不得，沮丧萦绕丹华心头久未散去，她行至一处静谧湖畔稍作歇息，湖面如镜，映出她的缕缕愁绪。

Name: 寻天香
Description: 不多时，一只粉蝶竟从柳梢枝头循着这缕天香翩跹而至，栖落于丹华鬓间的牡丹，蝶翼轻扇，仿若觅得心安归处。

Name: 振翅蝶
Description: 丹华双眸中掠过一丝讶色，陆陆续续，又有不少粉蝶朝她飞舞而来，或绕着衣袂裙裾打转，或轻盈落于她的指尖。

Name: 翩然诗
Description: 丹华所寻觅的花种牢牢扎根沃土，绿芽萌发，春风叩醒一片姹紫嫣红，蝶影翩跹，欢快地流连牡丹丛间。

Name: 拂云霓
Description: 心下一动，丹华似有所悟，便起身随那蝶影而行，粉蝶簇拥相伴，在前引路，穿过一片绿意盎然，眼前豁然开朗。

Name: 金玉璎
Description: 蝴蝶忽地振翅，直直朝着湖畔一旁的蓊郁林木而去，飞出约莫一丈远后，却又轻巧折返，在她眼前盈盈徘徊。

Name: 玲珑环
Description: 恰逢暮春，正是人间芳菲灿烂时，斜阳泼金，染出一树绯色连天，陌上新绿遍野，暖风过处，铺开一副斑斓画卷。

Name: 灵雀报春
Description: 天真的笑颜牵动了云翎的心弦，她飞到小娃娃面前，用爪子挑开发带的结扣，动作轻柔得像是春风拂过花蕾。

Name: 铺锦列绣
Description: 小娃娃看到云翎的样子，眼睛顿时亮得像盛满了星星，小手兴奋地拍着：“雀儿雀儿！你长得和鼓上画的一样！”

Name: 翔鸾蔚羽
Description: 刚刚苏醒的青蛙从嫩草丛中跳了出来，小娃娃一阵惊喜，将拨浪鼓摇个不停，连发带缠住了手腕也浑然不觉。

Name: 景明春和
Description: 小娃娃梳着的羊角辫一跑一颠，手中红漆拨浪鼓随着她的脚步叮咚作响，鼓面上还画着只歪歪扭扭的小雀儿。

Name: 瑶芳琼蕊
Description: 云翎歪头看着鼓面上稚拙的画，用喙尖在鼓面上轻轻一点，拨浪鼓上的雀儿便扑棱着翅膀飞出了鼓面。

Name: 琅声逸韵
Description: 稚童击鼗鸟伴欢，漫引生机入远峦。小娃娃玩累了，在柳下沉沉睡去，云翎的羽翼拂过她的额头，将她送回家中。

Name: 玲珑浮翠
Description: 流光勾勒出的雀鸟展翅盘旋，看得小娃娃满心欢喜。她轻轻抚上雀翎，鸟儿化作金光散去，掌心却多了一枚糖果。

Name: 锦粲珠环
Description: 每到春日，云翎便会回到人间，总有稚童指着她笑起来：“雀儿雀儿！春天要到了吗？雀儿雀儿，你可真好看！”

Name: 水佩霓裳
Description: 等孩子们玩够了，云翎便化作原型，升入青霄，翎羽柔和地拂过孩童们的脸颊，像是道别，也像是约定来年再会。

Name: 鼗铎欢音
Description: 偶尔玩心大起，云翎便幻化成少女模样，拨浪鼓打着欢快的节拍，引得孩子们追着她跑，笑声惊飞了满树的雀鸟。

Name: 胭红点绛
Description: 心中忽有所感，云翎在一阵春风中化作了人形。一面拨浪鼓在她手中幻化而出，轻快的乐音像极了稚童的笑语。

Name: 瑶蕊拂风
Description: 佳节将至时，云端人会在家中挂上一幅花鸟春景的图卷，祈愿绣画中的仙灵能够保佑孩子喜乐无忧，平安成长。

Name: 诚挚守护
Description: 走进密林的时候，树精从阴影中显现。藤蔓像枯槁的双手试图抓住她的衣摆，想将她留在一场永恒的梦中。

Name: 甘美燃烛
Description: 恶龙在剑光中低吼着，最终不甘心地退回巢穴，公主继续向前走，她无比清楚这一切都是自己必须经历的考验。

Name: 微缩茶会
Description: 狡猾的树精总是难以打败的，公主向它们讲述了自己的故事。在沙沙的风声中藤蔓逐渐放松，为她让出一条小路。

Name: 命运秘酿
Description: 公主在一个风雪中的黄昏抵达了古堡。大门向她缓缓敞开，窗户里亮着温暖的红色烛火，像一颗跳动不息的心脏。

Name: 灵魂契约
Description: 可爱的侍者摆放着餐具，金餐碟与水晶杯映着烛光，石榴果粒如红宝石般堆积，华美晚宴终于等到了尊贵的客人。

Name: 断罪狂想
Description: 小公主在华美宫殿中长大，她有一颗水晶般的心。恶毒的魔法师向她求爱，被拒绝后对她降下了残忍的诅咒。

Name: 岁月终焉
Description: 魔女坐在长桌的尽头，她有一头石榴籽般的绯红长发，公主隔着烛光凝望着她，岁月似乎不能给她留下任何痕迹。

Name: 纯白誓约
Description: 如同招待每一位远道而来的客人一样，魔女为公主斟了一杯酒。“为什么想要爱情秘药呢？”她这样问公主。

Name: 纯白誓愿
Description: 后来，少女们叩响古堡的门扉，烛火明亮如旧，魔女却不再孤身一人。她们并肩而坐，听完每个关于爱情的故事。

Name: 仙雾缭绕
Description: 本该是才子佳人的美谈，红线一端安稳拴在才子手上，另一端却套上了……一棵桃花树！阿绯在彤云上尖叫起来。

Name: 千千姻缘
Description: 阿绯第一次见到小帮手，便是在彤霞压枝，缠满红线的姻缘树下，少年眉目清朗，看呆了的阿绯手不由一抖。

Name: 灼灼花事
Description: 管事神仙也没想到阿绯会如此艰难，便使尽浑身解数又给阿绯找了个小帮手，惟愿能保住她所剩无几的功德。

Name: 风月纪年
Description: 阿绯花了半个月修补这段姻缘，总算让有情人终成眷属。回到月老府后，她望着自己被扣的功德欲哭无泪。

Name: 烟火赋诗
Description: 少年阿寻来到阿绯身边，面对的第一个问题就是被倒挂在了姻缘树上怎么办。阿绯急急忙忙道歉，将他解救下来。

Name: 情生动意
Description: 在阿寻的协助下，阿绯的工作渐渐步入正轨，虽然偶尔还是会闹出一些小乌龙，至少没有再给别人和桃花树牵线。

Name: 绮霞绣伞
Description: 某天一场惊天动地的雷暴后，红线乱作一团，阿绯在姻缘树下直叹气：不知是哪两尊神起了争执，殃及了月老府。

Name: 暗换流年
Description: 有时阿绯忙碌了一天，万家灯火升上梢头，阿寻就会在街角捧着热腾腾的糖糕等她，眼睛比天上的星星更加明亮。

Name: 万般机缘
Description: 在那些繁重琐碎的日常里，他的身影总是近在咫尺。原来两人已经一起看过了那么多风景，一起做了那么多事。

Name: 朝夕铭怀
Description: 阿绯的思绪忽然飘远了。她和阿寻的初见，也是在这姻缘树下呢。不知不觉，流水似的光阴已从指缝间悄然滑过。

Name: 梦雨溪头
Description: 月老府的神仙感到十分欣慰，自己的决策总是无比正确。随着姻缘线一条条牵起，月老府的香火日益旺盛。

Name: 仙云出岫
Description: 阿绯将被打乱的姻缘线一条条收好，整理其中一条时，另一端却被股力量拉扯着，她抬头，撞见阿寻泛红的脸颊。

Name: 溯影芳音
Description: 姻缘树生出的红线源源不断，阿绯没有再失手把书生拴给桃花树，阿寻也不会再因赶时间而差点带错了玉符。

Name: 花音百曲
Description: 无数道红线牵起人世间姻缘，怦然心动皆在无可言说的一瞬间。属于阿绯的那条红线，另一端如今又系在哪里呢？

Name: 葳蕤雕镌
Description: 渐渐地，雕塑家重新拿起了刻刀。他将所有情感与对爱人的思念倾注到雕塑中，在寂静的庄园里潜心打磨作品。

Name: 神迹之约
Description: 在很长一段时间里，雕塑家无法创作。站在空旷的工作室，他第一次产生了怀疑：世上真的有什么能抵达永恒吗？

Name: 虹彩掠羽
Description: 光阴缓慢流逝，庄园花木逐渐繁茂。雕塑家的身影也变得佝偻，他不再追问永恒，也许在雕塑中他已找到了答案。

Name: 镜湖庄园
Description: 庄园中处处都是爱人留下的痕迹，有时雕塑家觉得他们依然生活在一起，一起作画一起喝茶，从来没有真正分开。

Name: 未晞晨露
Description: 即便世上的雨早已停下，在雕塑家的心里那场大雨却从未断绝，他始终记得那天爱人牵起自己的手时所说的话。

Name: 流光序诗
Description: 雕塑家心中对永恒的信仰产生了裂痕，爱人的手抚过他的脸庞，向雕塑家承诺他们终将在未来的某一刻重逢。

Name: 无瑕誓言
Description: 所有的美好似乎都于此刻离他而去，连阳光都不再温暖。四季的轮回化作凌乱刻痕，斑驳留在石料和他的记忆里。

Name: 石中之心
Description: 雕塑家最满意的作品完成于一个雨过天晴的午后。看到身披白纱的爱人骑着白马于湖畔驻足，他忍不住泪流满面。

Name: 花曳轻风
Description: 薰风轻轻吹拂花藤缠绕的秋千架，秋千前后摇荡，暗合命运的起伏。无处不在的风塑造命运，亦见证命运。

Name: 盛绽心蕾
Description: 青鸟携着晨风，在安静的绢坊上空一遍又一遍掠过。细雨打湿长满青苔的石阶，亦打湿守望之人的衣襟。

Name: 荧蝶跹舞
Description: 绘满星图的书册被调皮的风拨动，不远处的床榻上，星星的孩子眼睫轻颤，似乎下个瞬间便会苏醒。

Name: 醒愿花铃
Description: 双生姐妹你挤着我，我靠着你沉沉睡去，枕边两对银铃淌着月光，清风拂过，铎舌几不可察地微微摇动。

Name: 流金雅韵
Description: 精致的礼服人偶坐在漆黑的魔术帽顶上，躺在楼顶的少年漫不经心地伸手，理了理人偶被风吹乱的缎带与裙边。

Name: 芬华诗篇
Description: 北地凛风不息，身披银甲的领袖疾步穿行在冒雪训练的士兵之间，时而轻声指点，坚毅的神色一如往常。

Name: Pearled Peacock Feathers
Description: Risa panics. She can't appear in such a state, yet the float is near. How can she fix it in time?

Name: Gilded Emerald Plumes
Description: With their kindness and wit, they save Risa. Her dress shines anew, adorned like a proud green peafowl.

Name: Radiant Spotlight
Description: Risa fans her plumes and strides to the stage. She becomes the festival's brightest star and the focus of the town.

Name: Passion Woven in Gold
Description: Seeing her plight, the girls help at once, straightening adornments, replacing hoops, and offering warm comfort.

Name: Carnival Till Dawn
Description: She dedicates the title to every girl, as their love and sincerity save her, and this shining honor is theirs too.

Name: 繁丝梦柳
Description: 妇人的十指因掘草挪石伤毁，深可见骨，此刻仍紧紧扣住襁褓勉强挪步，口中细细哼唱着不成调的散曲。

Name: 素影萦芳
Description: 终是血气耗竭，妇人踉跄跪倒在皲裂的黄土上，青芒不忍，一道青藤斜飞而出，将险些摔地的婴孩护住。

Name: 绣羽清啼
Description: 妇人似是有所感应，用了最后的气力抬头，瞧了眼啼哭的孩子，朝青芒所在的方位深深拜下，再无声息。

Name: 建木春屏
Description: 青藤轻轻抚上婴孩面颊，青芒看见了妇人一面摇晃摇篮，一面在绣屏上悉心绣制春花，眸中满是憧憬的旧时景象。

Name: 霜栖别枝
Description: 襁褓中掉出几枚枯黄花瓣，饶是青芒也难辨品种，它们落在了妇人血痕斑驳的手掌上，竟瑟瑟颤动，恢复了生机。

Name: 燕衔新绿
Description: 青芒恍惚之时，花瓣发出莹润的光芒遁入土块中，须臾发芽生长，花瓣卷曲，殷红如血，原是一株萱草花。

Name: 碧隐瑶珠
Description: 是夜，童子为青芒奉上笔墨，青芒独立画屏前沉吟，最终长叹一声，神色坚定，扬袖折下殿宇前一枝新芽为笔。

Name: 琅华琦珍
Description: 她绘妇人新嫁时鬓边鲜丽的海棠，绘她终于完成一样绣品时颊边的梨涡，也绘她昼夜苦熬，仍有灼灼生机的双瞳。

Name: 灵花献彩
Description: 青芒将新芽缓缓置于案上，释然步出殿宇，除簪而立。九十九道天雷蓄势待发，她早已知晓自己的终局。

Name: 晚晴长汀
Description: 最后一笔落定，画屏轰然迸发万丈霞光，化作漫天青雨洒向下界，雨点所落之处，焦土生蘼芜，枯井涌甘泉。

Name: 暖玉轻烟
Description: 幸存的婴孩被清香环绕，发出咯咯的笑声，几个孩子手牵手跑来，一面呼唤家中的大人，一面将襁褓抱起。

Name: 九畹兰佩
Description: 新发的草木皆带异香，病者闻之汗出而愈，心力衰竭者嗅之鬓角返青，眨眼之间，人间遍地春生。

Name: 山外晶莹
Description: 而今人们总能见雪散雨歇之时，云隙间浮起浅浅青光，都说那是青芒在绘制永不重复的人间春景时拂动的衣摆。

Name: 流光星引
Description: 但现在还不是时候——水推拒着娜伊达的回归，亦不忍让她的心被迷茫占据，总是一遍遍耐心地安抚她。

Name: 璨然挚愿
Description: 每当身体与水接触，娜伊达心底便会生出无穷的渴切与盼望，她应当融入这片宁静的湖泽，正如一滴水融入其中。

Name: 虚幔柔情
Description: 当熠烁的星辰隐没，所有生灵都沉睡时，水面会泛起一层层如梦似幻的微光，娜伊达便能听见水的低语。

Name: 涟漪梦乡
Description: 娜伊达会将面颊轻轻贴在水面上，任由水沾湿她的衣裙与翅膀，夜色的纱幕覆上水泽，也覆上她的肩膀。

Name: 蝶栖静屿
Description: 某日自沉睡中睁眼，几位精灵围拢在娜伊达身旁，头顶微微一沉，她们小心地将一顶精致的头冠戴在娜伊达头上。

Name: 秘语汐音
Description: 不久前曾红着双眼靠在她怀中哭泣的小精灵脸上洋溢着明快的笑意，取出缠满花藤的竖笛为她吹响悠扬的乐曲。

Name: 莹澈忆想
Description: 精灵们将在山崖上撷得的小花放在娜伊达手心，或是亲密地靠在她身旁，绘声绘色地为她讲森林外发生的趣事。

Name: 缀浪琉光
Description: 精灵们毫无保留的关切与爱，像连绵的雨珠洒向广阔的湖面，娜伊达的心不再无波无澜地继续沉寂。

Name: 霓梦之翼
Description: 她们伸出手，轻柔地抚摸娜伊达的翅膀，争相赞叹它的美丽——瑰丽的色彩在其上流淌，折射着动人心魄的光彩。

Name: 水镜遐光
Description: 当第一缕曦光透过树隙洒向森林，水畔已没有了娜伊达的身影，精灵们隐约知晓了昨夜那个梦境的意义。

Name: 盈彩幻翼
Description: 带着无尽的不舍与眷恋，娜伊达回归了她本源的模样，她会一直存在于这座森林中，倾听万物真切的私语。

Name: 曜阳光羽
Description: 阿吉尼站在圣焰之前，她第一次感受到神明的沉默。她将石板置于火中，一瞬间窜起的火苗几乎灼伤她的面庞。

Name: 天穹裂明
Description: 烈焰之中，石板上缓缓浮现金色神文，像是从圣焰中诞生的语言，向众人宣告：扭转命运的秘密就藏在圣焰之中。

Name: 新日初铸
Description: 圣焰的灼热与强横既是部落的庇护，也是他们真正脱离困境的阻碍。没有人能够靠近焰心，火焰拒绝了它的子民。

Name: 鎏金幻日
Description: 人群陷入了长久的沉默。连日的奔波，面对发狂的兽族时的抗争，一团迷雾似的未来……一切都令人心生绝望。

Name: 穹宇天音
Description: 有人终于开口，既然圣焰尚在，他们可以在神庙继续活下去，圣焰将是他们唯一的光明，足以等待黑夜的终结。

Name: 粲金传说
Description: 阿吉尼听到了部落众人的声音，可是在扑面而来的狂风中，她也听到了更遥远深刻的声音，像是对本心的召引。

Name: 通天之火
Description: 阿吉尼举起权杖重重叩击地面，沉沉的闷响压过了所有灵魂的颤抖，她已下定决心，为族人撕开黑夜的厚幕。

Name: 圣焰权杖
Description: 炽热的气浪扑面而来，狂火攀上她的裙摆，阿吉尼的身影消失在火光中，恍惚间众人似乎看见一只手触上焰心。

Name: 亘古歌谣
Description: 越来越多的人疲惫地闭上眼睛，仿佛已经接受了在火焰旁潦草度日的未来。黑暗中大风呼啸而过，没有人再开口。

Name: 岁月华羽
Description: 部落的人们惊呼着纷纷仰起头，他们看见火焰在高空汇聚、凝结，幻化出了一个崭新的，足以照彻大地的太阳。

Name: 焚夜神谕
Description: 光明重新降临于荒原之上，狂兽的影子隐没黑夜，没有人再见过阿吉尼。人们都说，她化作了新的、永恒的太阳。

Name: 命谕长刃
Description: 母亲温和地告诉她：唯有真正渴求这份力量，才能使之觉醒，不必心焦，属于她的“那个瞬间”尚未到来。

Name: 曦光悠羽
Description: 前所未有的暴风雪席卷了王国。昼夜不息的风雪使人们陷入无尽的慌乱，饥饿与恐惧在这片国度悄然蔓延。

Name: 缄默决裁
Description: 年轻的王储不知道自己能做什么。她跟在母亲身后，竭力挽救垂危的王国，而敌国的大军在此时踏雪而至。

Name: 黯影心笼
Description: 军队连日溃败，城墙坍塌，王都随之沦陷。欧珀亲眼看着亲人的鲜血染红石阶，王都的每个角落都满是血腥气。

Name: 黎明辉冕
Description: 耳畔只有金属碰撞的尖响与濒死的呼喊，那一刻，所有关于责任、身份与未来的想象，都被碾碎在冰冷的现实里。

Name: 诸星之祈
Description: 她听见王城之中零散的哭声，痛失爱子的父母、失去丈夫的妻子，那些声音被风雪卷起，抛向漆黑无光的夜空。

Name: 无瑕回音
Description: 她终于明白了昔日母亲的那句话：唯有真正渴求这份力量，它才会回应你的呼唤。这一次，她要守护她的臣民。

Name: 序日曙光
Description: 战斗持续到天色将明，敌军攻势凶猛，臣民的队伍却逐渐显露疲态，就在绝望几乎压垮所有人时，大地忽然震颤。

Name: 命运环响
Description: 悲痛交加的人们拾起盾牌和利剑，他们不再痛哭着屈从命运，而是跟随欧珀的脚步，为想要守护的人继续战斗。

Name: 璀璨圣礼
Description: 坚硬的铁笼剧烈震颤，如同回应神明的召唤。欧珀缓缓抬起手，铁笼顷刻化作无数锋利的长剑与坚实的铠甲。

Name: 凛霜秘翎
Description: 欧珀缓缓收拢僵硬的指尖。在王庭中自在无忧的日子像一场恍如隔世的美梦，如今她必须从梦境中醒来了。

Name: 共生神契
Description: 势弱无能的王储成了敌人最值得夸耀的战利品。伤痕累累的欧珀靠在巨大牢笼的角落，寒意顺着铁栏渗入骨髓。

Name: 晨音之祷
Description: 下一个冬季来临，晨光一如既往穿过厚重的云层，洒向皑皑雪原，风雪尽头，坚固的金属城池沉默伫立。

Name: 金乌负曜
Description: 巫祝向神明询问人间诸事，战火、饥荒与盛世的覆灭……此刻，她忘却了掌权者的要求，只为人间的悲苦落泪。

Name: 左辅右弼
Description: 神明如此博学、宽和而慈悲，巫祝却陷入了更深的迷茫。金飞玉走，流光易逝，人间的命运却似乎只是轮回。

Name: 紫极宝辇
Description: 巫祝从未与任何人说起过那场梦，她如常在苍穹下跳起祭舞，庄严的乐声响彻云霄，狂风吹散她的发尾。

Name: 玉锦华盖
Description: 她询问神明，能否拯救这凄惶人间？神明不再言语，只是垂下双眸，在金乌的振翅声中，宝辇飘然而去。

Name: 周天之度
Description: 日居月诸，腐朽的王朝走向灭亡。荣华富贵全作云烟，红尘紫陌尽付焦土。无边夜色缓缓褪去，晨曦自天际弥散。

Name: 衔昀驰光
Description: 朝晖照在昔日刀兵相向的战场，也照在旧时歌舞升平的宫阙。流离失所的人们蜷缩在墙根之下，眼中只有麻木。

Name: 流彩祥云
Description: 她跳起祭神的舞蹈，正如此前无数次那般。梦境之后，她再未受到神明的垂眸，好在此刻，她也不为神明起舞。

Name: 鸿蒙初辟
Description: 一道身影出现在断壁残垣之中。巫祝已不再年轻，但她的脊背仍然挺直，衣袂在大风中猎猎作响。

Name: 天命生辉
Description: 炽烈的光将一切吞没，时间如同被投入烈焰之中，开始扭曲、回溯。她睁开眼，重新站在了多年前的云台上。

Name: 神心渡世
Description: 乐音渐渐远去，她又回到了碎瓦颓垣之中。晨雾潺缓流淌，万物沐浴着希望的光辉。太阳，再一次升起了。

Name: 振羽抟摇
Description: 一片金红色的羽毛从天而降，悬在她的眼前。她停下舞蹈，怔怔抬起双手，捧住这渺茫的希冀。

Name: 旸谷明赫
Description: 没有祭坛，没有鼓乐，她在荒墟中婆娑起舞。人们望着她，望着她……渐渐地，眼中生出了一点微弱的光。

Name: Eternal Serenity
Description: The world had faded behind her. Ahead stood a graceful girl, her robes drifting as if she might ride the wind away.

Name: Gilded Palace Screen
Description: The young empress followed the song into a jade palace where phoenixes danced to celestial music.

Name: Ethereal Haze
Description: The girl was playing the sheng in an ethereal halo. Her lips curved in a smile when she saw the young empress.

Name: Phoenix Chirp
Description: The young empress sat by the girl as the music cleared her mind of all worries: war on the borders and court disputes.

Name: Celestial Harmony
Description: In the lingering music, the young empress curled before the jade stairs and fell soundly asleep.

Name: Luminous Cloudveil
Description: Whenever the empress lost her sleep, the ethereal music would play, guiding her to dreams in the jade palace.

Name: Heaven-Crafted Jade
Description: The sun woke the young empress. She realized she had been sleeping in her own bed and finally felt refreshed.

Name: Lucid Spirit
Description: The once lost young empress learned to handle state affairs and gradually took on a fitting air of majesty.

Name: Lilting Sheng Tune
Description: The music faded as the empress no longer lost sleep, the songs now only a distant dream to her.

Name: 聆风之羽
Description: 灿金之羽悠悠飘落，粉发少女双手合十，许下心愿：“希望生机与欢乐，永远如此刻这般，驻留在这片大地上。”

Name: 浮香缀影
Description: 粉发少女步履轻快，再度踏上了她的旅程。风中蕴藏的生机与奇迹，终有一日能真正降临这片大地。

Name: 绮彩心翼
Description: 树叶簌簌的轻响和着水波流动的细声，共同记录下这个传说，时至今日，它仍然在森林中的精灵间流传。

Name: Sparkling Voyage
Description: The witch holds a box of paper planes. The evening breeze sends them to the stars as they glow with secret feelings.

Name: Twinkling Blossom
Description: As sunlight cast on the church, the bride, dressed in white and holding a bouquet, runs toward happiness amid cheers.

Name: Passionate Ardor
Description: The sky takes on a deep blue hue as stars leap through the clouds. They bundle up beside Liv to listen to stories of the day.

Name: Heartward Arrow
Description: Under a warm yellow light, a middle-aged man awaits his partner with a bouquet as he hears the familiar footsteps.

Name: Echoes of Longing
Description: At sunset, a young man paces around the room as he fails to find the right words to put his feelings into the letter.

Name: Aromatic Letter
Description: Liv loves collecting these genuine feelings. They are pure and shiny, always bringing warmth to her heart.

Name: Spirit of Green Clovers
Description: Humming cheerfully, little fairies heave the grain. Plump kernels soak in clear springs, slowly turning golden malt.

Name: Golden Vintage Wine
Description: The grain ferments in wooden casks, where time gently brews memories of sun, rain, and soil into a mellow fragrance.

Name: Joyful Celebration
Description: Disheartened, Maxie sits by the barn door. Warm afternoon light lulls her into a doze, and a soft glow seems to land nearby.

Name: Light-woven Wishes
Description: The fairy lifts her arm, green light spilling from her fingers as tiny fairies answer the call from glowing clover leaves.

Name: Song of Valley Streams
Description: Maxie hears her gentle voice: 'You tend sprouts with care and toil through wind and rain. The earth rewards such hands.'

Name: Warm Soft Glow
Description: From the glow steps a fairy in green. Her light-brown hair shines like sunlight as she cups the grain and smiles.

Name: Call of Valley Brooks
Description: Crowds ask Maxie for her secret to brewing wine. She winks and says, 'Work the land well, then trust time and hope~'

Name: Dreamer's Path
Description: Corinne is now a well-known hiking blogger. Her photos feature rivers, peaks, and her ever-bouncy bunny.

Name: Verdant Journey
Description: Sun spills across the slopes as she crests the peak, bunny on her head. 'We really made it up a mountain!'

Name: Dreambound Steps
Description: Corinne shyly shares her hiking dream. Her parents cheer her on and buy her hiking boots, a pack, and poles.

Name: Glimmering Clouds
Description: She dresses her bunny in mini hiking gear to bring it along. It gave her the courage to face treatment.

Name: Packed and Ready
Description: Through grueling treatments, Corinne transforms. Pale cheeks turn rosy. Her limbs grow firm. She finds real power.

Name: Mark of Bravery
Description: Her world widens step by step. On her coming-of-age day, she stands beneath the hill she once watched.

Name: Spring Hiking Poles
Description: Corinne breathes in the wild scent. Step by step, she climbs. She pauses now and then to rest.

Name: Camping Fun
Description: More kids come by after the girls leave. They squat before Lucia's hand-drawn teapot and exclaim with curiosity.

Name: Spring Blossom Mat
Description: Lucia answers every question like it's an impromptu sharing event, and everyone leaves with a smile.

Name: Minute Paradise
Description: A few hesitant girls approach Lucia and sheepishly ask where to buy the tent and picnic mat.

Name: Sunlit Romance
Description: Only when the sunset dyes the sky golden does Lucia realize that she hasn't taken photos for her posts today!

Name: Verdant Prelude
Description: The lace on her hat dances in the wind as she builds her tent on the meadow, like a small castle of her own.

Name: Tender Recollection
Description: The flower-shaped picnic mat is rolled out like a canvas of life in soft pink and bright yellow.

Name: Perfumed Memory
Description: The wind writes an ode to friendship. Spring's romance lies not only in blooms, but also in every chance encounter.

Name: Afternoon Tea Delight
Description: Lucia finally gets everything sorted, and the teapot puffs to remind her to pour a cup of hot tea for herself.

Name: Garden of Fragrance
Description: Soon, Irena starts to feel pain. Day after day, she sits by the fountain and gazes at the reflections.

Name: Limpid Serenity
Description: Blooming is pointless if flowers don't wither. Without the sorrow of loss, the fulfillment of possession no longer exists.

Name: Sunlit Mist
Description: Flowers won't wither in winter, nor will girls age as time passes. Regret and loss will never arrive in this land.

Name: Scented Prelude
Description: The girls tell Irena this is the Eternal Garden. Everything stays in its most beautiful state here.

Name: Brilliant Heartnote
Description: Like an endless dream, time is meaningless in the garden. In the rich fragrances, Irena lets all her worries go.

Name: Infinite Fragrance
Description: They sit by the fountain, chattering or watching the reflection of the sky change color in the water in comfortable silence.

Name: Stellar Dew
Description: Irena spent the happiest time here. She tended the flowers with the girls and enjoyed tea in the afternoon sun.

Name: Cirrus Flow
Description: As the wind rustles the pages, Irena looks down to see a garden shrouded in mist, like the one in her memory.

Name: Moonward Chase
Description: Flags snap; lanterns gleam. Sky lets out a piercing neigh as Cheng strokes her neck, her eyes fixed on the banner ahead.

Name: Swift as the Wind
Description: As the horn sounds, the horses gallop as their red ribbons dance in the wind. The crowds cheer amidst the sound of hooves.

Name: Thunderous Drums
Description: In the resounding drumbeats, the townsfolk rush to the race tracks and wait only for the start of the match.

Name: Deafening Glory
Description: Clad in red, Cheng rides with eyes bright as stars, while her horse Sky surges ahead like a flash through the freezing wind.

Name: Snowward Charge
Description: As they near a slope, Cheng bends down and pulls the reins. Sky remains steady, just as they've practiced countless times.

Name: Lightning Sprint
Description: Beneath ice, cold springs run; on the road, horses race as one. Flags in wind, hearts in glee; all the world runs wild and free.

Name: Bunny Companion
Description: As if inviting her, the bunny hops ahead, then looks back at Elno. Smiling, she rises and follows it into the woods.

Name: Colorful Invitation
Description: The bunny stops at a patch of soft earth and paws at it lightly. Understanding, Elno digs and uncovers a colorful egg.

Name: Lush Green Fields
Description: By a babbling stream lies the first egg, with a small basket of fresh carrots beside it. Their sweet juice makes Elno smile.

Name: Playful Bunny's Eggs
Description: Are you playing an egg hunt game with me?' Elno laughs. The bunny nods hard, then dashes into the forest and vanishes.

Name: Low-Altitude Patrol
Description: The iron tower looms like a beast. Rotor blades whip the night. Back to back, they clear each threat with precision.

Name: Fated Alliance
Description: Gunfire cuts the melody. A shattered chandelier plunges the gala into darkness. The two pursue the target to the rooftop.

Name: Crimson Tower
Description: One bullet strikes true, freezing Night Owl's crimes in that instant as police cars surround the building.

Name: Explosive Roar
Description: The Night Owl falls and the corrupt official is arrested. As media swarm in, Carol and Morton fade into the dark.

Name: Radiant Engraving
Description: All prey are in place; the net is ready. A high-society gala draws her eye. Her long-watched target will trade there.

Name: Lingering Gunpowder
Description: Plan before action—Carol's creed. Patiently, she traces the chain and maps the full web behind the target.

Name: Hazy Dream
Description: Welton's night glows bright. Amid the elite crowd at the gala, Carol is simply one more guest.

Name: Chasing Light and Shadow
Description: They return as lovers, weaving among guests, closing in on their marked prey through music and dance.

Name: Shining Star
Description: A lavish gown hides her edge; dazzling jewels mask lethal intent. Sipping champagne, she meets a familiar gaze.

Name: Blood-Tinted Reverie
Description: In that glance, identities are known. She heads to the dressing room. Minutes later, Morton enters.

Name: Silent Operation
Description: Sharing intel, she learns Morton must eliminate Night Owl, the official set to defect and linked to her case.

Name: Unresolved Secrets
Description: She can be anyone: naive girl, learned professor, plain clerk... Beneath every mask, she is always Carol.

Name: Crimson Trail
Description: Morton once worked with Carol; unseen yet in perfect sync. Since then, a ripple stirs his steady heart.

Name: End of Sin
Description: Morton gives the rose to Carol and boards the rescue helicopter. Before night swallows them, he catches her faint smile.

Name: Deep Blue Illusion
Description: Gunshots shatter the night. The fleeing target climb the rooftop tower. Carol covers Morton, holding off hired guards.

Name: Message of Time
Description: At parting, he whips off his tie. In a flash, the bullet turns into a blooming rose, revealing his quiet affection.

Name: Mastermind Strategy
Description: A golden bullet ends crime and delusion. Morton retrieves the data device and turns to see Carol standing in the wind.

Name: Velvety Puff
Description: Nothing beats strawberries and cream!' she says happily. 'Unless it's one extra layer of strawberries!'

Name: Flavorful Selection
Description: As a fan of strawberries, Riko loves putting them in her designs. Friends always say she's like a strawberry cake.

Name: Beary Special
Description: Ding! The aroma fills the room as Riko takes a deep, contented breath, her heart swelling with happiness.

Name: Strawberry Smoothie
Description: Riko's rule for yumminess: no need to be perfect. Just the right amount of sweetness and a hint of sour!

Name: 同频传声
Description: 连续几天她把自己关在房间，可是写出的曲子总缺了点什么，连绵的雨声令人心烦，林夏烦闷地把自己埋进被子。

Name: 梦想升调
Description: 就在这时手机的屏幕亮起，乐队的好友发来简讯，难得生活没有被排练和表演排满，不如一起出门走走吧。

Name: 同频传声·夜紫
Description: 演出完毕，掌声与欢呼久久不散，乐队的大家开心地拥抱在一起，这个盛夏的夜晚深深刻进所有人的记忆中。

Name: 梦想升调·夜紫
Description: 那一刻，所有的梦想都近在咫尺，它就藏在旋律与鼓点中。盛夏尚未结束，属于林夏的音乐旅程也才刚刚开始。

Name: 同频传声·银白
Description: 朋友们还没反应过来，就看见林夏手忙脚乱地翻出笔记本，飞快地记下零散的词句与旋律线条，生怕灵感溜走了。

Name: 梦想升调·银白
Description: 大家习以为常，笑嘻嘻地围到了她身边，谁不知道林夏总是忽然陷入创作状态呢？也许这就是下一首新歌啦！

Name: 同频传声·青柠
Description: 少女们的话题在排练与玩笑之间来回跳跃，每个人都跃跃欲试，林夏哼着轻松的曲调，心情雀跃得不可思议。

Name: 梦想升调·青柠
Description: 窗外的风轻轻吹动窗帘，城市的声音缓慢流淌。就在这个尚未开始排练的夜晚，属于乐队的夏天已经悄悄开始。

Name: 随心时刻
Description: 茉琳出手的风格与她柔弱的外表截然相反。几次呼吸间，我就完全失去招架之力，被她重重摔在了雪地上。

Name: 熠熠铭光
Description: 我的心中亦涌起一阵不服输的倔强，再度朝茉琳攻去，但无论我的招式如何凌厉，始终被她轻而易举地化解。

Name: 启梦箱匣
Description: 后来我曾问过茉琳，她从不离身的小提箱里到底装了些什么，那时她朝我俏皮地眨了眨眼，说这是个秘密。

Name: 随心时刻·忆
Description: “来，把这个喝了，”茉琳将水杯塞在我的手心里，“好好睡一会吧，别担心，下船的时候，我会叫醒你的。”

Name: 熠熠铭光·忆
Description: 我硬着头皮向茉琳传达了歉意——上回体术课结束，我刻意忽略了她想要将我从地上拉起的手，赌气跑开了。

Name: 启梦箱匣·忆
Description: 茉琳愣住了，继而笑得前仰后合，一面笑，一面伸手在我脑门上结结实实地弹了一下：“好，这下我们扯平啦！”

Name: 随心时刻·海
Description: 那是我一生中最快乐的时光。白天我们会一同在雪原上探险，晚上则围着房间的火炉，两人有一搭没一搭地聊天。

Name: 熠熠铭光·海
Description: 茉琳央求我说了许多故乡的事：姥姥串的贝壳项链，夹人很疼的螃蟹，还有光脚踩在沙滩上脚底微微酥麻的感觉。

Name: 启梦箱匣·海
Description: 我也想听听茉琳小时候的事。但这个家伙裹着毛毯，不知何时抱着什么东西睡着了……我想，那就下次再问吧。

Name: 随心时刻·念
Description: 有天给小白鸽换水时，它忽然撞开我的手，扑在箱子上使劲扇动翅膀，那一刻，我忽然有了想打开箱子的冲动。

Name: 熠熠铭光·念
Description: 我最终打开了它。摆在最上面的几张照片，后来也刊登在了报纸上——是茉琳幼年时便在战争中牺牲的双亲。

Name: 启梦箱匣·念
Description: 手提箱里剩下的东西，是一叠速写画。大部分画的是你见过的那只小白鸽，还有天空之镜，还有……一片海。

Name: 尘封梦寐
Description: 不止萨迦有这样的心愿，许多年轻人从各地赶来，拜访祖母，渴望拜在这位伟大的占卜师门下，得到她的指引。

Name: 迷途回声
Description: 这些年轻的占卜师们会用不同的方式预测未来，哪怕是对相似的征兆，她们都有着截然不同的解读。

Name: 隽雅秘语
Description: 关于占卜技巧的争执和讨论在古堡的各处响起，祖母从不打断她们，思绪之间的碰撞往往会擦出新的火花。

Name: 暮色余晖
Description: 祖母的眉目柔和而慈爱，人们无法理解她在水晶球中所看到的景象，但总能从她沉静的话语中获得力量。

Name: 时光谶言
Description: 萨迦好奇地聆听着每一场占卜和讨论，在她眼里，每一位占卜师的话语都如同珍贵的宝石，闪烁着独特的光彩。

Name: 尘封梦寐·华丽
Description: 占卜结束，祖母重新清点了城堡物资并安排了往后的配给，为了宽慰众人，当晚她亲自下厨煮了一锅土豆浓汤。

Name: 迷途回声·华丽
Description: 浓郁的香气随着白雾升腾起来，每个人都在这种温馨的气氛中抛下了连日以来的焦灼，共同期待着冰雪消融那天。

Name: 隽雅秘语·华丽
Description: 接下来的日子简单而快乐，女孩们白天练习占卜，晚上围在壁炉旁准备御寒物资，讲述来到城堡前的经历与见闻。

Name: 暮色余晖·华丽
Description: 祖母的神色始终是平和的，漫长的岁月使她显得沉静而温柔，在她无声的安抚中，占卜师们的心情渐渐平静下来。

Name: 时光谶言·华丽
Description: 大雪持续了很久，世界仿佛只剩下灰与白。然而因为早早作出了规划，城堡的众人得以安稳度过冰封的漫长时光。

Name: 尘封梦寐·珍稀
Description: “占卜的结果并不是宣判，而是对某种可能性的映照。未来的伏线仍然系于人们的手中。”祖母平静地说。

Name: 迷途回声·珍稀
Description: 后来，萨迦接替祖母成为了城堡的主人，为世人解读未来与命运，祖母的话如同一盏明灯，照亮了她的心。

Name: 隽雅秘语·珍稀
Description: 也有年轻的占卜师源源不断涌入城堡，请求萨迦的帮助和指导，不知不觉中，萨迦成为了自己年少梦想中的样子。

Name: 暮色余晖·珍稀
Description: 出乎萨迦预料的是，祖母微笑着摇了摇头：“我看到了食物耗尽，火光熄灭，恐慌蔓延，无尽风雪淹没了城堡。”

Name: 时光谶言·珍稀
Description: 一些占卜师在萨迦身边找到答案后告辞离去，也有一些占卜师选择留在城堡，不断磨炼技艺，也叩问自己的内心。

Name: 尘封梦寐·苍穹
Description: 不知从什么时候开始，众人发现锋芒毕露的莉卡有所改变，她的占卜像往常一样清晰准确，但是言语柔和了许多。

Name: 迷途回声·苍穹
Description: 她会在阅读水晶球的讯息后为人们指出不同的可能性，也会在看似无望的困局中点明破局的方法，重新点燃希望。

Name: 隽雅秘语·苍穹
Description: 莉卡也渐渐明白，水晶球中的风暴与阴影亦能被坚定和努力驱散，人们将要奔赴的真正未来掌握在自己手中。

Name: 暮色余晖·苍穹
Description: 占卜只是映照着未来的一种可能。倘若过度依赖于外物的预言，便会失去找寻出路的耐心和打破困局的勇气。

Name: 时光谶言·苍穹
Description: 也许多年之后，莉卡会接替萨迦成为城堡新的主人。水晶球映照着岁月无声流逝，一代代占卜师的故事仍在相传。

Name: 尘封梦寐·樱华
Description: 得知行程要被取消，一位急需报酬为家人治病的水手忍不住崩溃痛哭，萨迦问明了原委，提出为商队重新占卜。

Name: 迷途回声·樱华
Description: 莉卡知道老师也会在水晶球中看到相似的景象，她确信自己的占卜绝对不会出错。然而萨迦却给出了不同的意见。

Name: 隽雅秘语·樱华
Description: 萨迦提出了一些行程中需要警惕的事。得到帮助的商队十分感激，调整了出行计划，最终平安归来。

Name: 暮色余晖·樱华
Description: 一次，莉卡为一支即将远航的商队占卜，面对水晶球中的阴影，她断言商队必然将遇险，直接命令他们取消行程。

Name: 时光谶言·樱华
Description: 那是莉卡占卜生涯的第一次失败，她彻夜难眠，无数次回想自己在水晶球中看到的预兆，究竟是哪里出了差错？

Name: 田园之声
Description: 孩子们叽叽喳喳缠着佩洛问起那只小羊的来历。佩洛笑而不语，从柜台后拿出一罐糖果分给兴奋欢呼的孩子们。

Name: 柔软往事
Description: 夜色降临，送走了最后几个客人，佩洛回到柜台后，抱起柔软的小羊玩偶，轻轻将脸颊贴在它的绒毛上。

Name: 拾忆法杖
Description: 镇里的孩子们总说，只要去佩洛的玩偶店待上一会，所有悲伤和烦恼都会飞走！每每听到这些，佩洛只是笑笑。

Name: 田园之声·华丽
Description: 那是妹妹做的第一只玩偶，也是最后一只。她的身体毫无征兆地衰弱下去，曾经闪闪发光的梦想也不再被提起。

Name: 柔软往事·华丽
Description: 最后的最后，妹妹把小羊交给了佩洛。她说：这只小羊被我施加了遗忘悲伤的魔法，它……会永远陪伴在你身边。

Name: 拾忆法杖·华丽
Description: 那一天，佩洛抱着小羊玩偶在妹妹床前坐了许久。她一遍又一遍地喃喃，为什么妹妹留下的魔法还没有生效？

Name: 田园之声·珍稀
Description: 与此同时，柜台后端正坐着的小羊玩偶晃了晃，它身下的沙发凹陷变得更深了，像是承载了原本不应存在的重量。

Name: 柔软往事·珍稀
Description: 女孩抱着小熊离开时，脸上重新浮现出轻松的笑容，佩洛却沉默了很久，默默回到柜台后，摸了摸小羊的头。

Name: 拾忆法杖·珍稀
Description: 这个消息很快在小镇中传开。神情严肃的大人们纷纷带着沉重的故事走进玩偶店，恳求佩洛施展遗忘悲伤的魔法。

Name: 田园之声·诺
Description: 缝制玩偶的工作台，留下了两种笔迹的魔法书，还有担心妹妹寂寞而特意买来的魔法自走棋……佩洛含泪而笑。

Name: 柔软往事·诺
Description: 无数次举起又放下，某个瞬间，佩洛猛地将法杖远远扔开。咚地一声闷响，她的执念似乎也跟着一块落了地。

Name: 拾忆法杖·诺
Description: 躺在妹妹的床上，泪流满面的佩洛搂紧了怀中的玩偶，良久，她将脸颊贴紧了小羊，轻声说：你放心……你放心。

Name: 田园之声·愈
Description: 于是女孩陷入了更深的茫然。如果一段记忆如此深刻，就连魔法也无法抹去，那么当初的自己为什么选择遗忘？

Name: 柔软往事·愈
Description: 如果铭记必然伴随痛苦，那我还是愿意带着它继续前行。女孩坚定地说着，佩洛的眼底有什么一闪而逝。

Name: 拾忆法杖·愈
Description: 佩洛再次举起了她的法杖，无数莹白的光点跟随法杖的指引从小羊玩偶中飞出，重新回到了女孩的身体内。

Name: 醇黑梦语
Description: 直至一场突如其来的暴雨，被淋得湿透的塔塔蜷缩在屋檐下无精打采，悠娜打开通向室内的门，呼唤它快快进来。

Name: 双面萌喵
Description: 塔塔迟疑地徘徊了几秒，才踏入人类的地盘，它像个国王般巡视完每个角落，最终选择在柔软的地毯上盘成一团。

Name: 猫咪访客
Description: 下个晴天，塔塔又懒洋洋地出现在阳台躺椅上。悠娜哭笑不得，她心想，就当是多了个偶尔一起晒太阳的朋友吧。

Name: 优雅闲暇
Description: 悠娜一边为它擦拭一边暗自雀跃，以为终于叩开了它的心门。然而雨一停，小猫抖抖耳朵，毫不留恋地离开了。

Name: 醇黑梦语·伴
Description: 这一晚，塔塔没有再离开。有它静静守在床边，房间似乎也不那么空旷冷清，悠娜在这安心的陪伴中沉沉睡去。

Name: 双面萌喵·伴
Description: 悠娜病愈后，一人一猫的关系也变得更加亲近，但塔塔依然是那只骄傲又独立的猫，不会为谁停留。

Name: 猫咪访客·伴
Description: 无形的信任与羁绊，在那个夜晚生根发芽。对悠娜而言，她和塔塔既是亲密的朋友，也是彼此关心的家人。

Name: 优雅闲暇·伴
Description: 但也有些改变悄然发生：当悠娜画画时，塔塔会蜷在她的腿边打盹，偶尔她深夜回家，总有一个身影在露台等待。

Name: 醇黑梦语·绘
Description: 画纸铺开，画笔就位，可惜这位“模特”没什么职业精神，不时追咬自己的尾巴，或是扑向墙上晃动的光斑。

Name: 双面萌喵·绘
Description: 悠娜笑着叹口气，拿起画笔捕捉那些瞬间：塔塔伸懒腰时弯起的背、阳光下抖动的耳朵、尾巴尖无意识的摇晃……

Name: 猫咪访客·绘
Description: 这组名为《我的猫咪朋友》的作品一经发布就广受好评，许多人留言说，这些画看着令人心生温暖与感动。

Name: 优雅闲暇·绘
Description: 经过几天的努力，这组作品终于完成了。画纸上的小猫或坐或卧，可爱而灵动，仿佛下一秒就会从纸上跑出来。

Name: 时尚主张
Description: 夜幕降临时，工坊便成了独属于缇妮的小世界，温暖灯光的陪伴下，年轻的设计师尽情地徜徉在灵感的海洋之中。

Name: 巧思创想
Description: 静谧的晚夜，脑海中的构想渐渐在指尖化为现实，缇妮歪着头，想象着客人喜悦的神色，忍不住也露出了笑容。

Name: 独特真我
Description: 工坊的客人越来越多，那些充满个性与创意的设计，会为人们的生活带来别样的美好时刻吧？缇妮这样坚信着。

Name: 时尚主张·忆
Description: 乐队的吉他手姐姐听完了缇妮支支吾吾的话，一拨琴弦，微微沙哑的嗓音唱起一首关于自由与生命的歌。

Name: 巧思创想·忆
Description: 缇妮的眸光被点亮了。她回到家，给父母留下一封书信，找出自己精心藏起的设计图稿，连夜离开了这座城镇。

Name: 独特真我·忆
Description: 无论未来会是如何，缇妮都已做好了勇敢面对的准备。她的人生不该是精美易碎的瓷器，而是生命力的激荡回响。

Name: 时尚主张·纪
Description: 她们成为了无话不谈的知心密友，少女用自己学习做面点时的经历鼓励缇妮，只要持之以恒，就会不断成长。

Name: 巧思创想·纪
Description: 出师前，缇妮为少女设计了一款围裙，上面绣制了两只开怀大笑的小熊，那是缇妮心中她们呆在一起时的样子。

Name: 独特真我·纪
Description: 少女则为缇妮做了一道独创的甜点，松软的舒芙蕾上洒着口感刺激的跳跳糖，正如同他们的友谊，温柔而热烈。

Name: 无言寒叶
Description: 终于有天，安腊忍不住质问安莱：“为什么你就是不愿肯定我？为什么你总是觉得我不能与你并肩？”

Name: 旷野淬炼
Description: 安莱看着安腊稚气未脱的脸，将她搂入怀中。“耐心些，你的路还很长。”许久的沉默后，安腊听到安莱这样说。

Name: 无言寒叶·丛森
Description: 夕阳将要沉入地平线时，安腊拖着猎物回到了部落。族人们惊讶的目光和赞叹的声音里，安腊对上了姐姐的视线。

Name: 旷野淬炼·丛森
Description: 安莱疾奔上前，不顾安腊满身的血污，带着欣慰与自豪拥抱了她。她的雏鹰终究展开了翅膀，翱翔于原野之上。

Name: 无言寒叶·天穹
Description: 老祭司语气温和地劝告安莱，原野上的雌鹰总要张开羽翼，循着本心自由翱翔，安腊终究要拥有自己的天空。

Name: 旷野淬炼·天穹
Description: 安莱沉默着，她并非不愿让安腊纵情驰骋于荒野，但失去至亲的痛苦，让她无法接受妹妹有哪怕一丝涉险的可能。

Name: Black Bunny Servant
Description: The bunny invites the girl to play hide-and-seek. She searches through bowtied bushes and around the cake-laden tree.

Name: Hop and Seek
Description: The girl catches the black bunny by a clear lake. With a shake of its ears, its bowtie wraps around her wrist.

Name: Striped Fantasy
Description: The girl looks to the water as she feels the soft bowtie. Eh!? Her eyes open wide: she just grew black bunny ears!

Name: 勇气诗篇
Description: 整个族群都因干渴奄奄一息，他是族里挑选出来的勇士，冒险翻越那座巍峨的高山，来到人类的村庄求助。

Name: 绿洲守望
Description: 他眨巴着一双亮晶晶的眼睛，感激地望着萝萝希，萝萝希这才发现，他好像是……某种奇特的仙人掌？

Name: 盈香心愿
Description: 一桶、两桶、三桶……她额头上沁出细密的汗珠，那神奇的小生灵终于在她的努力下渐渐莹润起来。

Name: 晶莹清露
Description: 小仙人掌喝饱了水，向萝萝希说明来意，他们一族生活在山的另一边，因为干旱与炎热，连山上的清泉也断流了。

Name: 澄澈甘泉
Description: 地面上的水源几乎都干涸了，村民们一时间也束手无策。萝萝希灵光一闪，提议为这群神奇的小生灵挖一口井。

Name: 馨香遥寄
Description: 听了他们的遭遇，萝萝希又担忧又着急，她捧着小仙人掌，风一般跑回村子，召集大家一起来想办法。

Name: 友谊之井
Description: 萝萝希吓了一跳，连忙蹲下仔细检查，那团绿色通体透明，小小的身体由于严重缺水，已经干瘪起皱。

Name: 芳甸新芽
Description: 急匆匆跑到井边，萝萝希小心地打上一桶清凉的井水，轻轻浇在他身上，小绿团只是抖了抖，却没有好转的迹象。

Name: Whimsical Egg Nest
Description: The girl dreams of becoming an artist. She paints spring colors onto the eggs, turning them into brilliant works of art.

Name: 五谷丰熟
Description: “大丰收！大丰收！”漫野的金色中，大喵欢呼着舞动小手，“本喵也在收获时节贡献了自己的一份力量哦！”

Name: 寒耕暑耘
Description: 乡野田间，汗水如雨，人们挥舞着锄头，播种希望，收获喜悦。每一份努力都化作土壤中茁壮成长的生命力。

Name: 凌乱书桌
Description: “菲奈，你是不是没听懂呀？”同桌温柔的声音在耳边响起，她浅浅的笑容像清爽的海风，吹散了眼前的阴霾。

Name: 课堂助手
Description: “快打起精神来，这道题要套入公式才能得出正确结果！”“等我补个妆，马上为你复述老师讲的解题步骤。”

Name: 倾倒梦境
Description: 在同桌的耐心讲解下，菲奈终于掌握了知识点。也许学会了数学，就能轻松得知鱼群的数量和海螺的体积吧？

Name: 题海漩涡
Description: 小章鱼们七嘴八舌地出谋划策，菲奈只觉得脑中一片混乱，黑板上的公式和坐标图拧成一团，变成了深海漩涡。

Name: 灵感妙解
Description: 身为蔚海之力的传承人，年幼的菲奈曾与同族在海岸边深居简出，无垠的海洋是她内心深处最眷恋的地方。

Name: 青春律动
Description: 日复一日在浪中聆听海鸟高歌，与鱼群共舞，菲奈的世界只有一片蔚蓝，她不愿任何外界的色彩侵染这份纯净。

Name: 真挚共鸣
Description: 最初，菲奈像一条刚学会在陆地行走的人鱼，难以适应校园里的一切，好在老师和同学都向她伸出了援助之手。

Name: 缤纷谐趣
Description: 浓厚的依恋并未令她得到更深的接纳，反而逐渐丧失了回应海洋的能力，年迈的族长建议她，多去体会人的温情。

Name: 未来随记
Description: 和同学们一起学习，共同成长，大家结下了深厚的友谊。菲奈明白了，世间万物，一切美好的本质或许是相同的。

Name: 心愿贴纸
Description: 晴朗午后，好奇于大海的学弟学妹推推搡搡围到了她身边。不知不觉间，菲奈也已经成为学校的风云人物了呢！

Name: Crimson Tale
Description: As Hecate chuckled and tied the dwarves' beards to trees, the legendary Strongest Witch magicked her into the air.

Name: Day-Night Concerto
Description: Hecate healed the wounded witches in silence and leaned on the dark coffin, while Violette lay there as if asleep.

Name: Darkwing Invitation
Description: Hecate was brought to Violette's castle under her watch. 'Hmph, the Strongest Witch? She just took me by surprise!'

Name: Crimson Gaze
Description: As she launched yet another ambush from behind, Violette simply shifted aside. Her magic only startled a flock of ravens.

Name: Tilted Scales
Description: For hundreds of years, the demons feared Hecate. She once obliterated an entire dark magic army in an instant.

Name: Velvet Fantasy
Description: That night, the crimson moon was summoned forth, breaking the seals of the castle. Hecate looked up vengefully.

Name: Rite of Thorns
Description: Sneaking out was crucial. But before that, she had to make Violette lose face! She unleashed trick after trick in the castle.

Name: Chaotic Pact
Description: Hecate was again suspended beside the chandelier. She noticed a special glint in Violette's eyes as she smiled.

Name: Bloodmoon Myth
Description: Hecate brought both destruction and rebirth at her will. In her laughter lay the hopes and sorrows of others.

Name: Grand Invitation
Description: The cast returns for bows. Applause surges like waves for the performance, echoing through the wild night.

Name: Illusory Stage
Description: Laughter drives the story forward. Each character wanders through their own maze, blind to fate's tightening threads.

Name: Interlude Illusion
Description: When truth surfaces and the curtain falls, the audience realizes fate has fooled them all.

Name: Masks of Illusions
Description: Old scripts feel outdated. Fiona writes a new one and builds a temporary stage for an unprecedented show.

Name: Starlight Magic
Description: On opening night, crowds arrive in waves, each taking a role: musician, knight, or wandering ghost.

Name: Fate's Opening Act
Description: All lose themselves, unsure who is performer or guest, as someone guides them to fate's whirlpool.

Name: Unfinished Enigma
Description: A ghost plays a lively tune. A maiden sings of love by her window. Carefree nobles whirl at a grand ball…

Name: Fool's Carnival
Description: Disguised in their roles, they join the tale, drawing tasks from the governor and immersing themselves in the show.

Name: Everlit Magnolia Lantern
Description: Fame and fortune ensued, yet beneath the hollow praise, she knew the score was only an extension of her mother's legacy.

Name: Ceaseless Thought
Description: She gained fame overnight. People hailed her as a pipa master as carriages crowded her gate, inviting her to perform.

Name: Teardrop of Springtime
Description: The Last Echo brought tears to all. Some heard the magnificence of nature; some heard the transience of life.

Name: Transient Fate
Description: She was too far from home to see her parents one last time. Only a courtyard of desolation remained when she returned.

Name: Melodious Legacy
Description: Silence replaced the music. She locked up her mother's studio and lived aimlessly, returning only to dust the room.

Name: Tears of Pearls
Description: Shakily, she plucked the strings to play her mother's unfinished work and recalled the past as tears rolled down.

Name: Dustbound Sorrow
Description: One night, under the clear moon, she opened her mother's cabinet and saw an unfinished score quietly lying there.

Name: Wind over Strings
Description: She played day and night, forgetting all about techniques and pouring all her feelings and memories into the music.

Name: Tinkling Streams
Description: Flowers bloomed and withered; the moon waxed and waned. She finished the score. The last note felt like a sigh, or a sob.

Name: Woeful Elegy
Description: Lingering notes wept like sorrow itself. She felt a strong urge to finish the score for her mother and bring it to a closure.

Name: Celestial Splendor
Description: Her experience through the years, her parents' unwavering love for her, and her grief all turned into notes on the strings.

Name: Purehearted Note
Description: A string of brown footprints was left on the floor. As I wiped them away, I realized they looked like latte art.'

Name: Tender Inspiration
Description: I got the idea for the backpack from a claw machine. He clung to it and stared at the toys, his tail swaying happily.'

Name: Furtastic Party
Description: Fluffy kittens were lined up in the claw machine as if in a welcoming queue. Some resembled him on a closer look.'

Name: Purrfect Delight
Description: We put in coin after coin and finally got the one we wanted. We shared a glance and laughed together.'

Name: Fresh Sprouts
Description: A spring storm breaks. Yuan hugs her basket close. Through the leaves, she glimpses a hidden little courtyard.

Name: Gatherer's Return
Description: Yuan shields her basket and dashes to the eaves. A girl opens the gate with a soft smile and invites her inside.

Name: Bamboo Brew
Description: Yuan enters to find shelves lined with dried herbs. The girl takes a handful and brews Yuan a steaming cup of tea.

Name: Rippling Blossoms
Description: The girl offers to show Yuan the little herb garden out back. Only then do they notice the rain has stopped.

Name: Gentle Elegance
Description: They chat about herbs. Yuan shares her herbal knowledge as the girl explains their growth patterns.

Name: Flourishing Foliage
Description: Fine rain wets her hair. She places the herbs into her basket and weighs her options. Maybe it's time to head back.

Name: Gentle Keepsakes
Description: Her attentive care is always present. She preserves every memory with us, treasuring them as the most precious keepsakes.

Name: Sparkling Parade
Description: Later, the lonely girl met a new friend, an adventurer. This town was only a stop on her long journey.

Name: Tidal Echo
Description: What's the real sea like?' Gilda poured her passionate and hopeful imagination into heart-warming songs.

Name: Cloudless Azure
Description: The sun shone on the piano like a bright dream. Leaping notes formed a tune. It was her best imagination of the world.

Name: Galactic Brilliance
Description: They became close friends over a few days. The adventurer told Gilda amazing stories of a world she'd never seen.

Name: Starry Serenity
Description: Gilda accepted the gift as if it were a letter from the sea. She put the conch to her ear, hearing the sea's whisper.

Name: Surging Echo
Description: Her songs were spread to a wider audience. The listeners were touched and felt the author's deep love for the sea.

Name: Misty Serenity
Description: At this moment, the sound of the tide merged with colorful fantasies. The conch glittered like a dream.

Name: Bygone Seafoam
Description: After seeing her friend off, Gilda wrote a song. Musical notes leapt like sea waves in a kaleidoscope of dreams.

Name: Sincere Serenade
Description: Before her friend flew away on another journey, she gave Gilda a gift: a white conch with an iridescent sheen.

Name: Serene Cosmos
Description: The sea was an endless blue, more vast than Gilda imagined. Waves rolled in and broke into white froth by their feet.

Name: Wandering Stars
Description: Gilda shared a smile with her friend at the seashore. The rushing waves sounded like the conch she once heard.

Name: Sleepless Mirage
Description: When she heard a witch talk about how Hecate pranked a mean goblin, the corner of her lips curved up.

Name: Dreambound Isle
Description: To appease the witches, Violette found Hecate. The child glared wide-eyed after being hit by her floating spell.

Name: Glistening Veil
Description: Hecate broke the bind in a blink and flashed behind Violette. A gust of wind, scented with rich roses, swept over her.

Name: Bloodlust Bats
Description: Proud Hecate didn't notice the cracks in Violette's illusion. The next moment, the bats confiscated her wand away.

Name: Thorned Rose Crown
Description: Her magic lost to Violette's centuries of wisdom and experience. She was brought to Violette's castle to temper her spirit.

Name: Soft Whispers of Night
Description: Her mischief remained: she turned teacups into servants and watched operas yet to premier with the crystal ball.

Name: Awakening Blossom
Description: Maybe this child will become the Strongest Witch one day. Violette smiled as she watched Hecate practice in secret.

Name: Witch's Heart
Description: When Violette passed by the garden, fences would move to block her way and a grinning face appeared in the air.

Name: Sparkling Wings
Description: Each time Violette effortlessly broke the pranking spells, Hecate would stubbornly prepare for the next attempt.

Name: Enigma of Time
Description: She gave Hecate access to her library. To her surprise, Hecate didn't focus on breaking the castle's seals.

Name: Crimson Shadow
Description: She felt a warm palm on her hand. In the flickering candlelight, she saw Hecate's glistening eyes staring at her.

Name: Oath of Centuries
Description: Violette nodded slowly but firmly as Hecate threw herself into her arms. 500 years had passed since the war.

Name: Crimson Dawn
Description: You're awake!' Violette heard a husky voice with unmasked joy and satisfaction, 'You're finally awake!'

Name: Sweetheart Signal
Description: After a simple conversation, she returns the umbrella to him and tries to say more, her cheeks flushing.

Name: Starlit Moment
Description: Wait! We...' he calls to her. As they lock eyes, their hearts beat in sync, beginning their love song.

Name: Drifting Plume
Description: She keeps chasing the secrets of color matching. Each breakthrough brings her closer to the town in her dreams.

Name: Gleaming Harmony
Description: She steadies herself on the cloud and gazes at the town. The cloud catches her wish and carries her to the border.

Name: Butterfly-Kissed Rose
Description: She peers at the statue and freezes. Its face mirrors her own. Then an elegant woman gently waves her over.

Name: Gentle Echo
Description: The crystal ball opens. The square overflows with roses, heavy with scent. They surround a fine and lovely statue.

Name: Heartfelt Tidings
Description: She loses sleep after winning Apple's Ten Elite Designers. The first sunlight finds her before dreams do.

Name: Frostblossom Hymn
Description: She unveils her masterwork. Crystal frost and bright roses dance across the dress, twinkling wondrously.

Name: Pure White Lullaby
Description: She opens her eyes, still wrapped in the dream. On her empty table lies a single rose covered in glistening frost.

Name: Crystal Isle
Description: She wakes with her heart racing. The dream town feels close, familiar, and somehow bound to her.

Name: 心跳脉冲
Description: 失温的掌心，盛大的葬礼，还有挚友陌生的眼神闪过脑海，来不及思考，奥兰多猛然前扑，想要挡住那枚暗器。

Name: 浮游阵列
Description: 硝烟的气息不知何时消失了，薰风拂过脸颊，奥兰多睁开眼，自家花园柔软的草坪和整齐的树篱出现在了视线里。

Name: 数据星漩
Description: 强光和巨响同时炸开，奥兰多感觉自己掀翻到一旁，意识因巨大的冲击而空白了一瞬，想象中的痛苦却迟迟未至。

Name: 悸动讯息
Description: 漫天的花瓣落了下来。玫红的、粉红的、粉白的，叫得出或者叫不出名字的花朵，都随风飘飘扬扬地落在了肩头。

Name: 梦境编码
Description: 奥兰多微微皱起眉。他盯着那个背光的、模糊的身影，嗓子略微发紧，尝试了两次才发出声音：“你是……”

Name: 时序索引
Description: “哈……”对方的语气里带着一丝戏谑，嗓音低低的，熟悉到有些不真实，他说，“你还是那么有趣啊。”

Name: 幻光日冕
Description: 枪口的浅粉色烟雾氤氲开来，对面的身影缓缓放下了朝天开枪的手，他身形挺拔，站姿却慵懒到有些眼熟。

Name: 机械核心
Description: 子弹穿过枪膛，旋转着击碎玻璃。血花飞溅的瞬间，他已经拉下了兜帽，快步走下天台，混入街道上的人流中。

Name: 鲸骨架构
Description: 有不知来处的风从耳畔拂过，光影变幻，我向后靠去，看着男子再次回到威尔顿的街头，漫无目的地寻找着什么。

Name: 幻彩洋流
Description: 他的脚步停下了，三米以外，一位绅士沉默地与他对峙着，一尘不染的镜片之后，是震惊又痛心的青绿色眸子。

Name: 频段校验
Description: 他调查，分析，追踪着那些过往的吉光片羽，面对妮娜的关怀，他狠心逃离，面对挚友的鲜血，他茫然若失。

Name: 溯流缓存
Description: 他，“灰影”，在那块越来越亮，越来越清晰的屏幕中徒劳地奔忙着，而我站在屏幕的另一边，注视着，回忆着。

Name: 极昼回路
Description: 一切渐渐归于黑暗，一片苍白中，我听到了一道机械的女声：“观察对象灰影，你是否确定执行此治疗程序？“

Name: 流光矢量
Description: 我本该怨恨他，我想，他夺走了我的时间与人生，将我困于这座无法逃离的囚牢之中，然而，我又有些可怜他。

Name: 着墨寄意
Description: 大功告成，小千弹了弹设计图，吹了声口哨。此时窗外阳光朗照，希望她们见面那天，天气也像现在这样好。

Name: 不羁风格
Description: 约定的时间悄然而至。站在月下游乐场入口处，小千远远望见融融晴光里，精心打扮的少女正向她招手。

Name: 潮流趋势
Description: 两人同时小跑向了对方，在少女惊喜的目光里，小千俏皮又得意地转了个圈，逗得少女捂着嘴咯咯直笑。

Name: 锦心相逢
Description: 灯影稀薄，两人依依惜别，少女学着小千的模样眨了眨眼：“下次来苹果看你，我也会让你眼前一亮！”

Name: 非凡印象
Description: 她们手牵着手玩遍了游乐场的每个项目，直至满足的疲倦感涌上心头，直至天际最后一抹紫霞融入夜色。

Name: Redolent Chronicle
Description: Camilla brushes aside the vines from the sculpture. Then it opens its eyes as the sun brings warmth to its cheeks.

Name: Evershining Gate
Description: Startled, Camilla takes a step back. The woman steadies her. 'Sorry, I didn't expect anyone to come.'

Name: Sylvan Exuberance
Description: The woman says she's been guarding the manor for years, waiting for its owner's return, but it never happened.

Name: Vernal Prelude
Description: Every day after work, Camilla comes to the gallery to talk to the woman about sculpture and revel in the art.

Name: Luxuriant Harmony
Description: She says the owner was a generous lady passionate about art who would want to help artists like Camilla.

Name: Crown of Temptation
Description: The woman's eyes light up after hearing Camilla's story. She holds her hand and leads her into the art gallery.

Name: Relics of Time
Description: The woman knows every anecdote about the art there and shares her thought-provoking opinions with her.

Name: Taboo Fruit
Description: She cleans the house as her footsteps echo through the hallway, where dust covers the gold candelabra.

Name: Fated Bestowal
Description: A piece of jewelry is enough to fund an artist's study for years. Such a pity it's all collecting dust here.

Name: Glimmer of Dreams
Description: Camilla thinks she's met a kindred spirit. One day, the woman plucks the reddest apple and passes it to Camilla.

Name: Timeborn Blossom
Description: The manor's been deserted for years, so no one would notice if anything went missing. The woman winks at her.

Name: Emerald Memory
Description: In the sweet aroma of the apple, she tells Camilla about the treasures that no one has touched in years.

Name: Everyday Briefcase
Description: Father's ordinary briefcase held endless magic: pinwheels, tangrams, and all her favorite little things!

Name: Comforting Warmth
Description: She said Father's tea was too bitter. Father smiled and handed her the cup again. This time, it was sweet honey water!

Name: Childhood Keepsake
Description: His daughter's handmade charm stayed on his keys from that day on. Though he called it heavy, he never took it off.

Name: 童趣魔法
Description: 醒来后第一时间将梦中见到的魔法棒认认真真画了下来——决定了，等放学回家，动手做只一模一样的吧！

Name: 梦愿绘图
Description: 不必担忧一时的挫折或失误，每一次修正都在校准人生的航向。无需彷徨，用坚持与信念绘制出梦想的图景吧！

Name: 理想行囊
Description: 等待多日的喜讯终于到来，将勇气和理想装入行囊，少年人怀着炽热的憧憬，向梦中的远方，向无限的可能出发。

Name: 几何法则
Description: 直尺丈量着奋斗的轨迹，三角尺构筑出梦的角度，勇敢地前进吧，让经年的努力与拼搏定位出你的理想坐标。

Name: Meadowbound Bunny
Description: The four-leaf clover chooses a fluffy bunny as the messenger of luck. Life returns to the ground where it bounces.

Name: Vernal Message
Description: The breeze carries the first letter of spring in fresh blooms. The secret meadow of four-leaf clovers awaits you.

Name: Dappled Sunshine
Description: Clovers bask in dappled sunlight filtered through the leaves. This isn't the destination, but the beginning of luck.

Name: Fortune Blessing
Description: The bunny messenger hops over amidst the grass and gently drops a four-leaf clover shimmering in a visitor's palm.

Name: True Meowsic
Description: A yellow-caped cat and his best friend pass by as the breeze carries her hum to them. 'Meowza! This is true meowsic!'

Name: Sapphire Bayside
Description: Marina was so engrossed in the music that when she realized it, the bus was already slowing to the terminal stop.

Name: Unbound Soaring
Description: Marina had to get off the bus and wait for the one home. Then she glimpsed a clear, unclouded stretch of azure sky.

Name: Chorus of Freedom
Description: It's a harbor at the edge of the city, where seagulls hover over the azure ocean. Marina slowly took in the view.

Name: Azure Moment
Description: Sea waves and birds sang a chorus of nature, finally soothing Marina's nerves after days of anxiety.

Name: Impromptu Journey
Description: Marina put on her earphones and played the unfinished song. The sound of ocean waves brought her inspiration.

Name: 即兴喵喵唱
Description: “诶？这么快就轮到我了吗？”“没错！暖暖选手，现在轮到你来演唱这首《五花肉之歌》了！好好表现喵！”

Name: 电音喵喵秀
Description: “我就说嘛，超酷炫电音版《五花肉之歌》绝对能引爆全场……等等！是谁趁机吃光了本喵的五花肉！”

Name: Perceptive Touch
Description: Daisy can sense the weakest life and capture the smallest change in plants. She tends every plant in the garden.

Name: Radiant Rebirth
Description: Her friend, a quiet marionette, has a simpler task. She strolls around and decides what to plant where.

Name: Wilting Rhymes
Description: Daisy gradually grows curious and starts to speculate. Her friend's identity doesn't seem so simple.

Name: Perceptive Touch - Decay
Description: So, she whispered to the marionette, 'I don't think you're a servant.' Seeing her surprised eyes, she smiled smugly.

Name: Radiant Rebirth - Decay
Description: The marionette blushed, her eyes wide. Instead of answering, she lowered her head and fussed over her dress.

Name: Wilting Rhymes - Decay
Description: Daisy didn't push further. Since then, they've been tending the thriving garden together with a shared secret.

Name: Fragrant Memento
Description: The look of joy flashed across her face when she saw Shalom. She explained sincerely that she was a marionette.

Name: Spotless Wonder
Description: Her grandma once told her a fairytale about a marionette who had a pure soul and was a girl's best playmate.

Name: Mellow Hope
Description: Shalom brought the marionette home. The garden basked in the moonlight and flowers danced for the guest.

Name: Fragrant Memento - Sunny
Description: She didn't notice the passing of time until the magic in her stagnated, so she decided to say goodbye to her friend.

Name: Spotless Wonder - Sunny
Description: The marionette finally found the old sea of flowers, but her friend was gone. She'd withered too, leaving only a seed.

Name: Mellow Hope - Sunny
Description: The next morning, only a photo was left on the table: the marionette and the girl in a sea of flowers under the stars.

Name: 喵语频道
Description: 她操纵着摇杆忙前忙后，接下一桩桩任务，搭建猫窝，升级猫粮，用赚来的金币不断改善小猫咪们的生活。

Name: 甜心约定
Description: 看着它们在屏幕里追逐打闹，对自己的亲密值一点点积累，每一只小猫都变得圆滚滚的，米洛洛成就感满满。

Name: 简约联结
Description: 米洛洛会对着屏幕里的小猫们小声说话，分享学校里的趣事，倾诉自己的小烦恼，岛上的猫就是她最好的伙伴。

Name: 掌中萌伴
Description: 屏幕里的猫猫会在她倾诉烦恼时凑近，呼噜噜地安慰着她，绕着她的像素小人转圈，这是现实里从未有过的放松。

Name: 电玩宅趣
Description: 周末，她会窝在房间，安安静静在猫猫岛待上一个下午，精心装点布置她的岛屿，给小猫制作各种各样的小玩具。

Name: 茸茸喵爪
Description: 猫猫岛的世界很简单，没有复杂的关卡，没有激烈的对抗，只有花色各异的小猫们，等着她喂食、梳毛、陪玩。

Name: Fruitful Sparkle
Description: You take the sweetest strawberry and leave me the biggest blueberry! Sharing doubles the happiness~

Name: Candid Expectation
Description: As the sea waves lap the shore, the girl wishes that the world thrives with life and goodness stays forever.

Name: Gleaming Feathers
Description: An elf pats her on the shoulder and the world changes: a lake glimmers under the moon in the forest shrouded in mist.

Name: Miracle Wand
Description: In a blink, she falls into a fantasy world of desserts and candy, holding a magic wand with a glittering gem.

Name: Dream's Shore
Description: The lake sparkles as an iridescent gem falls into the girl's palm. It feels warm with a wondrous power.

Name: Rosy Memories
Description: She looks down and sees her past reflected on the water: her most treasured adventures and memories.

Name: Shining Guardian
Description: Her friends smile as she casts her own magic: a melody of happiness sounds as balloons and ribbons sway in the wind.

Name: Innocent Prayer
Description: Miata realized the puppet was trapped in a weak body like hers. 'Don't worry. I'll help you!' She gently hugged her.

Name: Fingertip Healing
Description: After waking up, Miata became more positive about treatment and started learning to fix the cracks on the puppet.

Name: Everlasting Bond
Description: During her treatment and study, Miata also sang, painted for the puppet, and even sewed it a dress like her own.

Name: Sunshine Whisper
Description: Tawny is different. Like a fish returning to water, she preferred the countryside breeze to the dull city life.

Name: Poetic Aroma
Description: Her parents don't have time for her. Only the marionette who once tutored her mother is her most reliable companion.

Name: Sheltered Memory
Description: The marionette has been with her since she could remember. This tutor's greatest ability is to make her feel safe.

Name: Romantic Chords
Description: The marionette catches up soon despite her unhurried pace. Tawny turns around and throws herself into her arms.

Name: Windswept Garden
Description: Tawny doesn't know her much and wonders if she can make wilted flowers bloom again or talk to birds.

Name: Sunshine Whisper - Weave
Description: She clears her throat. 'I've got a present for you, tutor!' Tawny's heart feels ready to burst in her chest.

Name: Poetic Aroma - Weave
Description: A mannequin stands in the room with an elegant dress, adorned with flowers blooming in the countryside.

Name: Sheltered Memory - Weave
Description: I made it myself!' Tawny blushes and gazes at the tutor in anticipation, fully sincere. 'Do you like it?'

Name: Romantic Chords - Weave
Description: The marionette clearly wasn't expecting it. After a long pause, she steps forward and hugs the girl. 'Thank you, Tawny.'

Name: Windswept Garden - Weave
Description: Tawny designed, drew, and sewed each flower with care, leaving a bloom of splendor upon the dress for her tutor.

Name: 萌趣纸灵
Description: 怎样才能既保护她们对魔法的热情，又避免学生们陷入危险？奥瑞尔凝视着桌上的折纸小动物，脑海中灵光一闪。

Name: 秘咒典籍
Description: 奥瑞尔一转头的功夫，两位淘气包就能捅出新的篓子，课堂上的坩埚爆炸声和咒语失控的光束成了家常便饭。

Name: 展翼相随
Description: 童话绘本《奥瑞尔与淘气包》的主角奥瑞尔是魔法学院最受欢迎的老师之一，她的课堂总是充满了欢笑。

Name: 术法咏唱
Description: 翌日的课堂上，一只折纸小鸟落在了塞茜肩头，在彻底理解咒语原理之前，鸟儿会鸣叫着打断她的每一句咏唱。

Name: 温心护佑
Description: 蒂莉则获得了一只折纸小狗，每当她想要偷偷触碰那些危险的药剂时，小狗都会用湿漉漉的眼睛阻止她的动作。

Name: Covert Conjuring
Description: They bided their time and swarmed in when Trixie left the kingdom. Luckily, she had many allies helping her.

Name: Silent Pursuit
Description: Trixie had been in the monastery for too long. She saw the deaths of the white cat and the old nun in her memories.

Name: Urban Dive
Description: In those memories, she saw too many forgotten visions. Stories gently flowed in like a bubbling stream.

Name: Focused Listening
Description: The nun opened a hospital. Trixie had learned enough to understand how patients were invited for treatment.

Name: Misty Gloom
Description: She saw a nun who found the flute that was always playing in the attic. No one had heard the sound before Trixie did.

Name: Hushed Mystery
Description: They lay in black boxes underground that Trixie thought only the dead slept in. The good news is that they live long.

Name: Fated Capture
Description: She saw the patient wrapped in a black dress. She was so sick that she could barely walk down to the basement.

Name: Surreal Scheme
Description: She saw a magician walk in and the flute say something to him. After a power surge, he left a toy and stormed out.

Name: Reality in Haze
Description: Trixie grew tired of the servant changing every few decades. She shook her tail and gazed at the moon.

Name: Black Cat's Game
Description: A brown-haired girl picked up the toy. Wasn't it a royal possession? But the cat queen allowed it, seeing her worry.

Name: Black Cat's Prank
Description: A pink-haired girl left behind a ruby. Trixie looked closer and felt the flute sound become slower and gentler...

Name: Silver Night Plume
Description: She and her lover longed for the view beyond the sand blessed by the stars, but a sandstorm broke their dream.

Name: Lantern of Starlight
Description: The travelers' look of gratitude moved Atina. Even the light in her hand seemed to glow brighter with it.

Name: Gleaming Moonlight
Description: The storm ceased. Atina opened her eyes to an empty expanse and wailed as she helplessly searched the silent sand.

Name: Sand Sea Chimes
Description: But she never saw her lover again. One day, she met a traveler lost at night and immediately offered help.

Name: Dreamseeker's Path
Description: Atina didn't believe her lover was gone and searched the sand day and night, hoping her lover would find a way back.

Name: Night of Starlight
Description: Atina woke from her dreams in tears to a dark expanse of sand. She wiped her tears and walked into the night.

Name: Eternal Sentry
Description: Her lantern glowed brighter by the day. People would see the reassuring light from far across the dunes.

Name: 辉金之翎
Description: 灿金的翎羽满载风之祝愿缓缓落在粉发少女手心，温润的光辉闪烁不息，这份纯净的力量既是肯定，也是期许。

Name: 心途耀明
Description: 穿过森林迷雾，又潜入数据的海洋，不远千里奔赴高耸入云的神塔，灵鸟清鸣，玉匣中卷轴四溢着耀目的光晕。

Name: 时谕箴言
Description: 千风交汇于破碎的结界深处，与磅礴的守护之力一道为承袭风语者之名的少女推开时间之门，让遗憾终得圆满。

Name: 熠熠千光
Description: 旌旗飘扬，万灵喧豗，沐浴曙光的双翼预示璀璨明亮的未来，刹那的神迹注定被刻在永不风化的石板上。

Name: Lost Reminiscence
Description: Who is Roxanne? She is smart, beautiful, elegant, and kind... The girl would use every good word on Roxanne.

Name: Lavish Chronicle
Description: But unlike the other marionettes, she can come here in her mind, all thanks to the wisdom of her last owner, Roxanne!

Name: Glorious Shadow
Description: Roxanne built this perfect living room. She'd been feeling unwell then, and this room could keep away other forces.

Name: Era of Lost Glory
Description: With all her love and strength, though she's gone, the mirror can still carry her will and bring her back to old times.

Name: Elegy of Roses
Description: The last human she knew was Roxanne. Roxanne came here every day for tea and to tell her about the outside.

Name: Drifting Blossom Rain
Description: Roxanne started to miss their meetings. She'd return days later and then weeks, until the girl was the only one here.

Name: Whispered Emotion
Description: Sometimes she feels she's heard something, a song Roxanne used to play here... Is there a ball somewhere?

Name: Nightmarish Curse
Description: The girl looks down at her hands. Time doesn't leave marks on her, as if the world had forgotten about her.

Name: Aromatic Tea
Description: She prepared a pot of scented tea as usual and waited until it went cold, but Roxanne never showed up again.

Name: Visitor from the Wind
Description: Lumiel's never been interested in the lake. She isn't keen on crossing its mighty owner just for its view.

Name: Redolent Realm
Description: No elves seem to be living here. Lumiel looks down, frustrated, when a glimmering figure appears on the lake.

Name: Spotless Heartlight
Description: She only remembers this magical lake in the forest after she hurt her wings and none of the healers could help her.

Name: Echoing Expanse
Description: Will she be rejected for coming uninvited? Lumiel enters the forest and watches the moonlight shimmer on the lake.

Name: Floral Chapter
Description: The figure looks kind and quiet, but Lumiel feels nervous and explains that she just wants to visit the lake's owner.

Name: Drifting Chant
Description: Sabrina knows all about the lake and forest but only smiles when Lumiel asks how she knew the lake's owner.

Name: Spiraling Destiny
Description: Sabrina's body will break soon after she leaves the lake. She looks sad for the first time when she tells Lumiel about it.

Name: Wilted Memories
Description: The tranquil forest rustles under silver moonlight. Sabrina's gaze is as gentle as when they first met.

Name: Misty Waters
Description: As the moon shines on the lake, Lumiel holds Sabrina's hand and asks, 'I'm leaving. What can I do for you?'

Name: Turning Seasons
Description: Maybe Sabrina also wants to leave but can only stay here day after day. The world outside is but a distant dream.

Name: Drowsy Bunny
Description: Ruby lets out a sigh of relief in the pillows. Then two bunnies hop close. 'Welcome to the Adventure Forest!'

Name: Rainbow Memory
Description: Shh, don't let the moon see us!' Ruby wraps all of them up in her blanket and slips safely through the bushes.

Name: Tender Support
Description: The blanket flies Ruby to the moonlit forest. The wind gives her a playful push, and she falls into a pile of pillows.

Name: Velvet Wonder
Description: The pictures in the book suddenly come alive: as the brook babbles and leaves rustle, the blanket flies up with Ruby!

Name: Crown of Knowledge
Description: Seeing Ruby slip, the bunnies jump over and the books clatter to the ground. Ruby laughs in the scattered books.

Name: Roundy Rounds
Description: A bunny cheers. 'Thank you, clever and brave adventurer! Here, these magic glasses won't let you miss anything.'

Name: Starry Bliss
Description: Another bunny takes out a shiny brooch and shows it to Ruby. 'This is a badge of courage to remember this night!'

Name: Explorer's Light
Description: The rising sun shines on Ruby's sleeping smile as she holds the book, the torch turned off and lying quietly beside her.

Name: Adventurer's Key
Description: Ruby looks at the bunnies and then the shimmering forest before nodding firmly and striding to the mystic land.

Name: Symbol of Wisdom
Description: The bunnies are too short to reach the magic fruits atop the tree. Ruby stacks her books into steps. Problem solved!

Name: Kitten Patrol
Description: Chuyi snorts and strides atop the fence. She's on patrol by imperial order. Loiterers, keep away!

Name: Aureate Rain
Description: The Garden turns yellow again. Golden leaves rustle under her paws. How could it function without her?

Name: Gilded Vermilion
Description: Humans meow as her tail brushes over the glazed tiles. Unacceptable! She's not some cat to be teased.

Name: Ginkgo Opulence
Description: Visitors have been coming here lately, pointing weird machines at her and meowing nonstop.

Name: Noble Lineage
Description: Unlike the other well-born cats, Chuyi is very diligent. She patrols the Ginkgo Garden every day, rain or shine.

Name: Forsaken Ground
Description: Sandra searches the endless ruins for clues. The world around her is like a still painting, silent and lifeless.

Name: Barren Order
Description: On a warm afternoon, Sandra's owner brushed her hair, saying, 'Protect humans and the world, like how you protect me.'

Name: Distant Prospect
Description: Memories flow as Sandra remembers that even her name came from her most important owner who started it all.

Name: Endtime Afterglow
Description: As if freed from Pandora's box, it all flashes back to her: the promise, humans, friends... and her owner.

Name: Glittering Feathers
Description: The world of flowers unfolds like an anonymous gift from her, but she has yet to know her body is changing.

Name: Prelude of Visions
Description: Unlike other perfect 'creations', Sandra was almost recycled at first and didn't even have a consciousness.

Name: Echoing Promise
Description: Their promise guides Sandra again as she musters what little strength is left to nourish the lifeless world.

Name: Faint Heartsong
Description: Flowers bloom on the once arid ground with Sandra's care. A hope of life returns to the ravaged ruins.

Name: Lingering Vestige
Description: Sandra slowly understands and adapts to human life. She even keeps a flower on her desk like the other humans.

Name: Anchored Memory
Description: She doesn't know why humans do it, but in their history, flowers stand for life and hope. So they must be good.

Name: Radiance of Hope
Description: Without her owner's care, her power drained repeatedly. When she couldn't grow plants, she fell into dormancy.

Name: Mechanical Wing
Description: The frozen land starts to thaw as plants sprout from the soil with the hope of new life. Then, flowers begin budding.

Name: Windswept Plume
Description: Her owner insisted on keeping her. At first, Sandra often malfunctioned, which was quite a headache for her owner.

Name: Finale of Visions
Description: In the wind's whispers, Sandra hugs herself and recalls their promise, waiting for the world to rejoice again.

Name: Mechanical Dreamwing
Description: The past is so vivid in dreams, where people talk and laugh in a world so alive that she feels happy only watching it.

Name: Verdant Pinesong
Description: The little puppet said nothing, but when Yao fixed her body again, she saw tear stains on her cheek under the moon.

Name: Ephemeral Vision
Description: Wei Yao had performed in many places. If plants could become spirits, it was no surprise that a puppet could too.

Name: Operatic Verses
Description: The clothes cheered the puppet up, but her condition worsened. Her body would break even while sitting on her seat.

Name: Vivid Illusion
Description: She tried to fix the puppet, but whatever she used soon wore out, so she made clothes to cheer her up.

Name: Scent of Rosy Clouds
Description: How hard could it be to fix a puppet? Yao put the puppet in her backpack and started traveling to find a cure.

Name: Transient Delight
Description: The puppet protested, 'You're not my master! Stop it! It's impossible!' Yao tapped her wooden head. 'Quiet.'

Name: Flickering Heart
Description: They traveled through wind and snow. The puppet complained, sharp-tongued as ever, yet slowly let her in.

Name: Waving Blossoms
Description: Finally, a recluse revealed the puppet was an enchanted marionette, and the cure might lie where she was born.

Name: Dance in Harmony
Description: The marionette murmured, 'I don't really need a new body. You'll have no friends once I'm gone. I can stay.'

Name: Lingering Longing
Description: Wei Yao said nothing and refastened her falling parts. She bid farewell to her and promised they'd meet again.

Name: Lush Greenery
Description: Wei Yao entrusted a traveling merchant with the marionette, who held her finger and refused to say goodbye.

Name: Sky of Rosy Clouds
Description: After that, Wei Yao wrote a new story about a young ranger and a living puppet who adventured together.

Name: Emerging Edge
Description: Countless books fill the halls of the Garden, and the Tome Warden keeps the rats and insects at bay.

Name: Moonlit Glamor
Description: They restored peace on the border. As the crowds cheered on their return, she reached for the jade that wasn't there.

Name: Jadelit Radiance
Description: In an important battle, she was trapped in enemy ranks due to false information, and an arrow aimed at her heart.

Name: Sunken Moonlight
Description: At the last moment, a white light burst from her chest and broke the arrow. The jade at her chest crumbled into dust.

Name: Silken Crescent
Description: In her dream, armies gathered beneath a sea of fluttering banners. She stood in armor as the woman fastened her helm.

Name: Pellucid Chime
Description: The woman wished her a triumphant return and vanished. When Yongan awoke, the jade charm was aglow.

Name: Pristine Jade
Description: The jade dimmed by the day from rich green to murky gray. She worried but couldn't spare a thought amidst the war.

Name: Windborne Clouds
Description: For years, Yongan led her army across the country and always turned the tide in the end, as if protected by a higher force.

Name: Frostwoven Veil
Description: Yongan watched as the woman faded into light, like the moonlight on the night before her mother left for war.

Name: Dreambound Chimes
Description: I should go now.' The woman sighed at dawn and brushed the new empress's hair. 'Good girl, you've grown up.'

Name: Supreme Authority
Description: Alia didn't know what to do when the heavy crown settled on her head, marking the end of her carefree days.

Name: Divine Edict
Description: Alia entered her sister's study and learned to manage state affairs, finding it far harder than riding or fencing.

Name: Stairs of Coronation
Description: Even the closest sisters drift apart. To Alia, her once kind and patient sister became a graceful, distant heir.

Name: Cosmic Brilliance
Description: With the outbreak of war came news that her sister had fallen in battle. Then, Alia was made the new crown princess.

Name: Glorious Crown
Description: Alia was surprised to see simple notes written all over her sister's books, which enlightened her with just a few words.

Name: Pearly Yesterdays
Description: She remembered when she'd come here to play with her sister, who'd hold her and teach her to read every word.

Name: Effulgent Nights
Description: Since then, Alia seemed like a different person. She stopped attending lavish balls and drifted apart from her friends.

Name: Transient Mirage
Description: The past and present meet in this moment. Even time can't take away what has become a part of life.

Name: Scroll of Splendor
Description: Alia learned to discuss and issue policies and earned the people's trust. Bards wrote songs to praise her.

Name: Royal Principle
Description: Her behavior was impeccable in front of everyone. The tutor praised her, saying Alia grew more like her sister.

Name: Scarlet Paean
Description: Alia ascended the steps to the throne when she suddenly thought of her sister amidst the somber music and cheers.

Name: Majestic Grandeur
Description: Alia studied her notes over countless nights, as if following her sister's footsteps in the snow when they were young.

Name: Summoned Covenant
Description: The cats avoided humans in all conflicts, while hunters dared not enter the monastery and waited outside.

Name: Soundless Chase
Description: But her allies and hunters disappeared one by one. Trixie's memories became hazy. She felt something was off.

Name: Urban Stealth
Description: Trixie saw many young nuns and watched them grow old and then meet their end. She looked up at the moon.

Name: Roseate Splendor
Description: Except for the occasional scream in her head, the rose-filled manor with all its luxuries fascinates the girl.

Name: Monochrome Fantasy
Description: Everyone at the manor is surprised by the noble lady's changes. The harder she tried, the worse it got.

Name: Colorful Comic
Description: Between etiquette lessons, beauty training, and gossip-filled teas, she only rests when the stars are out.

Name: Mirrored Mirage
Description: The voice shrieks at first, but once she realizes it's better to offer advice, she becomes the girl's mentor.

Name: Gorgeous Perfection
Description: I'd rather go back to work!' Frustrated, she wanders around and catches the prince cheating on her.

Name: Crystalline Luster
Description: Now the girl wants to scream, too! Why is this happening at the manor? The prince sees her and strides over.

Name: Treasured Reverie
Description: The voice in her head urges her, 'Fill your eyes with tears! Pretend you're in love with him and heartbroken!'

Name: Glistening Glory
Description: Can't let him fool more girls! Right, Miss Rosalie?' After a pause, the voice replies, 'Let's expose him!'

Name: Midnight Phone Booth
Description: The light flickers, revealing bloody handprints smeared across the glass and sending a chill through passersby.

Name: Eerie Phone Booth
Description: So annoying...' Riola frowns. After another startled passerby runs away, she walks inside and answers the call.

Name: Veiled Secrets
Description: Hello? Can I help you?' Riola answers politely. But a chilling voice giggles, 'I'm a ghost, right beside you...'

Name: Shadowless Under Light
Description: Riola tentatively peeks outside. Her foot glows fluorescent green against the wet ground, yet casts no shadow.

Name: Unknown Caller
Description: Beep... Beep... The line goes dead. Riola is furious: some strange person is ruining the mood of this street!

Name: Traveler Through Time
Description: Riola looks around. 'What ghost? Never seen one in my 300 years of walking this street...'

Name: The Haunter Haunted
Description: Aaaah! You're a ghost!' A terrified scream echoes through the night, but it comes from the shadow, not Riola.

Name: Ashen Illusion
Description: When the dark engulfs the stars and moon, a giant ghostly shadow appears among the plants outside the booth.

Name: Hollow Rose
Description: Puppets can't speak or feel anything. They just follow routines, swirling and leaping with a smile day after day.

Name: Cagebound Vines
Description: Bound by strings, she taps the floor in ballet flats. The stage is a glamorous prison where cheers cage her heart.

Name: Resonant Concerto
Description: She repeats the same dance until the curtain falls. Then the puppeteer hangs her on a rack in the corner.

Name: Murky Murmur
Description: The puppeteer regularly replaces the loose joints and worn strings, but the work is no easy task for the old man.

Name: Tender Fetters
Description: As the lead dancer, she must be perfect. The old puppeteer retires, entrusting her to his apprentice.

Name: Threadborn Memory
Description: Feeling honored, the apprentice checks Olina's joints and rearranges her strings more carefully than ever.

Name: Unbound Night
Description: One night, on a whim, the apprentice loosens the strings on Olina. 'You must be tired, too. Take some rest.'

Name: Straying Vines
Description: She tears herself free from the tangled strings, pushes open the theater door, and steps into the moonlight.

Name: Echoing Zephyr
Description: As Olina breathes in the chilly air, she stands on tiptoe and leaps under the moon onto her own stage of freedom.

Name: Cheerful Colors
Description: She rushes back inside to pin her rainbow hair clip in place. Her journey wouldn't feel complete without it.

Name: Quest for Knowledge
Description: Completing her latest record, she faces the ruins. This near-disastrous journey has lit a new fire in her heart.

Name: Earth's Memory
Description: Her discovery leads the expedition to the long-lost site. The walls bear faded carvings, whispers of a forgotten age.

Name: Vibrant Moment
Description: A custom headband shows her spirit. It reminds her to embrace youth while it lasts. Run with all you have!

Name: Distant Tidesong
Description: It is a call from deep within time—a distant tide, nature's song, the sea's gentle murmur… A faraway dream.

Name: Little Carp Paopao
Description: The little carp, Paopao, has a special ability—he can blow all kinds of colorful bubbles.

Name: Leisurely Swim
Description: The fish try to steady themselves. 'The current is rushing again! Just like before! That's why he went missing…'

Name: Toward the Dragon's Gate
Description: They gather again as the water calms down. Paopao realizes that one of the fish is missing in the rushing current.

Name: Ethereal Palace
Description: We'll look for him together!' Paopao decides to look for the missing fish. 'Where was he last seen?'

Name: Glory at the Summit
Description: Paopao now realizes that some force brought him here! The shifting current suggests he may not be alone…

Name: Radiant Virtue
Description: Paopao and the others find the injured fish between two rocks. He had hit a rock, leaving a long gash in his tail.

Name: Bejeweled Elegance
Description: He decides to find his friends where the force came from. Other fish try to stop him. 'It's dangerous there…'

Name: Vast Cloudscape
Description: But Paopao is determined, fearing his friend may be hurt, so two brave fish decide to lead him there.

Name: Lofty Spirit
Description: The force turns the waters into a mess: changing currents, flying gravel, and algae blocking their sight…

Name: Wonders Within
Description: Luckily, they find him in time! Otherwise, it would have been hard to face these waters alone!

Name: Intrepid Pioneer
Description: They finally reach somewhere calmer, but the force disappears, too. Paopao wonders how to move on.

Name: Little Beauty
Description: Blub, blub, blub, bubbles drift away~ Swish, swish, swish, waters softly sway~ Rise and shine~ Let's swim and play~'

Name: Serene Drift
Description: Little Beauty lowers her eyes and hums softly. Slowly, a soft glow surrounds her, sending ripples outward.

Name: Rippling Mirage
Description: Before she knows it, her voice draws little sea creatures close. They clap to the beat and even dance.

Name: Celestial Grove
Description: You sing so well!' 'I've never heard such a beautiful voice…' 'It's gentle but powerful!' Everyone praises her.

Name: Ethereal Jewels
Description: Seeing her worried look, the fish and sea jellies eagerly offer ideas on how Little Beauty can find her friends.

Name: Snow-Kissed Blooms
Description: Little Beauty is surprised. A cat can swim in the sea, too? This world must be so different from hers!

Name: Distant Windsong
Description: Little Beauty soon realizes what makes this world different: 'Here, pure feelings are very powerful.'

Name: Sentimental Longing
Description: We can ask around.' 'Let's find the Whale! He knows everything!' 'I've got a horn. Its sound carries really far!'

Name: Ephemeral Cirrus
Description: Everyone shakes their heads except one fish, who says he saw a strange cat in a yellow cloak swimming nearby.

Name: Mange Snake
Description: Mange Snake burns with rage yet keeps his calm. 'Why do you say that? Have you ever seen a dragon?'

Name: State of Peril
Description: Mange Snake is pleased, but before he can gloat, an older fish says, 'This guest doesn't seem like a dragon.'

Name: Surging Storm
Description: Dragons haven't appeared in ages. You resemble one from a legend. Perhaps you'll become one someday.'

Name: Pursuit of Desire
Description: Mange Snake's threat sends the fish fleeing, except for the one he caught. Suddenly, a vortex appears.

Name: Glimmering Ripples
Description: Mange Snake notices that this vortex differs from the one that brought him here and senses familiar forces.

Name: Celestial Ascension
Description: Is that so?' Mange Snake lunges right up to the fish and bares his fangs. 'Tell me everything you know!'

Name: Hidden Threads of Fate
Description: Wait! I haven't even heard the legend yet!' Rolling waves carry Mange Snake out of this strange world.

Name: Echoes of Fate
Description: Using tricks to summon a demon?' Tura smiles spitefully. 'Perfect. I'll use your soul to restore my power!'

Name: Essence in Bloom
Description: Seeing her summoner, Tura falls silent. The doll can offer her nothing, with her old cotton body and patchwork.

Name: Crimson Reflection
Description: Long sleep has not restored Tura's power. She needs a strong soul now. Her summoner should've been ready.

Name: Slumbering Years
Description: Tura looks at her. One eye is glass, the other... a button?! For demon's sake! Where is the soul demons love most?

Name: Eternal Darkness
Description: Tura realizes Kelly's soul could fall apart at any moment. Even a clever demon like her is helpless to stop it.

Name: Afterlife Whispers
Description: Kelly never expected to summon a demon. She gazes sadly at the magic circle. 'It seems I got it wrong.'

Name: Darkened Judgment
Description: Tura rages, 'I'm the strongest of my kind! Are you mocking me?' Kelly hesitates, 'So you can mend a soul?'

Name: Embers of Carnage
Description: Tura's brow twitches. What does that mean? What is a demon feared on battlefields worth to this doll?

Name: Blood Moon of Void
Description: The self-proclaimed all-powerful demon hesitates. 'I-I know 30 ways to cook a soul!' Quite a feat for a demon!

Name: Deepest Wish
