Description: So this is how deals with demons work? Kelly thinks, then cautiously says, 'Please help me mend my soul.'

Name: Crimson Covenant
Description: The payment is my whole soul, if that's enough. I have nothing else to give.' The doll lowers her head.

Name: Crimson Accord
Description: What a hopeless bargain. 'Hmph. I'm very picky about souls... We'll talk once yours is repaired!'

Name: Mystic Stagecraft
Description: Eyes can be troublesome.' Materials are hard to find, so Kelly finally ends up with two eyes of different sizes.

Name: Desolate Journey
Description: Much later, Kelly draws a legendary magic circle said to summon souls. It may be her last hope of repair.

Name: Patchwork Wishes
Description: The witch mends Kelly with special thread. Finding no pale blue cloth, she makes Kelly a black-and-white dress.

Name: Luminous Hope
Description: You must mend your own soul.' Moonlight falls as the witch, now a black cat, leaps to the window.

Name: Tale of the Night
Description: After who knows how long, her fingers move, then she utters a few sounds. She then stumbles into human life.

Name: Unfallen Tears
Description: Kelly never searches for her owner. She seeks a way to mend her soul, poring over books on strange magic.

Name: Strange Companion
Description: A crimson light flares. Kelly summons Tura, a demon even more battered than herself. Their luck is truly awful.

Name: Lingering Elegy
Description: Kelly holds the doll in her arms. Someone seems to have held her this way long ago. Her soul begins to heal.

Name: Cunning Magic
Description: Dusk falls over the cottage, but for the witch, a new day has just begun. The black cat stretches and joins its friend.

Name: Refreshing Moment
Description: Blaire carries five huge beer mugs, weaving through the lively crowd with a bright smile. For her, it's a breeze.

Name: Baking Whimsy
Description: Knotted dough turns brown in the oven as coarse salt glints on top. Its crisp snap is the night's sweet prelude.

Name: Floral Elegance
Description: A food magazine reporter comes to see what the fuss is about, but Blaire's warm tavern moves her to fill a page.

Name: Tipsy Whispers
Description: Someone asks if working like this is tiring. She shakes her head: Everyone's smiles give her endless energy!

Name: Festive Cheer
Description: When a festival arrives, the streets fill with raised mugs and tempting aromas. Laughter flows freely.

Name: Old Castle Adventure
Description: Legend says a witch's castle lies in the dark forest. Kids who wander in will...' 'Does she have candy?' '...I guess.'

Name: Brilliant Autumn Leaves
Description: She places an acorn in a squirrel's paw. It swishes its tail in delight as the acorn transforms into a handful of nuts.

Name: Harvest Delight
Description: A black-feathered bird with gentle eyes perches in the treetops. She offers it jewel-like honeyed fruit.

Name: Autumn Blossom Dreams
Description: The squirrel offers her a beautiful leaf in return. She tucks it into her basket as a clear call rings through the grove.

Name: Flames of Memory
Description: People open albums and share stories of the past. Though gone, their loved ones are never forgotten.

Name: Flowers of Reunion
Description: Orange flowers glow like warm lanterns in the night, lit by love and longing to guide the departed home.

Name: Veil of Life and Death
Description: The veil between life and death separates loved ones across fate's divide, yet never hides memories.

Name: Shadowy Space
Description: Tricksters, no escape!' A lanky ghost leans out, sticking out its tongue. Now, her friend is startled too.

Name: Heart of Whimsy
Description: A little ghost peeks around the corner. Sheila pulls out her homemade candy popper, scaring it into a run.

Name: Soul of Sword
Description: Sharp sword qi covered by soft moonlight. When the soft and strong meet, a powerful relic is born.

Name: Millenary Dream
Description: Waking up from a millenary dream, the swords exude an aura of solemnity. Only the one proven worthy can wield them.

Name: Dual Swords
Description: Edges brightening as snow, tassels flowing like stars, when the dual swords combine, the world shall be shaken.

Name: Nebula Dual
Description: It's said that when the swords were drawn, rainbows will surge in the sky.

Name: Guqin Sound
Description: Melodious sound flows out from the guqin. The notes, like butterflies, hover their wings and dance in the wind.

Name: Decadant Music
Description: A thousand of guqins in a thousand people's eyes because it appears differently to different people.

Name: Stringless Sound
Description: People in Cloud believe that the most powerful guqin can be enchanting. It's called Stringless Sound.

Name: Stringless Guqin
Description: The reason it is called the Stringless Guqin is that it is played using spirit and heart.

Name: Newborn Feather
Description: I'm a lonely little feather floating in a water blue dream. When can I wake up from the dream and start a new life?

Name: Dawn Hatchling
Description: I grow up in the Tower of Zen but I also want to see the world outside. That man seems lonely. I'll go with him.

Name: Blue Messenger
Description: The man gave me to his beloved niece as a gift. Every time she gazes into the sky, I feel so close to her heart.

Name: Blue Phoenix's Letter
Description: Dear master, I've grown up. No matter how far I travel, I remember the road home and take the message back.

Name: Glory Soul
Description: Orlando carries with him many marvelous inventions. They are all Flynn's works back in Federal Military Academy.

Name: Glory Medal
Description: This badge has a built-in GPS that tracks your trace all the time, and the sapphire is actually a camera.

Name: Glory Pen
Description: This pen can function as a recorder and the ink in the holder is deadly poisonous.

Name: Glory Umbrella
Description: This umbrella consists of canopy made of bullet-proof fabric and a mini electromagnetic gun disguised as the pole.

Name: Lonely Years
Description: Years passed and I get used to loneliness. Then you broke in the quiet manor, lighting up the fire in my heart.

Name: Lonely Drink
Description: I believe in you, but the seal is collapsing, I don't know how long I can stand...

Name: Vintage Entanglement
Description: Breaking the chain, I took the first step in the world outside. I will travel alone and find you.

Name: Victory Wine
Description: May this happy reunion always stay in our hearts. Let's make the covenant once again, a bond of loyalty.

Name: Hare and March
Description: I'm March Hare, not because I'll get mad in March but I was born on a sunny afternoon in March long long ago.

Name: Hare and Secret
Description: I have a magical pocket watch which can take me to anyone's dream. Yes, I'm a hare who knows lots of secrets!

Name: Hare and Dream
Description: Although I've wandered through different dreams, I've never had one myself, what's the feeling of dreaming?

Name: Hare and Destiny
Description: You want to know what does the one you like dreamed last night? Give me a carrot, I might consider telling you!

Name: Spirit of Magic
Description: It's said that only the most innocent child can see the Illusion Elf. I see you now. Am I the most innocent one?

Name: Book of Dreams
Description: Oh magic book, can you make me a candy castle? Sweet candies, delicious chocolates, and also marshmallow bunnies!

Name: Star Moon Covenant
Description: The magic covenant has been signed when I see you. Magic mark on the souls now. We'll be together forever!

Name: Star Magic Circle
Description: The hexagram I wove with moonlight and love is shining in the dark. Where are you? Here? Or in my heart?

Name: Primal Bow
Description: Crafted by the first wood elf, its power and appearance vary among different wielders.

Name: Retribution Arrow
Description: When the young Chloris first gained the Ice Flame Bow, elegant engravings appear on the bow.

Name: Sunk Feather
Description: Chloris spent a great amount of time meditating but still cannot awaken the Ice Flame Bow. He's confused and upset.

Name: Ice Flame Bow
Description: Watered by his tears, the bow awakens and releases arrows which break time and space. There he sees Floral.

Name: Spirit of Time
Description: Nothing is longer than time, because it never ends; nothing is shorter than time, because it's always too late

Name: Childlike Magic
Description: Young Yvette always falls asleep holding her wand. She dreams that one day mum's wand will bring her to happiness.

Name: Momentary Wand
Description: Time may change the face, but not the heart and affection. Like the sun, hope will always shine upon us.

Name: Wand of Time
Description: When time flies backward, we sometimes want the magic of time relapse... But we gain strength in memory.

Name: Twin Serenade
Description: It's fated that we can not talk when we are awake, but I can feel your song through my silver tiara.

Name: Wood Elves' Ballad
Description: We elves are the guardian of the forest. As a duty, you sing the regal ballad.

Name: Century Symphony
Description: After centuries of sleep, he suddenly appears in my life. The laughter and tears are a symphony in my blood.

Name: Diamond Aria
Description: Wood elf's dormant chant once again infuses into the holy gem. It's a story of forgiving and waiting

Name: Spirit of Illusion
Description: Ever since I was conscious, I can create illusions. Power, fortune, or beauty, I can give you everything

Name: Reflection of Truth
Description: I'm just a mirror, but I'm unpredictable. I love reality, so I'll never conceal anything from you.

Name: Mirror of Illusion
Description: I'm just a mirror, people see themselves in me. I can reveal your deepest lust and delusion...

Name: Mirror of Forest
Description: I'm just a mirror. I can both reflect reality and create illusions. I named myself Eli when I was deserted.

Name: Deer's Whisper
Description: On the Mount Mango, a deer holds a flower in its mouth, with a boy listening to the sound of willows.

Name: Deer and Willow
Description: Nature gives the deer a nimble body and bright eyes. And the boy studies from the beauty of nature.

Name: Deer and Brook
Description: Beauty is never fixed and you should always follow your heart. After a talk, the deer's eyes were opened.

Name: Deer and Cliff
Description: The season may change, but flowers will bloom if there is spring in your heart. The boy never forgets this place.

Name: Cat Says · Vagrancy
Description: I'm a black cat with lapis lazuli colored eyes. Many praised the color of my eyes, but only she took me home.

Name: Cat Says · Encounter
Description: When I was abandoned, I thought I would never see that shy girl again. Until I met Mr. Mindless and Mr. Unhappy.

Name: Cat Says · Afternoon
Description: Actually Mr. Mindless is smart and Mr. Unhappy is happy. Meow, Nina smiles. I'll make fun of Mr. Mindless today.

Name: Cat Says · Time
Description: They won't stay with me in the afternoon. I know it but I just cannot help waiting on the windowsill.

Name: Snow on Begonia
Description: At the beginning of February, snow falls quietly. The little begonia sapling stands firm in the wind.

Name: Reflection of Begonia
Description: The color is washed away, leaving her pure white flowers behind. The little child was outlining begonia with ink.

Name: Lovesick Begonia
Description: Emotions stir deep in her heart. Under the begonia tree, she only thinks of the war in the North.

Name: Night Begonia
Description: It's the 23rd summer, the begonia still blooms as always, but the road home seems endless.

Name: Ivy in the Manor
Description: Full of energy, Mount Mango is a place immortals always visit. But hidden in the mist, it's secret to common people

Name: Grass Basket
Description: Time seems to forget this place. Liang Jing and the boy spent the whole summer enjoying the scenery here.

Name: Rattan Case
Description: Years later when the boy and Liang Jing meet again, both their hearts and faces are like before.

Name: Willow Casket
Description: I was lost in Mant Mango and when I returned home, the green yard there is dilapidated.

Name: Night Prelude
Description: In the midsummer night, dreamy dance shines in the girl's eyes and prelude comes out from the case.

Name: Toy March
